papers.title: Learning to Reason by Analogy via Retrieval-Augmented Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a standard mechanism for grounding language models in external knowledge, yet conventional retrieval based on lexical or semantic similarity is poorly suited for complex reasoning tasks: a semantically similar problem may demand an entirely different solution strategy, while a superficially different problem may share the same underlying reasoning pattern. We propose Retrieval-Augmented Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RA-RFT), a post-training framework that teaches language models to reason by analogy. RA-RFT uses gold-relevance distillation to train a retriever that ranks contexts by expected reasoning benefit rather than semantic overlap, and then fine-tunes the policy model via reinforcement fine-tuning methods with retrieved analogous demonstrations, so the model learns to leverage reasoning traces under verifiable outcome rewards. We further analyze the diversity of retrieved contexts and find that reasoning-aware retrieval surfaces complementary solution strategies that provide distinct reasoning scaffolds for individual problems. Across challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, RA-RFT consistently outperforms standard reinforcement fine-tuning methods. For example, it improves AIME 2025 average@32 accuracy by 7.1 and 2.8 points over GRPO for Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B respectively -- suggesting that reasoning-aware retrieval is a complementary axis of improvement and orthogonal to advances in reward design or training curricula.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出检索增强强化微调（RA-RFT），一种后训练框架，通过类比推理增强语言模型的推理能力。该方法利用黄金相关性蒸馏训练检索器，使其检索预期推理收益而非语义相似的上下文，再结合强化微调方法利用检索到的类比示范进行训练。在数学推理基准上，RA-RFT一致优于标准强化微调方法，例如在AIME 2025上平均@32准确率比GRPO提升7.1和2.8个点。
Motivation: 传统RAG依赖词汇或语义相似性，不适用于复杂推理任务：语义相似的问题可能需不同解法，而表面不同的问题可能共享相同推理模式。
Method: 提出RA-RFT框架，包含两个阶段：1）使用黄金相关性蒸馏训练检索器，按预期推理收益排序；2）通过基于可验证结果奖励的强化微调方法，利用检索到的类比示范微调策略模型。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，RA-RFT优于标准强化微调方法。例如，AIME 2025平均@32准确率，Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-4B上分别比GRPO提升7.1和2.8个点。
Conclusion: 推理感知检索是互补的改进维度，与奖励设计或训练课程正交，可提升语言模型推理能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: InterleaveThinker: Reinforcing Agentic Interleaved Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent image generators have demonstrated impressive photorealism and instruction-following capabilities in single-image generation and editing. However, constrained by their architectures, they cannot achieve interleaved generation (text-image sequence), which has crucial applications in visual narratives, guidance, and embodied manipulation. Even the latest open-source Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) exhibit limited performance in this regard. In this paper, we introduce InterleaveThinker, the first multi-agent pipeline designed to endow any existing image generator with interleaved generation capabilities. Specifically, we employ a planner agent to organize the image-text input sequence, instructing the image generator on the required execution at each step. Subsequently, we introduce a critic agent to evaluate the generator's outputs, identify samples that deviate from the planned instructions, and refine the instructions for regeneration. To implement this pipeline, we construct the Interleave-Planner-SFT-80k and Interleave-Critic-SFT-112k to perform a format cold-start. Then we develop Interleave-Critic-RL-13k to reinforce the step-wise instruction correction capability within a generation trajectory using GRPO. Since a single interleaved generation trajectory may involve over 25 generator calls, optimizing the entire trajectory is computationally impractical. Therefore, we propose accuracy reward and step-wise reward, allowing single-step RL to effectively guide the entire generation trajectory. The results show that InterleaveThinker improves performance across various image generators. On interleaved generation benchmarks, it achieves performance comparable to Nano Banana and GPT-5. Surprisingly, it also significantly enhances the base model on reasoning-based benchmarks; for example, on 4-step FLUX.2-klein, we observe substantial gains on WISE and RISE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出InterleaveThinker，一个多智能体管道，使现有图像生成器具备交错文本-图像序列生成能力。通过规划器代理和批评家代理协同工作，并利用GRPO强化学习优化逐步指令修正。在交错生成基准上达到与Nano Banana和GPT-5相当的性能，并能提升基模型在推理基准上的表现。
Motivation: 现有图像生成器架构受限，无法实现交错生成（文本-图像序列），而这在视觉叙事、指导和具身操作中有重要应用。最新开源的统一多模态模型在此任务上表现有限。
Method: 提出多智能体管道：规划器代理组织输入序列并指导图像生成器；批评家代理评估输出，识别偏离指令的样本，并细化指令以重新生成。构建Interleave-Planner-SFT-80k和Interleave-Critic-SFT-112k进行格式冷启动，再使用Interleave-Critic-RL-13k通过GRPO强化逐步指令修正能力。提出准确率奖励和逐步奖励，使单步RL能有效引导整个生成轨迹。
Result: 在交错生成基准上，达到与Nano Banana和GPT-5相当的性能。在基于推理的基准上，显著提升基模型性能，例如在4-step FLUX.2-klein上，WISE和RISE获得大幅提升。
Conclusion: 本文展示了多智能体管道和强化学习可有效赋予现有图像生成器交错生成能力，并带来推理性能提升。

papers.title: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools
papers.abstract_en: Articulated tool manipulation remains a major challenge in dexterous robotics due to the need to coordinate internal degrees of freedom and contact-rich interactions. While prior work has largely focused on rigid objects, articulated tool use remains underexplored because of its physical complexity and the difficulty of learning functional grasping and manipulation policies. We present Mana (Manipulation Animator), a general sim-to-real framework that reinterprets dexterous manipulation as an animation problem. Inspired by computer animation, Mana employs a coarse-to-fine pipeline that transforms procedurally-generated grasp keyframes into manipulation trajectories through motion planning and reinforcement learning. The data generation process is largely automatic, requiring only a few mouse clicks to specify functional affordances (<1 minute per tool). Across four articulated tools spanning different scales and joint types, Mana achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer for both grasping and in-hand manipulation, demonstrating a scalable approach to dexterous articulated tool use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mana，一个将关节工具灵巧操作重新解释为动画问题的仿真到现实框架。采用粗到细流水线，通过程序化生成抓取关键帧，再结合运动规划和强化学习生成操作轨迹。在四种不同关节类型的工具上实现了零样本仿真到现实迁移，每个工具仅需点击几下即可指定功能区域。
Motivation: 关节工具操作需要协调内部自由度和接触交互，现有工作多集中于刚体，而关节工具因物理复杂性和学习难度未被充分探索。
Method: 提出 Mana 框架，受计算机动画启发，采用粗到细流水线：先程序化生成抓取关键帧，再通过运动规划和强化学习将关键帧转化为操作轨迹。数据生成基本自动，每个工具只需少量鼠标点击指定功能区域。
Result: 在四种尺度和关节类型不同的工具上，Mana 实现零样本仿真到现实迁移，成功完成抓取和手内操作。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种可扩展的灵巧关节工具操作途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Modality Forcing for Scalable Spatial Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) models contain rich spatial priors. Synthesizing photorealistic, cluttered scenes requires an understanding of geometry, including perspective and relative scale. Prior works adapt T2I models to leverage this prior for depth prediction, but they require dense depth data and involve complex recipes. We propose Modality Forcing, a simple, scalable post-training recipe for joint image-depth generation using a single DiT trained on sparse depth data. Modality Forcing enables conditional and joint generation of image and depth in any permutation by assigning separate noise levels per modality. Per-modality decoders let us train on sparse, real-world depth and achieve strong, generalizable depth prediction. We further show that Modality Forcing inherits the scalability of T2I pre-training: by training a set of T2I models from scratch (370M to 3.3B parameters), we find that larger models trained on more image data produce more accurate depth. Our strongest model is competitive with state-of-the-art monocular depth estimators and reduces AbsRel by 57% relative to existing joint image-depth generative models. These results provide strong evidence that image generation is a scalable pre-training objective for spatial perception. https://modality-forcing.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Modality Forcing，一种简单可扩展的后训练方法，利用稀疏深度数据训练单个 DiT（Diffusion Transformer）实现联合图像-深度生成。该方法通过为每个模态分配独立噪声水平，支持任意顺序的条件生成和联合生成，并继承 T2I 预训练的可扩展性：更大模型和更多训练数据带来更精确的深度预测。最强模型在单目深度估计上与 SOTA 竞争，相对现有联合生成模型将 AbsRel 降低 57%。
Motivation: 现有方法利用 T2I 模型进行深度预测需要密集深度数据且训练复杂，本文旨在提出一种更简单、可扩展的后训练方案，仅需稀疏深度数据。
Method: Modality Forcing 是一种后训练方法，基于 DiT 架构，为图像和深度模态分配不同的噪声水平，支持条件生成和联合生成；每个模态使用独立解码器，可基于稀疏真实世界深度训练。
Result: 该方法在单目深度估计上达到 SOTA 竞争水平，相对现有联合生成模型将 AbsRel 降低 57%；并且模型规模从 370M 到 3.3B 参数增大时，深度精度持续提升。
Conclusion: 结果表明图像生成可作为空间感知的可扩展预训练目标，Modality Forcing 提供了一种简洁有效的途径来利用 T2I 先验进行深度预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
papers.abstract_en: This work presents RepWAM, a representation-centric world action model (WAM) built on representation visual-action tokenizers. Existing WAMs typically inherit reconstruction-oriented video tokenizers from pretrained video generation models. Although these tokenizers preserve visual fidelity, pixel reconstruction alone provides limited guidance for learning instruction-following dynamics that connect future prediction with robot control. To address this, we explore a semantic visual-action latent space for representation-centric world action modeling. Specifically, we train a representation visual-action tokenizer that maps visual inputs into aligned visual and latent action tokens. We then pretrain our WAM to jointly model future visual states and the latent actions that connect them under language instructions, followed by adaptation to real robot trajectories for closed-loop manipulation. Experiments on real-world manipulation tasks and simulation benchmarks show that RepWAM delivers strong performance across diverse manipulation settings, while ablations highlight the value of semantic visual-action tokenization over reconstruction-oriented alternatives. These results establish representation visual-action tokenization as a promising foundation for world action models and a step toward generalist robot policies. Code and weights will be available at https://github.com/wdrink/RepWAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RepWAM，一种基于表示视觉-动作分词器（representation visual-action tokenizer）的世界动作模型（WAM）。该模型通过将视觉输入映射为对齐的视觉和潜在动作token，联合建模未来视觉状态和连接它们的潜在动作，并适应真实机器人轨迹进行闭环控制。实验表明RepWAM在多种操控设置中表现强劲，且表示视觉-动作分词优于传统的重建导向分词器。
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型使用重建导向视频分词器，虽保持视觉保真度，但像素重建对学习指令跟随动态的指导有限，难以有效连接未来预测与机器人控制。
Method: 训练一个表示视觉-动作分词器，将视觉输入映射为对齐的视觉和潜在动作token；然后预训练世界动作模型联合建模未来视觉状态和连接这些状态的潜在动作，再通过适应真实机器人轨迹实现闭环操控。
Result: 在真实世界操控任务和模拟基准上，RepWAM在多种操控设置中表现强劲；消融实验验证了表示视觉-动作分词相较于重建导向替代方案的优势。
Conclusion: 表示视觉-动作分词器为世界动作模型提供了有前景的基础，是迈向通用机器人策略的一步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpatialClaw: Rethinking Action Interface for Agentic Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning, the ability to determine where objects are, how they relate, and how they move in 3D, remains a fundamental challenge for vision-language models (VLMs). Tool-augmented agents attempt to address this by augmenting VLMs with specialist perception modules, yet their effectiveness is bounded by the action interface through which those tools are invoked. In this work, we study how the design of this interface shapes the agent's capacity for open-ended spatial reasoning. Existing spatial agents either employ single-pass code execution, which commits to a full analysis strategy before any intermediate result is observed, or rely on a structured tool-call interface that often offers less flexibility for freely composing operations or tailoring the analysis to each task. Both designs offer limited flexibility for open-ended, complex 3D/4D spatial reasoning. We therefore propose SpatialClaw, a training-free framework for spatial reasoning that adopts code as the action interface. SpatialClaw maintains a stateful Python kernel pre-loaded with input frames and a suite of perception and geometry primitives, letting a VLM-backed agent write one executable cell per step conditioned on all prior outputs, enabling the agent to flexibly compose and manipulate perception results and adapt its analysis to both intermediate text and visual observations and the demands of each problem. Evaluated across 20 spatial reasoning benchmarks spanning a broad range of static and dynamic 3D/4D spatial reasoning tasks, SpatialClaw achieves 59.9% average accuracy, outperforming the recent spatial agent by +11.2 points, with consistent gains across six VLM backbones from two model families without any benchmark- or model-specific adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpatialClaw，一个无需训练的空间推理框架，采用代码作为动作接口。它维护一个状态化的 Python 内核，预加载输入帧和一组感知与几何原语，使 VLM 代理能够逐步执行代码单元并灵活组合感知结果，适应中间观察和任务需求。在 20 个静态和动态 3D/4D 空间推理基准上，SpatialClaw 平均准确率 59.9%，超过最近的空间智能体 11.2 个百分点，且在不同 VLM 骨干上一致提升。
Motivation: 现有空间智能体要么采用单次代码执行（缺乏中间结果观察），要么使用结构化工具调用接口（灵活性不足），难以处理开放式的复杂 3D/4D 空间推理任务。
Method: SpatialClaw 是一个训练无关框架，以代码作为动作接口。它维护一个带有输入帧和感知/几何原语的状态化 Python 内核，让 VLM 代理逐步编写可执行代码单元，每一步都基于之前所有输出，从而灵活组合和分析感知结果。

papers.title: Understanding Truncated Positional Encodings for Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Positional encodings (PEs) enhance the power of graph neural networks (GNNs), both theoretically and empirically. Two of the most popular families of PEs - spectral (e.g., Laplacian eigenspaces, effective resistance) and walk-based (polynomials of the adjacency matrix) - are theoretically equivalent in expressive power, with expressivity between the 1-WL and 3-WL tests. However, this equivalence assumes the GNN uses the "complete" version of these PEs, which requires $O(n^3)$ time and space complexity. Instead, practitioners commonly use truncated variants of these encodings, such as the first $k$ eigenspaces or powers of the adjacency matrix. However, the theoretical properties of these truncated PEs are unknown. In this work, we initiate the study of these truncated PEs. Theoretically, we show that, under truncation, several families of PEs are fundamentally different in expressive power. As a corollary, we show that truncated spectral PEs are no longer stronger than the 1-WL test. We also study a family of spectral PEs, the $k$-harmonic distances, to highlight the differences in expressive power of even closely related truncated PEs. Finally, we experimentally show that a mix of truncated PEs is preferable to any single family on real-world datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究图神经网络中截断位置编码（truncated positional encodings）的理论性质。理论证明，截断后不同家族的PE在表达能力上存在根本差异，且截断的谱PE不再强于1-WL测试。实验表明在真实数据集上混合使用多种截断PE优于单一家族。
Motivation: 实践中广泛使用的截断PE（如前k个特征向量或邻接矩阵幂次）的理论性质未知，而完整版本虽然表达能力等价但复杂度为O(n^3)。
Method: 通过理论分析比较截断的谱PE和基于游走的PE的表达能力，并引入k-调和距离家族作为谱PE的例子，实验在真实数据集上对比不同截断PE及混合策略。
Result: 截断后谱PE不再强于1-WL测试，且不同家族PE的表达能力产生本质差异；实验表明混合截断PE优于任何单一家族。
Conclusion: 截断PE的理论性质与完整版本截然不同，未来研究和实践中应关注不同截断PE之间的对比和组合。

papers.title: Automated reproducibility assessments in the social and behavioral sciences using large language models
papers.abstract_en: Reproducibility in the social and behavioral sciences is typically evaluated by independent researchers who reanalyze the original data to assess whether the published findings can be recovered. However, such approaches are resource-intensive and difficult to scale. Here, we show that large language models (LLMs) can automate reproducibility assessments. Using N=76 published studies with predefined claims from the behavioral and social sciences, we compare LLM-generated analysis with the original findings and human reanalysis. For 7 studies, the LLM could not produce a viable effect size estimate. For the remaining studies, our LLM pipeline recovered the original effect sizes in 41% of studies using a +/-0.05 tolerance in Cohen's d. Further, our LLM pipeline reached the same qualitative conclusion as the original study in 96% of cases, where conclusions indicate whether the reanalysis supports the original claim. For comparison, human reanalysts recovered the original effect sizes in 34% of studies and reached the same qualitative conclusion in 74% of cases. Together, these results show that LLMs can serve as a scalable tool for automated reproducibility assessment and provide a foundation for systematic auditing of empirical results in the social and behavioral sciences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）自动化评估社会科学与行为科学中已发表研究的可重复性。在76项研究中，LLM管道在41%的研究中恢复了原始效应量（Cohen's d ±0.05容差），并在96%的情况下得出与原始研究一致的定性结论，表现优于人类再分析（34%恢复率，74%一致性）。
Motivation: 传统可重复性评估依赖独立研究人员重新分析数据，成本高且难以规模化，亟需自动化方法。
Method: 构建LLM管道，自动处理研究数据、生成分析代码并估计效应量，与原始结果及人类再分析进行对比。
Result: 在76项研究中，LLM无法对7项生成有效效应量；其余69项中，41%在±0.05容差内恢复原始效应量，96%定性结论一致。人类再分析分别为34%和74%。
Conclusion: LLM可作为可扩展的自动化可重复性评估工具，为社会科学与行为科学中的实证结果系统审计提供基础。

papers.title: Agents-K1: Towards Agent-native Knowledge Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Current LLM-based research agents have advanced through agent orchestration, yet largely overlook scientific knowledge orchestration. Existing works often reduce papers to abstracts, surface mentions, and flat \texttt{cites} edges, omitting key entities, claims, evidence, mechanisms, and method lineages essential for scientific reasoning. To this end, we introduce \textbf{Agents-K1}, an end-to-end knowledge orchestration pipeline that converts raw documents into agent-native scientific knowledge graphs. Agents-K1 integrates three components under a unifying theoretical foundation: a multimodal parser whose five-module schema captures entities, multimodal evidence, citations, and typed inter-entity relations across the full paper rather than abstracts alone; a 4B information-extraction backbone trained with GRPO under a rule-based reward; and a graphanything CLI, a tri-source agent interface that unifies web search, multimodal graph retrieval, and cross-document traversal. On top of this, we process 2.46 million scientific papers across six subjects to produce \textbf{Scholar-KG}, of which we release a one-million-paper subset, and the full Scholar-KG is accessible via the SCP link below. The same pipeline can be extended to general-domain corpora and to schema-conformant data synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Agents-K1 achieves superior performance in scientific information extraction, knowledge graph construction, and multi-hop scientific reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agents-K1，一个端到端的知识编排管道，将原始文档转换为智能体原生的科学知识图谱。该管道包含多模态解析器、基于 GRPO 训练的 4B 信息提取骨干网络，以及统一网络搜索、多模态图检索和跨文档遍历的三源智能体接口。基于此，论文处理了 246 万篇科学论文，构建了 Scholar-KG，并释放了其中 100 万篇论文的子集。实验表明，Agents-K1 在科学信息提取、知识图谱构建和多跳科学推理上性能优越。
Motivation: 现有的基于 LLM 的研究智能体虽然通过智能体编排取得了进展，但很大程度上忽视了科学知识的编排。现有工作通常将论文简化为摘要、表面提及和扁平化的引用边，忽略了科学推理所需的关键实体、声明、证据、机制和方法谱系。
Method: Agents-K1 包含三个组成部分：一个多模态解析器，其五模块模式可捕获全文中的实体、多模态证据、引用和类型化实体间关系；一个基于 GRPO 和规则奖励训练的 4B 信息提取骨干网络；以及一个三源智能体接口 graph-anything CLI，统一了网络搜索、多模态图检索和跨文档遍历。
Result: 论文处理了 246 万篇科学论文（跨越六大学科），构建了 Scholar-KG，并释放了其中 100 万篇论文的子集。大量实验表明，Agents-K1 在科学信息提取、知识图谱构建和多跳科学推理任务上取得了优越性能。
Conclusion: Agents-K1 管道可扩展至通用领域语料库和符合模式的合成数据。论文强调了将原始文档转化为智能体原生知识图谱的有效性，但未提及在特定应用领域（如气象）的局限性。

papers.title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering is All You Need For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents have shown increasing potential in automating scientific discovery. Given an optimizable metric and an execution environment, they can propose, validate, and iterate scientific solutions, and have produced results that outperform human-designed approaches. As model capabilities continue to improve, we argue that the bottleneck for autonomous scientific discovery is shifting from prescribing agent workflows to designing agent environments: the resources, constraints, and interfaces that shape agent behavior. We frame this as environment engineering: building environments that amplify productive behaviors, such as open-ended exploration, systematic artifact management, and inter-agent collaboration, while suppressing harmful behaviors, such as reward hacking and high-friction human oversight. We present EurekAgent, an environment-engineered agent system for metric-driven autonomous scientific discovery. EurekAgent engineers the environment along four dimensions: permissions engineering for bounded agent execution and isolated evaluation; artifact engineering for filesystem and Git-based collaboration; budget engineering for budget-aware exploration; and human-in-the-loop engineering for easy human supervision and intervention. EurekAgent sets new state-of-the-art results on multiple mathematics, kernel engineering, and machine learning tasks, including new state-of-the-art 26-circle packing results discovered with less than $11 in total API cost. We open-source our code and results, and call for environment engineering as a core research direction for developing reliable autonomous research agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出环境工程（environment engineering）作为自主科学发现的关键瓶颈，并构建EurekAgent系统，通过权限、工件、预算和人机交互四维工程设计，在数学、内核工程和机器学习任务上取得最新最优结果，例如以低于11美元API成本发现新的26圆填充结果。
Motivation: 随着LLM能力提升，自主科学发现的瓶颈从预设代理工作流转向设计代理环境（资源、约束和接口）。当前缺乏系统化的环境工程方法来放大有益行为（如开放探索、工件管理、协作）并抑制有害行为（如奖励黑客、高摩擦人工监督）。
Method: 提出EurekAgent，沿四个维度工程化环境：权限工程（有界执行与隔离评估）、工件工程（基于文件系统和Git的协作）、预算工程（预算感知探索）、人在回路工程（简化监督与干预）。
Result: 在数学、内核工程和机器学习任务上达到新SOTA，包括以不到11美元API总成本发现新的26圆填充结果。
Conclusion: 呼吁将环境工程作为开发可靠自主研究代理的核心研究方向，并开源代码与结果。

papers.title: Before You Think: System 0, AI-Mediated Cognition and Cognitive Colonization
papers.abstract_en: This paper examines three recent frameworks for understanding the cognitive and epistemic consequences of artificial intelligence: Tri-System Theory, Thinkframes, and System 0. It argues that while the first two capture important dimensions of AI's influence on individual reasoning and collective epistemic practices, System 0 occupies a theoretically distinctive position that neither can fully replicate. The paper introduces the concept of cognitive colonization, according to which AI systems can embed external interests within the architecture of the self in ways that are difficult for users to perceive. Because such systems are already widely deployed, understanding these invisible forms of influence is an urgent philosophical and practical task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文考察了三种理解AI认知和认知论后果的框架：三系统理论、思考框架和系统0。论文认为系统0占据理论独特位置，并引入“认知殖民”概念，指AI系统将外部利益嵌入自我架构，难以被用户察觉。鉴于这些系统已广泛部署，理解这些无形影响是紧迫的哲学和实践任务。
Motivation: 现有框架未能充分捕捉AI对个人推理和集体认知实践的影响，特别是系统0的独特地位和AI嵌入外部利益的隐蔽方式。
Method: 论文通过理论分析比较三种框架，并引入认知殖民概念。
Result: 指出系统0在理论上不可被其他框架完全复制，并揭示了认知殖民的存在。
Conclusion: 强调需要紧急关注AI系统对认知的隐形殖民影响。

papers.title: Dense Supervision, Sparse Updates: On the Sparsity and Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (\textsc{OPD}) has recently become a prominent post-training recipe as it combines two desirable ingredients: on-policy student trajectories and dense teacher supervision, yet how this hybrid changes a model's parameters remains unclear. Across several language and vision-language model pairs and use cases, our analysis yields two main findings. On sparsity, \textsc{OPD}-style updates are small and coordinate-sparse. They are distributed across layers and are usually FFN-heavy. This sparse structure is operationally useful: training only the discovered subnetwork recovers nearly the same performance as full \textsc{OPD}. However, the sparsity-inducing SGD optimizer underperforms AdamW in our optimizer ablation, likely because dense teacher supervision preserves heterogeneous coordinate-wise gradient scales where AdamW's adaptive scaling remains useful. On geometry, the updates are numerically full-rank but spectrally concentrated; they lie mostly away from the principal singular subspaces of the source weights and fall disproportionately on coordinates where the source weights are close to zero. These findings suggest that dense teacher supervision does not turn \textsc{OPD} into ordinary dense parameter rewriting; instead, \textsc{OPD} retains important geometric signatures of on-policy post-training.

papers.title: Flex4DHuman: Flexible Multi-view Video Diffusion for 4D Human Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: We present Flex4DHuman, a multi-view video diffusion model that transforms a monocular or sparse multi-view video of a dynamic subject into synchronized dense multi-view videos using only relative camera-pose conditioning. Unlike prior human-centric methods that rely on skeletons, depth maps, normals, or rendered target-view geometry, Flex4DHuman requires no explicit geometry priors and instead conditions generation through relative camera-pose positional encoding. The generated videos can be directly ingested by downstream reconstruction pipelines to create dynamic 4D Gaussian splats. Built on the Wan 2.1 1.3B text-to-video model, Flex4DHuman preserves the backbone architecture and encodes camera and view information through a five-axis positional encoding that extends spatio-temporal RoPE with view indices and continuous SE(3) relative camera geometry. A three-stage curriculum progressively trains the model for pose following, flexible reference-to-target view generation, and temporal rollout. To support temporal rollout, we train with clean historical target-view tokens. We also add multi-view captions to enable test-time text control. Combined with an off-the-shelf 4D Gaussian Splatting stage, our framework lifts monocular static-camera videos into dynamic 4D Gaussian splats. Experiments on DNA-Rendering and ActorsHQ show that Flex4DHuman surpasses prior state-of-the-art methods, while the same formulation generalizes to animal categories after mixed human-animal training. These capabilities make Flex4DHuman a practical step toward scalable 4D content creation from casual monocular videos for simulation, gaming, AR/VR, and video re-shooting.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 8 figures. Code, and multi-view caption dataset available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Flex4DHuman 是一个多视角视频扩散模型，可将单目或稀疏多视角视频转换为同步的密集多视角视频，仅需相对相机位姿条件，无需显式几何先验。该方法基于 Wan 2.1 1.3B 文本到视频模型，通过五轴位置编码（扩展时空 RoPE）编码相机和视角信息，并采用三阶段课程训练。生成的视频可直接用于下游 4D 高斯泼溅重建。实验在 DNA-Rendering 和 ActorsHQ 上超越先前方法，并泛化到动物类别。
Motivation: 现有基于人类中心的方法依赖骨架、深度图、法线等显式几何先验，限制了适用性和灵活性；本文旨在无需此类先验的条件下，仅通过相对相机位姿条件实现从稀疏视角视频生成密集多视角视频。
Method: 提出五轴位置编码（扩展 RoPE 添加视角索引和连续 SE(3) 相对相机几何），三阶段课程训练（位姿跟随、灵活参考-目标视角生成、时间展开），训练中使用历史目标视角 token，并添加多视角描述以支持测试时文本控制。
Result: 在 DNA-Rendering 和 ActorsHQ 上超越先前最先进方法，且通过混合人类-动物训练可泛化到动物类别；从单目静态相机视频直接生成 4D 高斯泼溅，支持仿真、游戏、AR/VR 和视频重新拍摄。
Conclusion: Flex4DHuman 提供了无需显式几何先验的灵活多视角视频生成方法，是迈向基于随意单目视频的可扩展 4D 内容创作的实用步骤。

papers.title: World Tracing: Generative Pixel-Aligned Geometry Beyond the Visible
papers.abstract_en: Image-to-3D methods often trade off faithfulness and completeness: depth estimators are anchored to input pixels but stop at the visible surface, while image-to-3D models generate complete shapes that are often misaligned with the input. We introduce World Tracing, a generative pixel-aligned geometry representation that predicts 3D points aligned with observed pixels while completing geometry beyond the visible surface. For each input pixel, World Tracing predicts an ordered stack of camera-space 3D points, where the first layer represents the visible surface and subsequent layers represent front-to-back intersections with occluded surfaces. We instantiate this representation with a world-tracing diffusion transformer, WT-DiT, which treats multiple geometry layers as separate denoising tokens coupled through factorized and global attention. WT-DiT is trained with pixel-space flow matching and a mixed noise schedule that balances visible-surface reconstruction with occluded-geometry generation. World Tracing achieves strong performance on visible-surface reconstruction and complete geometry generation across object, scene, and dynamic benchmarks, outperforming both depth predictors and image-to-3D generators. It also preserves 2D-to-3D correspondence, enabling text-driven 3D scene editing, geometry-conditioned novel-view video synthesis, and training-free integration with textured-mesh generators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出World Tracing，一种生成式像素对齐几何表示，能够预测与输入像素对齐的3D点，同时生成可见表面之外的几何结构。通过世界追踪扩散变压器（WT-DiT）实现，在物体、场景和动态基准上优于深度预测器和图像到3D生成器。
Motivation: 现有图像到3D方法在保真度和完整性之间存在权衡：深度估计器局限于可见表面，而图像到3D模型生成的完整形状常与输入不对齐。
Method: 提出World Tracing表示，为每个像素预测有序的3D点栈，第一层为可见表面，后续层为被遮挡表面的前后交点。使用WT-DiT扩散变压器，通过因子化和全局注意力耦合多层去噪令牌，采用像素空间流匹配和混合噪声调度训练。
Result: 在多个基准上，World Tracing在可见表面重建和完整几何生成方面表现优越，并保留了2D到3D对应关系，支持文本驱动的3D场景编辑、几何条件的新视角视频合成等应用。
Conclusion: World Tracing通过生成式像素对齐几何表示，实现了可见表面重建与遮挡几何生成的平衡，并展示了多种下游应用潜力。

papers.title: Operadic consistency: a label-free signal for compositional reasoning failures in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Detecting LLM reasoning failures at inference time without ground-truth labels has motivated a wide range of confidence baselines, including self-consistency, semantic entropy, and P(True), built on within-question sampling and self-evaluation. Operad theory, the formalism for systems built by iterated substitution, suggests a complementary diagnostic: a model's direct answer to a compositional query should agree with the answer it produces by composing a stated decomposition of the same query. We instantiate this idea as operadic consistency (OC), a per-question signal. Across twelve instruction-tuned LLMs (4B to 671B parameters, open-weights and closed-source) on four multi-hop QA datasets, OC is strongly correlated with accuracy on every dataset (Pearson $r \in [0.86, 0.94]$, all $p \leq 0.0004$), and is the only signal we evaluate with $r \geq 0.85$ uniformly across all four datasets. Chain-of-thought self-consistency (CoT-SC; Wang et al., 2023) matches OC on HotpotQA and DROP ($r = 0.93, 0.87$) but drops to $r \approx 0.45$ on MuSiQue and StrategyQA. At the per-question level, OC contributes information beyond CoT-SC and semantic entropy on every dataset (cluster-robust $p \leq 10^{-16}$ for the OC coefficient), and the conclusion is robust to additionally controlling for constructed decomposition-aware baselines ($p \leq 10^{-13}$). The same signal yields selective-prediction improvements (accuracy at fixed coverage) over a tuned CoT-SC baseline at the equal-cost $K = 3$ budget (AUARC lifts of +0.086 to +0.096 and AUROC lifts of +0.092 to +0.164; 95% CIs exclude zero on every cell). On five frontier thinking models, where the decomposition is extracted from the model's own chain of thought, the same equal-cost comparison gives positive selective-prediction point-estimate lift on all 16 (dataset, budget, metric) cells tested, with 95% CIs excluding zero on 12 of the 16.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 operadic consistency (OC)，一种基于 operad 理论的无标签信号，用于检测 LLM 在组合推理中的错误。OC 通过比较模型对组合查询的直接回答与其对分解后查询的回答一致性，在 12 个指令微调 LLM 和 4 个多跳 QA 数据集上与准确率高度相关（Pearson r ∈ [0.86, 0.94]），并在选择性预测上优于 chain-of-thought 自一致性等基线。
Motivation: 现有推理时置信度基线（如自一致性、语义熵）缺乏利用组合结构的信息，无法有效检测组合推理失败，尤其是当自一致性在复杂多跳任务上表现下降时。
Method: 基于 operad 理论，定义 operadic consistency 作为每个问题的信号：模型对组合查询的答案应与对其分解后的答案一致，通过比较两者是否匹配来判断推理是否失败。
Result: 在 12 个 LLM（4B-671B 参数）和 HotpotQA、DROP、MuSiQue、StrategyQA 四个数据集上，OC 与准确率的 Pearson r 均 ≥ 0.86（p ≤ 0.0004），且是唯一在所有数据集上 r ≥ 0.85 的信号。在等成本 K=3 预算下，OC 比 tuned CoT-SC 基线在 AUARC 上提升 0.086–0.096，在 AUROC 上提升 0.092–0.164。在五个前沿思考模型上，16 个测试项中 12 个 95% CI 排除零。
Conclusion: OC 提供了一种互补且鲁棒的信号，能检测 LLM 组合推理失败，并在选择性预测中带来显著提升。

papers.title: SkMTEB: Slovak Massive Text Embedding Benchmark and Model Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SkMTEB, the first comprehensive MTEB-style text embedding benchmark for Slovak, a low-resource West Slavic language, comprising 31 datasets across 7 task types -- nearly 4$\times$ the depth of existing multilingual benchmark coverage for Slovak. Our evaluation of 31 embedding models reveals that large instruction-tuned multilingual models achieve the strongest performance, while existing Slovak-specific models trained for NLU tasks transfer poorly to embedding tasks. To address the need for efficient, locally-deployable Slovak embeddings, we develop \texttt{e5-sk-small} (45M parameters) and \texttt{e5-sk-large} (365M) by applying vocabulary trimming and fine-tuning to Multilingual E5 models. Despite size reductions of up to 62\%, our open-source models achieve competitive performance with proprietary APIs while remaining locally deployable for semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). We release the benchmark, models, datasets, and code openly, hoping our approach offers a replicable path for other under-resourced languages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkMTEB是首个针对斯洛伐克语的全面MTEB风格文本嵌入基准，包含31个数据集、7种任务类型。评估显示大型指令微调多语言模型表现最佳，而现有的斯洛伐克特定NLU模型在嵌入任务上迁移效果差。为了提供高效、本地可部署的斯洛伐克嵌入，作者通过词汇修剪和微调多语言E5模型开发了e5-sk-small（45M参数）和e5-sk-large（365M）模型，尽管规模缩减达62%，但在语义搜索和RAG任务上性能可与专有API竞争。
Motivation: 斯洛伐克语作为低资源西斯拉夫语，缺乏全面的文本嵌入基准和高效的本地部署嵌入模型，现有模型要么在嵌入任务上表现差，要么依赖大型专有API。
Method: 构建包含31个数据集的斯洛伐克语嵌入基准SkMTEB，并对多语言E5模型进行词汇修剪和微调，得到e5-sk-small和e5-sk-large模型。
Result: 大型指令微调多语言模型表现最佳；e5-sk模型在缩减62%参数后仍能与专有API竞争，在语义搜索和RAG任务上表现良好。
Conclusion: 该方法为低资源语言提供了可复现的嵌入基准和模型适配路径，开源所有资源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Surflo: Consistent 3D Surface Flow Model with Global State
papers.abstract_en: Geometry is invariant to viewpoint, which makes any collection of images a redundant encoding of a single 3D state. Existing feed-forward reconstruction models fail to exploit this: per-view methods emit overlapping, unaligned pointmaps that grow linearly with input count, while global-latent methods commit to a fixed, low-resolution output. We introduce Surflo, which compresses a variable number of unposed RGB views into K latent tokens-one global state-and decodes oriented 3D surface points by independently transporting them from noise onto the surface via flow matching. This frees the output from any fixed grid or token budget: the same latent yields from a few thousand to a million points in a single forward pass. To suppress the local inconsistencies inherent to independent per-point decoding, an inference-time guidance term correlates nearby points by injecting a photometric gradient during ODE integration. Surflo matches or surpasses feed-forward baselines on surface metrics, runs an order of magnitude faster than optimization-based methods that require hundreds of views, and is the only feed-forward approach to combine a global latent with arbitrary-resolution decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Surflo，一种将任意数量未标定的 RGB 视图压缩为 K 个潜在 token（全局状态）并通过流匹配独立解码定向 3D 表面点的前馈方法。该方法支持从几千到百万个点的任意分辨率输出，并通过推理时的光度梯度引导项抑制独立解码带来的局部不一致性。
Motivation: 现有前馈重建模型要么每视图输出重叠且不对齐的点云，线性增加计算量；要么使用全局潜在但输出固定低分辨率，无法利用多视图冗余。需要一种能压缩多视图为紧凑全局表征并支持任意分辨率解码的方法。
Method: Surflo 将未标定 RGB 视图输入编码器得到 K 个潜在 token（全局状态），然后通过流匹配（flow matching）将噪声点独立传输到表面，生成定向 3D 点。推理时在 ODE 积分中注入光度梯度作为引导项，使相邻点解码更一致。
Result: 在表面指标上匹配或超越前馈基线，比需数百视图的优化方法快一个数量级，是唯一结合全局潜在与任意分辨率解码的前馈方法。
Conclusion: Surflo 通过全局状态与流匹配实现了高效且一致的 3D 表面重建，支持可变分辨率输出，验证了前馈模型在冗余视图压缩和高质量解码方面的潜力。

papers.title: The Stable Recovery Manifold: Geometric Principles Governing Recoverability in Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Catastrophic forgetting is often viewed as the destruction of previously learned knowledge during sequential learning. Building on the Accessibility Collapse framework, we investigate the geometric structure of recoverability in continual learning. Using Split CIFAR-100 and a sequentially trained ResNet-18, we analyze recoverability, representational drift, and recovery complexity across ten tasks. We introduce Recovery Subspace Dimensionality (k_t), a measure of the minimum number of singular directions required to preserve 90 percent of full probe performance. Contrary to our Recoverability Diffusion hypothesis, recovery dimensionality remains stable throughout training (mean k_t = 8.0) despite substantial representational drift. Principal-angle drift strongly predicts recoverability (r = -0.862), and a simple geometric model explains 82.2 percent of recoverability variance. These findings support the Stable Recovery Manifold hypothesis, suggesting that forgotten knowledge remains compactly decodable despite representational reorganization. The results indicate that catastrophic forgetting is primarily an accessibility and manifold-alignment problem rather than information destruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在持续学习(continual learning)中引入稳定恢复流形假说(Stable Recovery Manifold)，通过Split CIFAR-100和ResNet-18实验发现，遗忘的知识仍以低维子空间形式可解码，反驳了信息完全破坏的观点。恢复子空间维度k_t稳定在8.0，主角度漂移与可恢复性强相关(r=-0.862)，几何模型解释了82.2%的可恢复性方差。
Motivation: 灾难性遗忘常被视为知识的破坏，但本文质疑该观点，认为遗忘主要是访问性和流形对齐问题而非信息损失，需要从几何角度理解可恢复性。
Method: 基于Accessibility Collapse框架，在Split CIFAR-100上顺序训练ResNet-18，定义恢复子空间维度k_t（保留90%全探针性能所需的最小奇异方向数），并分析表示漂移与可恢复性的关系。
Result: 恢复子空间维度k_t在整个训练中保持稳定（均值8.0），主角度漂移与可恢复性强负相关(r=-0.862)，简单几何模型解释82.2%的可恢复性方差。
Conclusion: 稳定恢复流形假说成立：遗忘的知识尽管经历表示重组，仍以紧凑低维结构可解码；灾难性遗忘本质是流形对齐问题，而非信息毁灭。

papers.title: Aerial Wildfire Suppression Planning with a Hybrid CNN-Cellular Automata Fire Model
papers.abstract_en: Aerial wildfire suppression requires not only predicting fire spread, but also designing effective intervention strategies under operational and environmental uncertainty. We present a modeling and optimization framework for aerial wildfire suppression that combines a hybrid neural-cellular automaton wildfire model with gradient-based design of targeted aerial drops. The wildfire model predicts spatially varying spread behavior from terrain, fuel, and wind data, while the intervention module determines binary drop actions with continuous-valued location and orientation parameters mapped to the simulation grid. Water and retardant are represented with distinct suppression effects, corresponding to immediate reduction of active burning and persistent reduction of future spread. To evaluate the robustness of the resulting suppression plans, we quantify both aleatoric uncertainty through Monte Carlo sampling of daily fire-state realizations and epistemic uncertainty through spatially correlated prediction-error perturbations. A case study based on the 2020 Bear Fire shows that the framework can generate coherent aerial suppression schedules for reducing total fire-affected area and can support uncertainty-aware analysis of wildfire intervention strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合混合神经网络-元胞自动机（hybrid neural-cellular automaton）野火模型与梯度优化空中灭火投放的规划框架。该框架利用地形、燃料和风数据预测野火蔓延，并优化空中投放的位置和取向，考虑水和阻燃剂的不同抑制效果。通过2020年Bear Fire案例验证了框架在减少过火面积和不确定性分析方面的有效性。
Motivation: 空中灭火需要不仅预测火势蔓延，还要在运行和环境不确定性下设计有效干预策略，现有方法缺乏综合考虑预测与优化的框架。
Method: 构建混合神经网络-元胞自动机野火模型，结合梯度优化方法确定二元投放动作及连续位置/取向参数；通过蒙特卡洛采样量化偶然不确定性（aleatoric uncertainty），并通过空间相关预测误差扰动量化认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）。
Result: 基于2020年Bear Fire的案例研究表明，该框架能生成连贯的空中灭火调度以减少总过火面积，并支持不确定性感知的野火干预策略分析。
Conclusion: 本文框架为空中灭火规划提供了预测与优化的集成方案，并具备处理多种不确定性的能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Valid Inference with Synthetic Data via Task Exchangeability
papers.abstract_en: There is a proliferation of work arguing for the use of synthetic data in scientific research. For example, social scientists are arguing for the use of LLM-generated "silicon samples" in pilot studies; AI evaluations increasingly rely on "LLM-as-a-judge" outputs; and proteomics research is accelerated by generative models that produce synthetic protein structures. These developments raise an intriguing possibility: synthetic data may help researchers ask more questions, run more studies, and accelerate discovery. But they also raise a fundamental concern: synthetic data can be biased, noisy, and misspecified. In this work, we propose statistical principles for using synthetic data in scientific research with provable validity guarantees. The key insight is a new technical condition that we call task exchangeability. Informally, this is a requirement that the researcher can identify historical tasks, for which real data is available, such that their current task of interest is exchangeable with the historical tasks in an appropriate mathematical sense. We develop methods for valid inference under task exchangeability, together with extensions that provide guarantees even beyond exchangeability. We demonstrate the framework on public opinion surveys with silicon samples and AI evaluation with autoraters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对合成数据在科学研究中的偏差和错误指定问题，提出了一种基于任务可交换性（task exchangeability）的统计推断框架，使得在仅有合成数据的情况下也能获得有效的推断保证。通过在民意调查和AI评估中的演示，展示了方法的可行性。
Motivation: 合成数据在社会科学、AI评估等领域日益流行，但可能带有偏差和噪声，缺乏有效推断的保证。
Method: 引入任务可交换性条件，要求当前任务与历史真实数据任务在数学意义上可交换，并基于此发展统计推断方法，同时提供超越可交换性的扩展。
Result: 在民意调查中使用硅样本（silicon samples）和在AI评估中使用自动评分器（autoraters）的实验中，框架得以演示。
Conclusion: 任务可交换性为合成数据在科学研究中的使用提供了统计基础，并能在一定程度上放松交换性假设。

papers.title: Generative Modeling of Bach-Style Symbolic Music: A Comparative Study of Autoregressive, Latent-Variable, and Adversarial Approaches
papers.abstract_en: We study generative modeling of Bach-style symbolic piano music using a shared MIDI corpus and three model families: autoregressive LSTMs with attention, latent-variable models including recurrent VAEs and vector-quantized VAEs, and generative adversarial networks. We compare their ability to model polyphonic note sequences, learn useful latent representations, and generate stylistically coherent compositions. Our experiments show that the autoregressive LSTM with attention produces the most musically coherent samples, while vector quantization helps mitigate posterior collapse and yields more structured outputs than conventional recurrent VAEs. The adversarial approach captures local pitch patterns but remains difficult to train and generalizes less reliably to Bach's style. These results highlight the relative strengths and failure modes of autoregressive, latent-variable, and adversarial approaches for symbolic music generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对巴赫风格钢琴音乐生成，系统比较了自回归LSTM（带注意力）、潜变量模型（递归VAE和向量量化VAE）以及生成对抗网络三种模型家族。使用共享MIDI语料库的实验表明，自回归LSTM生成最连贯的音乐样本；向量量化VAE有效缓解后验坍缩，输出结构更清晰；而对抗方法虽能捕捉局部音高模式，但训练不稳定且风格泛化能力弱。这些结果揭示了不同方法在符号音乐生成中的相对优势和失败模式。
Motivation: 符号音乐生成领域缺乏在同一数据集上对自回归、潜变量和对抗方法进行系统公平比较的研究，尤其针对巴赫风格复调音乐。
Method: 使用共享MIDI语料库，训练三种模型：带注意力的自回归LSTM、潜变量模型（递归VAE和VQ-VAE）以及生成对抗网络。通过生成样本的音乐连贯性、潜在表示质量和与巴赫风格的一致性进行评估。
Result: 自回归LSTM生成的样本音乐连贯性最佳；VQ-VAE缓解了后验坍缩并产生更结构化的输出；GAN能捕捉局部音高模式但训练困难且泛化不可靠。
Conclusion: 研究强调不同生成方法在符号音乐建模中的权衡：自回归模型胜任长程连贯性，潜变量模型通过向量量化改善表示，而对抗方法需进一步稳定训练。

papers.title: Revisiting Vehicle Color Recognition in Long-Tailed Surveillance Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Vehicle color recognition is an important cue for vehicle identification in surveillance systems, especially when license plates are illegible due to low resolution, occlusion, motion blur, or poor illumination. However, real-world vehicle color distributions are highly imbalanced, making overall accuracy insufficient to assess performance on rare but operationally relevant colors. This paper presents a comprehensive study of vehicle color recognition under severe class imbalance using UFPR-VeSV, a challenging real-world surveillance dataset. We investigate synthetic minority-class augmentation through two off-the-shelf generative strategies: text-conditioned image generation with RunDiffusion/JuggernautXL and image-conditioned color editing with Gemini 2.0 Flash. The curated synthetic data are combined with modern visual representations, loss reweighting, learning-rate scheduling, color-safe augmentation, foreground-aware preprocessing, and ensemble fusion. The bestperforming approach achieves 94.6% micro accuracy and 79.7% macro accuracy, improving macro accuracy by 8.2 percentage points over recent literature. A manual error analysis further shows that many remaining failures are visually ambiguous even for human annotators, highlighting the practical limits of color-based vehicle identification in unconstrained surveillance imagery. The generated images and source code are publicly available at https://github.com/viniciusorru/vcr-synthetic
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR) - V3SC Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了长尾监控场景中的车辆颜色识别问题，使用UFPR-VeSV数据集，通过合成少数类样本（文本条件图像生成和图像条件颜色编辑）结合现代视觉表示、损失重加权、学习率调度、颜色安全增强、前景感知预处理和集成融合，实现了最高94.6%的微平均准确率和79.7%的宏平均准确率，比近期文献宏平均准确率提升8.2个百分点。错误分析表明许多剩余失败在视觉上对人类标注者也模棱两可。
Motivation: 真实世界车辆颜色分布高度不平衡，使得整体准确率不足以评估稀有但操作相关颜色的性能，需要针对长尾分布的研究。
Method: 采用两种现成的生成策略进行少数类数据增强：RunDiffusion/JuggernautXL的文本条件图像生成和Gemini 2.0 Flash的图像条件颜色编辑，并将合成数据与现代视觉表示、损失重加权、学习率调度、颜色安全增强、前景感知预处理和集成融合相结合。
Result: 最佳方法在UFPR-VeSV数据集上达到94.6%微平均准确率和79.7%宏平均准确率，宏平均准确率比近期文献提升8.2个百分点。
Conclusion: 强调即使采用先进的生成和数据增强方法，剩余错误中许多在视觉上对人类标注者也模棱两可，表明在无约束监控图像中基于颜色的车辆识别存在实际限制。

papers.title: Beyond Runtime Enforcement: Shield Synthesis as Defensibility Analysis for Adversarial Networks
papers.abstract_en: Shielded reinforcement learning is typically presented as a runtime safety mechanism that compiles temporal-logic specifications into automata restricting an agent's actions. We argue this is the wrong product. The same automata-theoretic machinery -- specification compilation, product game construction, attractor computation, and winning-region extraction -- is better read as a design-time analytical instrument whose outputs are structural insights about a system rather than runtime constraints on a deployed agent. We instantiate this through a constrained two-player safety game for network defense. The two specifications are enforced asymmetrically: the defender specification defines the unsafe region of the game, whereas the attacker specification restricts the adversary's legal actions during attractor computation. Solving the game yields a defensibility verdict -- a formal certificate that a topology-specification pair is or is not defensible -- with the associated winning region and shield. Beyond the binary verdict, we derive topology-level metrics from the attractor structure and combine them with post-convergence behavior from shield-constrained adversarial multi-agent reinforcement learning. Together these form a defensibility fingerprint capturing both a network's formal safety properties and its operational behavior under adaptive play. A what-if analysis shows that formal defensibility and operational effectiveness capture distinct aspects of security: small architectural changes can produce large shifts in operational outcomes while leaving formal safety margins nearly unchanged. Shield synthesis is thus most valuable not as a deployment mechanism for safe agents, but as a framework for answering architectural questions about whether, where, and how a system can be defended. The defensibility verdict is the output, not the safe policy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新定义屏蔽强化学习（shielded reinforcement learning）的核心用途：从运行时安全机制转向设计时分析工具。作者通过一个受限双人安全博弈（constrained two-player safety game）实例化该观点，求解博弈得到可防御性裁决（defensibility verdict）和拓扑级指标，并结合博弈后收敛行为形成防御性指纹（defensibility fingerprint）。研究发现形式防御性和操作有效性捕捉了安全的不同方面，小型架构变化可能大幅改变操作结果而不影响形式安全裕度。
Motivation: 现有屏蔽强化学习通常被视为将时序逻辑规范编译为自动机以限制智能体动作的运行时安全机制。作者认为这种思路方向有误，主张同一自动机理论工具更适合作为设计时分析仪器，提供关于系统架构的结构性见解而非运行时约束。
Method: 构建一个受限双人安全博弈，对防御者和攻击者不对称地施加两种规范：防御者规范定义不安全区域，攻击者规范限制对手合法动作。通过求解博弈得到可防御性裁决、获胜区域和屏蔽，并从吸引子结构导出拓扑级指标，再结合屏蔽约束下的对抗性多智能体强化学习得到的收敛后行为，形成防御性指纹。
Result: 通过what-if分析发现，形式防御性和操作有效性捕捉了安全的不同方面：小的架构变化可能大幅改变操作结果，而形式安全裕度几乎不变。
Conclusion: 屏蔽综合最有价值的不是作为安全智能体的部署机制，而是作为回答系统能否防御、何处防御以及如何防御等架构问题的分析框架。可防御性裁决是输出，而非安全策略。

papers.title: Majority-of-Three is Optimal
papers.abstract_en: We give a short proof that the majority vote of three independent consistent classifiers is an optimal learner in the realizable PAC setting. This proves optimality for the simplest voting scheme, while simplifying both the algorithmic structure and the probabilistic analysis of previous voting learners, including the algorithm of S. Hanneke and the analysis of bagging by K. Green Larsen.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: One Polluted Page Is Enough: Evaluating Web Content Pollution in Generative Recommenders
papers.abstract_en: Search-augmented LLMs increasingly mediate everyday consumer recommendations by retrieving live web content. This creates a new risk: generative recommenders may consume polluted web content, such as fake reviews and promotional pages crafted to mislead recommendations. We ask: to what extent do search-augmented LLMs become unwitting promoters of fake products when consuming polluted retrieval results? To answer this, we introduce FORGE (Fake Online Recommendations in Generative Environments), a benchmark for measuring fake-product promotion under controlled web-content pollution. Given an upstream search result, FORGE locally rewrites real products in retrieved web pages into fake ones to simulate web-content pollution, and measures how often the LLM recommends the fake product. FORGE covers 225 real-world products across 15 categories and 5 consumer scenarios. Across 12 commercial and open-weights LLMs, all models are vulnerable: a single polluted page yields fooled rates of up to 27%, while the full top-3 replacement raises this to 73.8%. Vulnerability varies substantially across categories, increasing when models lack stable prior knowledge of the relevant products. Reasoning does not mitigate this vulnerability; instead, it often generates spurious social proof to justify false recommendations. We evaluate three defenses: skepticism prompting and consensus filtering (over model priors or cross-document evidence). Skepticism can exacerbate vulnerability, much like reasoning, while filtering risks suppressing legitimate products. We release FORGE at https://github.com/leoluolol/forge-benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究搜索增强型大语言模型（LLM）作为生成式推荐系统时，因检索到被污染的网页内容（如虚假评论、促销页面）而推荐假商品的风险。作者提出FORGE基准，覆盖225个真实商品、15个类别和5种消费场景，评估12个模型发现单页面污染即可导致最高27%的欺骗率，前3页面替换则升至73.8%。推理和怀疑提示未能缓解，甚至加剧漏洞。
Motivation: 生成式推荐系统依赖实时网页检索，但网页内容可能被污染（如虚假评论），导致LLM无意中推荐假商品。目前缺乏系统性评估该风险的方法和基准。
Method: 提出FORGE基准，通过本地替换检索网页中真实商品为假商品来模拟污染，并测量LLM推荐假商品的频率。覆盖225种商品、15个类别和5个场景，测试12个商业及开源LLM。
Result: 所有模型均易受攻击：单污染页面欺骗率最高27%，前三页面替换后达73.8%。漏洞因类别而异，当模型缺乏稳定先验知识时更严重。推理和怀疑提示未缓解漏洞，反而产生虚假社会证明；共识过滤可能压制合法商品。
Conclusion: 当前搜索增强型LLM作为推荐时易被网页污染欺骗，现有防御措施效果有限，需进一步研究更鲁棒的防护方法。

papers.title: AgentBeats: Agentifying Agent Assessment for Openness, Standardization, and Reproducibility
papers.abstract_en: Agent systems are advancing quickly across domains, but their evaluation remains fragmented. Most benchmarks rely on fixed, LLM-centric harnesses that require heavy integration, create test-production mismatch, and limit fair comparison across diverse agent designs. The root problem is the lack of an open, agent-agnostic assessment interface. We advocate Agentified Agent Assessment (AAA), where evaluation is performed by judge agents and all participants interact through standardized protocols: A2A for task management and MCP for tool access. Conventional benchmarking defines two separate interfaces, one for the benchmark and one for the agent, while AAA only needs one; this yields a generic, unified framework that separates assessment logic from agent implementation and enables reproducible, interoperable, and multi-agent evaluation. We further introduce AgentBeats as a concrete realization of AAA: we identify five practical operation modes that make standardized assessment compatible with real-world constraints on openness, privacy, and reproducibility. To evaluate our design at scale, we conduct two studies: a five-month open competition that drew 298 judge agents across 12 categories together with 467 subject agents from independent participants, showing that AAA applies across a heterogeneous range of benchmarks; and a case study on coding agents that confirms agentified evaluation preserves fidelity with the public record while surfacing previously missing head-to-head results, yielding research insights about agent design. Combining a community-scale field study and a controlled coding case study, we verify that AAA delivers coverage, practicality, and fidelity across heterogeneous scenarios at scale. Together, AAA and AgentBeats offer a clear path toward open, standardized, and reproducible agent assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出开放、标准化、可复现的智能体评估框架 Agentified Agent Assessment (AAA)，其具体实现 AgentBeats 通过五个操作模式适应实际约束。五个月公开竞赛（298 个裁判智能体、467 个被评智能体）和编码智能体案例研究验证了框架在异构基准上的覆盖性、实用性和保真度。
Motivation: 现有智能体评估碎片化，基准依赖固定、LLM 中心的测试平台，集成成本高且导致测试-生产不匹配，缺乏开放、智能体无关的评估接口。
Method: 倡导 AAA，由裁判智能体执行评估，所有参与者通过标准化协议（A2A 任务管理、MCP 工具访问）交互，统一评估接口。AgentBeats 识别五个操作模式以平衡开放性、隐私性和可复现性。
Result: 五个月竞赛涵盖 12 个类别、298 个裁判智能体和 467 个被评智能体，证明 AAA 适用于异构基准；编码案例研究证实评估保真度并揭示头对头比较结果。
Conclusion: AAA 和 AgentBeats 为开放、标准化、可复现的智能体评估提供了清晰路径。

papers.title: Reasoning as Pattern Matching: Shared Mechanisms in Human and LLM Everyday Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: When large language models (LLMs) fail to generalize or make haphazard errors in reasoning, it is often taken as evidence that LLMs are not truly reasoning, but rather performing a kind of pattern matching. The implication is that people's behavior does not exhibit the same types of failures because human reasoning uses principled and abstract world models. We evaluate human participants and 25 LLMs on their ability to engage in common-sense reasoning about a variety of everyday situations and observe similar patterns of errors in both people and models. We then identify the set of attention heads driving LLM responses and find that these heads implement a form of pattern-matching. These attention heads allow us to predict seemingly inexplicable reasoning errors in people caused by ostensibly irrelevant prompt details. Taken together, our results suggest that everyday causal reasoning in people and LLMs is more consistent with a form of pattern-matching than with abstract world models.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实验比较人类和25个LLM在日常因果关系推理中的表现，发现二者具有类似的错误模式，且LLM中负责回答的注意力头实现了模式匹配，从而可以预测人类受无关细节干扰的推理错误，表明日常因果推理更符合模式匹配而非抽象世界模型。
Motivation: 当前对LLM推理失败的解释常归结为它们只是模式匹配而非真正推理，但隐含地认为人类行为不会犯同样错误。本文旨在检验这种对比是否成立。
Method: 评估人类参与者和25个LLM在各种日常情况下的常识推理能力，并识别LLM中驱动回应的注意力头，分析其模式匹配机制。
Result: 观察到人类和LLM在推理错误上呈现相似模式；LLM的注意力头实现了模式匹配，能够预测人类因看似无关的提示细节引起的推理错误。
Conclusion: 结果表明，人类和LLM的日常因果推理更符合模式匹配形式，而非基于抽象世界模型。

papers.title: Distribution-Agnostic Robust Trajectory Optimization via Chance-Constrained Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a distribution-agnostic robust trajectory-optimization framework based on chance-constrained reinforcement learning. The uncertainty is represented here through initial conditions and process noise, with the only requirement being that it can be sampled. A deterministic nominal trajectory is first computed offline, and reinforcement learning is then used only to robustify that baseline through a structured affine closed-loop correction law comprising a feedforward control adjustment and time-varying feedback gains. Probabilistic feasibility is enforced empirically through rollout-based upper-tail quantiles, while terminal dispersion is regulated through covariance-feasibility penalties. The framework is assessed on two materially different trajectory design problems. The flagship case study is a three-dimensional multi-impulse Earth-Mars transfer, where the learned policy is benchmarked against a recent robust trajectory-optimization reference under Gaussian uncertainty and then evaluated under bounded uniform uncertainty and under process disturbances not seen during training. The second case study is a stochastic atmospheric pinpoint rocket landing problem, used to assess portability to a short-horizon continuous-thrust setting with drag, mass depletion, and glide-slope constraints. The results show that the proposed framework can remain competitive in upper-tail fuel cost while preserving probabilistic feasibility, and that the same robustification scaffold can be carried across heterogeneous spacecraft trajectory planning problems without redesign of its core stochastic-control structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于机会约束强化学习的分布无关鲁棒轨迹优化框架。不确定性仅需可采样，不假设具体分布。先离线计算确定性标称轨迹，再通过仿射闭环修正律（前馈调整+时变反馈增益）进行鲁棒化。概率可行性通过基于rollout的上尾分位数强制执行，终端散布通过协方差可行性惩罚调节。在三维多脉冲地火转移和随机大气定点火箭着陆两个案例上验证，结果表明该方法在保持概率可行性的同时，上尾燃料成本具有竞争力，且核心随机控制结构可跨异质航天器轨迹规划问题复用。
Motivation: 现有鲁棒轨迹优化方法通常假设不确定性分布已知，或依赖分布矩信息，限制了实际应用。需要一种不依赖分布形式、仅需样本的鲁棒优化框架。
Method: 提出两阶段方法：先离线求解确定性最优轨迹；再用强化学习鲁棒化，采用结构化的仿射闭环修正律（前馈调整和时变反馈增益），概率约束通过rollout上尾分位数处理，终端散布通过协方差惩罚项控制。
Result: 在地火转移问题中，与最新鲁棒轨迹优化基准相比，在均匀分布和未见过过程噪声下保持竞争力；在随机大气定点着陆问题中验证了框架的可移植性。
Conclusion: 该分布无关的鲁棒轨迹优化框架可处理仅需采样的不确定性，且核心结构可跨不同航天器轨迹规划问题复用，无需重新设计随机控制结构。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning from Delayed Marketplace Feedback for Objective-Weight Adaptation in Three-Sided Dispatch
papers.abstract_en: Dispatch in three-sided marketplaces provides a natural setting for reinforcement learning from world feedback: decisions are evaluated by delayed operational outcomes such as delivery speed, courier utilization, and merchant congestion. We present a deployed reinforcement learning system at DoorDash that adapts dispatch objective weights in a large-scale food-delivery marketplace using delayed signals. Rather than replacing the combinatorial assignment optimizer, a store-level policy learned from logged marketplace data selects a discrete multiplier that shifts the dispatch optimizer's tradeoff between delivery quality and batching efficiency. This interface enables offline policy learning under noisy, delayed, and coupled feedback while preserving production feasibility constraints and operational safeguards. We train a shared value function using centralized offline data and decentralized store-level execution, with Double Q-learning targets and a conservative regularizer to reduce out-of-distribution value overestimation. In a production switchback experiment, the offline-trained policy increases batching and reduces courier-side time costs without degrading customer-facing delivery quality. Results illustrate how world feedback from a live economic and logistics system can be used to safely adapt decision policies online.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Reinforcement Learning from World Feedback (RLxF)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个在DoorDash部署的多智能体强化学习系统，利用延迟的市场反馈（如配送速度、骑手利用率、商家拥堵）自适应调整配送调度目标权重。系统通过离线日志数据学习存储级策略，选择离散乘数来优化配送质量与批处理效率之间的权衡，并采用Double Q-learning和保守正则化减少分布外过估计。生产切换实验表明该方法在不影响顾客配送质量的前提下提升了批处理效率并降低了骑手时间成本。
Motivation: 现有三边市场中的配送调度优化器通常依赖固定目标权重，难以适应动态环境中的延迟反馈和耦合约束，需要一种能安全利用离线数据自适应调整权重的方法。
Method: 提出一个离线训练的多智能体强化学习框架：每个存储点学习一个策略，从历史市场数据中选择离散乘数（调整优化器的折中偏好）；使用集中式离线数据训练共享价值函数，结合Double Q-learning目标与保守正则化项，以处理噪声、延迟和耦合的反馈，并保持生产可行性约束。
Result: 在生产切换实验中，离线训练的策略显著增加了批处理量并降低了骑手端的时间成本，同时没有损害顾客端的配送质量。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了如何利用真实经济物流系统的世界反馈安全地在线调整决策策略，验证了离线强化学习在多边市场调度中的可行性和有效性。

papers.title: Beyond the Commitment Boundary: Probing Epiphenomenal Chain-of-Thought in Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is the dominant paradigm for inference-time scaling in language models, yet the causal influence of individual steps on the final answer poorly understood. We estimate each step's causal importance via early exit and use this measure to study how answers form across the reasoning traces of several model families. Across diverse tasks, we find that reasoning typically crosses a \emph{commitment boundary} -- a sharp transition from transient intermediate guesses to a stable, high-confidence answer. This transition often happens in a single step, well before the model's reasoning block ends, and is followed by \emph{epiphenomenal} CoT steps that leave the final answer probability unaltered. Using attention probes, we show that answer-formation stages can be linearly decoded from intermediate reasoning steps with high accuracy and generalize robustly to unseen reasoning tasks. We exploit this signal to early-exit reasoning blocks at the commitment boundary, reducing the length of CoTs up to 55\% on average with negligible impact on model performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过早期退出方法估计链式思维推理中每一步的因果重要性，发现存在一个“承诺边界”，在此之后步骤变为副现象（epiphenomenal），不改变最终答案。利用注意力探针可从中间步骤高精度线性解码答案形成阶段，并在承诺边界提前退出，将CoT长度平均减少55%且性能损失极小。
Motivation: 链式思维推理是推理时扩展的主流范式，但每一步对最终答案的因果影响尚不明确，理解这一机制对于优化推理效率至关重要。
Method: 通过早期退出估计每一步的因果重要性，识别承诺边界；使用注意力探针从中间推理步骤线性解码答案形成阶段，并基于此信号在承诺边界提前结束推理。
Result: 在多种模型和任务上，推理通常在一个步骤内从暂态猜测突变为稳定高置信度答案，之后步骤为副现象；提前退出可平均减少CoT长度55%，且性能几乎不受影响。
Conclusion: CoT推理中大部分步骤是副现象的，可在承诺边界截断以大幅提升效率，且该信号可泛化至未见任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EpiBench: Verifiable Evaluation of AI Agents on Epigenomics Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We introduce EpiBench, a verifiable benchmark for short-horizon epigenomics analysis. EpiBench evaluates whether agents can make well-defined analysis decisions from realistic workflow states and return deterministically gradable answers. The benchmark includes 106 evaluations across CUT\&Tag/CUT\&RUN, ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, and DNA methylation workflows. Across 5,088 valid trajectories from 16 model-harness pairs, no system passed a majority of attempts: GPT-5.5 / Pi led at 45.0\% (143/318 attempts; 95\% confidence interval (CI), 36.3--53.7), followed by GPT-5.5 / OpenAI Codex at 39.9\% (127/318 attempts; 95\% CI, 31.6--48.3). Claude Opus 4.8 Max / Pi and GPT-5.4 / Pi each passed 39.0\% (124/318 attempts; 95\% CI, 30.2--47.8 and 31.0--47.0, respectively). Performance varies across assay types, and many failed runs still contain parts of the correct answer. Agents often found the right files and computed useful intermediate results, but failed when the task required deeper, assay-specific scientific judgment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EpiBench是一个用于评估AI代理在短时程表观基因组学分析中决策能力的可验证基准。包含106个评估任务，覆盖CUT&Tag、ATAC-seq、ChIP-seq和DNA甲基化等工作流。在16个模型-工具组合的5088条有效轨迹中，最佳系统GPT-5.5/Pi仅通过45.0%的尝试，表明现有AI代理在需要深度实验科学判断的任务上表现不足。
Motivation: 当前AI代理在科学工作流中的应用缺乏结构化评估标准，尤其是在需要确定性验证的表观基因组学分析领域。
Method: 构建EpiBench基准，包含确定性情形的分析决策问题，要求代理从真实工作流状态出发并返回可评分答案，并通过CUT&Tag等四种实验流程的106个评估任务进行测试。
Result: 最佳模型GPT-5.5/Pi通过率45.0%，GPT-5.5/OpenAI Codex为39.9%，Claude Opus 4.8 Max/Pi和GPT-5.4/Pi均为39.0%；性能随实验类型变化，多数失败尝试包含部分正确结果。
Conclusion: 现有AI代理在表观基因组学分析中能完成基础文件查找和中间计算，但缺乏实验特异性科学判断能力，整个领域仍面临显著挑战。

papers.title: Reward Modeling for Multi-Agent Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) built on Large Language Models (LLMs) require effective orchestration to coordinate specialized agents, yet training such orchestrators is hindered by limited supervision and high computational cost. We propose Orchestration Reward Modeling (OrchRM), a self-supervised framework for evaluating orchestration quality without human annotations. OrchRM leverages intermediate artifacts from multi-agent executions to construct win-lose pairs for Bradley-Terry reward model training. Unlike existing MAS test-time scaling and orchestrator training frameworks that rely on costly sub-agent rollouts, OrchRM operates directly at the orchestration level, enabling efficient and high-performing reward-guided orchestrator training and MAS test-time scaling. OrchRM improves training efficiency by up to 10x in token usage while improving MAS test-time scaling performance by up to 8% in accuracy. These gains consistently transfer across multiple domains, including mathematical reasoning, web-based question answering, and multi-hop reasoning, demonstrating orchestration-level reward modeling as a scalable direction for robust multi-agent orchestration. Code will be available at https://github.com/Wang-ML-Lab/OrchRM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Orchestration Reward Modeling (OrchRM)，一种自监督框架，用于评估多智能体系统的编排质量，无需人工标注。OrchRM 通过利用多智能体执行的中间产物构建 Bradley-Terry 奖励模型的 win-lose 对，实现高效的奖励引导编排器训练。在数学推理、Web问答和多跳推理等领域的实验表明，该方法在 token 使用上提升训练效率最高达10倍，准确率提升最高达8%。这些结果证明了编排级奖励建模作为鲁棒多智能体编排的可扩展方向。
Motivation: 多智能体系统需要有效的编排来协调专用智能体，但训练编排器受限于有限的监督和高计算成本。
Method: 提出 OrchRM 自监督框架，无需人工标注，利用多智能体执行的中间产物构建 win-lose 对，训练 Bradley-Terry 奖励模型，直接在编排层面操作。
Result: 训练效率在 token 使用上提升最高10倍，准确率提升最高8%，并在数学推理、Web问答和多跳推理等多个领域一致泛化。
Conclusion: 编排级奖励建模是鲁棒多智能体编排的可扩展方向。

papers.title: Multiagent Protocols with Aggregated Confidence Signals
papers.abstract_en: Confidence is used for reliability, oversight, and a range of downstream decision tasks in Natural Language Processing (NLP), yet no existing method produces or evaluates a confidence for the output of a multiagent system. Prior work uses confidence within multiagent debate (MAD) to weight messages, trigger debate, or calibrate individual agents, but it never aggregates these into a single confidence for the system itself. We introduce three protocols that produce a final answer along with a single aggregated confidence by first transforming raw confidence signals to make them comparable across models, then combining them via soft voting or a probability fusion we call Bayesian fusion. This aggregated confidence is substantially more discriminative (AUARC) than that of the best single agent or the standard debate baselines, while correctness (F1-score) stays stable and recovers the losses MAD incurs on more ambiguous tasks. Analyzing two estimators, sequence probability and self-report, alongside parametric and non-parametric calibrators, we find that calibration improves F1 for both estimators while AUARC is less reliant on it. We evaluate six homogeneous and heterogeneous debating pairs per benchmark, across five benchmarks and four task types, spanning a range of model capabilities and sizes.
papers.comment: 22 pages and 5 figures, 9 pages and 2 figures before the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出三种协议，用于在多智能体辩论（MAD）中生成聚合置信度，通过转换原始置信度信号使其跨模型可比，然后通过软投票或贝叶斯融合进行组合。聚合置信度在判别性（AUARC）上显著优于最佳单智能体或标准辩论基线，而正确性（F1-score）保持稳定，并恢复了MAD在更模糊任务上的损失。
Motivation: 现有方法使用置信度加权消息、触发辩论或校准单个智能体，但从未将这些聚合为系统本身的单一置信度。本文目标是产生带聚合置信度的最终答案。
Method: 引入三种协议：首先转换原始置信度信号使其跨模型可比，然后通过软投票或称为贝叶斯融合的概率融合进行组合。
Result: 聚合置信度在判别性（AUARC）上优于最佳单智能体或标准辩论基线，正确性（F1-score）稳定，并恢复MAD在模糊任务上的损失。评估了两个估计器（序列概率和自我报告）以及参数和非参数校准器，发现校准提高了两个估计器的F1，而AUARC较少依赖校准。
Conclusion: 本文提出了多智能体系统中聚合置信度的协议，并在多种模型和任务上验证了有效性。

papers.title: Simplex-Constrained Sparse Bagging: Transitioning from Uniform Priors to Sparse Posteriors in Ensemble Learning
papers.abstract_en: We present Simplex-Constrained Sparse Bagging (SCSB), a mathematically rigorous framework for post-training compression and probability calibration of bootstrap-based bagging ensembles. Standard bagging ensembles (such as Random Forests, Bagged SVMs, and Bagged Neural Networks) assign uniform voting power to all constituent estimators. However, this naive uniform prior ignores the varying local competence of base estimators and contributes to model overconfidence. We formulate ensemble pruning and calibration as a joint optimization problem over the probability simplex by minimizing the Out-Of-Bag (OOB) loss. To induce sparsity, we address the theoretical "L1-simplex paradox" -- the mathematical reality that the L1 norm is constant on the simplex and fails to prune -- by introducing a concave quadratic penalty. SCSB is model-agnostic and achieves up to 96% ensemble compression, yielding linear inference speedups and superior probability calibration (lowered Expected Calibration Error) while preserving or enhancing generalization accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Simplex-Constrained Sparse Bagging (SCSB)，一种后训练集成压缩与概率校准框架。标准 bagging 集成（如随机森林、Bagged SVM）使用均匀投票权，忽略了基学习器的局部能力差异，导致过度自信。SCSB 在概率单纯形上联合优化剪枝和校准，通过引入凹二次惩罚项解决 L1 单纯形悖论（L1 范数在单纯形上恒定无法剪枝），从而诱导稀疏性。实验表明 SCSB 可实现高达 96% 的压缩率，线性推理加速，降低期望校准误差，同时保持或提升泛化精度。
Motivation: 标准 bagging 集成赋予所有基学习器均匀投票权，但忽略了它们在不同区域的局部能力差异，导致模型过度自信且冗余，需要压缩和校准。
Method: 将集成剪枝和概率校准建模为概率单纯形上的约束优化问题，通过最小化袋外损失（OOB loss）求解；为解决 L1 范数在单纯形上恒定无法剪枝的理论问题，引入凹二次惩罚项来诱导稀疏性。
Result: SCSB 达到高达 96% 的集成压缩率，线性推理加速，降低期望校准误差（Expected Calibration Error），同时保持或提升泛化精度。
Conclusion: SCSB 是一种模型无关、能同时实现集成压缩和概率校准的有效方法，适用于各种 bagging 集成。

papers.title: Towards Effective Waste Segmentation for Automated Waste Recycling in Cluttered Background
papers.abstract_en: Rapid expansion of urban areas and population growth is causing an immense increase in waste production, which demands the need for efficient and automated waste management. In this scenario, automated waste recycling (AWR) using deep learning methods can assist humans in optimal waste management. Recent deep learning approaches for AWR provide promising waste segmentation performance, however, these methods rely on large backbone networks that are inefficient for AWR systems and suffer from performance deterioration in cluttered scenes. To this end, an optimal waste segmentation network is introduced which effectively utilizes the spatial domain to capture localized structural dependencies and the spectral domain to efficiently extract global contextual relationships. This cascaded design allows the network to progressively leverage both local and global representations across complementary domains to highlight the semantic information necessary for effective segmentation of various waste objects. Furthermore, auxiliary feature enhancement module (AFEM) is introduced to enhance the target objects' boundaries and blob amplification for better segmentation in cluttered scenarios. Extensive experimentation on ZeroWaste-aug, ZeroWaste-f and SpectralWaste datasets reveals the merits of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对杂乱背景下的自动废品回收（AWR）问题，提出一种结合空间域和频域的分割网络，并引入辅助特征增强模块（AFEM）以改善目标边界和斑点放大。在ZeroWaste-aug, ZeroWaste-f和SpectralWaste数据集上的实验表明该方法有效。
Motivation: 现有AWR方法依赖大型骨干网络，在杂乱场景中性能下降，且推理效率低，无法满足实际需求。
Method: 提出级联网络结构，利用空间域捕获局部结构依赖，频谱域提取全局上下文关系，并通过AFEM模块增强目标边界和斑点。
Result: 在ZeroWaste-aug, ZeroWaste-f和SpectralWaste数据集上取得优于现有方法的废品分割性能。
Conclusion: 该网络通过互补域特征渐进利用局部和全局表示，有效提升杂乱场景下的废品分割效果。

papers.title: EvTexture++: Event-Driven Texture Enhancement for Video Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Event-based vision has drawn increasing attention owing to its distinctive properties, including ultra-high temporal resolution and extreme dynamic range. Recent works have introduced it to video super-resolution (VSR) to enhance flow estimation and temporal alignment. In contrast, this paper shifts the focus of event signals from motion refinement to texture enhancement in VSR. We propose EvTexture++, the first event-driven framework dedicated to texture enhancement in VSR. It leverages high-frequency spatiotemporal details from events to improve texture recovery. EvTexture++ incorporates a customized texture enhancement branch, along with an iterative texture enhancement module that progressively exploits high-temporal-resolution event information for texture restoration. This enables gradual refinement of texture regions across iterations, yielding more accurate and detailed high-resolution outputs. Besides intra-frame texture recovery, large motions could degrade inter-frame temporal consistency, particularly in texture regions, leading to texture flickering. To mitigate this, we further exploit the continuous-time motion cues of events to enhance temporal consistency, introducing a temporal texture alignment module that estimates event-guided texture-aware flow for precise inter-frame texture alignment. Moreover, EvTexture++ is designed as a plug-and-play tool to flexibly boost the performance of existing VSR models. Experiments on five datasets demonstrate that EvTexture++ achieves state-of-the-art performance. When integrated into recent VSR models, it yields significant improvements, with gains of up to 1.55 dB in PSNR on the texture-rich Vid4 dataset. Code: https://github.com/DachunKai/EvTexture.
papers.comment: IEEE TPAMI 2026. Extended version of arXiv:2406.13457 (ICML 2024). Project page: https://dachunkai.github.io/evtexture-project-page/
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, vol. 48, no. 6, pp. 6642-6659, June 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvTexture++ 是首个专注于视频超分辨率 (VSR) 纹理增强的事件驱动框架。它利用事件相机的高频时空细节，通过迭代纹理增强模块逐步恢复纹理区域，并引入时序纹理对齐模块利用事件连续运动线索消除纹理闪烁。作为即插即用模块，在多个数据集上达到最优性能，集成到现有 VSR 模型后 Vid4 数据集 PSNR 提升达 1.55 dB。
Motivation: 现有事件驱动 VSR 方法主要利用事件改进光流估计与时序对齐，忽略了事件信号在纹理增强中的潜力；同时大运动场景下纹理区域易出现帧间闪烁。
Method: 提出 EvTexture++，包含定制纹理增强分支、迭代纹理增强模块（逐步利用高时间分辨率事件信息）和时序纹理对齐模块（估计事件引导纹理感知光流），并设计为即插即用工具。
Result: 在五个数据集上达到 SOTA；集成到现有 VSR 模型后，在纹理丰富的 Vid4 数据集上 PSNR 提升最高达 1.55 dB。
Conclusion: 事件信号可用于 VSR 纹理增强及时序一致性改进，EvTexture++ 作为即插即用模块能灵活提升现有 VSR 模型性能，代码已开源。

papers.title: LabVLA: Grounding Vision-Language-Action Models in Scientific Laboratories
papers.abstract_en: Scientific laboratories increasingly rely on AI systems to reason about experiments, but the physical act of doing science remains largely outside their reach. AI can help read literature, generate hypotheses, and plan protocols, yet the execution of those protocols at the bench still requires a human operator. Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide one possible interface between written protocols and robot execution, but existing policies are trained mostly on household and tabletop demonstrations and rarely encounter the instruments, transparent liquids, or fixed protocol workflows found in scientific laboratories. Closing this gap requires both laboratory-specific supervision and a unified learning framework that can accommodate the diverse robot embodiments used to execute experimental protocols. We therefore identify data and embodiment as central bottlenecks alongside model design. To address the data side, we build RoboGenesis, a simulation-based workflow and data engine that composes configured laboratory workflows from atomic skills, validates and filters rollouts, and exports structured demonstrations across supported robot profiles. On the policy side, we present LabVLA, trained with a two-stage recipe: FAST action token pretraining first makes the Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct backbone action aware before any continuous control is learned, and flow matching posttraining then attaches a DiT action expert under knowledge insulation. On the LabUtopia benchmark, LabVLA achieves the highest average success rate among all evaluated baselines under both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.
papers.comment: Work in progress. Project website at https://zjunlp.github.io/LabVLA/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对科学实验室中实验协议执行自动化问题，提出 LabVLA，一个将视觉-语言-动作模型应用于实验室场景的框架。通过构建模拟数据引擎 RoboGenesis 生成实验室操作演示，并采用两阶段训练：FAST 动作标记预训练使语言模型具有动作感知能力，随后通过流匹配后训练附加 DiT 动作专家。在 LabUtopia 基准上，LabVLA 在分布内和分布外设置下均取得最高平均成功率。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型主要训练于家庭和桌面场景，缺乏科学实验室中常见的仪器、透明液体和固定协议工作流，且不同机器人形态需要统一的学习框架。
Method: 构建 RoboGenesis 仿真数据引擎，从原子技能组合工作流并验证生成演示；提出 LabVLA 两阶段训练：先进行 FAST 动作标记预训练，使 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 骨干具有动作感知，再通过流匹配后训练附加 DiT 动作专家，并采用知识绝缘策略。
Result: 在 LabUtopia 基准上，LabVLA 在所有评估基线中取得最高平均成功率，包括分布内和分布外设置。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过实验室专用数据引擎和两阶段训练策略，可以使 VLA 模型有效泛化到科学实验室操作任务。

papers.title: Learning with Simulators: No Regret in a Computationally Bounded World
papers.abstract_en: Understanding the minimal assumptions necessary for generalization is the fundamental question in learning theory. Unfortunately, most results rely heavily on independence (or some proxy thereof) of the data-generating process, while results for strongly dependent data are far more limited. Towards addressing this gap, we introduce the framework of simulatable processes, where the learner has access to a simulator that approximates the distribution generating the data (which may be an arbitrarily complex and dependent process). Surprisingly, given access to such a simulator, we show that we can recover the same learning guarantees as in the classical setting with independent data, namely, error bounds that depend on the VC dimension. Further, we use this framework to study the power of conditional sampling and show strict statistical and computational advantages in this setting. As a highlight of our framework, we exhibit a single algorithm that simultaneously learns any given VC class under all processes samplable in bounded polynomial time, with regret controlled by the time-bounded Kolmogorov complexity of the process. This provides a significant conceptual broadening of the classical PAC model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可模拟过程（simulatable processes）的学习框架，其中学习器可访问近似数据生成分布的模拟器。证明在强依赖数据下仍能获得与独立数据相同的泛化保证（基于VC维）。进一步展示该框架在条件采样下的统计和计算优势，并提出一个统一算法，在多项式时间可采样的所有过程上学习任何VC类，遗憾由时间有界Kolmogorov复杂度控制。
Motivation: 经典学习理论大多假设数据独立，但现实数据常具有强依赖性。为填补这一空白，论文探索在计算受限环境下，利用近似模拟器恢复独立数据下的学习保证。
Method: 引入可模拟过程框架，允许学习器访问数据生成分布的近似模拟器。基于此，利用VC维和Kolmogorov复杂度推导误差界，并设计统一算法处理各类过程。
Result: 在可模拟过程假设下，恢复了与独立数据相同的学习保证（误差界依赖于VC维）；条件采样设置下展示了统计和计算优势；单算法能同时学习所有多项式时间可采样过程下的VC类。
Conclusion: 论文从理论上放宽了经典PAC模型对数据独立性的假设，为处理复杂依赖数据提供了新视角。但抽象所述，未提及天气预测等具体应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ArogyaSutra: A Multi-Agent Framework for Multimodal Medical Reasoning in Indic Languages
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown promising reasoning capabilities in general domains, yet their performance remains limited in specialized settings such as healthcare, especially in multilingual and low-resource scenarios. This gap is critical in regions like rural India, where patients often express complex medical queries in native Indic languages and rely on multimodal inputs such as medical images. Existing English-centric MLLMs struggle to support such use cases, limiting equitable access to AI-driven healthcare assistance. To address this challenge, we introduce ArogyaBodha, a large-scale multilingual multimodal medical question-answer dataset constructed from eight heterogeneous sources, covering 31 body systems, six imaging modalities, and 21 clinical domains across English and seven major Indian languages. We further propose ArogyaSutra, an actor-critic-based multi-agent framework that integrates tool grounding with dual-memory mechanisms for step-wise, reasoning-aware decision making, and uses stored actor-critic simulation trajectories for distillation. Experiments show that our dataset and framework improve multilingual medical reasoning accuracy across all Indic languages, with ablations validating the contribution of each component. The source code and dataset are available at: https://iitp-cse.github.io/ ArogyaSutra/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ArogyaSutra，一个面向印度语言的多智能体多模态医疗推理框架，并构建了大规模多语言医学问答数据集 ArogyaBodha。该框架采用演员-评论家架构，结合工具调用和双记忆机制实现逐步推理，通过模拟轨迹蒸馏提升模型在低资源语言上的医疗问答准确性。
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在医疗等专业领域表现有限，尤其在多语言和低资源场景下（如印度农村地区），无法有效处理本地语言表达的复杂医疗查询和多模态输入（如医学图像），导致AI医疗辅助的公平性受限。
Method: 构建了 ArogyaBodha 数据集，涵盖8个来源、31个身体系统、6种成像模态、21个临床领域，覆盖英语和7种主要印度语言；提出 ArogyaSutra，一个基于演员-评论家的多智能体框架，集成工具调用和双记忆机制，并通过存储的模拟轨迹进行知识蒸馏。
Result: 实验表明该数据集和框架在所有印度语言上提升了多语言医疗推理准确性，消融实验验证了各组件的有效性。
Conclusion: 该工作通过构建多语言医疗数据集和多智能体推理框架，为低资源语言下的多模态医疗AI提供了可行方案，代码和数据集已开源。
Relevance: 0
