papers.title: Existence Precedes Value: Joint Modeling of Observational Existence and Evolving States in Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Real-world time series are often highly incomplete and irregular due to sensor dormancy, transmission delays, and event-driven sampling, making reliable forecasting fundamentally challenging. Existing methods have evolved from impute-then-forecast pipelines to continuous-time models such as Neural ODEs and continuous-time graph networks. While these approaches improve the modeling of historical irregularity, they still rely on an implicit oracle assumption at inference time: the timestamps of future valid observations are presumed to be known in advance. This assumption limits practical relevance, since in many real systems the more fundamental question is not only what the future value will be, but also whether a valid observation will occur at all. In this paper, we propose Timeflies, a unified framework that reformulates forecasting as a joint problem of future observability inference and value estimation. To explicitly model the interaction between observation dynamics and state evolution, Timeflies adopts an observation stream and a value stream, coupled through three dedicated modules for reliability-aware embedding, observation-guided dependency modeling, and joint prediction. We further construct Shadow, a benchmark that combines natural missingness from public datasets with real-world industrial data, and introduce the Observation-Value Joint Entropy (OVJE) metric to comprehensively evaluate this coupled predictability. Extensive experiments show that Timeflies consistently outperforms existing methods, highlighting the importance of explicitly modeling future observability in time series forecasting with missing values. Code and dataset are available in https://github.com/ant-intl/Timeflies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Timeflies框架，将时间序列预测重新定义为未来观测存在性推断与数值估计的联合问题。现有方法隐式假设未来观测时间戳已知，这在实际中不成立。Timeflies通过观测流和值流双流架构，结合可靠性感知嵌入、观测引导依赖建模和联合预测模块，显式建模观测动态与状态演化的交互。在包含公共数据和工业数据的Shadow基准上，Timeflies超越现有方法，展示了对缺失值序列中未来可观测性建模的重要性。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测方法在推理时隐式假设未来有效观测的时间戳已知，这在传感器休眠、传输延迟等实际系统中不现实；更根本的问题是未来是否会有有效观测，而非仅预测未来值。
Method: 提出Timeflies统一框架，包含观测流和值流，通过三个专用模块耦合：可靠性感知嵌入（将观测不确定性与时间信息融合）、观测引导依赖建模（利用历史观测模式指导注意力权重）、联合预测（同时输出观测存在概率和数值估计）。另构建Shadow基准（结合公共数据缺失模式与工业真实数据）并提出观测-值联合熵（OVJE）评估指标。
Result: 在Shadow基准上的大量实验表明，Timeflies在预测精度和可观测性推断上持续优于现有方法，验证了显式建模未来可观测性的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，在具有缺失值的时间序列预测中，显式建模未来观测是否存在（可观测性）对于提升预测性能至关重要。
Relevance: 50

papers.title: Adjusted Cup-Product Neural Layer
papers.abstract_en: Many important observables in physics and geometry are cup products of cochains. The adjusted cup product neural layer has been introduced in this paper. It is a neural primitive that hard wires the cup product with an adjustment term from higher gauge theory. This creates a readout that is gauge invariant by design. Their main theoretical result shows that on a closed cycle the output relies entirely on the adjustment coefficient. Setting this coefficient to zero removes the output completely regardless of other parameters. Thus the adjustment is the only source of gauge invariant signal. They prove this observable is a nonzero quadratic form and is exactly invariant under one and two gauge transformations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种调整杯积神经层（adjusted cup-product neural layer），该层将上同调中的杯积与高规范理论中的调整项硬编码为神经基元，从而在设计中保证规范不变性。理论结果证明，在闭合循环上输出完全取决于调整系数，且该调整是规范不变信号的唯一来源。
Motivation: 物理和几何中的许多重要可观测量是上同调杯积的结果，现有的神经网络结构无法保证规范不变性，导致模型预测缺乏物理一致性。
Method: 构建了一个神经层，将杯积 (cup product) 与高规范理论中的调整项结合，作为硬编码的神经网络基元，使得输出自动满足规范不变性。
Result: 理论上证明，在闭合循环上输出仅依赖于调整系数；调整系数为零时输出完全消失，且该可观测量是非零二次型，在一阶和二阶规范变换下严格不变。
Conclusion: 调整项是保证规范不变性的唯一来源，该层为物理和几何问题的神经网络建模提供了理论保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Three-Layer Framework for AI in Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Current discussions of AI in scientific discovery are often dominated by two visible capabilities: search over existing knowledge and execution through optimization, simulation, and automation. Both are important, but neither fully captures the central act of discovery: the formation and evolution of models. This paper proposes a three-layer view of AI in discovery. Layer 1 is search and retrieval by large language models. Layer 2, as the main innovation of this paper, is model formation through qualitative reasoning: the capacity to recognize when a current framework is structurally inadequate and to understand the problem within a broader representational space, not through trial and error, but through structural insight into what is missing and where it can be found. Layer 3 is execution, optimization, and refinement. The main claim is that Layer 2 is both the most important and the least developed. Search without model formation remains confined to inherited frameworks, while execution without conceptual revision only amplifies an existing formulation. We illustrate Layer 2 reasoning through three case studies: S. S. Chern's intrinsic proof of the Gauss-Bonnet theorem, the resolution of the Nesterov Accelerated Gradient convergence problem via Lyapunov functions, and the autonomous disproof of the Erdos unit distance conjecture by OpenAI in 2026. Each case exhibits the same structural signature: a framework that had become inadequate, a missing conceptual object, and a resolution found in an unexpected neighboring field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个三层框架来理解AI在科学发现中的作用：第1层是搜索与检索，第3层是执行与优化，第2层（核心创新）是通过定性推理进行模型形成——识别现有框架的结构性不足，并在更广的表征空间中理解问题。通过切赫-高斯-博内定理、Nesterov加速梯度收敛问题、Erdos单位距离猜想的三个案例说明第2层推理。
Motivation: 当前关于AI在科学发现中的讨论主要集中于搜索和执行能力，但忽略了发现的核心——模型的形成与演化。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 提出一个三层框架，其中第2层是定性推理驱动的模型形成，通过结构洞察（而非试错）识别框架缺失并找到解决方案。通过三个案例（切赫的Gauss-Bonnet证明、Nesterov加速梯度收敛、Erdos单位距离猜想的反证）展示该层的结构特征。
Result: 摘要未报告定量结果，但通过三个案例展示了第2层推理的共同模式：框架变得不充分、缺失概念对象、在意外相邻领域找到解决方案。
Conclusion: 第2层是AI在科学发现中最重要但最不发达的能力；没有模型形成的搜索局限于继承框架，没有概念修正的执行只是放大现有表述。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A2D2: Fine-Tuning Any-Length Discrete Diffusion for Adaptive Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models offer a simple and stable likelihood-based framework for sequence generation, recently extended to any-length settings via token insertion. Principled reward-guided fine-tuning for any-length discrete diffusion, however, remains largely unexplored. We introduce Fine-Tuning Any-Length Discrete Diffusion for Adaptive Decoding (A2D2), a unified framework for reward-guided fine-tuning of any-length discrete diffusion models via joint optimization of the insertion and unmasking policies together with a quality-based inference schedule. We derive the Radon-Nikodym derivative for the joint insertion-unmasking path measures, enabling theoretically guaranteed convergence to the intractable reward-tilted sequence distribution without requiring target samples. Building on this, we establish unmasking and insertion quality as tractable approaches for minimizing decoding error and introduce the Adaptive Joint Decoding (AJD) loss, which provably yields the optimal path measure that generates the reward-tilted distribution. Empirically, A2D2 improves reward optimization while enhancing generation flexibility and accuracy over prior fixed-length fine-tuning and inference-time guidance methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出A2D2框架，用于任意长度离散扩散模型的奖励引导微调，通过联合优化插入和去掩码策略以及基于质量的推理调度，推导了Radon-Nikodym导数以实现收敛到奖励倾斜分布，并引入自适应联合解码损失。实验表明A2D2在奖励优化和生成灵活性上优于先前的定长微调方法。
Motivation: 现有任意长度离散扩散模型的奖励引导微调尚未被充分探索，缺乏统一框架。
Method: 提出A2D2框架，联合优化插入和去掩码策略，推导路径测度的Radon-Nikodym导数，保证收敛到奖励倾斜分布；引入自适应联合解码损失。
Result: 摘要声称A2D2在奖励优化和生成灵活性与准确性上优于先前的定长微调和推理时指导方法。
Conclusion: A2D2为任意长度离散扩散模型提供了一种原则性的奖励引导微调方法，具有理论保证和实证改进。

papers.title: Contrast-Informed Augmentation and Domain-Adversarial Training for Adult-to-Neonatal MR Reconstruction Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: To investigate whether contrast-informed data augmentation and domain-adversarial training improve the adult-to-neonatal generalization of the E2E-VarNet. Methods: Three training regimes were investigated: (1) adult-only training with unaugmented adult data, (2) mixed training with paired unaugmented and neonatal-informed augmented adult data, and (3) mixed training with a domain-adversarial objective. Models were trained on retrospectively undersampled multi-coil adult T2-weighted brain MR data and evaluated on neonatal and adult test data at acceleration factors $R=4$ and $R=8$ using quantitative metrics and qualitative evaluation. Feature analyses assessed whether domain-adversarial training altered the latent representations of unaugmented adult, augmented adult, and neonatal test samples. Results: Mixed training (Mixed) and mixed domain-adversarial training (Mixed-DAT) outperformed unaugmented adult-only training (Unaug-Only) when evaluated on neonatal data. At R=4, Mixed-DAT achieved the best performance (SSIM = 0.924 +/- 0.027, PSNR = 33.98 +/- 1.15 dB). At R=8, Mixed-DAT performed best when measured using SSIM (0.848 +/- 0.031 vs. 0.766 +/- 0.037 for Unaug-Only and 0.814 +/- 0.035 for Mixed) and Mixed performed best when measured using PSNR (29.56 +/- 0.83 dB vs. 26.26 +/- 0.78 dB for Unaug-Only and 29.43 +/- 0.83 dB for Mixed-DAT). Qualitative assessment of t-SNE plots suggested that Mixed-DAT increased the overlap among the latent representations of the unaugmented adult, augmented adult, and neonatal test data. Conclusion: Contrast-informed augmentation and domain-adversarial training improved adult-to-neonatal generalization of deep learning-based MR reconstruction. These findings suggest that contrast-informed data augmentation combined with adversarial training may improve robustness to domain shift in undersampled neonatal MR reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对比信息增强（contrast-informed augmentation）和领域对抗训练（domain-adversarial training）能否改善E2E-VarNet从成人到新生儿MR重建的泛化能力。实验采用三种训练方案，在回顾性欠采样成人T2加权脑MR数据上训练，并在新生儿和成人测试数据上评估。结果表明，混合训练加领域对抗目标（Mixed-DAT）在新生儿数据上取得最佳SSIM（R=4时0.924，R=8时0.848），且t-SNE特征分析显示领域对抗增加了不同领域潜在表示的重叠。
Motivation: 成人训练的MR重建模型在新生儿数据上因域偏移（domain shift）而性能下降，现有方法缺乏针对对比信息增强和领域对抗训练结合的研究。
Method: 基于E2E-VarNet框架，研究三种训练策略：（1）仅使用未增强成人数据训练；（2）混合未增强成人数据和新生儿信息增强的成人数据训练；（3）在混合训练基础上加入领域对抗目标（domain-adversarial objective）。所有模型在回顾性欠采样多线圈成人T2加权脑MR数据上训练，在R=4和R=8加速因子下评估。
Result: 混合训练（Mixed）和混合领域对抗训练（Mixed-DAT）在新生儿测试数据上均优于仅成人未增强训练（Unaug-Only）。R=4时，Mixed-DAT的SSIM=0.924±0.027，PSNR=33.98±1.15 dB，为最佳；R=8时，Mixed-DAT的SSIM最高（0.848±0.031），而Mixed的PSNR最高（29.56±0.83 dB）。t-SNE可视化表明Mixed-DAT增加了未增强成人、增强成人和新生儿测试数据潜在表示的叠合程度。
Conclusion: 对比信息增强和领域对抗训练有效提升了深度学习MR重建从成人到新生儿的泛化能力，表明结合这两种方法可增强对欠采样新生儿MR重建中域偏移的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Edit the Bits, Diff the Codes: Bitwise Residual Editing for Visual Autoregressive Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided image editing with visual autoregressive (VAR) generators requires controlling both what the model samples and where the sampled change is written back into the image code. Existing VAR editors mainly operate on token streams, features, or flat next-token logits, leaving two native structures of bitwise-residual VAR models underused: the per-bit Bernoulli prediction head and the additive multi-scale residual code field from which the image is assembled. We propose BitResEdit, a training-free editor for bitwise-residual VAR generators such as Infinity. BitEdit performs source-negative guidance by tilting the post-CFG per-bit log-odds along a source--target contrast computed on a shared edited prefix, then projects each update into a closed-form Bernoulli-KL trust region around the clean CFG sampler. ResEdit converts the sampled bits into per-scale continuous-code residuals, gates them with a localization mask, and re-injects them through the generator's native sum-of-scales. Together they couple decision-time bit guidance with combination-time code composition, so masked-out latent features are preserved exactly by code arithmetic while localized, scale-aware edits are applied inside the target region. On PIE-Bench with Infinity-2B, BitResEdit attains the strongest text alignment among same-backbone VAR editors, improving CLIP on the edited region by +1.07 over the strongest prior editor while keeping background preservation competitive with it. Ablations show BitEdit and ResEdit play complementary roles in target alignment and background preservation.

TL;DR: 本文提出 BitResEdit，一种无需训练的编辑器，用于位残差视觉自回归生成器（如 Infinity）。它通过 BitEdit 和 ResEdit 两个组件，分别进行逐位伯努利预测头的源-目标对比引导和按尺度连续码残差编辑，实现了编辑区域内的文本对齐与背景保持。
Motivation: 现有视觉自回归（VAR）编辑方法未充分利用位残差 VAR 模型的两种原生结构：逐位伯努利预测头和加性多尺度残差码场。
Method: 提出 BitResEdit，包含 BitEdit（基于源-目标对比的位级贝叶斯信任域引导）和 ResEdit（将采样位转换为按尺度连续码残差，用定位掩码选通并重新注入生成器）。

papers.title: Is It You or Your Environment? A Bayesian Inference Framework for Genomically-Anchored Personalized Physiological Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized health AI systems face a fundamental cold-start problem: machine learning models for physiological interpretation require weeks of individual behavioral data before they can distinguish constitutional variation from environmentally driven deviation. We propose a solution grounded in causal inference and Bayesian prior design. An individual's genomic profile serves as an exogenous genetic anchor -- a domain-informed, personalized prior that is fixed at conception, immune to reverse causation, and available before a single behavioral observation is collected. The anchor initializes a Bayesian belief state over an individual's physiological set point G-hat = mu + sum(beta_i * g_i), where beta_i are GWAS-derived effect sizes and g_i are risk-allele counts. Each incoming physiological measurement P produces a non-constitutional deviation delta = P - G-hat that separates the signal attributable to environment and state from the constitutionally fixed baseline. As behavioral data accrue, the prior decays according to G-hat_t = w(t)*G-hat_genomic + [1-w(t)]*P-bar_t, transitioning from genome-dominated to empirical-baseline-dominated inference. The same observed HRV of 55 ms generates a suppression hypothesis for a person whose prior predicts 80 ms, and an enhancement hypothesis for a person whose prior predicts 30 ms -- a reversal impossible without a personalized anchor. We develop this architecture across six physiological domains, grading genomic priors by evidence strength, distinguishing robustly replicated anchors (FTO, FADS1/2, FKBP5) from contested candidate genes (SLC6A4, MAOA, DRD2). We address the inference boundary between association, Mendelian randomization, and individual token causation, and define four constraints for deployment: evidence-graded priors, dynamic decay, ancestry-matched effect sizes, and attribution rather than deterministic output.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯推理的框架，利用个体的基因组谱作为先验，解决个性化健康AI的冷启动问题。该框架通过将基因锚定先验与生理测量相结合，区分体质变异和环境引起的偏差，并逐步从基因组主导过渡到经验基线主导的推理。
Motivation: 现有个性化生理解释的机器学习模型需要数周的行为数据才能区分体质变异和环境驱动偏差，存在冷启动问题。
Method: 提出基于因果推断和贝叶斯先验设计的框架：利用基因组谱作为外生遗传锚定，初始化基于GWAS效应大小的贝叶斯信念状态；每个生理测量计算非体质偏差δ = P - Ĝ；行为数据累积后，先验通过权重衰减函数从基因组主导过渡到经验基线主导。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，但描述了框架能在没有行为数据的情况下生成个性化推理，例如相同HRV值对不同基因先验的人产生不同解释。
Conclusion: 该框架提出了四个部署约束：证据分级的先验、动态衰减、祖先匹配的效应大小、属性而非确定性输出。并讨论了关联、孟德尔随机化和个体因果推理之间的边界。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Hybrid Retrieval for Long-Document RAG
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) depends critically on the quality and granularity of retrieved evidence. Large retrieval units preserve context but often introduce irrelevant content, which can dilute answer bearing evidence and worsen long context utilization. Fine-grained units are more compact, but they may be difficult to retrieve reliably because short chunks can lack semantic, lexical, or bridging cues needed to match the query. We propose Uncertainty-aware Multi-Granularity RAG (UMG-RAG), a training-free hybrid retrieval framework that treats chunk granularity as query-specific reliability estimation. Instead of training a new retriever or modifying the generator, UMG-RAG uses existing dense and sparse retrievers as complementary experts across multiple chunk granularities. For each query, it converts each expert-granularity score list into an evidence distribution, estimates reliability from distribution entropy, and fuses candidates according to query-specific semantic, lexical, and granularity confidence. We further introduce UMGP-RAG, a parent promotion variant that uses fine-grained hits to locate relevant evidence while returning broader non-redundant parent chunks for local coherence. Experiments on question answering benchmarks show that uncertainty-aware fusion and parent promotion improve generation quality while maintaining a lightweight, plug-and-play retrieval pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Uncertainty-aware Multi-Granularity RAG (UMG-RAG)，一种无需训练、即插即用的混合检索框架，通过估计不同粒度分块的不确定性来融合密集与稀疏检索结果，提升长文档问答质量。还引入父级提升变体 UMGP-RAG，利用细粒度命中定位证据并返回非冗余父块。实验表明该方法在问答基准上改进生成质量。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 系统在检索粒度上存在矛盾：大检索块保留上下文但引入噪声，小检索块紧凑但缺乏检索线索。需要一种能根据查询自动调整检索粒度的机制。
Method: 将现有密集和稀疏检索器作为多粒度互补专家，对每个查询将各专家-粒度得分列表转为证据分布，利用分布熵估计可靠性，并按语义、词汇和粒度置信度融合候选。UMGP-RAG 进一步通过细粒度命中定位证据并返回父块以保持局部连贯性。
Result: 在问答基准上，基于不确定性的融合和父级提升方法在保持轻量、即插即用流水线的同时，提升了生成质量。
Conclusion: 该方法无需训练或修改生成器，可灵活应用于现有 RAG 系统，但实验仅限于问答任务，未涉及其他长文档任务。

papers.title: Symmetry-electronic fingerprints reveal competing magnetic phases in two-dimensional materials
papers.abstract_en: Two-dimensional magnets offer compelling platforms for spintronics and quantum technologies, yet predicting their magnetic ground states, moments, and anisotropy remains challenging. This limitation primarily arises because existing machine-learning representations encode chemical environments without capturing the symmetry or exchange physics that govern magnetism. In this work, we introduce the symmetry-electronic fingerprint (SEF), a physically interpretable representation that encodes crystallographic symmetry operations, Wyckoff-site geometry, together with site-resolved electronic structure. Combined with ensemble learning with random forests, the SEF accurately classifies magnetic ordering while regressing moments alongside anisotropy energies while simultaneously resolving the distinct regimes of itinerant Stoner ferromagnetism from localized superexchange. What sets the SEF-trained models apart is that regions of elevated model uncertainty are not a failure but a diagnostic, identifying materials where these mechanisms compete. First-principles calculations on Co- and Ni-based halides and oxides confirm that these regions correspond to genuine near-degenerate FM and AFM phases with magnetic frustration, suppressed anisotropy, and emergent non-collinear ordering. By encoding symmetry together with exchange physics directly into the representation unlike conventional descriptors, the SEF transforms model uncertainty into a compass pointing toward two-dimensional materials where small perturbations drive transitions between collinear, frustrated, or non-collinear magnetic phases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对称电子指纹（SEF）表示，编码晶体对称操作、Wyckoff位点几何和位点分辨电子结构，结合随机森林集成学习，用于分类二维材料的磁序、回归磁矩和磁各向异性能，并能区分斯通纳铁磁性和局域超交换。在Co/Ni基卤化物和氧化物上验证，高模型不确定性区域对应近简并的铁磁和反铁磁相，具有磁阻挫和抑制各向异性。
Motivation: 现有机器学习表示无法捕捉对称性和交换物理，导致预测二维磁性材料基态、磁矩和磁各向异性困难。
Method: 引入对称电子指纹（SEF）表示，集成晶体对称操作、Wyckoff位点几何和电子结构信息，结合随机森林集成学习进行磁序分类和磁矩/各向异性能回归。
Result: 摘要表明SEF准确分类磁序，回归磁矩和磁各向异性能，并区分斯通纳铁磁性和局域超交换。高模型不确定性区域对应近简并的铁磁和反铁磁相，带有磁阻挫、抑制各向异性和非共线序。
Conclusion: SEF将模型不确定性转化为指向二维材料中竞争相的指南，其中小扰动可驱动相变。

papers.title: Adaptive Turn-Taking for Real-time Multi-Party Voice Agents
papers.abstract_en: Turn-taking in multi-party spoken conversations remains a fundamental challenge for voice-based agents, particularly under dynamic floor competition and varying user expectations. We propose ModeratorLM, a role-playing voice agent that conditions turn-taking behavior on an explicitly assigned role in multi-party settings. The system is built on a speech large language model operating in chunk-wise streaming manner. We further introduce a reasoning-augmented variant that incorporates chain-of-thought reasoning over conversational context and the assigned role. We construct RolePlayConv, a large-scale synthetic dataset of spoken multi-party conversations with diverse assistant roles. Experiments on real-world meeting data and RolePlayConv show improved turn-taking precision by over 40% and recall by more than 70%, while substantially reducing false-positive interruptions compared to non-role-conditioned baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ModeratorLM，一个基于角色扮演的语音智能体，通过显式分配角色来调节多方对话中的轮次切换行为。系统基于流式分块处理的语音大语言模型，并引入基于推理的变体，利用链式思考对对话上下文和分配角色进行推理。作者构建了 RolePlayConv 合成数据集，实验表明轮次切换精确率提升超过 40%，召回率提升超过 70%，同时大幅减少误报中断。
Motivation: 多方对话中动态的抢话竞争和不同的用户期望使得轮次切换成为语音智能体的核心挑战，现有方法缺乏对明确角色条件的利用。
Method: 提出 ModeratorLM 角色扮演语音智能体，基于流式分块语音大语言模型，并引入推理增强变体，在对话上下文和分配角色上使用链式思考推理。同时构建大规模合成多方对话数据集 RolePlayConv。
Result: 在真实会议数据和 RolePlayConv 上，轮次切换精确率提升超过 40%，召回率提升超过 70%，并显著减少误报中断。
Conclusion: 通过显式角色条件化可以显著改善多方对话中语音智能体的轮次切换性能。

papers.title: NetCause: Counterfactual Learning for Root Cause Analysis in Large-Scale Networks
papers.abstract_en: Can a learned model capture how faults propagate through a large-scale network and use this knowledge to causally attribute customer impact to its underlying root cause? Existing root cause analysis techniques often rely on static rules, correlation heuristics, or topology-local reasoning, which struggle to generalize in dynamic environments where faults propagate across complex physical and logical dependencies. We present NetCause, a self-supervised learning-based framework that models network incidents as graph-temporal processes and uses counterfactual simulation to rank candidate root causes. This approach produces an interpretable ranking of root cause hypotheses and integrates naturally with operator-defined mitigation and remediation actions. We train the model on over 1,500 incidents collected over six months from a leading cloud provider's production network and evaluate it on 31 expert-labeled incidents. NetCause consistently improves root cause ranking quality in the regime most relevant to operational decision-making, achieving a 16.1% accuracy improvement over a rule-based heuristic baseline. While training is computationally intensive, inference is lightweight, requiring only seconds of GPU runtime per incident (well below typical telemetry collection latencies).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NetCause，一个基于自监督学习的框架，将网络故障建模为图时序过程，并通过反事实模拟来排序候选根因。该方法在云生产网络的 1500 多个故障训练和 31 个专家标注事故上，根因排序质量提升 16.1%，推理仅需数秒。
Motivation: 现有根因分析技术依赖静态规则或相关启发式，难以泛化到故障跨复杂物理逻辑依赖传播的动态网络环境。
Method: NetCause 将网络故障建模为图时序过程，采用自监督学习和反事实模拟来生成根因假设的可解释排序，并集成运维定义的缓解与修复动作。
Result: 在领先云提供商生产网络的 31 个专家标注事故上，NetCause 相比基于规则的基线在根因排序准确率上提升 16.1%，推理时间仅需数秒 GPU。
Conclusion: 该方法在运营决策最相关的故障规模上持续改善根因排序质量，训练虽计算密集但推理轻量，适合部署。

papers.title: AgentRivet: an automated system for producing Rivet routines from journal publications
papers.abstract_en: Particle physics collider experiments provide Rivet routines as part of the analysis preservation strategy for model-independent measurements. Rivet is a C++ toolkit that allow new theoretical models to be compared to the measurements, thus aiding the development and tuning of Monte Carlo event generators as well as searches for physics beyond the Standard Model. However, analysis coverage is known to be incomplete, with only 39% of measurements having documented and publicly available Rivet routines. In this article, we design and implement an automated workflow based on Large Language Models with the goal of providing the missing routines. This multi-step workflow, referred to as AgentRivet, extracts the physics analysis information from published papers and writes the missing Rivet routines, with intermediate code- and physics- reviews as part of an autonomous quality control. We report the results obtained using commercial Large Language Models, provided by OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, for two recent measurements from the ATLAS and CMS experiments. We find that AgentRivet produces competent Rivet routines with few syntax errors. The physics fidelity of the routines is reasonable and follows the explanations given in the relevant publications. Nevertheless, physics-implementation issues do arise and are investigated using the artefacts produced by AgentRivet. The majority of physics implementation issues arise from subtle-but-ambiguous definitions in the given publication, although some models struggle to implement complex observables even when clear definitions are given.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentRivet，一个基于大语言模型的自动化系统，用于从期刊论文中提取物理分析信息并生成缺失的 Rivet 例程。该系统包含多步骤工作流，包括代码和物理审查，并在 ATLAS 和 CMS 实验的两次测量中进行了测试，生成的例程语法错误少，物理保真度合理，但存在由于论文定义模糊导致的物理实现问题。
Motivation: 粒子物理对撞实验的 Rivet 例程覆盖率仅 39%，不完整的例程阻碍了蒙特卡洛事件生成器的调优和新物理搜索。
Method: 设计并实现了一个基于大语言模型的多步骤自动化工作流（AgentRivet），从论文提取物理分析信息，编写缺失的 Rivet 例程，并集成中间代码和物理审查作为自主质量控制。
Result: 使用 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google 的商业大语言模型，对 ATLAS 和 CMS 的两次测量生成例程，发现语法错误少，物理保真度合理，但部分物理实现问题源于论文中细微但模糊的定义。
Conclusion: AgentRivet 能自动生成可用的 Rivet 例程，但物理实现问题仍存在，主要源于论文定义不清，即使清晰定义时复杂观测量仍可能实现困难。

papers.title: Graphical Causal Reasoning for Root Cause Analysis in Cloud Networks
papers.abstract_en: Cloud-computing relies on large-scale networks which are inherently complex systems. In this paper, we present a novel approach to root cause analysis (RCA) of cloud network incidents, leveraging graph-based causal discovery techniques. Our method addresses the limitations of rule-based automation by introducing a spatiotemporal grouping strategy and an automation ontology to reduce the dimensionality of the problem. We construct a causal graph from binary time series data using bivariate Granger causality and conditional independence tests. For inference, we introduce a probabilistic method that assigns edge-specific conditional probabilities as a function of time lag, allowing for interpretable, time-aware root cause scoring via causal graph traversal. We evaluated the system using a labeled dataset of 35 production incidents from a major cloud provider. The model successfully recalled the correct root cause in 85.7% of incidents and produced an exact match in 74.3%. In production, the deployed system has been used in over 800 real-world incidents, with positive qualitative feedback from network engineers. These results highlight the practicality of a data-driven, causal approach to RCA in dynamic and large-scale operational environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图因果推理的云网络根因分析方法（RCA），利用二元Granger因果性和条件独立性测试从二进制时序数据构建因果图，并通过时空分组与自动化本体降低问题维度。推理时引入基于时间滞后的边条件概率，实现可解释的根因评分。在35个生产事故数据集上达到85.7%的召回率和74.3%的精确匹配，并在800+真实事故中部署验证。
Motivation: 现有基于规则的自化RCA方法在处理复杂云网络时存在局限性，需要更通用、数据驱动的因果推理方法。
Method: 提出结合时空分组和自动化本体的因果发现框架，使用双变量Granger因果性和条件独立性测试构建有向因果图；推理时通过因果图遍历，计算每条边随滞后时间的条件概率，得到根因评分。
Result: 在35个生产事故上，模型正确召回根因占比85.7%，精确匹配占比74.3%；系统已在800+实际事故中使用，获得网络工程师积极反馈。
Conclusion: 该研究展示了数据驱动的因果方法在动态大规模网络运营中用于根因分析的实用性和有效性。

papers.title: Ride, Track, and Recover: Pilot Randomized Trial of a Wearable Digital Self-Management Intervention During a Veteran Endurance-Cycling Program
papers.abstract_en: Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) in veterans is characterized by persistent hyperarousal and comorbid anxiety and depressive symptoms that are difficult to monitor and manage outside clinical settings. Thirteen veterans participating in a Project Hero cycling event in Texas were randomized by computer-generated sequence in a naturalistic setting to two arms: (1) digital intervention plus physical activity, or (2) physical activity only, plus a third at-home monitoring control cohort consisting of 7 veterans selected from the broader Project Hero veteran community. Continuous smartwatch sensing combined heart rate and accelerometer features to detect hyperarousal events, which were confirmed in real time by participants. Weekly self-report measures of anxiety, depression, and PTSD severity were collected. Generalized additive mixed models characterized nonlinear trajectories over time. Baseline-normalized hyperarousal trajectories differed significantly across conditions, with the digital intervention group (n=7) showing structured stabilization compared to late-study escalation in the physical-only group (n=3). Both cycling groups exhibited acute symptom improvements during the endurance event; however, the digital intervention group demonstrated a higher overall maintenance of gains. The at-home control group (n=4) showed gradual symptom declines. Perceived precision of ML detections varied substantially across individuals and was positively associated with symptom severity, with higher-severity participants confirming a greater proportion of detected events. These results suggest that coupling wearable detection with digital self-management tools may support stabilization of hyperarousal and symptom improvement while emphasizing the importance of personalization and human-centered design in wearable mental health systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文报告了一项针对退伍军人PTSD的初步随机试验，将可穿戴智能手表检测高唤醒事件与数字自我管理工具相结合，并与仅进行体力活动及居家对照组比较。结果表明数字干预组的高唤醒轨迹更稳定，症状改善维持更好，但机器学习检测的感知精度因人而异，与症状严重程度呈正相关。
Motivation: 退伍军人PTSD的持续高唤醒及共病焦虑抑郁症状难以在临床环境外监测和管理，需要可穿戴数字干预来支持自我管理。
Method: 13名退伍军人被随机分为数字干预加体力活动组、仅体力活动组，以及额外的居家监测对照组。使用智能手表连续感测心率和加速度计特征检测高唤醒事件，由参与者实时确认；每周收集焦虑、抑郁和PTSD严重程度的自我报告。采用广义加性混合模型刻画非线性轨迹。
Result: 基线归一化高唤醒轨迹在组间显著不同，数字干预组显示结构化稳定，而仅体力活动组在后期恶化。耐力活动期间两组均有急性症状改善，但数字干预组总体维持收益更好。居家对照组症状逐渐下降。ML检测感知精度个体差异大，且与症状严重程度正相关。
Conclusion: 将可穿戴检测与数字自我管理工具结合可能支持高唤醒稳定和症状改善，同时强调个性化与以人为中心的设计在可穿戴心理健康系统中的重要性。

papers.title: What's Old is New Again: Classical Dimensionality Reduction for Efficient Saliency-Guided Biometric Attack Detection
papers.abstract_en: Saliency-guided training is a paradigm in visual recognition that encourages models to focus on the most relevant image regions during learning. While its application in biometric presentation attack detection (PAD) has shown strong benefits in robustness and generalization, adoption is often limited by the high cost, domain specificity, and limited scalability of existing saliency acquisition methods, such as human annotations over a limited dataset. We present a novel, cost-efficient, and highly-scalable approach to saliency acquisition using maps inspired by classical dimensionality reduction techniques: PCA and LDA. Our proposed methods generate saliency maps directly from raw training data, requiring no human annotation nor domain knowledge. We contextualize the effectiveness of these saliency sources in three saliency-explored domains (iris PAD, synthetic face detection, fingerprint PAD) and demonstrate its scalability in two saliency-novel domains (fingerprint vein PAD and ID card PAD). Across all domains tested, models trained using dimensionality reduction-sourced saliency maps exceed baseline and sometimes SOTA saliency methods without any resource investment or domain-specific tooling. Our findings overcome an important yet unaddressed barrier to saliency-guided training for biometric attack detection and beyond.
papers.comment: 16 pages (8 main, 2 references, 6 appendix), 4 figures (3 main, 1 appendix), 13 tables (3 main, 10 appendix)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用PCA和LDA等经典降维技术直接从原始训练数据生成显著性图，用于生物特征呈现攻击检测（PAD），无需人工标注或领域知识。在虹膜PAD、合成人脸检测、指纹PAD等三个领域验证有效性，并在指纹静脉PAD和身份证PAD两个新领域展示可扩展性。使用降维显著性图训练的模型在多个任务上超越基线和部分SOTA方法，且无需额外资源或领域特定工具。
Motivation: 现有显著性引导训练虽然能提升生物特征PAD的鲁棒性和泛化性，但显著性图获取成本高、领域特异性强、可扩展性有限，如依赖人工标注。
Method: 提出基于经典降维技术PCA和LDA的显著性图生成方法，直接从原始训练数据计算，无需标注或领域知识。
Result: 在虹膜PAD、合成人脸检测、指纹PAD三个领域验证，并在指纹静脉PAD和身份证PAD两个新领域展示可扩展性。使用降维显著性图训练的模型超越基线和部分SOTA方法。
Conclusion: 该方法克服了显著性引导训练在生物特征攻击检测中的关键障碍，具有成本效益和可扩展性。

papers.title: MaskWAM: Unifying Mask Prompting and Prediction for World-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) present a promising paradigm for robotic control via video prediction. However, current WAMs suffer from fundamental spatial bottlenecks: standard text inputs introduce referential ambiguity in cluttered scenes, while unstructured RGB predictions lack semantic grounding and remain biased by task-irrelevant backgrounds. To overcome these limitations, we introduce MaskWAM, an object-centric world-action model. By jointly integrating masks as both explicit inputs and predictions via a unified Mixture of Transformers (MoT), MaskWAM unlocks robust policy generalization. This design provides two key benefits: (1) predicting future masks yields object-centric semantic supervision that suppresses visual noise, significantly enhancing even standard text-conditioned WAMs; and (2) coupling this predictive supervision with first-frame visual prompts, such as target object masks, establishes a precise spatial anchor that substantially reduces language ambiguity. Crucially, as WAMs are inherently vision-driven architectures, direct mask conditioning yields substantially stronger guidance than text alone, establishing a precise and robust paradigm for manipulating unseen objects. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and real-world tasks demonstrate that MaskWAM significantly outperforms baselines in both language-clear and language-ambiguous tasks.

papers.title: CloudCons: A Comprehensive End-to-End Benchmark for Cloud Resource Consolidation
papers.abstract_en: Driven by conservative over-provisioning to guarantee service reliability, resource utilization in cloud data centers remains at low levels. To mitigate this, the forecast-then-optimize paradigm has emerged to optimize consolidation by anticipating future demands. While emerging time series foundation models promise to enhance this paradigm through zero-shot generalization, existing benchmarks focus solely on prediction error metrics. The actual decision utility of these advanced models remains unverified, rendering their practical value for downstream tasks uncertain. To bridge this gap, we propose CloudCons, a comprehensive end-to-end benchmark designed to evaluate forecasting models within the specific context of cloud resource consolidation. We build high-quality datasets that cover diverse workloads from Huawei Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Google Borg, capturing distinct service characteristics ranging from synchronized diurnal rhythms to stochastic, pulse-like bursts and high-frequency noise. We conduct an extensive evaluation of statistical, deep learning, and foundation models. Our experiments reveal a pivotal finding: while foundation models demonstrate superior zero-shot forecasting accuracy, this advantage does not inherently translate into better decision utility. Of practical significance, we systematically analyze how the selection of predictive quantiles acts as a critical lever. We provide actionable guidelines for calibrating these selections to balance the trade-off between resource efficiency and service reliability, offering vital insights for real-world deployment decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CloudCons，一个面向云资源整合场景的端到端基准测试，用于评估预测模型在资源整合中的决策效用。实验覆盖华为云、微软Azure和Google Borg的多样性负载，对比统计、深度学习和基础模型，发现基础模型在零样本预测精度上占优但未转化为更好的决策效用，并分析了预测分位数选择对资源效率与可靠性的权衡。
Motivation: 现有云资源整合基准仅关注预测误差指标，未评估先进模型在下游决策任务中的实际效用，导致其实际价值不明确。
Method: 构建包含同步昼夜节律、随机脉冲突发和高频噪声等特征的高质量数据集，系统评估统计、深度学习和基础模型，并分析预测分位数选择对整合决策的影响。
Result: 基础模型在零样本预测精度上优于传统方法，但该优势并未自然转化为更好的资源整合决策效用；预测分位数的校准是平衡资源效率与服务可靠性的关键杠杆。
Conclusion: 强调了在云资源整合中评估预测模型决策效用的重要性，并提供了实际部署中调整分位数选择的指导。

papers.title: Measurement-Calibrated Multi-Camera Fusion for Vision-Based Indoor Localization
papers.abstract_en: Indoor vision-based localization systems are affected by detection noise, occlusions, and limited camera coverage, leading to uncertainty at multiple stages of the pipeline. While multi-camera data fusion is widely used to mitigate these issues, it is typically treated as a black-box component and evaluated solely end-to-end, obscuring its mechanistic contributions. To address this gap, this work investigates whether explicitly characterizing single-camera localization errors can be leveraged to calibrate and optimize multi-camera data fusion. We introduce a measurement-calibrated fusion approach that integrates component-wise error quantification, specifically isolating homography calibration, human detection, and motion tracking. A component-wise evaluation is conducted to quantify error contributions from homography calibration, human detection, and motion tracking. Experimental results show that data fusion improves localization accuracy compared to single-camera baselines. While measurement-calibrated fusion provides only limited improvement in absolute accuracy over standard fusion, it substantially reduces trajectory variance and improves motion smoothness, which are critical for applications requiring stable and continuous motion estimates. These results highlight the value of explicit error characterization when designing data fusion strategies for vision-based indoor positioning systems.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the IEEE 22st International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究室内视觉定位系统中多相机数据融合的效果，提出一种测量校准的融合方法，该方法明确量化单相机误差（包括单应性校准、人体检测和运动跟踪）。实验表明，与单相机基线相比，数据融合提高了定位精度；测量校准融合相比标准融合在绝对精度上改进有限，但显著降低了轨迹方差并提高了运动平滑性。
Motivation: 现有室内视觉定位系统受检测噪声、遮挡和相机覆盖限制影响，而多相机融合通常作为黑盒组件评估，其机制贡献不明确。本文旨在通过显式表征单相机定位误差来校准和优化多相机融合。
Method: 提出测量校准融合方法，集成组件级误差量化，分别隔离单应性校准、人体检测和运动跟踪的误差贡献，并进行组件级评估。
Result: 数据融合相比单相机基线提高了定位精度；测量校准融合在绝对精度上仅提供有限改进，但显著降低了轨迹方差并提高了运动平滑性。
Conclusion: 显式误差表征有助于设计视觉定位系统的数据融合策略，尤其对于需要稳定连续运动估计的应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Heterogeneous LiDAR Early Fusion and Learned Re-Ranking Strategy for Robust Long-Term Place Recognition in Unstructured Environments
papers.abstract_en: Robust localization in unstructured environments, such as agricultural fields, is a critical challenge for autonomous systems. LiDAR sensors provide detailed 3D information about the environment and are invariant to lighting conditions. For this reason, LiDAR-based place recognition methods have gained significant attention. In this paper, we propose MinkUNeXt-VINE++, a novel approach that combines early fusion of heterogeneous LiDAR data from two sensors (Livox Mid-360 and Velodyne VLP-16) and a learned re-ranking strategy in inference time. This fusion leverages the strengths of each sensor to provide a more comprehensive representation of the environment. Additionally, the re-ranking approach is particularly important in repetitive environments, such as vineyards, as finding true positives is a major challenge. We evaluated our approach using the TEMPO-VINE dataset, which provides heterogeneous LiDAR data in vineyard environments across different phenological stages. Our results demonstrate that MinkUNeXt-VINE++ significantly improves place recognition performance compared to single-sensor approaches and state-of-the-art methods. MinkUNeXt-VINE++ achieves a 20% improvement in the Recall@1 metric compared to single-sensor approaches, and +30% including re-ranking. The code of our method is publicly available for reproduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MinkUNeXt-VINE++方法，通过异质LiDAR传感器（Livox Mid-360和Velodyne VLP-16）的早期融合和推理时的学习重排序策略，提升非结构化环境（如葡萄园）中的长期地点识别鲁棒性。在TEMPO-VINE数据集上，Recall@1相比单传感器方法提升20%，加入重排序后提升30%。
Motivation: 非结构化环境（如农业领域）中的鲁棒定位是自主系统的关键挑战，而重复场景（如葡萄园）的假阳性问题使得地点识别困难。
Method: 提出MinkUNeXt-VINE++，包含两个核心：1) 异质LiDAR数据的早期融合，结合不同传感器的互补优势；2) 推理时使用学习重排序策略，提高重复环境中真阳性的识别精度。
Result: 在TEMPO-VINE数据集上，Recall@1相比单传感器方法提升20%，加入重排序后进一步提升30%，优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 异质LiDAR早期融合结合重排序策略能显著提升非结构化环境下的长期地点识别性能，代码已开源。

papers.title: GF-DiT: Scheduling Parallelism for Diffusion Transformer Serving
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become the dominant architecture for image and video generation, creating growing demand for efficient DiT serving. Existing systems assign each request a fixed parallel configuration throughout its lifetime. However, DiT workloads exhibit substantial heterogeneity across requests, execution stages, and system conditions, making static parallelism inefficient and often leading to poor GPU utilization and degraded service quality. This paper argues that DiT serving should treat GPU parallelism as a first-class schedulable resource. We present GF-DiT, a policy-programmable runtime for elastic DiT serving that dynamically adapts the parallelism of running requests according to workload demands and service objectives. GF-DiT introduces an asynchronous execution abstraction that decomposes requests into independently schedulable trajectory tasks and enables online GPU reallocation. To make elastic parallelism practical, GF-DiT further proposes group-free collectives, a lightweight communication abstraction that supports low-overhead online formation and reconfiguration of arbitrary execution groups. We implement GF-DiT in vLLM-Omni and evaluate it on representative image and video diffusion workloads. Compared with fixed-pipeline execution with static parallelism, GF-DiT improves throughput by up to 6.01$\times$, reduces mean latency by up to 95%, lowers SLO violation rates by up to 90%, and reduces communication-group setup overhead from 778 ms to approximately 60 $μ$s.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GF-DiT，一个策略可编程的运行时系统，用于弹性扩散 Transformer (DiT) 服务。它通过将请求分解为独立可调度的轨迹任务，并支持在线 GPU 重分配，动态调整运行请求的并行度。相比固定并行度执行，GF-DiT 在图像和视频扩散工作负载上实现了最高 6.01 倍的吞吐量提升、95% 的平均延迟降低和 90% 的 SLO 违反率降低。
Motivation: 现有 DiT 服务系统为每个请求使用固定的并行配置，但 DiT 工作负载在请求、执行阶段和系统条件上存在显著异质性，导致静态并行效率低下、GPU 利用率不佳和服务质量下降。
Method: 提出 GF-DiT 运行时，引入异步执行抽象将请求分解为独立可调度的轨迹任务，并支持在线 GPU 重分配；同时提出无组集合 (group-free collectives) 轻量级通信抽象，支持低开销的在线执行组形成和重新配置。
Result: 在与固定流水线静态并行执行的对比中，GF-DiT 将吞吐量提升至多 6.01 倍，平均延迟降低至多 95%，SLO 违反率降低至多 90%，通信组设置开销从 778 ms 降至约 60 μs。
Conclusion: 论文认为 DiT 服务应将 GPU 并行度视为一阶可调度资源，GF-DiT 通过弹性并行调度显著提升了服务效率。

papers.title: SPARC: Reliable Spatial Annotations from Robot Demonstrations at Scale
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces Spatial Annotations from Robot Demonstrations with Reliability Calibration (SPARC), a risk-aware framework that automatically labels robot demonstrations with structured spatial annotations and assigns each annotation a reliability score. Structured spatial annotations, such as bounding boxes, object trajectories, and manipulation phase labels, benefit a broad range of robotics applications from training grounded robot policies and embodied foundation models to motion planning and hierarchical task composition. Existing automated pipelines generate such annotations at scale but provide no reliable quality signal: detector confidence is poorly calibrated for annotation correctness, forcing a choice between accepting noisy labels or discarding useful samples. In contrast to existing automated pipelines, SPARC leverages the spatio-temporal structure inherent to robot tasks to generate a reliability signal, reducing noisy labels and retaining more useful samples. We further introduce Interaction-Aware Bench (IA-Bench), a benchmark that measures model accuracy in grounding the locations of interacted objects in robot demonstrations. On 1.7k human-annotated demonstrations spanning diverse embodiments and scenarios, SPARC significantly outperforms detection-only baselines in localization accuracy while retaining three times more samples at high-precision operating points. Our experiments demonstrate that models finetuned on our annotations achieve state-of-the-art results on object-grounding and pointing benchmarks among similarly sized models, while remaining competitive on broader spatial-reasoning suites without manually verified or annotated training data. Furthermore, policies trained on SPARC-generated annotations outperform baselines in cluttered, visually ambiguous real-world scenes. Code, data, and models are available at intuitive-robots.github.io/sparc-labeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SPARC 是一个风险感知框架，用于自动为机器人演示生成结构化空间注释（如边界框、对象轨迹和操作阶段标签），并为每个注释分配可靠性分数。与仅依赖检测置信度的现有管道不同，SPARC 利用机器人任务中的时空结构来生成可靠性信号，从而减少噪声标签并保留更多有用样本。在1.7k个人工标注演示上，SPARC 在定位精度上显著优于纯检测基线，同时在高精度操作点保留三倍样本。基于其注释微调的模型在对象接地和指代基准上达到同类模型的最新水平，并在杂乱、视觉模糊的真实场景中训练的策略优于基线。
Motivation: 现有自动化注释管道生成大规模注释但缺乏可靠的质量信号：检测器置信度与注释正确性校准不佳，导致用户必须在接受噪声标签或丢弃有用样本之间做出选择。
Method: SPARC 利用机器人任务中固有的时空结构来生成可靠性信号，从而降低噪声标签并保留更多有用样本。具体通过时空一致性校验等方法实现。
Result: 在1.7k个人工标注演示上，SPARC 在定位精度上显著优于纯检测基线，同时在高精度操作点保留三倍样本。微调模型在对象接地和指代基准上达到同类最佳，且训练的策略在杂乱真实场景中优于基线。
Conclusion: SPARC 提供了一种可靠且可扩展的机器人演示空间注释方法，能够提高注释质量并支持下游任务。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有自动化注释管道生成大规模注释但缺乏可靠的质量信号：检测器置信度与注释正确性校准不佳，导致用户必须在接受噪声标签或丢弃有用样本之间做出选择。
summary_sections.method: SPARC 利用机器人任务中固有的时空结构来生成可靠性信号，从而降低噪声标签并保留更多有用样本。具体通过时空一致性校验等方法实现。
summary_sections.result: 在1.7k个人工标注演示上，SPARC 在定位精度上显著优于纯检测基线，同时在高精度操作点保留三倍样本。微调模型在对象接地和指代基准上达到同类最佳，且训练的策略在杂乱真实场景中优于基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: SPARC 提供了一种可靠且可扩展的机器人演示空间注释方法，能够提高注释质量并支持下游任务。

papers.title: Budget-Constrained Step-Level Diffusion Caching
papers.abstract_en: Step-level caching accelerates diffusion models by exploiting temporal redundancy across denoising steps. Existing methods make per-step cache decisions using threshold-based heuristics, without directly optimizing for final output quality. As a result, their inference latency varies across inputs and is difficult to control at deployment. In this work, we propose BudCache, which inverts this formulation: rather than letting per-step error thresholds dictate the runtime cost, we fix the compute budget in advance and search for the cache policy that best preserves the final output. To tackle the combinatorial complexity of step selection, we combine Simulated Annealing with deterministic Hill Climbing. This offline search identifies high-quality cache policies within minutes and introduces no online search or thresholding overhead during inference. When the compute budget is very tight, we further introduce cache-aware schedule alignment, which adapts the time discretization to the selected cache policy to reduce cache-induced trajectory mismatch. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev and Wan2.1 show that BudCache achieves better generation quality than heuristic caching baselines under the same inference budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Westlake-AGI-Lab/BudCache
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出BudCache方法，在固定推理计算预算下，通过离线搜索最优步级缓存策略来保留扩散模型的最终输出质量。结合模拟退火与确定性爬山算法解决步骤选择的组合复杂度，并在预算极紧时引入缓存感知的时间离散化对齐。在FLUX.1-dev和Wan2.1上，相同预算下生成质量优于启发式缓存基线。
Motivation: 现有步级缓存方法基于阈值启发式逐步决策，未直接优化最终输出质量，导致推理延迟因输入而异且难以在部署时控制。
Method: 固定计算预算后，使用模拟退火结合确定性爬山算法离线搜索最优缓存策略；在预算极紧时额外采用缓存感知的调度对齐以减少轨迹失配。
Result: 在FLUX.1-dev和Wan2.1模型上，相同推理预算下生成质量优于现有启发式缓存基线。
Conclusion: 将缓存决策从误差阈值驱动转为预算约束搜索可有效提升扩散模型加速中的生成质量，且离线搜索不增加在线开销。

papers.title: NavWAM: A Navigation World Action Model for Goal-Conditioned Visual Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Goal-conditioned visual navigation requires a robot to act under partial observability by anticipating how its motion will change the future egocentric view and whether that change brings it closer to the goal. Navigation world models provide such visual foresight, but they remain prediction modules that require an external planner to convert predicted futures into closed-loop control. We propose Navigation World Action Model (NavWAM), a diffusion-transformer policy that turns navigation world-model prediction into executable action by representing future observations, goal-progress values, and action chunks in a shared latent sequence. By learning future prediction jointly with the action and value targets that determine closed-loop behavior, NavWAM makes visual foresight directly usable for robot control. We build NavWAM through simulation pretraining and real-robot adaptation, and evaluate it on image-goal navigation against planning-based world models and a representative direct navigation policy. Across offline benchmarks and closed-loop real-robot deployment, NavWAM improves over planning-based world-model baselines in our evaluations while using the default policy mode without CEM-style action search. Project page: https://dachii-azm.github.io/navwam/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出导航世界动作模型(NavWAM)，一种扩散-Transformer策略，通过学习联合表示未来观察、目标进展值和动作块，将导航世界模型的视觉预测直接转化为机器人的可执行动作。在模拟预训练和真实机器人微调后，其在图像目标导航任务上超越基于规划的世界模型基线。
Motivation: 现有导航世界模型虽能提供视觉预测，但需外部规划器将预测转化为闭环控制，导致效率低且不直接。NavWAM旨在使视觉预测直接用于机器人控制。
Method: NavWAM基于扩散-Transformer，在共享潜在序列中编码未来观察、目标进展值和动作块，联合学习未来预测、动作和价值目标，使视觉预测可直接用于控制。
Result: 在离线基准和真实机器人闭环部署中，NavWAM在使用默认策略模式（无CEM风格动作搜索）的情况下，优于基于规划的世界模型基线。
Conclusion: 论文展示通过联合学习预测和动作价值，导航世界模型可转化为直接可用的策略，无需外部规划器。

papers.title: Point-Wise Geometry-Aware Transformer for Partial-to-Full Point Cloud Registration in Computer-Assisted Surgery
papers.abstract_en: Partial-to-full registration remains challenging due to varying overlap ratios, fluctuating point densities, and the presence of noise. While transformers have shown strong potential for point cloud processing, prior methods typically confine them to global context aggregation, overlooking fine-grained local geometry crucial for accurate correspondence. We propose \emph{GAPR-Net}, a learning-based point cloud registration framework with a coarse-to-fine architecture that combines convolution and transformer modules, in which local and global information is fused between the partial and full point clouds using a cross-attention mechanism. To achieve this, a transformation-invariant point-wise geometric feature representation is proposed, which can robustly capture relative geometric features for individual points with respect to their neighboring points. To evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, experiments are conducted on four geometrically distinct bones, including the tibia, femur, pelvis, and thoracic cartilage. The overall registration recall reaches 94.2\%, the method results in a low RMSE of 1.992 mm and $R^2$ values of 0.908 and 0.974 for rotation and translation, respectively. The results demonstrate that the proposed method effectively addresses the partial-to-full point cloud registration problem. The proposed method enables highly accurate 3D point cloud registration using partial observation, providing a critical foundation for precise surgical navigation and robotic interventions in computer-assisted surgery. The code will be accessed after the double-blind review process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GAPR-Net，一种基于学习的部分到完整点云配准框架，采用粗到细架构结合卷积与Transformer，通过跨注意力融合局部与全局信息，并提出变换不变的点向几何特征表示。在四类骨骼数据上实现了94.2%的配准召回率、1.992 mm的RMSE和旋转/平移R²值0.908/0.974。
Motivation: 部分到完整点云配准面临重叠率变化、点密度波动和噪声等挑战，现有Transformer方法局限于全局上下文聚合，忽略了对精确对应至关重要的细粒度局部几何信息。
Method: 提出GAPR-Net，包含粗到细架构，结合卷积和Transformer模块，利用跨注意力机制在部分和完整点云之间融合局部与全局信息，并设计了一种变换不变的点向几何特征表示以鲁棒捕获相对几何特征。
Result: 在胫骨、股骨、骨盆和胸软骨四个几何不同的骨骼数据集上，配准召回率达94.2%，RMSE为1.992 mm，旋转R²=0.908，平移R²=0.974。
Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了部分到完整点云配准问题，为计算机辅助手术中的精确手术导航和机器人干预提供了关键基础。代码将在双盲评审后公开。

papers.title: CRAFTIIF: Cross-Resolution Analytic Four-Type Interpretable Isolation Forest for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection in multivariate time series is challenged by four structurally distinct anomaly types -- point (isolated spikes), distributional (level shifts), temporal (rhythm changes), and collective (inter-sensor correlation breakdowns) -- each requiring different feature representations. Most unsupervised methods target only one or two types and provide limited interpretability. We present CRAFTIIF (Cross-Resolution Analytic Four-Type Interpretable Isolation Forest), a fully unsupervised framework targeting all four types without dataset-specific tuning. CRAFTIIF generates K=500 random analytic wavelet feature draws across four families (Morlet, DOG, Haar, Coiflet), each targeting a specific anomaly type, feeding five structured Isolation Forests -- one per type plus a meta-IF for compound anomalies. An adaptive Otsu/MAD threshold calibrates detection automatically across anomaly rates from 0.1% to 69.2%. Because each IF is trained exclusively on type-specific features, branch firing provides direct anomaly-type attribution by construction, without post-hoc explanation. Evaluated on all 19 datasets of the mTSBench benchmark (Zhou et al., TMLR 2026), CRAFTIIF achieves mean F1=0.228 (all 19 datasets) and F1=0.322 (13 detectable datasets), ranking first among all 25 evaluated methods on VUS-PR (0.463 vs. previous best 0.329, +40.7%). A diagnostic framework -- oracle F1, detectability limits, and branch separation ratios -- identifies 6 of 19 datasets as fundamentally undetectable by any unsupervised method. Ablation over 11 conditions confirms adaptive thresholding (+38% F1), four-branch structure (+20%), and meta-IF (+23%) are each essential. Code: https://github.com/smitswil/craftiif
papers.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 2 appendices. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering (TKDE). Code: https://github.com/smitswil/craftiif
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CRAFTIIF 是一个完全无监督的多元时间序列异常检测框架，针对四种异常类型（点异常、分布偏移、时间节奏变化、跨传感器相关性崩溃）分别设计特征。它使用 K=500 个随机解析小波特征（Morlet、DOG、Haar、Coiflet 四种族）构建五个孤立森林（每类型一个 + 元森林），并采用自适应 Otsu/MAD 阈值校准。在 mTSBench 基准的全部 19 个数据集上，CRAFTIIF 平均 F1=0.228，VUS-PR 达到 0.463，比先前最佳提升 40.7%，且消融实验验证了各组件的必要性。
Motivation: 现有无监督异常检测方法通常只针对一两种异常类型，且解释性有限。多元时间序列中四种结构不同的异常类型需要不同的特征表示，但缺乏统一框架。
Method: 生成 500 个随机解析小波特征（四种小波族），分别输入四个类型特异孤立森林和一个元森林；采用自适应 Otsu/MAD 阈值自动校准，无需数据集特定调参。每个森林仅用类型特异特征训练，分支激活直接提供异常类型归因。
Result: 在 mTSBench 的 19 个数据集上，平均 F1=0.228，13 个可检测数据集上 F1=0.322；VUS-PR 0.463（优于先前最好 0.329，+40.7%）。消融表明自适应阈值（+38% F1）、四分支结构（+20% F1）和元森林（+23% F1）均关键。诊断框架识别 6 个数据集为无监督方法不可检测。
Conclusion: CRAFTIIF 能同时对四种异常类型进行高效检测和归因，无需后处理解释，且自适应阈值使其适应不同异常率。框架提供了可诊断的基准，表明部分数据集对无监督方法本质不可检测。

papers.title: SupraBench: A Benchmark for Supramolecular Chemistry
papers.abstract_en: Supramolecular chemistry, which includes the study of non-covalent host-guest assemblies, has advanced various applications. However, designing host-guest systems remains time-consuming, requiring days of dry-lab verification per candidate pair. Although LLMs have emerged as a fast alternative with strong performance on molecular binding tasks, no benchmark currently systematically evaluates LLMs for host-guest reasoning across fundamental supramolecular chemistry tasks, e.g., binding affinity prediction. To this end, we collaborate with domain experts to release the first Supramolecular Benchmark, called SupraBench, to evaluate LLMs in chemistry reasoning. Specifically, we design four fundamental tasks, i.e., binding affinity prediction, top-binder selection, solvent identification, and host-guest description, plus an auxiliary vision-based task for molecular identification. We also release SupraPMC, a curated 16M-token corpus of Supramolecular chemistry articles distilled from Europe PMC, to support the adaptation to the supramolecular domain. We benchmark a broad range of open and proprietary LLMs and find that LLMs leave substantial headroom across all tasks. Domain adaptation pretraining over SupraPMC transfers cleanly to in-distribution regression but trades off against strict letter-format output. Moreover, the difficulty profile differs sharply across task families, revealing distinct failure modes that indicate specific gaps in current supramolecular chemistry reasoning. Our source codes and benchmark datasets are available at https://github.com/Tianyi-Billy-Ma/SupraBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了SupraBench，首个评估大型语言模型（LLM）在超分子化学推理能力的基准测试。基准包含四个核心任务（结合亲和力预测、最佳结合物选择、溶剂识别、主客体描述）和一个辅助视觉任务。同时发布SupraPMC语料库（含1600万token的超分子化学文章）。实验表明，现有LLM在所有任务上仍有显著提升空间，领域适应预训练能提高分布内回归性能，但可能牺牲严格格式输出。
Motivation: 超分子化学中主客体系统设计耗时耗力，而LLM作为快速替代方案虽在分子结合任务上表现良好，但缺乏系统评估其在基础超分子化学任务（如结合亲和力预测）上推理能力的基准。
Method: 与领域专家合作构建SupraBench基准，包含四个核心任务和一个视觉任务；同时从Europe PMC收集并整理SupraPMC语料库用于领域适应预训练。
Result: 对多种开源和专有LLM的基准测试表明，所有任务上仍有较大性能提升空间；领域适应预训练在分布内回归任务上效果明显，但会牺牲严格格式输出；不同任务族难度分布差异大，揭示了当前超分子化学推理的特定不足。
Conclusion: SupraBench为评估LLM在超分子化学推理提供了标准化测试平台，指出了现有模型的能力差距和未来改进方向。

summary_sections.motivation: 超分子化学中主客体系统设计耗时耗力，而LLM作为快速替代方案虽在分子结合任务上表现良好，但缺乏系统评估其在基础超分子化学任务（如结合亲和力预测）上推理能力的基准。
summary_sections.method: 与领域专家合作构建SupraBench基准，包含四个核心任务和一个视觉任务；同时从Europe PMC收集并整理SupraPMC语料库用于领域适应预训练。
summary_sections.result: 对多种开源和专有LLM的基准测试表明，所有任务上仍有较大性能提升空间；领域适应预训练在分布内回归任务上效果明显，但会牺牲严格格式输出；不同任务族难度分布差异大，揭示了当前超分子化学推理的特定不足。
summary_sections.conclusion: SupraBench为评估LLM在超分子化学推理提供了标准化测试平台，指出了现有模型的能力差距和未来改进方向。

papers.title: MaxProof: Scaling Mathematical Proof with Generative-Verifier RL and Population-Level Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: We present MaxProof, a population-level test-time scaling framework for competition-level mathematical proof in the MiniMax-M3 series. M3 first trains three proof-oriented capabilities -- proof generation, proof verification, and critique-conditioned proof repair -- using a defense-in-depth generative verifier engineered for low false-positive rate. These capabilities are merged into a single released M3 model. At test time, MaxProof treats the model as a generator, verifier, refiner, and ranker, searches over a population of candidate proofs, and returns one final proof through tournament selection. With MaxProof test-time scaling, the M3 model reaches 35/42 on IMO 2025 and 36/42 on USAMO 2026, exceeding the human gold-medal threshold on both.

TL;DR: 本文提出MaxProof，一种种群级别测试时缩放框架，用于竞赛级数学证明。M3模型经过训练具备证明生成、验证和修复能力，通过MaxProof测试时缩放，在IMO 2025上达到35/42，USAMO 2026上达到36/42，超过人类金牌线。
Motivation: 缺乏有效的测试时计算扩展方法用于数学证明。
Method: 采用深度生成验证器（低误报率）训练证明能力，在测试时通过种群搜索、锦标赛选择生成最终证明。
Result: M3模型在IMO 2025上达到35/42，USAMO 2026上达到36/42，超过人类金牌线。
Conclusion: 种群级别测试时缩放可以有效提升数学证明性能。

papers.title: Understanding the Rejection of Fixes Generated by Agentic Pull Requests -- Insights from the AIDev Dataset
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents are increasingly used to generate pull requests (PRs) that propose code fixes in software projects. From a first exploration of the AIDev dataset, we find that 46.41\% of the fixes proposed by the agents Copilot, Devin, Cursor, and Claude are rejected. This represents a significant amount of wasted resources that require human reviews, verifications, and running tests and validations for fixes that are merely discarded. Our goal in this paper is to understand the failure modes of AI-agents, an understanding that is crucial for better integrating AI-agents as efficient teammates. In this paper, we conduct a qualitative study on a representative sample of 306 non-merged pull requests created or co-authored by the agents mentioned earlier, followed by a quantitative analysis of the reasons for rejection. Our qualitative findings identify 14 reasons divided into four high-level categories for rejecting AI-agent fixes. We observe that developers can reject fixes due to fixes whose implementation is incorrect (e.g., incomplete, wrong approach), fixes that do not pass the continuous integration (CI) pipelines and fail tests, fixes for which the agent is unable to perform the implementation (e.g., no code generated, sessions lost), and fixes whose priority is low. Our results shed light on the importance of better guiding the model at these levels: (1) proposing hints about the approach to follow for fixing an issue, (2) outlining constraints or limitations regarding the approaches that should not be taken, and (3) instructing the agent on how to validate the implementation through CI pipelines and without introducing a breaking change. Our results suggest the need for good prioritization of tasks so that generated fixes do not lead to wasted human review efforts or wasted agent resources (e.g., tokens, compute, or allowed number of requests).
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, MSR '26: Proceedings of the 23rd International Conference on Mining Software Repositories, April 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析AI编码代理（Copilot、Devin、Cursor、Claude）生成的pull request被拒绝的原因。基于AIDev数据集，发现46.41%的修复提案被拒绝，通过对306个未合并PR的定性与定量分析，归纳出14个被拒绝原因，分为四类：实现不正确、CI管道失败、代理无法完成实现、优先级低。研究建议从三个层面改进：提示修复方法、约束不应采用的方法、指导通过CI验证实现。
Motivation: AI代理生成的pull request大量被拒绝（46.41%）导致人工审查、测试等资源浪费，需要理解失败模式以更好地将AI代理集成到开发流程中。
Method: 从AIDev数据集中选取306个由AI代理创建或共同创作的未合并pull request样本，进行定性分析识别拒绝原因，再对原因类别进行定量统计。
Result: 识别出14个拒绝原因，分为四类：实现不正确（如不完整、错误方法）、未能通过CI测试、代理无法完成实现（如未生成代码、会话丢失）、优先级低。研究指出需要从方法提示、约束限制和CI验证三方面改进模型指导。
Conclusion: AI代理生成的修复需要更好的任务优先级排序，以避免浪费人工审查和代理资源（如tokens、计算量）。

papers.title: Ontology Memory-Augmented ASR Correction for Long Text-Speech Interleaved Conversations
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) correction has traditionally focused on isolated utterances or short local contexts. However, as text and speech become increasingly interleaved in long interactions, ASR correction requires conversation-level contextual evidence. Existing ASR correction methods often rely on the current hypothesis or concatenate raw dialogue history. In such contexts, sparse correction evidence can be difficult to locate amid redundancy and noise. Addressing these challenges, we propose an ontology memory-augmented ASR correction framework for long text-speech interleaved conversations. The framework organizes preceding interaction history into a dynamically updatable ontology memory, where entities, terminology, surface variants, potential ASR confusions, and semantic relations are stored as retrievable nodes for context-grounded correction. To evaluate this setting, we construct RAMC-Corr, a dataset derived from MAGIC-RAMC for long-range ASR correction with grounded context. Experiments on RAMC-Corr show that our method improves over direct correction in 9 out of 10 paired backbone-setting combinations and encourages more selective and evidence-grounded corrections for context-dependent ASR errors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长文本-语音交错对话中的ASR校正问题，提出本体记忆增强的ASR校正框架。该框架将交互历史组织为动态可更新的本体记忆，存储实体、术语、变体、潜在混淆和语义关系作为可检索节点，以支持上下文校正。构建了RAMC-Corr数据集，实验表明该方法在10个组合中的9个上优于直接校正。
Motivation: 传统ASR校正仅关注孤立语句或短上下文，而在长文本-语音交错对话中需要对话级上下文证据，但现有方法难以在冗余和噪声中定位稀疏的校正证据。
Method: 提出本体记忆增强的ASR校正框架，将先前交互历史组织为动态可更新的本体记忆，以可检索节点存储实体、术语、表面变体、潜在ASR混淆和语义关系，用于上下文校正。
Result: 在RAMC-Corr数据集上，该方法在10个配对主干-设置组合中的9个上优于直接校正，并鼓励更选择性和证据基础的校正。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法促进了上下文依赖的ASR错误校正，但未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Neural Model Editing
papers.abstract_en: Editing pretrained neural networks requires specialized algorithms tailored to specific objectives. Designing such algorithms is often time-consuming and demands significant effort. We present an exploratory framework that formulates neural model editing as a reinforcement learning problem, where agents modify models using reward feedback. We introduce two environments: MaskWorld, where agents scale weights multiplicatively, and ShiftWorld, where agents apply additive weight updates. The reward function combines a utility-preservation objective with a task-specific editing objective, enabling agents to learn targeted modifications while maintaining overall model performance. We evaluate the framework on bias mitigation in text classification and machine unlearning in image classification, both of which traditionally rely on specialized algorithms. Our results show that the learned policies reduce forget set accuracy to nearly 0% while preserving over 90% retain set accuracy on the unlearning task. In the bias mitigation setting, the learned policies improve bias-related performance by more than 5% while maintaining general classification utility. Our findings show that neural model editing can be cast as a reinforcement learning problem, allowing editing policies to be learned from reward feedback rather than manually engineered for each task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将神经模型编辑（neural model editing）形式化为强化学习问题，代理通过奖励反馈学习编辑策略。设计了两个环境：MaskWorld（乘性缩放权重）和ShiftWorld（加性更新权重），奖励函数结合效用保持和任务特定编辑目标。在文本分类的偏差缓解和图像分类的机器遗忘任务上评估，遗忘任务中遗忘集准确率降至近0%而保留集准确率保持90%以上，偏差缓解任务中偏差相关性能提升超过5%。
Motivation: 传统神经模型编辑需要针对特定目标设计专用算法，耗时且费力。本文探索将模型编辑转化为强化学习问题，使编辑策略能从奖励反馈中学习，避免手动工程。
Method: 构建两个强化学习环境：MaskWorld（代理对权重进行乘性缩放）和ShiftWorld（代理对权重进行加性更新）。奖励函数由效用保持目标和任务特定编辑目标组成，代理通过与环境交互学习编辑策略。
Result: 在机器遗忘任务中，遗忘集准确率几乎降至0%，保留集准确率保持90%以上；在偏差缓解任务中，偏差相关性能提升超过5%，同时保持总体分类效用。
Conclusion: 神经模型编辑可以视为强化学习问题，使得编辑策略能够从奖励反馈中自动学习，而非为每个任务手动设计。

papers.title: VISA: VLM-Guided Instance Semantic Auditing for 3D Occupancy World Models
papers.abstract_en: Semantic 3D occupancy provides a voxelized world state for autonomous driving and robot decision making, but object and rare-class errors can affect free-space interpretation, collision checking, and temporal state propagation. We show that a common VLM strategy, aligning 3D voxel or object features with crop-caption embeddings, improves text-space similarity without reliably improving closed-set occupancy mIoU. Motivated by this mismatch, we propose VISA, a training-time semantic auditing approach for existing occupancy world models. VISA queries an offline VLM on a representative crop of each physical object instance, obtains a structured audit with class hypotheses, plausible confusions, reliability, attributes, and evidence, and propagates it along the object track. The audit is grounded to matched 3D object voxels and distilled into semantic logits through reliability-weighted taxonomy, attribute-factor, and scene-level audit graph losses, while inference remains unchanged and requires no VLM. On nuScenes, averaged across three runs, VISA improves OccWorld from 19.06 to 20.05 mIoU and GaussianWorld from 21.36 to 21.91 mIoU; on GaussianWorld, object mIoU improves from 18.18 to 19.16 and rare-class mIoU from 15.60 to 16.79. These results suggest that VLMs are better suited to closed-set occupancy as reliability-aware semantic auditors than as generic caption-embedding targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VISA，一种基于VLM指导的实例语义审计方法，用于改进3D占用世界模型（如OccWorld、GaussianWorld）的语义分割性能。通过在训练时利用离线VLM对物理对象实例进行结构化审计（包括类别假设、混淆、可靠性等），并将其蒸馏到语义logits中，而推理时不需VLM。在nuScenes数据集上，VISA将OccWorld的mIoU从19.06提升至20.05，GaussianWorld从21.36提升至21.91，特别对物体类（18.18→19.16）和稀有类（15.60→16.79）提升显著。
Motivation: 现有VLM策略通过对齐3D体素/对象特征与裁剪标题嵌入，虽提高了文本空间相似度，却未可靠提升封闭集占用mIoU。作者旨在利用VLM作为语义审计器而非通用嵌入目标，以解决对象和稀有类错误对自由空间解释、碰撞检测和时序状态传播的影响。
Method: VISA在训练时对每个物理对象实例的代表性裁剪查询离线VLM，获取包含类别假设、可能混淆、可靠性、属性和证据的结构化审计，并沿对象轨迹传播。审计结果与匹配的3D对象体素对齐，通过可靠性加权分类、属性因子和场景级审计图损失蒸馏到语义logits中，推理时不需VLM。
Result: 在nuScenes上三次运行平均，VISA将OccWorld的mIoU从19.06提升至20.05，GaussianWorld从21.36提升至21.91；GaussianWorld上物体mIoU从18.18提升至19.16，稀有类mIoU从15.60提升至16.79。
Conclusion: 结果表明，VLM更适合作为可靠性感知的语义审计器来改进封闭集占用任务，而非作为通用标题嵌入目标。

papers.title: Optical Implementation of Equilibrium Propagation Using Spatial Photonic Ising Machines
papers.abstract_en: Equilibrium Propagation offers a compelling alternative to traditional machine learning for training energy-based networks. Here we demonstrate a hybrid optical-digital implementation of EP using a Spatial Photonic Ising Machine (SPIM). The SPIM exploits the gauge transformation method to optically encode both continuous neuron states and rank-1 binary trainable patterns as phase modulations via a spatial light modulator, with inference realized using a finite difference scheme. The experimental system is evaluated on the Wine classification dataset. The potential of this approach, including the use of continuous couplings and structured coupling matrices, is evaluated numerically on the more complex MNIST dataset. Our work provides a concrete pathway toward energy-efficient physical implementations of Equilibrium Propagation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在空间光子伊辛机（SPIM）上实现了平衡传播（Equilibrium Propagation）的混合光-数字实现，通过规范变换方法在空间光调制器上编码连续神经元状态和秩一二进制可训练模式，利用有限差分方案进行推理。在Wine数据集上实验评估，并在MNIST数据集上数值评估了连续耦合和结构化耦合矩阵的潜力。
Motivation: 平衡传播为训练基于能量的网络提供了有吸引力的替代方案，但缺乏节能的物理实现。本文旨在通过光学手段实现平衡传播，以提高能效。
Method: 利用空间光子伊辛机（SPIM）和规范变换方法，将连续神经元状态和秩一二进制可训练模式编码为空间光调制器上的相位调制，推理采用有限差分方案。
Result: 在Wine分类数据集上实验验证了该光学实现，并在MNIST数据集上数值展示了连续耦合和结构化耦合矩阵的潜力。
Conclusion: 该工作为平衡传播的节能物理实现提供了具体路径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Rapid mixing for Gibbs measures in Riemannian manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Langevin dynamics on Riemannian manifolds is analyzed. Conditions ensuring the existence of a suitable logarithmic Sobolev inequality (rapid mixing to the Gibbs measure) are identified. These conditions involve the curvature of the manifold, the inverse temperature, escaping directions from saddle points, and exclude barren plateaus and spurious local minima. We show that when these conditions are met, mixing times polynomial in the dimension of the manifold are achievable. This result is obtained through a relation between Langevin processes in the domain and in the image of a Riemannian submersion. Such a relation can be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析黎曼流形上的Langevin动力学，识别出确保快速混合到Gibbs测度的条件，涉及流形曲率、逆温度、鞍点逃逸方向，并排除贫瘠高原和虚假局部极小值。当条件满足时，混合时间与流形维度呈多项式关系。该结果通过建立黎曼淹没的域与像中Langevin过程之间的联系获得。
Motivation: 当前对黎曼流形上Langevin动力学快速混合的条件缺乏系统性理解，尤其缺少对曲率和几何结构的影响分析。
Method: 通过引入对数Sobolev不等式，推导出快速混合的充分条件（曲率、逆温度、逃逸方向），并利用黎曼淹没将流形上的Langevin过程与子流形上的过程关联起来。
Result: 证明了在满足上述条件时，混合时间与流形维度成多项式关系，即实现了多项式时间的快速混合。
Conclusion: 该工作为黎曼流形上的Gibbs采样提供了理论保证，排除了贫瘠高原和虚假局部极小值，且所建立的黎曼淹没关系可能具有独立的理论价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty Estimation for Molecular Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have seen wide adoption for 3D molecular generation, yet they offer no principled signal of when a generated molecule is likely to be of low quality. We propose a post-hoc method for estimating per-sample uncertainty in pretrained molecular diffusion models. Building on a Laplace approximation of the denoising network, we measure the variability of the noise prediction across the generation trajectory. Empirically, we show that the resulting uncertainty score is informative of sample quality, exhibiting a negative correlation with established sample-level quality metrics. We further study how the proposed uncertainty score can be used to filter generated samples, improving model performance via test-time scaling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种后验方法，用于估计预训练分子扩散模型中每个生成样本的不确定性。基于去噪网络的拉普拉斯近似，测量生成轨迹中噪声预测的变异性，得到的不确定性分数与样本质量负相关，可用于过滤低质量样本，提升模型性能。
Motivation: 分子扩散模型在3D分子生成中广泛应用，但缺乏有效的信号来指示生成分子的质量，需要一种不确定性估计方法。
Method: 在预训练的分子扩散模型上，利用去噪网络的拉普拉斯近似，计算噪声预测在生成轨迹中的变异性作为不确定性分数。
Result: 实验表明，不确定性分数与样本质量负相关，可用于过滤样本，通过测试时缩放（test-time scaling）提升模型性能。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种无需重新训练的后验不确定性估计，能够改善分子扩散模型的样本质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward Instructions-as-Code: Understanding the Impact of Instruction Files on Agentic Pull Requests
papers.abstract_en: AI-agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot) collaborate as teammates in different software engineering tasks, including code generation proposed through pull requests (Agentic-PRs). For better agent efficiency, developers create instruction files that guide the AI-agents, including how to navigate the project, locate the right components, run tests, respect best practices, and more. In this paper, we investigate the relationship between the creation of these instructions and the performance of AI-agents in creating better pull requests, which have a higher chance of success (i.e., the merge rate), address more complex tasks (e.g., code churn), and require less effort to be merged (e.g., time to merge). To this end, we analyze 15,549 agentic PRs from 148 projects in the AIDev dataset. Using the three dimensions, we compare each project before and after the creation of the instruction files. We find that specifying instructions for AI-agents does not necessarily lead to better results. With the instruction files, 27.7\% of the projects increased their merge rate by at least 20\%, while 26.35\% decreased it. The same observation is seen with the amount of changes (e.g., code churn, number of modified files) and with the efforts to merge an agentic PR (e.g., merge time and number of comments). From a first exploration, we find that projects that managed to increase their merge rate have substantially longer instruction files, which are also well structured into a higher number of sections and sub-sections. Our results motivate the need for research to assist practitioners in framing the development of instruction files as a software engineering activity (aka, \textbf{Instructions-as-Code}).
papers.comment: 5 pages, 8 figures, 23rd International Conference on Mining Software Repositories, April 13--14, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI代理（如GitHub Copilot）在软件工程任务中，指令文件对代理性拉取请求（Agentic PRs）性能的影响。通过分析15,549个来自148个项目的代理性PRs，发现指令文件的创建并不总是带来更好的结果：约27.7%的项目合并率提升至少20%，但26.35%的项目反而下降。初步探索表明，成功提升合并率的项目拥有更长且结构更清晰的指令文件。研究呼吁将指令文件开发视为软件工程活动（即“指令即代码”）。
Motivation: 开发者创建指令文件指导AI代理以提高其效率，但指令文件的实际影响尚不明确。本文旨在量化指令文件对代理性PRs性能（合并率、任务复杂度、合并工作量）的影响。
Method: 基于AIDev数据集的15,549个代理性PRs，从合并率、代码变更量（如代码流失、修改文件数）和合并工作量（合并时间、评论数）三个维度，对比同一项目在创建指令文件前后的性能变化。
Result: 指令文件的创建效果非单调：27.7%的项目合并率提升≥20%，26.35%的项目下降；代码变更量和合并工作量的变化也呈现类似两极分化。成功提升合并率的项目指令文件显著更长且章节划分更细。
Conclusion: 指令文件并非总是提升AI代理性能，其效果与文件长度和结构相关。未来需要研究如何将指令文件开发系统化，作为软件工程活动（指令即代码）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Clustering Node Attributed Networks with Graph Neural Networks and Self Learning
papers.abstract_en: Graph clustering - partitioning the node set of a graph into disjoint subsets that reflect some latent information - is a fundamental problem as it finds applications in a myriad of different scenarios. While this classic problem has been tackled for decades by different communities, a recent variation of the problem driven by real data considers the scenario where nodes have attributes that are also informative. This has triggered novel methods that simultaneously leverage network information (edges) and node information (attributed) in the design of novel clustering algorithms. This work proposes a novel framework that builds on prior works that have applied graph neural networks (GNN) to graph clustering. The proposed framework operates in rounds of self learning in a fully unsupervised setting. In each round, a GNN generates representations for nodes that are used to cluster the nodes. This clustering influences the graph used to generate the node representation in the next round. Moreover, a context graph built in each round using the original graph is used to generate the node representations. Empirical results show that the proposed methodology extracts information from both network edges and node attributes in synthetic data, outperforming algorithms focused solely on the network or attributes when neither are very informative. Multiple rounds of learning also improve the performance and always outperforms a long single round of training (i.e., classic GNN graph clustering). When considering real datasets, empirical results indicate that the proposed methodology is competitive to state-of-the-art methods when cluster sizes are balanced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于图神经网络（GNN）的自学习框架用于节点属性图聚类，在无监督设置下通过多轮迭代改进聚类性能。实验表明，该方法在合成数据上优于仅利用网络或属性的算法，在真实数据集上平衡簇时与现有方法竞争力相当。
Motivation: 现有图聚类方法大多仅利用网络结构或节点属性之一，而真实场景中两者都包含信息。需要一种能同时利用网络边和节点属性的无监督聚类方法。
Method: 提出多轮自学习框架：每轮使用GNN生成节点表示，基于此聚类；聚类结果影响下一轮用于生成表示的图结构；同时利用原始图构建上下文图来增强表示。
Result: 在合成数据上，当网络和属性信息均不丰富时，方法优于仅依赖网络或属性的算法；多轮学习总是优于单轮长训练；在真实数据集上，当簇大小平衡时与最先进方法竞争力相当。
Conclusion: 多轮自学习能有效融合网络和属性信息，提升图聚类性能，但性能受簇平衡性影响。

papers.title: How Much Memory Do We Need? Adaptive Memory Gate for Neural Operators
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators have emerged as a powerful data-driven approach for solving time-dependent PDEs. Among recent advances, memory-augmented neural operators explicitly incorporate past states and have achieved remarkable performance under low-resolution observation settings. However, existing approaches apply a fixed memory weight regardless of observation conditions, such as resolution or physical parameters, limiting their adaptability. Our preliminary experiments reveal that optimal memory weight varies with resolution and viscosity, implying that a fixed memory weight cannot simultaneously optimize performance across diverse settings. We propose AMGFNO, which dynamically modulates memory weight through a learnable gate. On the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky and Burgers' equations, AMGFNO achieves 55-79% nRMSE reduction over at low resolution, with the learned gate value automatically decreasing from $\bar{g} \approx 0.7$ to near-zero as resolution increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应记忆门控的神经算子 AMGFNO，通过可学习的门控动态调整记忆权重，解决现有方法固定记忆权重在不同观测条件下（如分辨率、物理参数）无法同时最优的问题。在 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 和 Burgers 方程上，低分辨率下 nRMSE 降低 55-79%，且门控值随分辨率提高自动趋近于零。
Motivation: 现有记忆增强神经算子使用固定记忆权重，无法适应不同分辨率或物理参数，导致跨设置性能次优。
Method: 提出 AMGFNO，在神经算子中引入可学习的门控机制，根据输入条件动态调制记忆权重。
Result: 在 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 和 Burgers 方程上，低分辨率下 nRMSE 降低 55-79%，门控值从约 0.7 自动降至接近零（随分辨率升高）。
Conclusion: 自适应记忆门控能有效提升神经算子在不同观测条件下的泛化能力，门控值可解释地与最优记忆需求一致。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: Why Sampling Is Not Choosing: Intentionality, Agency, and Moral Responsibility in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have prompted claims that such systems exhibit agency or qualify as moral agents. This paper argues that these attributions are misguided. We maintain that moral responsibility requires commitment-bearing agency grounded in intrinsic intentionality and self-attributed action, and that such agency constitutes the form of free will relevant to responsibility. Although LLMs generate coherent and normatively evaluable outputs, their operation is fully characterized by probabilistic input-output mappings learned from data. Their apparent intentionality is derived rather than intrinsic, and their outputs are neither owned as commitments nor guided by reasons. Variability introduced by stochastic sampling does not amount to choice or authorship. We address objections from the intentional stance, functionalism, compatibilism, and the presence of moral reasoning in model outputs, arguing that none suffice to establish genuine agency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文论证大型语言模型（LLMs）不应被视为道德代理或具有自主选择能力，因为它们缺乏内在意向性和承诺行为，其输出完全由概率映射决定。
Motivation: 针对近期声称LLMs具有代理或道德主体地位的观点，指出这些归因是错误的。
Method: 通过分析内在意向性、自我归因行为、随机采样与选择之间的区别，反驳意向立场、功能主义、相容论等观点。
Result: 无具体实验结果，论文是哲学论证。
Conclusion: 强调道德责任需要基于内在意向性和自我归因行为的承诺性代理，而LLM不满足这些条件。

papers.title: S-GBT: Smooth Growth Bound Tensor for Certified Robustness Against Word Substitution Attacks in NLP
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress in Natural Language Processing (NLP), models remain vulnerable to word substitution attacks. Most existing defenses focus on first order sensitivity and measure how much the output changes when the input is slightly perturbed. However, they ignore how this sensitivity evolves, which is described by curvature. When gradients vary sharply, models can still fail. This paper introduces the Smooth Growth Bound Tensor (S-GBT), a second order method that bounds the Hessian element-wise, for which we provide formal theoretical proofs on the resulting robustness bounds. A regularization term is added during training to minimize these bounds. This yields tighter certified robustness against word substitution attacks. The change in the output under word substitution is bounded by both a linear term and a quadratic term. S-GBT is derived for two architectures: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). The method is integrated directly into the training objective. Its effectiveness is evaluated on multiple benchmark datasets. The results show that combining first and second order regularization improves certified robust accuracy by up to 23.4% compared to prior methods, while clean accuracy remains competitive. These findings indicate that controlling both the gradient and its variation is a promising direction for building more robust models.
papers.comment: The paper has been accepted at NETYS 2026 - 14th edition of the International Conference on Networked Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Smooth Growth Bound Tensor (S-GBT)，一种基于二阶 Hessian 元素级边界的认证鲁棒性方法，用于防御 NLP 中的词替换攻击。在 LSTM 和 CNN 架构上实现，通过训练中正则化最小化边界，结合一阶和二阶正则化使认证鲁棒准确率提升高达 23.4%，同时保持干净准确率竞争性。
Motivation: 现有防御主要关注一阶灵敏度，忽略曲率（Hessian）影响，当梯度变化剧烈时模型仍会失效。
Method: 提出 S-GBT，元素级界定期望的 Hessian 张量，并给出正式理论证明；在训练目标中加入正则化项以最小化这些边界。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上，结合一阶和二阶正则化的方法相比先前方法将认证鲁棒准确率提升高达 23.4%，干净准确率保持竞争性。
Conclusion: 同时控制梯度及其变化（曲率）是构建更鲁棒 NLP 模型的有前景方向。
Relevance: 0
