papers.title: Evaluation Sovereignty in Metadata-Driven Classification: A Multi-Track Framework for Weakly Supervised Information Systems
papers.abstract_en: Evaluation in machine learning is typically treated as a neutral measurement process. However, in operational information systems, evaluation outcomes are often conditioned by the processes used to generate labels. This paper does not seek to improve classification performance. Instead, it examines the validity of performance measurement under differing label-authority regimes. This issue is particularly relevant in large-scale metadata-driven systems, where labels are often incomplete, inconsistent, or weakly supervised. We introduce evaluation sovereignty, defined as the degree to which performance metrics are independent of label authority and supervision regime, and propose a multi-track evaluation framework that systematically varies training and evaluation label sources. Using hierarchical multi-label classification on large-scale scientific metadata, we demonstrate that models exhibiting strong performance under operational ("silver") evaluation degrade substantially under independent ("gold") evaluation, particularly for fine-grained classification. For example, Micro-F1 decreases from approximately 0.54 to 0.03. Notably, ranking-based metrics remain above baseline, revealing a divergence between latent model signal and classification validity. These findings suggest that commonly reported performance metrics may reflect alignment with labeling processes rather than true predictive capability. We therefore reconceptualize evaluation validity as a system-level property shaped by label governance and provide a practical methodology for auditing intelligent systems operating under weak supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“评估主权”概念，定义性能指标对标签权威和监督制度的依赖程度。在弱监督元数据驱动系统中，通过多轨评估框架（变化训练和评估标签来源）发现，模型在操作环境（银标准）下表现良好，但在独立金标准评估下性能急剧下降（如Micro-F1从0.54降至0.03），揭示常见性能指标可能反映与标注过程的对齐而非真实预测能力。
Motivation: 在操作信息系统中，评估结果常受标签生成过程影响，但传统评估视为中性测量。本文旨在检验不同标签权威制度下性能测量的有效性，特别针对大规模元数据驱动弱监督系统。
Method: 引入“评估主权”概念，提出多轨评估框架，系统变化训练和评估标签来源（银标准vs金标准），并在大规模科学元数据的层次多标签分类上验证。
Result: 模型在银标准评估下性能良好，但在金标准评估下显著下降：例如Micro-F1从约0.54降至0.03。排名指标仍高于基线，显示潜在信号与分类有效性之间存在分歧。
Conclusion: 常见性能指标可能反映与标注过程的对齐而非真实预测能力；评估有效性应作为由标签治理塑造的系统级属性；提供了一种审计弱监督智能系统的实用方法。

papers.title: OmniDirector: General Multi-Shot Camera Cloning without Cross-Paired Data
papers.abstract_en: Cloning camera motion from reference videos is an important task in video generation, as videos provide intuitive and precise control. Existing methods either directly use parametric representations that fail to handle multi-shot generation or synthesize cross-paired data, which suffer from data scarcity, resulting in poor performance in complicated camera motion cloning. To address these issues, we introduce a general camera motion representation that encodes cameras as grid motion videos. This camera grid represents the camera parameters visually and supports the integration of diverse trajectories for multi-shot video generation. Building upon this, we propose OmniDirector, a unified framework trained on a million-scale camera grid-video pairs that coordinates characters, actions, and cameras to provide director-level control for multimodal diffusion transformers. Furthermore, we design a novel hierarchical prompt expansion agent that harmoniously integrates different control signals by systematically describing camera motion and visual content through understanding signal relationships. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance and outstanding controllability of our framework. Project page: https://ymlinfeng.github.io/OmniDirector.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniDirector统一框架，用于从参考视频克隆相机运动以生成多镜头视频。引入网格运动视频（grid motion video）作为通用相机运动表示，并在百万级网格-视频对上训练模型，结合层级提示扩展代理实现人物、动作与相机的协调控制。实验表明该方法在复杂相机运动克隆上性能优越。
Motivation: 现有相机运动克隆方法要么使用参数化表示无法处理多镜头生成，要么依赖稀缺的跨配对数据导致性能差。需要一种无需跨配对数据、支持多镜头且控制精细的通用方案。
Method: 提出网格运动视频作为相机运动的通用视觉表示，支持多轨迹集成；构建OmniDirector统一框架，基于百万级网格-视频对训练多模态扩散Transformer；设计层级提示扩展代理，通过理解信号关系系统描述相机运动和视觉内容，协调不同控制信号。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在复杂相机运动克隆任务上表现优越，具有出色的可控性。具体定量结果未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: OmniDirector提供了无需跨配对数据的通用多镜头相机克隆方案，通过网格运动视频表示和层级提示扩展代理实现了导演级控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VietFashion: Benchmarking Sketch-Text Composed Image Retrieval for Cultural Outfits
papers.abstract_en: Cultural garments pose a unique challenge for visual retrieval systems, as their identity often depends on subtle structural and symbolic details that are poorly captured by standard AI models. We introduce VietFashion, a new benchmark for sketch-text composed image retrieval centered on the Ao Dai, a traditional Vietnamese garment. VietFashion enables designers and researchers to retrieve culturally meaningful outfits using a combination of hand-drawn sketches, which convey garment structure, and textual descriptions, which encode cultural semantics. The dataset is initialized with 650 sketches and expanded using generative models to produce over 21,000 photorealistic images with aligned captions. Textual prompts that describe detailed outfit attributes, which are extracted from fashion magazines to ensure authenticity and diversity. To better reflect the inherent ambiguity of design intent, VietFashion adopts a multi-target retrieval setting, where a single query may correspond to multiple valid results. We establish standardized evaluation protocols and benchmark state-of-the-art composed image retrieval methods. Experimental results reveal significant performance gaps in modeling fine-grained cultural semantics and multi-modal composition, positioning VietFashion as a challenging benchmark for fine-grained fashion retrieval. The dataset is publicly available at: https://hng0303.github.io/VietFashion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 VietFashion，一个面向越南传统服装 Ao Dai 的草图-文本组合图像检索基准。数据集包含 650 张草图，利用生成模型扩展至 21,000 多张逼真图像及其对齐描述。采用多目标检索设置，评估了现有组合检索方法，发现建模细粒度文化语义和多模态组合方面存在显著性能差距。
Motivation: 文化服装的视觉检索面临挑战，其身份依赖于微妙的结构和象征细节，标准 AI 模型难以捕捉。现有基准缺乏针对文化服装的草图-文本组合检索。
Method: 构建 VietFashion 基准，包括初始 650 张草图和通过生成模型扩增至 21,000 多张照片级真实图像及对齐描述。文本提示从时尚杂志提取以确保真实性和多样性。采用多目标检索设置，并为评估建立标准化协议。
Result: 实验表明现有最先进的组合图像检索方法在细粒度文化语义和多模态组合建模上存在显著性能差距。
Conclusion: VietFashion 为细粒度时尚检索提供了一个有挑战性的基准。

papers.title: Accelerating Speculative Diffusions via Block Verification
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding speeds up LLM inference by using a draft model to generate tokens, with an acceptance-rejection scheme that ensures that the output matches the target distribution. Adapting this to continuous diffusions is difficult because speculative sampling requires drawing from a residual distribution. While straightforward in discrete spaces, efficiently sampling this residual in continuous space is non-trivial. Consequently, existing diffusion adaptations either use computationally inefficient sampling techniques or rely on an alternative scheme. In this work, we introduce a novel scheme that efficiently implements the original speculative sampling mechanism for diffusion models. Our approach offers a critical advantage over current methods: it enables us to adapt block verification from LLMs to diffusions -- which provably improves the acceptance rate of drafts. Furthermore, we formalize and analyze the Free Drafter, a heuristic self-speculative drafter for diffusions that requires no training. By enabling block verification, our Free Drafter yields up to a 6.3% speedup over existing speculative methods with no additional training and negligible overhead beyond the existing parallel verification pass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的扩散模型推测解码加速方案，通过将来自LLM的块验证技术适配到连续扩散过程，提高了草稿的接受率。作者进一步形式化和分析了无需训练的Free Drafter，该方案在现有推测性方法基础上实现了高达6.3%的加速。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型的推测解码方法要么计算效率低，要么依赖替代方案，难以有效实现连续空间中的残差采样。
Method: 引入了一种高效实现原始推测采样机制的新方案，使块验证技术能从LLM适配到扩散模型，并形式化分析了无需训练的Free Drafter。
Result: 块验证方法提升了草稿接受率，Free Drafter在无额外训练和开销下，相比现有推测方法取得高达6.3%的加速。
Conclusion: 该工作将块验证从LLM扩展到扩散模型，并通过Free Drafter展示了无需训练的自我推测加速潜力。

papers.title: Foundations of Practical Quantum Advantage in Quantum-Informed Machine Learning for Predicting Chaos
papers.abstract_en: We develop theoretical foundations for a practical quantum-advantage mechanism in quantum-informed machine learning for chaotic dynamical systems. A family of k-indexed higher-order quantum statistical priors (Q-Priors) hosts the k-point marginal of the invariant measure on n_q = kq qubits, extending the single-site construction of prior work. We prove a two-stage advantage. In the representation stage, superposition and entanglement compactly store non-factorisable spatial correlations of the invariant measure on n_q qubits. In the extraction stage, joint Bell measurements on two copies estimate any post hoc Pauli functional with a copy-pair count independent of n_q, whereas any adaptive single-copy protocol for the corresponding full-Pauli read-out requires Omega(2^(n_q)) copies; this is a provable quantum-classical separation in copy-measurement complexity. The two-copy read-out is realised in simulation and on IQM superconducting processors. Two case studies instantiate the mechanism in workflows of independent scientific value: a turbulent channel-flow study in which the two-copy read-out yields a named non-diagonal correlator of the invariant measure (the velocity-direction coherence), and a medium-range weather forecasting workflow on the European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts ERA5 reanalysis in which the diagonal k <= 2 Q-Prior steers a Koopman rollout, improves anomaly-correlation skill by 10-39% across 48-240 h lead times, and reduces the long-horizon collapse of rollouts onto a static mean field. The two conditions of our practical-advantage definition are met at complementary levels, identifying a candidate route to practical quantum advantage before fault-tolerant hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为量子信息机器学习在混沌动力系统中的应用建立了实用量子优势的理论基础。提出一族基于k指标的量子统计先验（Q-Priors），将不变测度的k点边际编码在n_q = kq量子比特上。证明了两阶段优势：表示阶段中叠加和纠缠紧凑存储非因子化空间相关性；提取阶段中联合Bell测量对两副本进行任意泡利泛函估计，副本对数量与n_q无关，而任何自适应单副本协议需要Ω(2^(n_q))副本，这是可证明的副本测量复杂度量子-经典分离。在仿真和IQM超导处理器上实现了双副本读取。两个案例研究展示了该机制：湍流通道流中双副本读取获得了不变测度的非对角相关器；基于ECMWF ERA5再分析的中期天气预报工作流中，对角k≤2 Q-Prior引导Koopman展开，在48-240小时提前期将异常相关技能提高10-39%，并减少了长时展开向静态平均场的坍缩。
Motivation: 当前量子机器学习在混沌动力系统中的应用缺乏实用的量子优势机制，且现有先验构造局限于单站点。本文旨在提供可证明的量子-经典分离，并通过实际科学工作流验证其可行性。
Method: 提出一族k索引的高阶量子统计先验（Q-Priors），将不变测度的k点边际编码在n_q = kq量子比特上。采用两阶段优势：表示阶段利用叠加和纠缠编码空间相关性；提取阶段采用双副本联合Bell测量，实现泡利泛函估计的副本对数量与n_q无关。案例研究中，在湍流通道流中计算非对角相关器，在中期天气预报中使用对角k≤2 Q-Prior引导Koopman展开。
Result: 证明了双副本读取的副本测量复杂度与n_q无关，而任何自适应单副本协议需要Ω(2^(n_q))副本。在天气预报应用中，Q-Prior在48-240小时提前期将异常相关技能提高10-39%，并减少了长时展开向静态平均场的坍缩。
Conclusion: 该工作满足了实用量子优势定义的互补条件，为在容错量子硬件出现前实现实用量子优势提供了候选路线。

papers.title: Person Identification from Contextual Motion
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of identifying people based on their motion styles. We present a generative model describing the action instance creation process and derive a probabilistic identity inference scheme for two common person identification scenarios motivated by the surveillance and authentication applications. We introduce a novel, \emph{interactive}, scenario for person identification from motion patterns. To this end, we formalize the identification process in the context of a sequential message exchange session between the subject and the system. The subject's behavior is modeled using a probabilistic generative model inspired by the Human Information Processing (HIP) paradigm. At each stage, the system presents a visual stimulus (a cue) to the subject and records their motion response. The cue is selected so as to maximize the mutual information of the expected response and the subject's identity. Once recorded, the response is used to update the a posteriori probability over possible subjects' identities. The process terminates once a sufficient classification confidence level is reached. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time person identification is addressed in such interactive setting. We report high recognition rates on five publicly available datasets and our own novel dataset consisting of 4,476 recordings of 22 test subjects responding to 15 cues.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于运动风格的人物识别生成模型，并引入了一种新的交互式识别场景，其中系统通过依次呈现视觉刺激并记录受试者的运动响应来最大化关于身份的互信息。在五个公开数据集和一个包含22名受试者、4476条记录的自建数据集上报告了高识别率。
Motivation: 现有基于运动的人物识别大多是被动观察，本文首次将交互式识别形式化，模拟监控与认证应用中的场景。
Method: 提出一个概率生成模型描述动作实例的创建过程，并结合人类信息处理（HIP）范式，在交互过程中系统依次选择最大化预期响应与身份互信息的视觉刺激，并利用响应更新身份后验概率，直到达到足够置信水平。
Result: 在五个公开数据集以及自建数据集（4476条记录，22名受试者，15种刺激）上取得了高识别率。
Conclusion: 本文是首次在交互式场景中处理人物识别问题，实验验证了其有效性，但未讨论实时性或大规模部署的限制。

papers.title: Optimizing Appliance Scheduling for Solar Energy Management Using Metaheuristic Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Renewable energy is essential for meeting future energy demands; however, solar energy generation, which occurs only during daylight hours often does not align with household consumption patterns. Appliances such as cookers, washing machines, and dryers are typically operated according to user preferred schedules rather than solar energy availability, creating a scheduling optimization problem. The objective is to determine optimal appliance start times to maximize renewable energy utilization while minimizing user inconvenience and adhering to system constraints. This paper presents a metaheuristic approach using Iterated Local Search (ILS) and Simulated Annealing (SA) to optimize appliance start times, while considering appliance operating durations, power consumption, inverter limit, battery state of charge constraints, and solar generation forecasts. Unlike most existing work, the scheduling is extended beyond a single day to accommodate unfinished tasks from previous days (spillover), ensuring operational continuity and enabling sequential operation across multiple days. Experimental results show that the sequential multi-day scheduling framework effectively manages system constraints while ensuring user convenience under exclusive solar generation. These findings also open opportunities for future research on multi-objective trade-offs between investment in equipment of various sizes, return on that investment, and user satisfaction.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用迭代局部搜索（ILS）和模拟退火（SA）等元启发式算法优化家电启动时间，以最大化太阳能利用并减少用户不便。与大多数现有工作不同，调度扩展至多天以处理前一天未完成的任务，确保操作连续性。实验表明多天顺序调度框架能在仅依赖太阳能的情况下有效管理系统约束并保障用户便利。
Motivation: 太阳能发电仅在白天可用，与家庭用电模式不一致，而用户通常根据个人偏好而非太阳能可用性安排家电运行，形成调度优化问题。现有研究多限于单日调度，未考虑跨天任务溢出，需要一种能处理多天连续运行的方法。
Method: 采用迭代局部搜索（ILS）和模拟退火（SA）两种元启发式算法，以家电启动时间为决策变量，目标为最大化可再生能源利用并最小化用户不便。调度框架支持多天顺序运行，考虑设备运行时长、功耗、逆变器限制、电池荷电状态约束以及太阳能发电预测。
Result: 实验表明，多天顺序调度框架能有效管理系统约束，在仅依赖太阳能发电的情况下保障用户便利。
Conclusion: 该方法为多天家电调度问题提供了有效解决方案，并为进一步研究多目标权衡（如设备投资、投资回报与用户满意度）打开了机会。

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic Agents for Regulated Process Automation: Challenges and Research Agenda
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents are entering regulated industries where they automate judgment intensive quality management processes. We argue that symbolic structures already embedded in these domains, including regulations, typed process models, and compliance constraints, should be treated not merely as external monitoring mechanisms but as core architectural components that shape the agent's decision-making and behavior. We propose compliance-by-construction as a complementary paradigm to guardrail-based monitoring: a structural foundation that prevents control-flow violations, while guardrails remain essential for catching semantic errors. We identify a structured set of neuro-symbolic research challenges on foundational and capability level and show that addressing them jointly enables compliance-by-construction. We call on the neuro-symbolic community to engage with regulated process automation as a high impact research domain.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster in NILA Workshop @ IJCAI-ECAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨基于LLM的代理在监管行业自动化中的应用，提出将已有的符号结构（如法规、流程模型、合规约束）作为核心架构组件，而非外部监控机制。作者提出“合规性构建”（compliance-by-construction）作为护栏式监控的补充范式，旨在防止控制流违规，并识别出一组神经符号研究挑战。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理在监管行业中自动化质量敏感流程时，仅依靠外部护栏机制监控行为，而忽略了领域内已有的符号结构。本文主张将这些符号结构融入代理决策核心，以确保合规性。
Method: 提出“合规性构建”范式，将法规和流程模型嵌入代理架构，防止控制流违规；同时保留护栏机制捕获语义错误。在此基础上，识别基础能力和能力层面的神经符号研究挑战。
Result: 文中未提供具体实验数量结果，但指出联合解决这些挑战能够实现“合规性构建”。
Conclusion: 呼吁神经符号社区关注监管过程自动化这一高影响力研究领域。

papers.title: PolyFlow: Safe and Efficient Polytope-Constrained Flow Matching with Constraint Embedding and Projection-free Update
papers.abstract_en: While flow-based generative models have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of domains, deploying them in safety-critical physical systems remains challenging due to strict constraint requirements. Existing approaches typically enforce safety through post-hoc corrections, which incur substantial computational overhead and may distort the learned distribution. We propose PolyFlow, a polytope-constrained flow matching framework that embeds constraints directly into the model and flow dynamics. PolyFlow introduces a discrete-time flow formulation and a projection-free architecture, which eliminate the discretization error and guarantee strict satisfaction of arbitrary polyhedral constraints, without the need for expensive iterative solvers. Experimental results show that PolyFlow achieves zero constraint violation while maintaining high distributional fidelity across a range of planning and control tasks. Compared to state-of-the-art constrained generation baselines, PolyFlow significantly reduces inference latency and demonstrates a favorable trade-off between safety, efficiency, and generative quality. Code is available on https://github.com/MJianM/PolyFlow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolyFlow，一种多面体约束流匹配框架，通过将约束直接嵌入模型和流动力学，并引入离散时间流公式和无投影架构，消除了离散化误差，严格满足任意多面体约束，且无需昂贵迭代求解器。实验表明，在多个规划与控制任务中，PolyFlow 在零约束违反的同时保持高分布保真度，相比最先进的约束生成基线，显著降低推理延迟，实现了安全性、效率和生成质量之间的良好权衡。
Motivation: 现有的基于流的生成模型在安全关键物理系统中部署时面临严格约束，而传统后处理修正方式计算开销大且可能扭曲学习到的分布。
Method: 提出 PolyFlow 框架：将约束嵌入模型和流动力学，采用离散时间流公式和无投影架构，确保任意多面体约束的严格满足，避免使用迭代求解器。
Result: 在多个规划与控制任务中实现零约束违反，同时保持高分布保真度；相比现有约束生成基线，推理延迟显著降低，在安全性、效率和生成质量之间取得良好权衡。
Conclusion: PolyFlow 提供了一种安全高效的约束流匹配方法，适用于需要严格约束满足的物理系统。

papers.title: Mod-Guide: An LLM-based Content Moderation Feedback System to Address Insensitive Speech toward Indigenous Ethnic and Religious Minority Communities
papers.abstract_en: Language operates as a mechanism of both marginalization and resistance, especially for minority communities navigating insensitive and harmful speech online. As content moderation increasingly depends on large language models (LLMs), concerns arise about whether these systems can recognize culturally insensitive speech-language that disregards or marginalizes the cultural and religious perspectives of historically underrepresented communities, often through implicit erasure, misrepresentation, or normative framing, rather than overt hostility. Focusing on Bangladesh's Hindu and Chakma communities -- the country's largest religious and Indigenous ethnic minorities, respectively -- this paper investigates the epistemic limits of LLM-based moderation systems and explores methods for incorporating minority perspectives. We co-created a culturally grounded corpus of insensitive speech with community members and integrated their narratives into moderation pipelines using retrieval augmented generation (RAG). Our tool, Mod-Guide, improves LLM sensitivity to minority viewpoints by leveraging contextual cues derived from lived experience. Through mixed-method evaluations involving both minority and majority participants, we demonstrate that RAG-enhanced moderation responses are more contextually accurate and perceived differently across ethnic lines. This work advances research in human-computer interaction, AI ethics, and social computing by foregrounding restorative justice and hermeneutical inclusion in the design of content moderation systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对孟加拉国印度教和查克玛社区面临的不敏感言论，探讨LLM内容审核系统的认知局限性，并与社区共同构建文化敏感语料库，通过检索增强生成（RAG）集成少数群体视角。开发了工具Mod-Guide，利用来自生活经验的上下文线索提升LLM对少数群体观点的敏感性。混合方法评估表明，RAG增强的审核回应在上下文准确性上更好，且不同族裔的感知存在差异。
Motivation: 现有LLM内容审核系统难以识别针对少数群体的文化不敏感言论（如隐性抹除、误代、规范性框架），特别是在孟加拉国印度教和查克玛等宗教和族裔少数群体中，需要融入少数群体视角以提升公平性。
Method: 与社区成员共同创建文化敏感语料库，使用检索增强生成（RAG）将社区叙事整合到审核流水线中，构建Mod-Guide工具以增强LLM对少数群体观点的敏感性。
Result: 混合方法评估（包括少数和多数群体参与者）显示，RAG增强的审核回应在上下文准确性上更优，且不同族裔对回应的感知存在差异。
Conclusion: 该工作通过将恢复性司法和解释学包容性纳入内容审核系统设计，推进了人机交互、AI伦理和社会计算研究。

papers.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention
papers.abstract_en: Ultra-long-context capability is becoming indispensable for frontier LLMs: agentic workflows, repository-scale code reasoning, and persistent memory all require the model to jointly attend over hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, yet the quadratic cost of softmax attention makes this untenable at deployment scale. We introduce MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA), a blockwise sparse attention built upon Grouped Query Attention (GQA). A lightweight Index Branch scores key-value blocks and independently selects a Top-k subset for each GQA group, enabling group-specific sparse retrieval while maintaining efficient block-level execution; the Main Branch then performs exact block-sparse attention over only the selected blocks. Designed around a principle of simplicity and scalability, MSA is deliberately streamlined, making it straightforward to deploy efficiently across a broad range of GPUs. To translate sparsity into practical speedups, we co-design MSA with a GPU execution path that uses exp-free Top-k selection and KV-outer sparse attention to improve tensor-core utilization under block-granular access. On a 109B-parameter model with native multimodal training, MSA performs on par with GQA while reducing per-token attention compute by 28.4x at 1M context. Paired with our co-designed kernel, MSA achieves 14.2x prefill and 7.6x decoding wall-clock speedups on H800. Our inference kernel is available at: https://github.com/MiniMax-AI/MSA. A production-grade natively multimodal model powered by MSA has been publicly released at: https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA)，一种基于分组查询注意力 (GQA) 的块稀疏注意力机制，通过轻量级索引分支为每个 GQA 组独立选择 Top-k 键值块，再由主分支执行精确的块稀疏注意力。在 109B 多模态模型上，MSA 与 GQA 性能相当，但在 1M 上下文长度下将每 token 注意力计算量减少 28.4 倍，配合定制内核在 H800 上实现 14.2 倍预填充和 7.6 倍解码加速。
Motivation: 前沿大语言模型需要超长上下文能力，但 softmax 注意力的二次复杂度在部署规模上难以承受，亟需高效的稀疏注意力方法。
Method: MSA 采用双分支设计：索引分支通过无指数 Top-k 选择对每个 GQA 组独立选出重要键值块，主分支仅对所选块执行精确的块稀疏注意力；同时与 GPU 执行路径协同设计，利用外稀疏注意力提升张量核心利用率。
Result: 在 109B 参数原生多模态模型上，MSA 在 1M 上下文下减少 28.4 倍 attention 计算量，H800 GPU 上实现 14.2 倍预填充和 7.6 倍解码墙钟加速，且性能与 GQA 持平。
Conclusion: MSA 作为一种简洁可扩展的稀疏注意力方案，能有效将稀疏性转化为实际加速，适用于超长上下文 LLM 的高效部署。

papers.title: Who Pays the Price? Stakeholder-Centric Prompt Injection Benchmarking for Real-world Web Agents
papers.abstract_en: Web agents driven by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world environments, where they operate over untrusted web content and execute actions with direct consequences. This makes them vulnerable to prompt-injection attacks, in which seemingly benign content embeds adversarial instructions that manipulate agent behaviour. Existing security benchmarks adopt an \textit{attack-centric} perspective, focusing on the technical feasibility of injections while overlooking the nuanced distribution of resulting harms. In practice, however, prompt-injection risk is victim-dependent: a single exploit can produce asymmetric consequences for different stakeholders, and the same attack pattern may exhibit substantially different effectiveness depending on whom it targets. To capture these properties, we introduce \textbf{\sysname}, a \textit{stakeholder-centric} benchmark to systematically categorize and attribute harm in real-world web agent systems. It distinguishes between affected entities (e.g., user, seller, platform), decomposes the attacks into concrete objectives, and evaluates each case with complementary outcome- and process-level metrics. Our results reveal substantial and heterogeneous vulnerabilities: not a single attack objective is reliably resisted by current agents, and failures distribute across qualitatively distinct modes ranging from \emph{stealthy parasitism} (attack succeeds without disrupting the user's delegated task) to \emph{misaligned disruption} (task disrupted without attack success) and \emph{compounded failure} (both adversarial objective and task integrity simultaneously violated). These patterns are missed by conventional evaluation, highlighting the need for stakeholder-aware assessment of LLM-based agents in real-world deployments. Benchmark is available at https://github.com/StakeBench/SBC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个以利益相关者为中心的提示注入基准测试，用于评估面向真实世界Web环境的大型语言模型驱动代理的安全性。该基准系统地区分受害者实体（用户、卖家、平台），将攻击分解为具体目标，并采用结果与过程双重指标评估。实验发现当前代理无法可靠抵抗任何攻击目标，并揭示了隐蔽寄生、失调干扰和复合失败等多种失败模式。
Motivation: 现有安全基准采用攻击中心视角，仅关注注入的技术可行性，忽略了危害分布对利益相关者的不对称影响。
Method: 构建利益相关者中心基准，区分用户、卖家、平台等实体，将攻击分解为具体目标，并使用结果与过程级指标进行系统性评估。
Result: 未有任何攻击目标被当前代理可靠抵抗；失败模式包括隐蔽寄生（攻击成功但不干扰用户任务）、失调干扰（任务中断但攻击未成功）和复合失败（两者同时违背）。
Conclusion: 传统评估忽略了这些模式，凸显了在真实部署中对LLM代理进行利益相关者感知评估的必要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SmartFont: Dynamic Condition Allocation for Few-Shot Font Generation
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot font generation simultaneously requires global structural completeness and fine-grained local style fidelity. Existing methods usually either rely on global content-style modeling, which is robust but imperfectly disentangled, or emphasize component/local modeling, which captures fine details but relies heavily on local priors and reference coverage. We argue that the key challenge is not merely to learn purer conditions, but to organize complementary yet biased global and local conditions through multi-level allocation during generation. To this end, we propose SmartFont, a diffusion-based few-shot font generation framework that combines global content-style generation with weakly supervised local corrective experts. The local branch performs semantic-spatial allocation by learning expert-wise local concepts and semantically meaningful spatial maps under weak component supervision, enabling fine-grained correction without requiring explicit component-conditioned inference. On top of this, a denoising-state condition allocation module adaptively weights global content, global style, and local corrective feature across timesteps and injection blocks. Extensive experiments show that SmartFont achieves better global-local balance, improves glyph quality and local detail fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SmartFont，一个基于扩散的少样本字体生成框架，通过全局内容-风格生成与弱监督局部校正专家的结合，实现多级条件分配。该方法在保证全局结构完整性的同时提升局部细节保真度，实验表明其在字形质量和全局-局部平衡上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有少样本字体生成方法要么依赖全局内容-风格建模但解耦不完美，要么强调局部/组件建模但过度依赖局部先验和参考覆盖，难以同时满足全局结构完整性和局部风格保真度的需求。
Method: 提出SmartFont框架，包含全局内容-风格生成分支和弱监督局部校正专家分支。局部分支通过学习专家级局部概念和语义空间映射实现语义-空间分配，无需显式组件条件推理；去噪状态条件分配模块自适应地加权全局内容、全局风格和局部校正特征。
Result: 摘要报告SmartFont在全局-局部平衡、字形质量和局部细节保真度上取得更好效果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调关键挑战在于通过多级分配组织互补但有偏的全局和局部条件，而非单纯学习更纯净的条件。

papers.title: Hölder++: Improving the Quality-Coherence Trade-off in Multimodal VAEs
papers.abstract_en: Existing approaches for multimodal variational autoencoders (VAEs) face a trade-off between generative quality and coherence-i.e., they struggle to generate realistic and diverse samples that, at the same time, are semantically consistent across modalities. A recent work shows that using a simple approximation to Hölder pooling as an aggregation method improves coherence over the SOTA MMVAE+, despite assuming a single shared representation across all modalities. Yet, it slightly compromises sample diversity. Inspired by this insight, we propose Hölder++, a novel multimodal VAE that improves the generative quality-coherence trade-off through: (i) the first implementation of Hölder pooling without any approximation for multimodal VAEs; (ii) an extended architecture that models distinct shared and private (i.e., modality-specific) representations (Hölder+); and (iii) hierarchical inference that further enhances the disentanglement between the shared and private representations (Hölder++). Our experiments corroborate that Hölder++ consistently improves the generative quality-coherence trade-off, yields more structured latent spaces, and learns shared representations that are informative for downstream tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Hölder++，一种改进的多模态VAE，通过对Hölder池化的精确实现、扩展的分层架构以及层次推理来提升生成质量与模态间一致性之间的权衡。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上优于现有方法，生成更结构化且对下游任务有益的共享表示。
Motivation: 现有多模态VAE在生成质量与模态间一致性之间存在权衡，即难以同时生成高质量、多样且跨模态语义一致的样本。
Method: 提出Hölder++，包含：(i) 首次在多模态VAE中无近似实现Hölder池化；(ii) 扩展架构以建模独立的共享和私有表示（Hölder+）；(iii) 层次推理以增强共享与私有表示的解耦（Hölder++）。
Result: 实验表明，Hölder++一致地改善了生成质量与一致性的权衡，产生更结构化的潜在空间，且共享表示对下游任务具有信息量。
Conclusion: Hölder++通过精确Hölder池化、共享/私有表示分离和层次推理，有效提升多模态VAE的生成质量与一致性。

papers.title: An LLM System for Autonomous Variational Quantum Circuit Design
papers.abstract_en: The design of high performing quantum circuits remains largely dependent on human expertise. We introduce an autonomous agentic framework that employs large language models (LLMs) to conduct iterative quantum circuit designs under explicit design constraints. Our system integrates seven components: Exploration, Generation, Discussion, Validation, Storage, Evaluation, and Review. These components form a closed-loop workflow that combines web-based knowledge acquisition, literature-grounded critique, executable code generation, and experimental feedback. We evaluate the framework on two tasks: quantum feature map construction for quantum machine learning and ansatz generation for variational quantum eigensolver applications in quantum chemistry. In image classification benchmarks, the best generated feature map outperforms representative quantum feature maps and, when scaled to larger qubit counts, surpasses the classical radial basis function kernel. In molecular ground state estimation across seven molecules, the generated ansatz attains competitive accuracy with widely used chemically inspired and hardware-efficient constructions while satisfying the imposed scaling constraints. These results establish LLM driven agentic system as a viable paradigm for automated quantum circuit design and illustrate how AI systems can participate in iterative scientific optimization workflows across scientific domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的自主代理框架，用于自动设计变分量子电路。系统包含七个组件（探索、生成、讨论、验证、存储、评估和审查），形成闭环工作流，结合网络知识获取、文献批评、可执行代码生成和实验反馈。在量子机器学习特征映射和变分量子本征求解器（VQE）的量子化学应用上评估，生成的电路在图像分类基准上优于代表性特征映射并超越经典径向基函数核，在分子基态能量估计中达到与化学启发式和硬件高效构造相当的精度。
Motivation: 高性能量子电路设计仍主要依赖人类专家，缺乏自动化方法。论文旨在利用LLM自动生成满足约束条件的量子电路，减少人工干预。
Method: 提出一个由七个组件构成的闭环代理系统：探索（网络搜索）、生成（LLM生成电路候选）、讨论（文献批判性分析）、验证（语法和约束检查）、存储（数据库）、评估（实验反馈）、审查（迭代优化）。
Result: 在图像分类任务中，生成的最佳特征映射性能优于代表性量子特征映射，并在更大量子比特数时超越经典径向基函数核。在七种分子的基态能量估计中，生成的ansatz达到与化学启发式和硬件高效构造相近的精度。
Conclusion: LLM驱动的代理系统为自动量子电路设计提供了可行范式，展示了AI系统在迭代科学优化中的潜力。

papers.title: Positional Encoding in the Context of Memristor-Based Analog Computation for Automatic Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Memristors provide a new chance for resource-efficient computation of neural models for natural language processing by enabling analog execution of vector-matrix-multiplication. Yet, computations on these devices are currently subject to larger distortion, both in weight programming and execution. In this work, we identify large output values of transformed positional encodings to cause major degradation within analog-to-digital conversion (ADC) as part of memristor-based computation. By adjusting the proportion of weight and precision bits of the ADC of specific memristor layers, we reduce the degradation of the execution by ~50% relative, while keeping the estimated energy consumption stable. Additionally, we investigate scenarios where the ADC cannot be modified. In that case the degradation can be reduced by ~30% relative after removing encoding-related linear transformations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于忆阻器（memristor）的神经网络模拟计算中，位置编码的大输出值导致模数转换（ADC）性能严重下降的问题，通过调整特定忆阻器层的ADC权重和精度位比例，在保持能耗稳定的前提下将执行退化减少约50%；若无法修改ADC，则通过移除编码相关的线性变换可减少约30%的退化。
Motivation: 忆阻器为实现资源高效的神经网络计算提供了新机会，但其模拟执行易受权重编程和执行失真影响。本文发现变换后的位置编码的大输出值是导致ADC退化的主要原因。
Method: 调整特定忆阻器层的ADC权重和精度位比例，或者在无法修改ADC时移除编码相关的线性变换。
Result: 调整ADC参数后执行退化降低约50%；无法修改ADC时退化降低约30%，且估计能耗保持稳定。
Conclusion: 通过针对性地调整ADC或去除线性变换，可以显著缓解位置编码在忆阻器模拟计算中的退化问题。

papers.title: MoVerse: Real-Time Video World Modeling with Panoramic Gaussian Scaffold
papers.abstract_en: We present MoVerse, a real-time video world model that creates an interactively navigable scene from a single narrow-field-of-view image. This setting is challenging because the input observes only a small fraction of the environment, while interactive roaming requires a complete surrounding world, persistent geometry, controllable camera motion, and temporally coherent high-fidelity observations. MoVerse addresses this problem by separating world construction from observation rendering. It first expands the input into a gravity-aligned 360$^\circ$ panorama with topology-aware diffusion, closing the missing field of view before 3D reasoning. It then lifts the panorama into a persistent 3D Gaussian scaffold using panoramic geometry-aware residual prediction, yielding a dense and directly renderable spatial memory. Finally, a Gaussian-conditioned video renderer translates scaffold renderings along user-specified camera trajectories into photorealistic video. To make this renderer practical for interaction, we train a bidirectional diffusion teacher for high-quality conditional rendering and distill it into a causal autoregressive student for bounded-latency streaming. This design combines the controllability and long-range consistency of explicit 3D representations with the perceptual quality of generative video models. MoVerse supports real-time scene roaming at 8~FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX~4090 GPU, demonstrating a practical path toward single-image world creation with interactive video output.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: A Quantitative Experimental Repeated Measures Study of Training Dynamics in a Small Llama Style Language Model Under a Compute-Aware Token Budget
papers.abstract_en: This study examines training dynamics in a small Llama-style language model trained under a fixed, compute-constrained token budget. Rather than evaluating efficiency solely through endpoint performance, the study uses a quantitative experimental repeated measures design to analyze how validation loss, validation perplexity, rolling volatility, backslide behavior, spike behavior, and between-seed variability change across token-based training intervals. Six independent training runs were conducted on a 4.26-million-parameter model using the TinyStories corpus, CPU-based full-precision training, and a target budget of approximately 20 million cumulative training tokens. Metrics were collected across 21 intervals, producing 126 seed-by-interval observations. Repeated measures ANOVA showed statistically significant interval effects for validation loss, validation perplexity, and rolling volatility. Descriptive trajectories revealed rapid early improvement followed by non-monotonic degradation during later training intervals. Mean validation loss decreased from 8.3552 at initialization to 2.7996 near 4 million tokens, but increased to 3.9010 by the final checkpoint. Validation perplexity followed the same pattern, falling sharply early in training before rising later. Derived telemetry further showed recurrent validation-loss backslides and no interval-summary evidence of a stable phase under the predefined criteria. These findings suggest that compute-aware language model evaluation should examine training trajectories rather than endpoint metrics alone. In constrained compute settings, additional token exposure may increase computational cost without producing proportional generalization gains, and interval-level telemetry can reveal instability, regression, and diminishing returns that final metrics may obscure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文采用定量实验重复测量设计，研究固定计算预算下小型Llama风格语言模型的训练动态。基于4.26M参数模型和TinyStories语料，在约2000万token预算下进行6次独立训练，收集21个间隔的指标。结果显示验证损失和困惑度早期快速下降后后期上升，出现回退和不稳定行为，无稳定阶段。
Motivation: 现有评估仅关注最终性能，可能忽略计算约束下训练过程中的退化与不稳定性，需更细致地分析训练轨迹。
Method: 使用4.26M参数的Llama风格模型，在TinyStories语料上进行CPU全精度训练，固定约2000万token预算。进行6次独立运行，在21个间隔收集验证损失、困惑度、滚动波动率等指标，采用重复测量ANOVA分析。
Result: 验证损失从初始8.3552降至近400万token时的2.7996，但最终升至3.9010；困惑度呈相同模式。滚动波动率有显著间隔效应，存在验证损失回退和尖峰行为，无稳定阶段。
Conclusion: 在计算受限环境下，额外token可能增加计算成本而无比例泛化收益，应使用训练轨迹而非端点指标评估模型。间隔级遥测可揭示最终指标隐藏的不稳定性与边际收益递减。

papers.title: IterCAD: An Iterative Multimodal Agent for Visually-Grounded CAD Generation and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Computer-Aided Design is pivotal in modern manufacturing, yet existing automated methods predominantly rely on open-loop, one-shot generation, creating a mismatch with iterative real-world practices. In this paper, we present IterCAD, a unified multimodal agent framework for closed-loop, interactive CAD generation and editing. We formulate the task as a multi-turn interaction between a multimodal agent and an executable CAD sandbox, covering three tasks: Drawing-to-Code, Text-to-Code, and Interactive Editing. To support this, we develop a data synthesis pipeline incorporating advanced industrial manufacturing features to generate standard-compliant multi-view engineering drawings, complex code-editing tasks, and high-fidelity interaction trajectories. We optimize the agent via progressive SFT followed by geometry-aware reinforcement learning with viable-prefix masking to enhance code executability and geometric fidelity. Finally, we introduce the IterCAD-Bench evaluation suite and propose the Chamfer Distance Tolerance-Recall (CD-TR) curve alongside its AUC-TR metric, establishing a survivor-bias-free standard that unifies code validity and geometric precision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IterCAD achieves highly competitive performance across multiple benchmarks, significantly outperforming existing approaches in both code executability and geometric precision, while exhibiting superior capabilities in closed-loop iterative refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IterCAD，一个统一的多模态agent框架，用于闭环交互式CAD生成和编辑。它通过多轮交互、数据合成管道和几何感知强化学习优化，在代码可执行性和几何精度上超越了现有方法。
Motivation: 现有自动CAD方法多采用开环单次生成，与实际的迭代设计实践不匹配，本文目标实现闭环交互式生成和编辑。
Method: 将任务建模为多模态agent与可执行CAD沙箱的多轮交互，涵盖Drawing-to-Code、Text-to-Code和Interactive Editing三种任务。开发数据合成管道，采用渐进式SFT和几何感知强化学习（viable-prefix masking）优化agent。
Result: 在多个基准上取得竞争力，显著优于现有方法，在代码可执行性和几何精度上表现优异，并具备闭环迭代精炼能力。
Conclusion: IterCAD通过闭环交互式框架统一了CAD生成和编辑，提出的CD-TR曲线和AUC-TR评估标准消除了存活偏差，为代码有效性和几何精度提供了统一度量。

papers.title: Dual-Constrained Diffusion Image Compression for Operational Rate-Distortion-Perception Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The rate-distortion-perception (RDP) trade-off extends classical rate--distortion theory by imposing a distributional constraint on reconstructions, providing a unified framework for neural image compression that jointly governs fidelity and perceptual realism. While prior work achieves near-optimal rate--perception trade-offs, practical frameworks explicitly realizing the full RDP surface remain scarce, primarily due to the difficulty of introducing common randomness at the decoder. We propose DCIC (Dual-Constrained Diffusion Image Compression), which integrates a learned codec with a diffusion-based decoder governed by joint distortion and idempotence constraints. The distortion constraint bounds reconstruction fidelity relative to the base codec output; the idempotence constraint -- requiring that re-encoding the restored image recovers the base codec reconstruction -- serves as a tractable surrogate for the distributional perception requirement. Together, they steer the reverse denoising process via iterative optimization with consistent noise injection, realizing common randomness without additional rate overhead. At fixed rate, dual attenuation factors $(K_D, K_P)$ jointly navigate the Pareto frontier of the distortion-perception plane, enabling continuously adjustable fidelity-realism trade-offs from a single bitstream. DCIC$_{RD}$ ($K_P{=}0$) and DCIC$_{RP}$ ($K_D{=}0$) arise as boundary curves, with DCIC$_{RDP}$ ($K_D = K_P=1$) realizing the optimal interior operating point. Experiments on CelebA-HQ, CLIC2020, and ImageNet-1K across CNN, Transformer, and hybrid architectures confirm that DCIC$_{RDP}$ achieves superior BD-PSNR over all perceptual codecs, while DCIC$_{RP}$ matches dedicated perception-oriented methods in BD-FID, validating the practical value of full RDP surface navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双约束扩散图像压缩（DCIC），将学习的编解码器与基于扩散的解码器结合，通过失真约束和幂等约束实现率-失真-感知（RDP）优化。该方法在固定码率下通过双衰减因子连续调整失真-感知平衡，无需额外码率开销。实验表明DCIC在BD-PSNR和BD-FID上优于现有感知编解码器，验证了完整RDP曲面的实用价值。
Motivation: 现有神经图像压缩方法难以实现完整的率-失真-感知（RDP）曲面，主要因为解码器引入公共随机性困难。
Method: 提出DCIC框架，集成学习编解码器与扩散解码器，通过联合失真约束和幂等约束引导逆向去噪过程，利用一致噪声注入实现公共随机性，并通过双衰减因子(K_D, K_P)导航失真-感知帕累托前沿。
Result: 在CelebA-HQ、CLIC2020和ImageNet-1K上，DCIC_RDP在BD-PSNR上优于所有感知编解码器，DCIC_RP在BD-FID上匹配专用感知方法。
Conclusion: 双约束扩散图像压缩实现了完整的RDP曲面导航，证明了率-失真-感知联合优化的实践可行性。

papers.title: VideoMDM: Towards 3D Human Motion Generation From 2D Supervision
papers.abstract_en: We introduce VideoMDM, a diffusion-based framework that trains 3D human motion priors directly from accurate 2D poses extracted from monocular videos, without any 3D ground truth. A pretrained 2D-to-3D lifter provides approximate 3D pose sequences that serve as a noisy teacher: these are diffused, denoised by the model in 3D, and supervised in 2D by reprojecting the prediction and comparing against accurate keypoints. We show that, under mild assumptions, a depth-weighted 2D reprojection loss is equivalent in expectation to direct 3D supervision, and we adapt standard 3D motion regularizers - velocity consistency and over-parameterized representation alignment - to this 2D setting. Unlike methods that lift 2D to 3D only at inference, VideoMDM learns a coherent 3D motion manifold during training. On HumanML3D it nearly closes the gap to fully 3D-supervised MDM (FID 0.88 vs 0.54); On real video datasets Fit3D and NBA the method learns to generate motions consistently preferred by humans, with strong quantitative results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VideoMDM，一个基于扩散的框架，仅从单目视频的精确 2D 姿态训练 3D 人体运动先验，无需 3D 真值。通过预训练的 2D 到 3D 提升器提供近似 3D 序列作为噪声教师，模型在 3D 中扩散和去噪，再通过重投影在 2D 中监督。在 HumanML3D 上，FID 0.88 接近完全 3D 监督的 MDM (0.54)；在真实视频数据集 Fit3D 和 NBA 上，生成的运动被人类偏好。
Motivation: 现有 3D 人体运动生成依赖昂贵的 3D 真值数据，限制了可扩展性。
Method: 使用 2D 到 3D 提升器生成近似 3D 序列作为噪声教师，对 3D 序列扩散和去噪，然后通过深度加权的 2D 重投影损失与精确 2D 关键点比较进行监督，并调整 3D 运动正则化器到 2D 设置。
Result: 在 HumanML3D 上 FID 0.88 vs 3D 监督的 0.54；在 Fit3D 和 NBA 上生成的运动被人类偏好。
Conclusion: VideoMDM 训练时学习一致的 3D 运动流形，缩小了与 3D 监督方法的差距，且适用于真实视频数据。

papers.title: Can I Buy Your KV Cache?
papers.abstract_en: Right now, across the world, AI agents are repeating the same absurd act: to read one document, they each recompute it from scratch. Every agent re-runs prefill, the most compute-intensive step a large model takes, over identical text, only to rebuild a key-value (KV) cache identical to the one the agent before it just built. The same answer, computed a million times. We make a proposal that is almost offensively simple: compute it once. Let a publisher precompute a document's KV cache, and let every other agent buy the right to load it and skip prefill. It works, and it is token-exact: loading a precomputed KV and continuing matches prefilling from scratch (24/24 greedy tokens, and at the logits level), with no accuracy cost. On Qwen3-4B, reuse is 9-50x cheaper in compute than prefill, and the gap widens with length (prefill's attention scales with L^2), so a single reuse already pays it back. Then the part that matters: where the KV lives. Shipping it fails, because KV is nearly incompressible, so per-load egress costs more than the prefill it saves. Hosting it provider-side, exactly as production prompt-caching works, removes egress entirely. The size of the prize is set by our measured compute saving: serving one hot 3774-token document to 80M agents costs ~$1.5M to re-prefill but only ~$0.03M of reuse compute (49.7x less). The 0.1x cache-read tariff APIs charge passes a 10x discount to users while sitting inside this measured envelope, so the 10x is a floor that the measured ~50x compute saving clears, and the gap to the physical ~50x is provider margin: millions of dollars per popular document. We frame the resulting agent-native prefill CDN and leave lossless KV compression and a cross-party payment layer as the open problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种极其简单的方案：让发布者预计算文档的KV缓存（key-value cache），其他AI代理付费加载该缓存以避免重复进行预填充（prefill）计算。实验表明，加载预计算KV缓存与从头预填充在符号和logits级别上完全一致，无精度损失。在Qwen3-4B模型上，重用KV缓存的计算成本仅为预填充的1/9到1/50，且差距随文档长度增大。然而，由于KV缓存几乎不可压缩，传输缓存的外部成本过高；若在服务端托管（类似提示缓存），则可消除传输成本。以一篇热门3774 token文档为例，服务8000万代理的预填充计算成本约150万美元，而重用计算仅约3万美元（节省49.7倍）。作者提出了一个面向代理的原生预填充CDN框架，并将无损KV压缩和跨方支付层作为开放问题。
Motivation: 当前AI代理每次读取文档都重复执行最耗计算的预填充步骤，导致巨大算力浪费。本文旨在提出一种共享KV缓存的商业和技术方案，避免重复计算。
Method: 提出由发布者预计算文档的KV缓存，其他代理付费加载缓存并跳过预填充。通过实验验证KV缓存加载与从头预填充在符号和logits级别上完全一致。分析传输成本（高）和托管成本（低），并基于实际测量估算计算节省量。
Result: 在Qwen3-4B上，KV缓存重用计算成本比预填充低9-50倍，且随长度增加优势扩大。以3774 token文档为例，8000万代理的重用计算成本仅约预填充的1/50（3万美元 vs 150万美元）。
Conclusion: 该方案在技术上可行且能大幅降低计算成本，但需解决KV缓存传输成本高昂的问题；托管方案可消除传输成本。作者将无损KV压缩和跨方支付层视为开放问题。

papers.title: Real-Time Execution with Autoregressive Policies
papers.abstract_en: Real-time execution, enabled by asynchronous inference that ensures both smooth action trajectories and fast reactivity, is critical for realistic deployments of large-scale Vision-Language-Action models. However, recent work on real-time execution primarily focuses on variants of diffusion policies, even though it is more critical for autoregressive policies given their slower rollout speed in synchronous inference. In contrast, we demonstrate that autoregressive policies can achieve real-time execution by adjusting the tokenization horizon and applying constrained decoding, thereby guaranteeing strict latency bounds that enable multi-trajectory decoding to maximize performance. Across simulated and real-world environments, we find that the autoregressive policy consistently outperforms its equivalent-level flow-matching policy counterpart while achieving significantly improved task completion speeds from synchronous inference. Coupled with the inherent advantages of autoregressive policies, such as faster convergence and better generalizability in instruction-following, these results confirm that autoregressive policies can remain a competitive policy type supporting real-time execution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自回归策略（autoregressive policies）在实时执行中的应用，通过调整标记化范围和约束解码实现严格的延迟界限，从而支持多轨迹解码以提高性能。在模拟和真实环境中，自回归策略优于等流动匹配策略，并提高了任务完成速度。
Motivation: 现有的实时执行工作主要关注扩散策略的变体，而自回归策略由于同步推理速度较慢，更有必要实现实时执行。
Method: 通过调整标记化范围（tokenization horizon）和应用约束解码（constrained decoding）来保证严格的延迟界限，从而支持多轨迹解码（multi-trajectory decoding）以最大化性能。
Result: 在模拟和真实环境中，自回归策略持续优于等流动匹配策略，同时从同步推理中显著提高了任务完成速度。
Conclusion: 自回归策略可以成为支持实时执行的竞争性策略类型，并具有更快的收敛速度和更好的指令跟随泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IVIE: A Neuro-symbolic Approach to Incremental and Validated Generation of Interactive Fiction Worlds
papers.abstract_en: Computational creativity in Interactive Fiction faces a fundamental tension: Large Language Models (LLM) may produce creative narratives but struggle with world coherence, while symbolic systems ensure consistency but lack creative flexibility. We present IVIE (Incremental & Validated Interactive Experiences), a neuro-symbolic approach to generating complete and playable interactive fiction worlds from scratch. Building upon PAYADOR's neuro-symbolic framework, IVIE implements a four-stage incremental generation pipeline that delegates creative decisions--setting and character creation, puzzle design--to LLMs while grounding the world state through symbolic validation. The system generates worlds with interconnected locations, functional items, non-player characters, and coherent puzzles, all structured around a central goal-oriented architecture. Human evaluation shows the approach generates immersive, thematically coherent worlds with high player engagement. Results seem to indicate that the neuro-symbolic approach successfully balances flexibility with narrative coherence: symbolic validation grounds LLM generation without eliminating generative freedom. However, challenges remain: LLM inconsistencies occasionally bypass puzzle constraints, and objective validation gaps allow some structurally impossible goals. We identify key design considerations for future neurosymbolic interactive storytelling systems, particularly regarding LLM capabilities and their limitations.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. To appear in the Proceedings of the 16th International Conference on Computational Creativity (ICCC'26), June 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种神经符号方法 IVIE，通过四阶段增量生成管道，结合 LLM 的创意与符号验证的连贯性，自动生成可玩的交互式小说世界。人工评估表明生成的世界具有沉浸感和主题连贯性，但 LLM 的不一致性和验证漏洞仍导致部分目标不可达。
Motivation: 交互式小说生成中，LLM 富有创意但世界连贯性差，符号系统一致性强但缺乏灵活性，需要一种平衡两者的方法。
Method: 基于 PAYADOR 框架，实现四阶段增量生成：由 LLM 负责设定、角色、谜题等创意决策，通过符号验证确保世界状态一致性，最终生成包含地点、物品、NPC 和谜题的完整世界。
Result: 人工评估显示生成的世界具有高沉浸感和主题连贯性，玩家参与度高；但 LLM 不一致性偶尔绕过谜题约束，客观验证漏洞导致部分目标结构上不可能。
Conclusion: 神经符号方法成功平衡了灵活性与叙事连贯性，符号验证约束了 LLM 生成而不消除其自由度；未来需注意 LLM 能力限制和验证设计。

papers.title: Enhanced Low-Density Region Exploration in Classifier-Guided Diffusion Models Through Modified Reverse Diffusion Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have emerged as state-of-the-art generative models for high-fidelity image synthesis, particularly in their classifier-free guided and classifier-guided forms. However, standard classifier guidance concentrates probability mass around high-density class mean, leading to poor coverage of rare samples in the tails of the class-conditional distributions. Recent work on diffusion-based tail sampling mitigates this by training an additional low-density-seeking classifier with a synthetic-vs-real discriminator, at the cost of additional networks and training. In parallel, a number of samplers and distillation techniques accelerate or refine diffusion sampling, but do not explicitly address long-tail coverage. We propose a purely sampling-time, density-aware extension of classifier-guided conditional diffusion model that targets low-density regions without any additional training. We have applied guidance at noisy images not on predicted noise like most diffusion models. Starting from a pretrained conditional diffusion model and classifier on ImageNet, we modify the guided reverse dynamics by steering trajectories toward low-confidence regions via the modified classifier gradient, and at each time step, we also guide the sampling process toward the predicted real image. 1st guidance helps explore low-probability samples, and 2nd guidance helps to generate samples to be close to the real data manifold. The proposed sampler consistently improves ADM model recall at 64x64 resolution while maintaining a comparable FID, and with a 256x256 ADM model, we showed the results visually with different combinations of both guidance. We also showed that standard ADM classifier guidance, combined with predicted real image guidance, helps generate high perceptual quality samples with a 256x256 ADM model on ImageNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种纯采样阶段的密度感知扩展方法，用于分类器引导的条件扩散模型，旨在探索低密度区域，无需额外训练。通过修改反向扩散动力学，将轨迹引向分类器低置信区域，同时引导向预测的真实图像，提高了ADM模型在64x64分辨率下的召回率，并保持FID相当。在256x256分辨率下，结合标准分类器引导与预测真实图像引导可生成高感知质量样本。
Motivation: 标准分类器引导将概率质量集中于高密度区域，导致对类条件分布尾部稀有样本的覆盖不足。现有方法需额外训练网络，成本较高。
Method: 在预训练的条件扩散模型和分类器基础上，修改引导反向动力学：第一，用修改的分类器梯度将轨迹引向低置信区域；第二，在每一步引导采样过程接近预测的真实图像。两种引导均作用于噪声图像而非预测噪声，无需额外训练。
Result: 在64x64分辨率ImageNet上，ADM模型召回率一致提升，FID保持相当；在256x256分辨率下，通过不同组合展示了视觉结果。
Conclusion: 该方法无需额外训练即可探索低密度区域，且标准分类器引导与预测真实图像引导结合可提升生成样本的感知质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JointEdit3D: Feed-Forward 3D Scene Editing in a Unified Latent Space
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D scene editing methods typically rely on per-scene optimization over explicit 3D representations or cascaded edit-and-reconstruct pipelines, resulting in high test-time cost, limited 3D awareness, and structural inconsistencies. To couple appearance synthesis and geometry prediction during editing, we build on a unified RGB-geometry reconstruction-generation latent space and adapt it to feed-forward 3D scene editing. The resulting framework, \textbf{JointEdit3D}, performs asymmetric latent inpainting by observing only a single edited RGB reference latent and generating the remaining RGB views and edited geometry latent under source-scene anchoring. JointEdit3D introduces a dedicated SceneAnchor Branch to inject source-scene structure without forcing direct copying, and adopts edit/background-aware losses to balance edited-region fidelity with unedited-content preservation. To address the lack of paired resources for standardized 3D scene editing evaluation, we introduce SceneEdit3D-15K, a dataset with 15K paired editing samples and renderer-provided 3D annotations, together with SceneEdit3D-Bench, a curated 100-sample benchmark. Experiments show that JointEdit3D improves edited-region quality and 3D structural completeness over prior baselines while maintaining competitive background preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JointEdit3D，一种前馈式 3D 场景编辑框架，基于统一的 RGB-几何重建生成潜在空间，通过非对称潜在修复仅利用单张编辑后的 RGB 参考图生成其余视图和编辑后的几何潜在变量，并引入 SceneAnchor Branch 注入源场景结构。同时构建了包含 15K 配对编辑样本的 SceneEdit3D-15K 数据集和 100 样本的 SceneEdit3D-Bench 基准。实验显示该方法在编辑区域质量和 3D 结构完整性上优于先前基线，且背景保留具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有 3D 场景编辑方法依赖逐场景优化或级联编辑重建流水线，导致测试时间长、3D 感知有限、结构不一致，亟需一种更高效且保持 3D 一致性的前馈式编辑方法。
Method: 构建统一 RGB-几何潜在空间，通过非对称潜在修复从单张编辑后的 RGB 参考图生成其余 RGB 视图和编辑后的几何潜在变量；设计 SceneAnchor Branch 注入源场景结构避免直接拷贝，并采用编辑/背景感知损失平衡编辑区域真实性与未编辑内容保留。
Result: 在自建 SceneEdit3D-Bench 基准上，JointEdit3D 在编辑区域质量和 3D 结构完整性上超越先前基线，同时背景保留与基线相当或更优。
Conclusion: JointEdit3D 通过统一的潜在空间和前馈架构实现了高效且结构一致的 3D 场景编辑，但依赖单张参考图可能限制复杂编辑的灵活性，且数据集为合成场景，未来需扩展到真实场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dual-Domain Equivariant Generative Adversarial Network for Multimodal CT-PET Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We present a Dual-Domain Equivariant Generative Adversarial Network (DDE-GAN) for multimodal CT-PET image synthesis. Traditional GAN-based approaches often operate solely in the spatial domain and ignore geometric consistency, resulting in limited structural fidelity. DDE-GAN addresses these challenges by jointly learning from both spatial and frequency (Fourier) domains, capturing complementary anatomical and spectral information. Furthermore, rotational equivariance embedded in the physics of the CT and PET measurements are integrated into the loss of both the generator and discriminator to ensure consistent responses under rotations, improving anatomical accuracy. A hierarchical dual-domain training strategy enforces intra- and inter-domain consistency through multi-stage loss functions. Evaluated on the HECKTOR 2022 CT-PET dataset, DDE-GAN achieves superior synthesis quality over baseline models for CT-PET image synthesis. The results demonstrate that combining dual-domain learning with geometric equivariance substantially enhances multimodal image synthesis accuracy and robustness, enabling practical applications in PET completion and data augmentation.

TL;DR: 本文提出双域等变生成对抗网络（DDE-GAN）用于多模态CT-PET图像合成。该网络联合学习空间域和频率（傅里叶）域特征，并利用CT和PET测量物理中固有的旋转等变性约束生成器和判别器损失，以保证旋转一致性。采用层次化双域训练策略，通过多阶段损失函数强制域内和域间一致性。在HECKTOR 2022数据集上评估，DDE-GAN在CT-PET合成质量上优于基线模型。结果表明，双域学习与几何等变性显著提高了多模态图像合成的准确性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 传统基于GAN的方法通常仅在空间域操作，忽略几何一致性，导致结构保真度有限。
Method: 提出双域等变生成对抗网络，联合学习空间和频率域，将旋转等变性嵌入生成器和判别器损失，并采用层次化双域训练策略。
Result: 在HECKTOR 2022 CT-PET数据集上，DDE-GAN的合成质量优于基线模型。
Conclusion: 双域学习与几何等变性相结合能显著增强多模态图像合成的准确性和鲁棒性，可应用于PET补全和数据增强。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Navigating the Safety-Fidelity Trade-off: Massive-Variate Time Series Forecasting for Power Systems via Probabilistic Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic forecasting models are increasingly deployed on multivariate systems with distinct channel physics and operational constraints, but existing benchmarks evaluate neither property at scale. Public canonical multivariate benchmarks cap out at 2,000 channels, while power-system benchmarks either lack temporal structure or probabilistic evaluation. We introduce PowerPhase, a probabilistic forecasting benchmark built on six transmission grids ranging from 2,000 to 36,964 jointly forecasted channels, more than an order of magnitude beyond popular canonical multivariate benchmarks. Each target trajectory is the output of an AC power-flow solve, and PowerPhase ships with constraint-aware metrics, including Safety_mBrier, NECV, and CVaR-alpha, that complement CRPS and Distortion. Across eight baselines and three seeds, distributional accuracy and constraint satisfaction rank models differently, a trade-off we term safety-fidelity. We further propose PowerForge, a scenario-based quantile forecaster with type-specific decoding heads and a causal bridge between variable groups, which achieves the best average rank on every grid.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电力系统大规模多元时间序列概率预测，提出PowerPhase基准（包含6个传输网格，通道数多达36,964）和PowerForge模型（基于场景的分位数预测器，具有类型特异性解码头和变量组间的因果桥）。通过引入安全感知指标（Safety_mBrier、NECV、CVaR-α），揭示了预测准确性与约束满足之间的安全-保真度权衡。实验表明，PowerForge在所有网格上平均排名最佳。
Motivation: 现有概率预测基准的通道数不超过2,000，且缺乏对电力系统物理约束和安全指标的评估，无法指导大规模实时预测中的实际部署。
Method: 构建基于交流潮流求解的电力系统概率预测基准PowerPhase，涵盖2,000至36,964个通道；提出PowerForge模型，采用类型特异解码头和多变量组间的因果桥，生成场景式分位数预测。
Result: 在8个基线与3个随机种子的实验中，PowerForge在所有网格上取得最佳平均排名，且分布精度和约束满足的模型排名不一致，验证了安全-保真度权衡。
Conclusion: 电力系统概率预测需同时考虑分布准确性与安全约束，所提基准和模型为大规模多变量预测提供了标准化评估框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: OR-Action: Multi-Role Video Understanding with Fine-Grained Actions
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained understanding of operating room (OR) activity could enable workflow-aware assistance, yet remains difficult due to clutter, occlusions, and limited sensing. The prevailing approach to model this environment is scene graphs as an interpretable representation of OR interactions. Converting their frame-wise relational predictions into temporally extended, fine-grained actions however, is challenging without explicit temporal modeling. To enable a principled temporal evaluation of current OR understanding methods, we introduce the first action-centric benchmark built on a publicly available ego-exocentric OR dataset by defining a fine-grained, multi-role action taxonomy and generating dense action segments via distillation from ground-truth scene graph state changes. Experiments on this benchmark show that current scene graph prediction methods struggle to model temporal structure, even when adding explicit modeling through Graph Neural Networks. We therefore introduce a vision-only temporal model that outperforms graph-based methods significantly when using all available egocentric video as input. Building on this model we also introduce a novel multi- to single-view feature alignment strategy that improves single-view performance on multi-role action recognition, mitigating the need for extensive egocentric video capture. Benchmark and code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对手术室（OR）细粒度动作理解问题，提出了第一个基于公开数据集的以动作为中心的基准，定义了多角色细粒度动作分类，并通过从场景图状态变化中提取密集动作段。实验表明当前场景图方法难以建模时间结构，为此提出了纯视觉时序模型，显著优于图方法，并引入多视图到单视图的特征对齐策略以提升单视图多角色动作识别。
Motivation: 现有手术室理解方法主要依赖场景图，但将其帧级关系预测转化为时间扩展的细粒度动作缺乏显式时间建模，且缺乏以动作为中心的评估基准。
Method: 构建基于公开ego-exocentric OR数据集的动作基准，定义多角色细粒度动作分类，通过从场景图状态变化蒸馏生成密集动作段；提出纯视觉时序模型，并引入多视图到单视图特征对齐策略。
Result: 纯视觉时序模型在使用所有可用ego视频作为输入时显著优于图方法；多视图到单视图特征对齐策略提升了单视图多角色动作识别性能。
Conclusion: 该基准和模型为手术室细粒度动作理解提供了评估框架和有效方法，代码和基准将在接收后公开。

papers.title: ReSum: Synergizing LLM Reasoning and Summarization with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a central technique for improving long-horizon reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing RLVR methods often encourage unnecessarily long reasoning rollouts, which can degrade reasoning coherence and exhaust the available context budget. Existing approaches to long-context organization often depend on external mechanisms to organize rollouts, rather than enabling the model to manage its own reasoning trajectory. To address this limitation, we propose ReSum, a novel RLVR framework that enables LLMs to compress and organize their reasoning trajectories through self-summarization. Our pilot studies show that self-summarization stabilizes generation by lowering token-level entropy, and that introducing a ``summarization'' phrase can substantially mitigate errors propagated from an incorrect rollout prefix. Motivated by these findings, ReSum adopts a summarization-aware adaptive rollout mechanism that contrastively evaluates whether self-summarization benefits the ongoing reasoning process. Specifically, when the model spontaneously triggers self-summarization, ReSum masks the summarization phrase to create a contrastive branch; for non-summarization positions, it instead randomly injects the phrase to create a matched branch. We further design a summarization-aware advantage to enable finer-grained comparison between contrastive rollout trajectories. Extensive experiments show that ReSum improves performance at an average of 4\% while reducing rollout length by 18.6\%.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReSum框架，利用强化学习中的可验证奖励（RLVR）使大语言模型（LLM）通过自我总结压缩和组织推理轨迹。实验表明，ReSum平均提升性能4%，同时缩短推理长度18.6%。
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法常导致过长的推理轨迹，降低推理连贯性并耗尽上下文预算，且缺乏让模型自主管理推理轨迹的能力。
Method: ReSum采用总结感知的自适应展开机制，通过对比评估自我总结是否有利于当前推理过程：在模型触发自我总结时掩蔽总结短语创建对比分支，在非总结位置随机注入短语创建匹配分支，并设计总结感知优势进行细粒度比较。
Result: 在多个基准上，ReSum平均提升性能4%，并将推理长度减少18.6%。
Conclusion: 自我总结能稳定生成并减少错误传播，ReSum通过强化学习有效协同推理与总结，提升效率。

papers.title: Masked and Predictive Self-Supervised Foundation Models for 3D Brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised foundation models have shown strong promise in medical imaging. However, existing MRI foundation-model studies have primarily emphasized segmentation and dense prediction tasks, while systematic investigation of self-supervised foundation models for MRI-based disease detection remains limited. In this work, we investigate two major self-supervised pretraining paradigms for MRI-based disease detection: reconstruction-based learning via Masked Autoencoders (MAE) and predictive representation learning via Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA). We study the role of auxiliary objectives by introducing a novel spectral-domain reconstruction loss for MAE to enhance sensitivity to fine-grained anatomical structure, and by integrating variance--covariance regularization (VCR) within our JEPA framework to encourage decorrelated latent representations. Our models are pretrained on heterogeneous single-contrast MRI volumes in a contrast-agnostic setting, without modality concatenation. Across five downstream disease detection tasks, our results highlight the importance of self-supervised objective design for medical foundation model pretraining, demonstrating that the downstream benefit of each objective is determined by its relevance to the task's structure. Specifically, spectral regularization yields the largest improvements when the downstream discriminative signal is characterized by strong high-frequency anatomical structures, while covariance regularization is most beneficial when discriminative information spans multiple decorrelated feature dimensions. MAE with spectral-domain supervision consistently achieves superior downstream performance for MRI-based disease detection. These findings suggest that self-supervised objectives in medical imaging encode specific biases, and their downstream benefit is fundamentally conditioned on the task's structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了基于掩码自编码器（MAE）和联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的两种自监督预训练范式用于MRI疾病检测。通过引入光谱域重建损失（MAE）和方差-协方差正则化（JEPA），在五个下游疾病检测任务上评估，结果表明MAE+光谱监督始终最优，且下游收益取决于目标函数与任务结构的匹配程度。
Motivation: 现有MRI基础模型研究主要集中于分割和密集预测任务，对基于MRI的疾病检测的系统性自监督预训练研究不足。
Method: 在对比无关的异构单对比MRI体素上预训练，采用MAE（添加光谱域重建损失以增强细粒度解剖结构敏感性）和JEPA（集成方差-协方差正则化以鼓励去相关潜在表示）两种范式。
Result: MAE结合光谱域监督在五个下游疾病检测任务中一致取得最优性能；当判别信号具有强高频解剖结构时光谱正则化提升最大，当判别信息跨越多个去相关特征维度时协方差正则化最有利。
Conclusion: 自监督目标在医学影像中编码特定偏置，其下游收益根本上取决于任务结构。

papers.title: MagPlus: Bridging Micro-to-Regular Facial Expressions through Learnable Magnification
papers.abstract_en: Facial micro-expressions are subtle and short-lived facial movements that provide important cues about genuine human emotions. However, modeling and generating them remains difficult because annotated micro-expression data is limited and the underlying facial motions are extremely weak. Existing micro-expression generation methods therefore often suffer from limited quality, weak robustness, and poor generalization. We propose MagPlus, a transferable micro-expression processing pipeline that connects micro-expression analysis with standard facial animation models. Instead of training a dedicated generator from scratch, MagPlus learns to magnify subtle facial motions into the range of regular facial expressions, transforming micro-expressions into signals that are compatible with existing facial expression processing models. The magnified sequence is then used by a standard facial expression model for tasks such as transfer and synthesis. A complementary DeMagPlus module then restores the generated motion back to realistic micro-expression intensity levels while preserving the synthesized dynamics. We evaluate the framework using four facial animation models: FOMM, FSRT, MetaPortrait, and EmoPortraits. None of these models are trained on micro-expression data. Experiments show that MagPlus-DeMagPlus enables pretrained macro-expression models to generate more realistic micro-expression motion without retraining the backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MagPlus，一种可迁移的微表情处理流水线，通过学习放大微妙的运动到常规表情范围，再利用标准面部动画模型（如FOMM、FSRT、MetaPortrait、EmoPortraits）进行表情生成，最后通过DeMagPlus模块还原回真实微表情强度。实验表明，该方法使预训练的宏表情模型能生成更真实的微表情运动，无需重新训练。
Motivation: 微表情数据稀缺且运动微弱，现有生成方法质量有限、鲁棒性差、泛化能力不足。
Method: 学习放大微表情运动至常规表情范围，使标准表情模型能够处理，再通过互补的DeMagPlus模块还原回微表情强度。
Result: 在四种面部动画模型（FOMM、FSRT、MetaPortrait、EmoPortraits）上评估，这些模型均未在微表情数据上训练，实验显示MagPlus-DeMagPlus使预训练宏表情模型生成更真实的微表情运动。
Conclusion: 该方法无需重新训练骨干网络即可让宏表情模型处理微表情生成任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rarity-Gated Context Conditioning for Offline Imitation Learning-Based Maritime Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Contextual anomaly detection aims to identify abnormal behavior conditional on context variables, but practical deployments often face highly imbalanced context distributions where rare regimes can be critical information. Under such frequency bias, context-conditioned models can produce unstable decisions and excessive false alarms in rare contexts. We propose Rarity-Gated Feature-wise Linear Modulation (RGFiLM), a rarity-aware conditioning module that combines feature-wise modulation (i.e., context-conditioned scaling and shifting of hidden features) with a gate controlled by a data-driven rarity score. The rarity score is estimated from the empirical distribution of context variables and regulates how strongly context modulates intermediate representations: the gate becomes more decisive under rare contexts while remaining conservative under frequent contexts. We evaluate RGFiLM on maritime trajectory anomaly detection using AIS motion sequences with ERA5 environmental context in an environment-sensitive detour scenario. When instantiated in a sequential anomaly scoring pipeline, RGFiLM achieves the best mean F1--False Positive Rate (FPR) trade-off among the compared context-agnostic and context-conditioned methods. These results suggest that explicitly accounting for context rarity is an effective approach for reducing false alarms in context-sensitive anomaly detection.

Result: 在海上轨迹异常检测（使用AIS运动序列和ERA5环境上下文）上，RGFiLM在F1与假阳性率权衡上优于对比的上下文无关和上下文条件方法。
Conclusion: 显式考虑上下文稀有性是降低上下文敏感异常检测中假警报的有效方法。

papers.title: ReFree: Towards Realistic Co-Speech Video Generation via Reward-Free RL and Multilevel Speech Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Speech-driven talking character animation seeks to generate life-like portrait videos that convey natural conversation behavior, aligning facial motion with spoken audio. Although recent advances in video generation have substantially improved realism in video-based animation, achieving both accurate lip articulation and expressive behavior remains challenging. Existing approaches typically trade off precise phoneme-to-lip synchronization against dynamic facial expressions and head motion, yielding animations that are either accurate yet rigid, or expressive but poorly synchronized. We address this challenge by proposing ReFree-S2V, a flow-matching speech-to-portrait animation framework that builds upon a pretrained video generation model to achieve fine-grained speech articulation and high-level expressive cues in speech-driven portrait animation. This model introduces a multi-level speech representation capturing phonetic and prosodic information at both local and global granularities. These representations are selectively injected into transformer blocks via learnable level selectors, enabling both accurate lip synchronization and natural expressive motion. To achieve natural head movements, we further introduce a novel reward-free reinforcement learning scheme into flow-matching training to discourage perceptually implausible motion without relying on handcrafted synchronization metrics or reward models, or the high cost of human preference annotation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ReFree-S2V achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming existing methods in both quantitative lip-sync accuracy and qualitative human evaluations of naturalness and expressivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReFree-S2V，一种基于流匹配（flow-matching）的语音驱动肖像动画框架，通过多级语音表示（捕捉音素和韵律信息）和可学习的层级选择器注入Transformer块，实现精确唇同步与自然表情。同时引入无奖励强化学习（reward-free RL）训练策略，避免手工同步指标或偏好标注，生成逼真的头部运动。实验表明该方法在定量唇同步精度和定性自然度、表现力上均达到SOTA。
Motivation: 现有方法难以同时实现精确的唇同步与丰富的面部表情及头部运动，往往在两者间取舍，导致动画要么准确但僵硬，要么表现力好但同步差。
Method: 基于预训练视频生成模型构建流匹配框架，使用多级语音表示（局部和全局的音素、韵律信息），通过可学习的层级选择器选择性注入Transformer；引入无奖励强化学习（reward-free RL）在流匹配训练中抑制感知上不合理的运动，无需手工设计同步指标或人类偏好标注。
Result: 在定量唇同步精度和定性人类评估（自然度、表现力）上显著优于现有方法，达到SOTA。
Conclusion: 所提出的多级语音表示与无奖励强化学习方案有效平衡了唇同步与表情/头部运动的自然度，为语音驱动肖像动画提供了更逼真的方案。

papers.title: DuET: Dual Expert Trajectories for Diffusion Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Recent diffusion editors perform diverse instruction-based edits while conditioning on the source image at every denoising step. Yet persistent source-image conditioning can limit how fully an edit is executed and how natural the result appears, especially when the target scene diverges substantially from the input. We introduce DuET (Dual Expert Trajectories), a training-free inference method that temporarily relaxes source-image conditioning by transitioning through a text-to-image phase before returning to edit mode, allowing the denoising trajectory to move toward the target distribution while retaining the structural benefits of image-conditioned editing. Without modifying model weights or increasing sampling cost, DuET consistently improves instruction relevance, semantic fidelity, and perceptual quality across diverse models and benchmarks. In some cases, these gains come with a modest reduction in source-image preservation, revealing a predictable trade-off between source preservation and edit fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DuET，一种无需训练的图像编辑推理方法，通过在去噪过程中暂时切换到文本到图像阶段来放松对源图像的持续条件约束，从而提升编辑指令相关性、语义忠实度和感知质量。该方法不修改模型权重或增加采样成本，但在某些情况下会轻微降低源图像保持度。
Motivation: 现有扩散编辑器在每一步都依赖源图像条件，当目标场景与输入差异较大时，编辑效果受限且结果不自然。
Method: DuET 在去噪轨迹中插入一段无源图像条件的文本到图像生成阶段，之后再返回编辑模式，从而在保留图像条件编辑的结构优势的同时，使轨迹更接近目标分布。
Result: 在多个模型和基准上，DuET 一致提升了指令相关性、语义忠实度和感知质量，但源图像保持度略有下降，揭示了编辑保真度与源保持度之间的可预测权衡。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种训练自由的推理策略，能有效改善扩散编辑器的性能，但存在源图像保持与编辑效果之间的权衡。

papers.title: Physics-Guided Spatiotemporal Learning for Coastal Wave Peak Period Estimation from Video
papers.abstract_en: Wave parameters in the nearshore are crucial for coastal engineering, shoreline protection, marine hazard assessment, and coastal management for climate resilience. Traditional monitoring systems like buoys and radar platforms offer accurate monitoring but can have high installation and maintenance expenses and limited spatial coverage. Passive ocean monitoring using video has been achieved by leveraging deep learning, however, many methods are not physically interpretable, feasible, and validated for oceanography. In thiswork, a Physics-Guided Deep Spatiotemporal Learning Framework for direct estimation of nearshore wave peak periods from passive coastal video stream is proposed. The framework combines automated temporal-variance based region-of-interest detection, multi-stage Sim-to-Real transfer learning, and physics-informed regularization to enhance the predictive accuracy and physical consistency. A variety of spatiotemporal architectures were assessed, such as transformer-based and recurrent-convolutional ones, alongside synthetic pretraining,silver-label adaptation, and expert fine-tuning. The results show that transformer-based architectures outperformed in terms of the accuracy of the instantaneous prediction, while lightweight recurrent-convolutional architectures achieved higher temporal stability and operational oceanographic skill. Ablation studies also demonstrated the benefits of physics-guided regularization in terms of trend-following consistency, and physically implausible predictions. Explainability auditing also helped to focus attention in hydrodynamically active surf-zone regions and showed good agreement with the physically derived wave propagation behavior. In general, the proposed framework shows the promise of physics-guided video-based deep learning systems for long-term coastal wave monitoring that are cost-efficient and operationally feasible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种物理引导的深度时空学习框架，用于从海岸视频流直接估计近岸波浪峰值周期。框架结合了基于时间方差的感兴趣区域检测、多阶段模拟到真实迁移学习以及物理信息正则化。实验表明，Transformer架构在瞬时预测精度上最优，而轻量级循环卷积架构在时间稳定性和海洋学技能上更优。物理引导正则化有助于提升趋势一致性和减少物理上不可信的预测。
Motivation: 传统波浪监测系统（如浮标、雷达）成本高且空间覆盖有限，现有基于视频的深度学习方法缺乏物理可解释性和海洋学验证。
Method: 提出物理引导的深度时空学习框架，包含自动时间方差感兴趣区域检测、多阶段Sim-to-Real迁移学习（合成预训练、银标签适应、专家微调）以及物理信息正则化，并评估了多种时空架构（Transformer、循环卷积等）。
Result: Transformer架构在瞬时预测精度上最优，轻量级循环卷积架构具有更高的时间稳定性和海洋学技能；消融实验验证了物理正则化在趋势一致性和减少不可信预测上的益处；可解释性审计显示注意力聚焦于水动力活跃的破波区，与物理传播行为一致。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了物理引导的视频深度学习系统在长期近岸波浪监测中的成本效益和操作可行性潜力。

papers.title: Quantizing Time-Series Models As Dynamical Systems: Trajectory-Based Quantization Sensitivity Score
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Trajectory-based Quantization Sensitivity Score (TQS), a metric that reframes post-training quantization (PTQ) through the lens of dynamical-systems stability. By modeling the network's rollout as a discrete-time dynamical system, TQS characterizes how quantization-induced errors propagate and amplify over the rollout horizon. Unlike conventional PTQ methods, where sensitivity analysis is often coupled to the quantization procedure, TQS enables a priori sensitivity estimation decoupled from quantizer selection and bit-width assignment. This separation allows for quantization budget planning even for black-box or compiled networks with fused operators. Building on this, we present TQS-PTQ, a flexible mixed-precision framework that requires no calibration data or costly second-order approximations. Our experiments show that a dynamical-systems perspective provides a robust, high-performing pathway for low-precision deployment in resource-constrained settings.

TL;DR: 本文提出基于轨道的量化敏感度分数（TQS），将后训练量化重新解释为动力系统稳定性问题。TQS能够独立于量化器选择和位宽分配，提前估计量化误差的传播。基于TQS，作者提出无需校准数据的混合精度量化框架TQS-PTQ。实验显示该方法在资源受限场景下有效。
Motivation: 现有后训练量化方法的敏感度分析通常与量化过程耦合，难以独立评估误差传播，且需要校准数据或二阶近似，对黑盒模型不友好。
Method: 将网络展开视为离散时间动力系统，定义TQS度量量化误差在时间步上的放大效应。TQS可先验计算，与具体量化器解耦，支持混合精度分配。
Result: 摘要报告TQS-PTQ在资源受限环境下实现了高性能低精度部署，无需校准数据或二阶近似。
Conclusion: 动力系统视角为时间序列模型的低精度部署提供了鲁棒且高效的路径。

papers.title: Mining Architectural Quality Under Agentic AI Adoption: A Causal Study of Java Repositories
papers.abstract_en: AI coding tools are now used by a majority of developers, and agentic use of these tools has popularized the practice colloquially called "vibe coding". Yet causal evidence on their effect on software architecture is scarce. Prior causal work has measured code-level outcomes (complexity, static analysis warnings); whether such degradation propagates to architecture-level outcomes remains unknown. We mine 151 open-source Java repositories, 74 with detectable agentic AI adoption (identified via configuration files and Co-Authored-By commit trailers) and 77 propensity-matched controls, across a 13-month per-repository window yielding 1,811 monthly Arcan snapshots. We estimate the causal effect of adoption on architectural smell density (ASD) with a staggered difference-in-differences design and the Borusyak imputation estimator, applying a causal design recently used for code-level metrics to the architecture level. Total smell counts are essentially unchanged (+1.1%, p = 0.82) while lines of code grow +12.8% (p = 0.003); the resulting 6.7% ASD decline (p = 0.004) is therefore a denominator effect rather than an architectural improvement. Per-type estimates and robustness checks (wild cluster bootstrap, Lee bounds, stale-observation sensitivity) corroborate the pattern; pre-trends are flat (Wald p = 0.90), consistent with parallel trends. Density-normalized outcomes can mislead when treatment affects system size: raw counts and explicit decomposition are required for causal mining studies of AI tool adoption. The complete replication package, including the curated 151-repository monthly panel, is publicly available.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文采用因果推断方法研究Agentic AI采用对Java仓库架构质量的影响。通过对151个开源Java仓库（74个采用AI，77个倾向得分匹配对照）进行13个月的月度分析，发现代码总行数显著增长（+12.8%），但架构坏味总数未显著变化（+1.1%），导致坏味密度下降6.7%，该下降是分母效应而非架构改善。研究强调在AI工具采用研究中必须同时报告原始计数和密度指标。
Motivation: 先前因果研究仅关注代码级指标（如复杂度、静态分析警告），但AI工具对架构级质量的影响尚不清楚。
Method: 采用交错双重差分设计（staggered difference-in-differences）及Borusyak插补估计法，分析151个Java仓库的月度Arcan快照（共1811个），通过配置文件及提交信息识别Agentic AI采用。
Result: 总坏味数未显著变化（+1.1%, p=0.82），代码行数增长12.8%（p=0.003），导致坏味密度下降6.7%（p=0.004），该下降为分母效应而非架构改善；稳健性检验（wild cluster bootstrap、Lee bounds等）支持该结论。
Conclusion: 密度标准化结果在AI工具影响系统规模时可能产生误导，因果挖掘研究需同时报告原始计数并进行显式分解。
