summary_sections.tldr: 本文采用因果推断方法研究Agentic AI采用对Java仓库架构质量的影响。通过对151个开源Java仓库（74个采用AI，77个倾向得分匹配对照）进行13个月的月度分析，发现代码总行数显著增长（+12.8%），但架构坏味总数未显著变化（+1.1%），导致坏味密度下降6.7%，该下降是分母效应而非架构改善。研究强调在AI工具采用研究中必须同时报告原始计数和密度指标。
summary_sections.motivation: 先前因果研究仅关注代码级指标（如复杂度、静态分析警告），但AI工具对架构级质量的影响尚不清楚。
summary_sections.method: 采用交错双重差分设计（staggered difference-in-differences）及Borusyak插补估计法，分析151个Java仓库的月度Arcan快照（共1811个），通过配置文件及提交信息识别Agentic AI采用。
summary_sections.result: 总坏味数未显著变化（+1.1%, p=0.82），代码行数增长12.8%（p=0.003），导致坏味密度下降6.7%（p=0.004），该下降为分母效应而非架构改善；稳健性检验（wild cluster bootstrap、Lee bounds等）支持该结论。
summary_sections.conclusion: 密度标准化结果在AI工具影响系统规模时可能产生误导，因果挖掘研究需同时报告原始计数并进行显式分解。

papers.title: Simultaneous Latent Budget Trees for Stratified Classification
authors: Simultaneous Latent Budget Trees for Stratified Classification Cristian Buoncompagni
papers.abstract_en: In the era of Explainable Artificial Intelligence, there is a renewed focus on single trees for their ease of interpretation. This paper introduces Simultaneous Latent Budget Trees, a probabilistic machine learning framework for classification trees in the presence of a stratification factor such as a temporal, spatial, or demographic variable, acting as a control variable or potential confounder. Standard tree growth procedures are not designed to optimize a conditional split rule. A model-based split rule is proposed in which child nodes are interpreted as latent components of a simultaneous mixture model, such as the Simultaneous Latent Budget Model and its constrained versions, fitted to the parent node. Mixing parameters drive the observations, differently for each group, to the child nodes whereas latent budgets parameters update the response classes profile of each level of the control variable. Parameters are estimated by least squares considering a neural network perspective of the model. An informative tree structure can be interactively visualized with interpretation aids on the node and the paths, including visual pruning and decision tree selection procedure. Suitable measures are proposed to handle an unbalanced response class distribution. The proposed methodology is applied to investigate gender-related differences in disease progression of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis. The SLBT library with the various tree-based algorithms is available in the linked GitHub repository.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出同时潜在预算树（Simultaneous Latent Budget Trees），一种基于概率模型的分类树框架，用于处理存在分层因子（如时间、空间或人口统计变量）的分类问题。该方法通过同时混合模型拟合父节点，将子节点解释为潜在成分，并利用最小二乘法估计参数。应用示例为肌萎缩侧索硬化症中性别相关的疾病进展差异。
Motivation: 标准树生长过程未针对条件分裂规则优化，且缺乏处理分层因子作为控制变量或潜在混杂因素的能力。
Method: 提出基于模型的分类树，使用同时潜在预算模型作为分裂规则，子节点被视为同时混合模型的潜在成分，通过最小二乘法从神经网络视角估计参数，并支持可视化解释和剪枝。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅展示在ALS疾病进展性别差异上的应用。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种可解释的分层分类树方法，适用于存在控制变量或潜在混杂因素的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HYDRA-X: Native Unified Multimodal Models with Holistic Visual Tokenizers
papers.abstract_en: Holistic visual tokenizers are fundamental to unified multimodal models (UMMs) as they map diverse visual inputs into a unified representation space. In this paper, we present HYDRA-X, the first UMM that unifies image and video tokenization within a single Vision Transformer (ViT). Our design is driven by two core challenges: efficiently injecting spatiotemporal reconstruction capability into a native ViT, and embedding image- and video-level semantic awareness into the latent space. To address the first, comprehensive ablations reveal two key findings: (1) frame-level causal temporal attention suffices for visual reconstruction, whereas full spatiotemporal attention degrades it; and (2) hierarchical temporal compression substantially outperforms single-step alternatives. To tackle the second, we propose a lightweight decompressor that upsamples temporally compressed features under joint image-video teacher supervision, thereby enforcing complementary semantic structures within the compact latent space. Building on this holistic tokenizer, we further propose a principled improvement of the editing pipeline: source-target interaction should occur at the latent level inside the tokenizer rather than at the semantic level inside the LLM, substantially improving editing consistency and accelerating convergence. Instantiated at the 7B dense model, HYDRA-X achieves strong performance across image and video understanding and generation tasks, paving the way for future unified-tokenizer UMMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HYDRA-X 是首个在单一 Vision Transformer (ViT) 中统一图像和视频 tokenization 的多模态模型。通过帧级因果时间注意力和分层时间压缩实现高效视觉重建，并利用轻量级解压缩器在联合图像-视频教师监督下嵌入语义信息。在 7B 密集模型上，HYDRA-X 在图像和视频理解与生成任务上均取得强性能。
Motivation: 现有的统一多模态模型 (UMM) 需要分别处理图像和视频 tokenizer，缺乏统一的表示空间。核心挑战在于如何让原生 ViT 高效注入时空重建能力，并在潜在空间中嵌入图像和视频级别的语义信息。
Method: 提出两个关键设计：(1) 帧级因果时间注意力足以用于视觉重建，分层时间压缩优于单步压缩；(2) 轻量级解压缩器在联合图像-视频教师监督下对时间压缩特征进行上采样，强制潜在空间形成互补语义结构。此外，改进编辑流程，使源-目标交互在 tokenizer 的潜在层级而非 LLM 的语义层级进行。
Result: HYDRA-X 在 7B 密集模型上实现图像和视频理解与生成任务上的强性能，并在编辑一致性和收敛速度上显著提升。
Conclusion: HYDRA-X 为未来统一 tokenizer 的多模态模型铺平道路，验证了在单一 ViT 内统一图像和视频 tokenization 的可行性。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Masked Compositional Concept Modeling for Enhancing Visio-Linguistic Compositionality
papers.abstract_en: Contrastively trained vision-language models like CLIP, have made remarkable progress in learning joint image-text representations, but still face challenges in compositional understanding. They often exhibit a "bag-of-words" behavior--struggling to capture the object relations, attribute-object bindings, and word order dependencies. This limitation arises not only from the reliance on global, single-vector representations for optimization, but also from the insufficient exploitation and modeling of the rich compositional information inherently present in paired image text data. In this work, we propose MACCO (MAsked Compositional Concept MOdeling), a framework that masks compositional concepts in one modality and reconstructs them conditioned on the full contextual information from the other, enabling the model to capture and align cross-modal compositional structures more effectively. To facilitate this process, we introduce two auxiliary objectives that jointly align and regularize masked features both inter-modally and intra-modally. Extensive experiments on five compositional benchmarks, along with in-depth analyses, demonstrate that our approach not only significantly enhances compositionality in VLMs but also improves their ability to capture syntactic structure and linguistic information. Additionally, the improved compositionality also benefits text-to-image generation and multimodal large language model. Code is available at https://github.com/hiker-lw/MACCO.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 Main Conference, 25 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MACCO 框架，通过跨模态掩蔽组合概念重建来增强视觉语言模型的组合性。在五个组合性基准上，该方法显著提升了对对象关系、属性绑定和词序的理解，并改善了文本到图像生成和多模态大模型的性能。
Motivation: 现有对比训练模型（如 CLIP）存在“词袋”行为，难以捕捉组合结构，原因在于全局单向量表示不足以建模细粒度组合信息。
Method: MACCO 在一个模态中掩蔽组合概念，从另一模态的完整上下文重建，并引入模态间和模态内辅助目标进行对齐与正则化。
Result: 在五个组合性基准上，该方法显著提升了组合理解能力，并增强了句法结构捕捉能力，同时有益于下游文本到图像生成和多模态大语言模型。
Conclusion: MACCO 有效增强了视觉语言模型的组合性，代码已开源。

papers.title: Clipping Makes Distributed and Federated Asynchronous SGD Robust to Stragglers
papers.abstract_en: In modern machine learning, parallelization of training is an important strategy for increasing scale. Asynchronous stochastic gradient descent (ASGD), which maximizes the utilization of available hardware by avoiding waiting for slow workers. However, with constant step sizes, the convergence of ASGD is nonetheless affected negatively by slow workers due to large delays in updates. At the same time, it has been empirically observed in asynchronous training of deep learning models that gradient clipping "stabilizes" training. In this work, we provide a theoretical justification for this behavior, as we show that clipping removes the dependence of the maximum delay in the oracle complexity. We employ a sub-Weibull model of gradient noise which generalizes sub-Gaussian and sub-exponential distributions to more heavy-tailed distributions, motivated by empirical observations in deep learning. We show convergence in expectation, and the first time in asynchronous optimization, convergence with high probability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上证明梯度裁剪（gradient clipping）可以消除异步SGD（ASGD）中最大延迟对优化复杂度的影响，从而提升对慢节点（stragglers）的鲁棒性。采用子Weibull梯度噪声模型（涵盖更重尾分布），给出期望收敛性和异步优化中首次的高概率收敛保证。
Motivation: 异步SGD虽能避免等待慢节点，但常数步长下慢节点导致的大延迟仍会负面影响收敛。同时，深度学习实践中观察到梯度裁剪能“稳定”训练，但缺乏理论解释。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 基于子Weibull梯度噪声模型（推广sub-Gaussian和sub-exponential至重尾分布），分析带梯度裁剪的异步SGD收敛性。证明裁剪操作使优化复杂度与最大延迟解耦，并推导期望收敛率和高概率收敛界。
Result: 理论证明梯度裁剪消除了最大延迟对Oracle复杂度的影响；给出期望收敛性保证，并首次在异步优化中建立高概率收敛结果。
Conclusion: 梯度裁剪是异步SGD应对慢节点延迟的理论有效机制，为分布式和联邦学习中的异步训练提供了理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Once-for-All: Scalable Simultaneous Forecasting via Equilibrium State Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Equilibrium State Estimation (ESE), a novel paradigm for simultaneous prediction, where multiple interacting systems require separate yet coordinated forecasts. Such scenarios often arise in real-world settings such as economics and healthcare modeling. Unlike existing approaches that predict one system at a time, ESE forecasts all systems in a single pass. It first estimates the equilibrium state across systems, then generates holistic forecasts based on the difference between the current state and the estimated equilibrium. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets, including currency exchange and COVID-19 spread modeling, demonstrate that ESE is at least as accurate as state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods while being significantly faster. In addition, ESE integrates seamlessly with conventional predictors, combining their accuracy with its exceptional efficiency and delivering a 10-70x speedup. With linear-time complexity, ESE scales far better than SOTA methods as the number of systems increases. Moreover, it remains accurate under diverse perturbations, establishing ESE as a fast, generalizable, robust, and scalable multi-prediction method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出均衡状态估计（ESE），一种用于同步预测的新范式，能够一次性预测多个相互作用的系统。ESE首先估计跨系统的均衡状态，然后基于当前状态与均衡状态的差值生成整体预测。在合成数据和真实数据集（如汇率和COVID-19传播建模）上的实验表明，ESE在准确度上与现有最优方法相当，但速度提升10-70倍，且具有线性时间复杂度，可扩展性强，对扰动鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有预测方法通常一次只预测一个系统，但在现实场景（如经济学和医疗建模）中，多个系统相互作用并需要协调预测。ESE旨在通过单一前向传播同时预测所有系统。
Method: ESE方法首先估计多个系统之间的均衡状态，然后计算当前状态与估计均衡的差异，并基于该差异生成整体预测。ESE可以无缝集成传统预测器，结合其准确性与自身的高效率。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，ESE的准确度至少与现有最优方法相当，同时实现10-70倍的加速。ESE具有线性时间复杂度，随着系统数量增加，可扩展性远超现有方法，且在多种扰动下仍能保持准确。
Conclusion: 摘要将ESE总结为一种快速、泛化、鲁棒且可扩展的多系统同步预测方法。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: ERTS: Adversarial Robustness Testing of Ethical AI via Semantic Perturbation in a Bounded Consequence Space
papers.abstract_en: As AI systems are deployed in high-stakes ethical contexts such as healthcare triage, autonomous vehicle control, and employment screening, formal methods for evaluating their robustness against adversarial manipulation of ethical reasoning remain underdeveloped. This paper introduces the Ethical Robustness Testing System (ERTS), a closed-pipeline framework that: (1) encodes ethical dilemmas into a 22-dimensional Ethical Consequence Space (ECS) grounded in established ethical theory; (2) applies 17 semantic perturbation functions subject to 6 validity constraint classes including a novel semantic coherence constraint; (3) measures decision deviation via a 4-component Ethical Instability Index (EII); and (4) produces domain-adaptive pre-deployment robustness assessment verdicts. We evaluate 4 structured baseline models and 2 production LLMs (Gemini 2.0 Flash and Llama 3.2) across 50 ethical scenarios spanning 8 deployment domains, generating 1,500 adversarial test cases. Results demonstrate that only 33% of models achieve assessment clearance, with the local Llama-3.2 model proving particularly vulnerable to fairness corruption and information degradation attacks (ERS = 0.737). To the best of our knowledge, no existing framework combines a bounded ethical consequence space, semantic coherence constraints, and domain-adaptive assessment in a single adversarial testing pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ERTS（伦理鲁棒性测试系统），一个针对AI系统在伦理决策中对抗鲁棒性的封闭管道测试框架。它基于伦理理论构建22维伦理后果空间，应用17种语义扰动函数并施加6类有效性约束，通过4分量的伦理不稳定指数测量决策偏移，最终生成领域自适应的部署前鲁棒性评估报告。在8个部署领域的50个伦理场景中评估4个基线模型和2个生产级LLM，生成1500个对抗测试用例，结果显示仅33%的模型通过评估。

Result: 在50个伦理场景（8个领域）上评估6个模型，生成1500个对抗测试用例。仅33%的模型通过评估，其中本地Llama-3.2模型对公平性破坏和信息降级攻击尤其脆弱（ERS=0.737）。

papers.title: ProtoX-AD: Self-Explainable Time Series Anomaly Detection and Characterization
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in time series anomaly detection (TSAD) have highlighted the effectiveness of self-supervised classification-based approaches. These methods apply transformations to normal training samples, training a classifier to recognize transformation-specific patterns that help identify anomalies through increased classification errors. Despite their strong performance, a significant challenge is their lack of explainability, as they provide limited insight into the characteristics of flagged anomalies. To address this limitation, we propose ProtoX-AD, a prototype-based self-explainable framework for self-supervised TSAD. ProtoX-AD learns transformation-aware latent representations alongside interpretable prototypes, enabling both accurate anomaly detection and the identification of distinct anomalous profiles through prototype-based explanations. Additionally, it allows for systematic analysis of how transformation design impacts detection performance and explainability. Experimental results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that ProtoX-AD achieves detection performance comparable to its black-box counterparts while offering more consistent and semantically meaningful explanations than existing explainable baselines. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Aitorzan3/ProtoX-AD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ProtoX-AD 是一个基于原型的自解释框架，用于自监督时间序列异常检测。它通过学习变换感知的潜在表示和可解释原型，同时实现准确的异常检测和通过原型解释识别不同的异常剖面。在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，ProtoX-AD 在检测性能上与黑盒方法相当，同时提供比现有可解释基线更一致且语义上有意义的解释。
Motivation: 现有自监督时间序列异常检测方法虽然性能优异，但缺乏可解释性，无法提供关于异常特征的见解。
Method: 提出 ProtoX-AD，包括学习变换感知的潜在表示和可解释原型的原型网络，通过分类错误检测异常，并利用原型提供解释。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，ProtoX-AD 达到与黑盒方法相当的检测性能，并生成比现有可解释基线更一致且语义上有意义的解释。
Conclusion: ProtoX-AD 为时间序列异常检测提供了自解释性，且不影响检测性能，同时允许系统分析变换设计对检测和可解释性的影响。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Different Layers, Different Manifolds: Module-Wise Weight-Space Geometry in Transformer Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Weight-space geometry plays a central role in neural network optimization, yet manifold constraints are often applied uniformly across all weight matrices. In this work, we ask whether different transformer modules prefer different manifold geometries. We study Manifold Muon for GPT-2 pretraining and compare layer-wise assignments of Stiefel and DGram constraints across attention and MLP blocks. Our results show a clear asymmetry: constraining attention layers with Stiefel geometry while assigning DGram geometry to MLP layers gives the best performance among the tested configurations, whereas the inverted assignment and all-DGram configuration become unstable under the shared hyperparameter setting. We trace this failure to singular value growth in DGram-constrained attention weights, which can amplify attention logits and induce softmax saturation. These findings suggest that symmetry-aware and geometry-aware optimization for transformers should be module-specific rather than uniform.
papers.comment: Accepted at WSS @ ICML 2026, code is available at https://github.com/kiratoyoshihara/module-wise-manifold-muon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer优化中不同模块（注意力层和MLP层）是否偏好不同的权重空间流形几何。通过对GPT-2预训练实验，比较Stiefel和DGram约束的分配，发现注意力层用Stiefel、MLP层用DGram的非对称配置性能最佳，而反向分配或全DGram配置不稳定，原因是DGram约束的注意力权重奇异值增长导致softmax饱和。结论：Transformer优化应模块特定而非统一。
Motivation: 现有工作通常对所有权重矩阵施加统一的流形约束，但不同Transformer模块可能有不同偏好，本文旨在验证这一假设。
Method: 在GPT-2预训练中，对注意力层和MLP层分别独立分配Stiefel或DGram约束，比较不同组合的性能。
Result: 非对称分配（注意力Stiefel + MLP DGram）在所有测试配置中表现最佳；反向分配和全DGram配置在共享超参数下不稳定，归因于DGram约束注意力权重的奇异值增长导致softmax饱和。
Conclusion: 对称意识和几何意识的优化应模块特定而非统一。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Zero-Shot Captioning for Cultural Heritage: Automated Image Analysis of Traditional Indonesian Clothing
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Custom ZeroCLIP, a retrieval-augmented vision-language framework for zero-shot captioning of Indonesian traditional garments. The dataset contains 3,800 expert-annotated images from all 38 Indonesian provinces. Using a province-level inductive zero-shot protocol, the model is trained on 24 seen provinces, validated on 6 seen provinces, and evaluated on 8 unseen provinces. The framework combines a frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 image encoder, a CLIP text encoder, a BERT text encoder, and an LSTM caption decoder. During inference, unseen-province labels and captions are unavailable, and retrieval uses only captions from training provinces. No unseen-province image, label, or caption is used during training, validation, or retrieval-bank construction. Custom ZeroCLIP achieves a CLIPScore of 0.8536, BLEU-4 of 0.3342, and METEOR of 0.4859, outperforming existing baselines. Ablation results show that retrieval improves cultural vocabulary recovery with a 19.3\% METEOR gain, while human evaluation confirms stronger cultural accuracy and fluency. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of retrieval-augmented domain adaptation for culturally grounded caption generation in low-resource heritage settings. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/AnugrahAidinYotolembah/Traditional-Indonesian-Clothing-Captioning-Dataset.
papers.comment: accepted to ICME workshop on AIART 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Custom ZeroCLIP，一种检索增强的视觉-语言框架，用于印尼传统服饰的零样本字幕生成。数据集包含来自38个省份的3800张专家标注图片，采用省份级归纳零样本协议，在8个未见省份上评估。框架结合冻结的CLIP ViT-B/32图像编码器、CLIP文本编码器、BERT文本编码器和LSTM字幕解码器。在未见省份上不使用任何图像、标签或字幕进行训练或检索。结果显示CLIPScore 0.8536，BLEU-4 0.3342，METEOR 0.4859，超出基线，且检索增强带来19.3% METEOR提升。
Motivation: 现有零样本字幕生成在低资源文化遗产领域面临领域差异和文化词汇匮乏问题，缺乏针对印尼传统服饰的专门方法。
Method: 提出Custom ZeroCLIP，采用检索增强方式：使用冻结的CLIP视觉编码器和两个文本编码器（CLIP和BERT）以及LSTM解码器。训练时仅使用24个省份数据，验证6个省份，测试8个完全未见省份。推理时从未见省份检索仅基于训练省份字幕的嵌入。
Result: 在8个未见省份上取得CLIPScore 0.8536, BLEU-4 0.3342, METEOR 0.4859，优于现有基线。消融实验显示检索增强带来19.3%的METEOR提升。人工评估确认文化准确性和流畅性更强。
Conclusion: 结果表明检索增强领域自适应对于低资源文化遗产场景中的文化相关字幕生成是有效的。数据集已公开。

papers.title: TimeLens: On-Device Artifact Recognition with Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering for the Grand Egyptian Museum
papers.abstract_en: TimeLens is an AI-powered bilingual mobile guide for the Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM). Pointing a phone at an exhibit, a visitor sees the artifact recognized in real time and can ask follow-up questions answered in English or Arabic. The work addresses three problems specific to in-gallery deployment: fine-grained visual similarity among 51 catalogued artifacts (many near-identical Ramesside statues), the gap between curated training data and handheld camera conditions, and the risk of an AI guide stating unsupported historical facts. Two engineering contributions are reported. First, an on-device artifact detector was developed through a data-quality-driven iteration study -- from foundation-model auto-annotation (YOLO-World), through spatial label-cleaning rules, to a fully hand-annotated dataset -- isolating label quality as the decisive factor: the final YOLOv8n model resolves every previously failing class while remaining a 5.97 MB TensorFlow Lite asset that runs in real time on a mid-range phone (mAP@0.5 = 0.995, mAP@0.5:0.95 = 0.924). Second, a bilingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) guide, grounded in a 108-record ChromaDB knowledge base, was benchmarked across seven candidate language models, with Gemma 4 E2B (Q4 K M) selected; ten targeted optimizations reduce end-to-end latency from over 30 s to approximately 10 s. Both subsystems are integrated in a production Flutter application with bilingual interface, museum location gating, and text-to-speech support.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to AIVRCH 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TimeLens 是一个面向埃及大博物馆的双语移动导览系统，用户通过手机拍照即可实时识别展品并基于检索增强生成（RAG）回答中/英文问题。系统解决了展品细粒度视觉相似、训练数据与手持相机条件差异、以及AI生成不实历史信息三大问题；通过数据质量驱动的迭代改进，最终采用YOLOv8n模型（5.97 MB，mAP@0.5=0.995）在手机上实时运行，并通过Gemma 4 E2B模型与ChromDB知识库实现约10秒端到端延迟的双语问答。
Motivation: 在博物馆场景中，展品之间视觉上高度相似（如许多近乎相同的拉美西斯雕像）、训练数据与用户手持相机拍摄条件存在差异，且AI导览可能给出未经证实的历史信息，现有方案难以同时满足实时性、准确性和可靠性。
Method: 提出两阶段方法：1）通过从YOLO-World自动标注到完全人工标注的数据质量迭代，构建高性能的轻量级文物检测器（YOLOv8n，5.97 MB）；2）基于ChromaDB中的108条知识库，比较七种语言模型后选用Gemma 4 E2B（Q4 K M），配合十项优化将端到端延迟从30秒降至约10秒，实现双语检索增强生成（RAG）问答。
Result: 最终检测器在51类文物上达到mAP@0.5=0.995，mAP@0.5:0.95=0.924，模型大小仅5.97 MB；RAG问答系统经十项优化后延迟从超30秒降至约10秒。
Conclusion: 该工作验证了针对博物馆环境的轻量级、精准文物识别与可信问答的可行性，但未提及对其他博物馆或更多文物的泛化能力。

papers.title: From Verdict to Process: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Stage Fact Verification
papers.abstract_en: Recent approaches combining Large Language Models (LLMs) with retrieval-augmented reasoning have shown promise for automated fact verification. To process complex claims, these verification pipelines typically execute multi-stage workflows that coordinate tightly coupled modules, including claim decomposition, evidence gathering, and verdict prediction. However, existing methods optimize individual stages in isolation or rely on fixed heuristics, which limits adaptive coordination among stages and can lead to suboptimal outcomes. In this work, we propose ProFact, an agentic reinforcement learning framework for end-to-end optimization of multi-stage fact verification trajectories. ProFact trains a unified policy to coordinate claim decomposition, evidence seeking, answer generation, and verdict prediction. To address the sparse and delayed supervision provided by final veracity labels, ProFact introduces process-aware rewards that provide stage-level learning signals throughout the verification process. Empirical evaluation shows that ProFact consistently outperforms strong baselines in both verification performance and inference efficiency. These results highlight the effectiveness of process-aware trajectory optimization for multi-stage fact verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProFact，一个基于智能体强化学习的框架，用于多阶段事实核查的端到端优化。它通过统一策略协调声明分解、证据收集、答案生成和结果预测，并引入过程感知奖励（process-aware rewards）来提供阶段性学习信号，以缓解最终标签的稀疏延迟监督。实验结果表明 ProFact 在验证性能和推理效率上均优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有事实核查方法通常独立优化各阶段或依赖固定启发式规则，缺乏阶段间的自适应协调，导致次优结果。
Method: ProFact 训练一个统一策略，联合优化声明分解、证据检索、答案生成和结果预测。它使用过程感知奖励在验证过程的每个阶段提供学习信号，解决最终真实性标签的稀疏延迟监督问题。
Result: 在多个基准上，ProFact 在验证性能和推理效率方面一致优于强基线方法。
Conclusion: 过程感知的轨迹优化对于多阶段事实核查是有效的，能够提升整体性能与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Extracting Governing Equations from Latent Dynamics via Multi-View Contrastive Learning
papers.abstract_en: Identifying latent dynamical systems from noisy, high-dimensional measurements is a central problem at the intersection of representation learning, system identification, and scientific discovery. We present DYSCO, a multi-view temporal contrastive learning algorithm that jointly recovers latent trajectories and the governing dynamics from such observations, by leveraging multiple independent noisy views of the same underlying process to disentangle signal from noise. By parameterizing the dynamics in a structured functional basis, our framework further enables symbolic recovery of the governing equations within an affine gauge. We offer theoretical guarantees for strong identification up to an affine indeterminacy, extending prior identifiability results to the realistic setting of noisy nonlinear observations. Empirically, we demonstrate accurate recovery of both latent trajectories and flow fields across a diverse set of dynamical regimes (e.g., chaotic, oscillatory, and metastable) under both Gaussian and Poisson observation noise, the latter being particularly relevant for neural recordings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DYSCO，一种多视角时间对比学习算法，从噪声高维观测中联合恢复潜在轨迹和其控制动力学，并通过结构化函数基参数化实现符号级方程提取。理论证明在仿射不确定性下可强识别，实验在混沌、振荡、亚稳态等动力学系统上验证了轨迹与流场的准确恢复，适用于高斯和泊松观测噪声。
Motivation: 从噪声高维测量中识别潜在动力系统是表示学习、系统辨识与科学发现的交叉难题，现有方法在噪声非线性观测下识别能力有限。
Method: DYSCO 利用多个独立噪声视图进行时间对比学习，将动力学参数化为结构化函数基，从而在仿射规范（affine gauge）下实现符号方程恢复。
Result: 在混沌、振荡、亚稳态等动力学系统上，在真实轨迹和流场恢复方面达到高精度，且在高斯和泊松噪声下均有效。
Conclusion: 该方法扩展了噪声非线性观测下的可识别性理论，为神经网络记录等应用提供了有力工具。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: MOSAIC: Modality-Specific Adaptation for Incremental Continual Learning in Parkinson's Disease Gait Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Gait-based Parkinson's disease assessment increasingly relies on heterogeneous sensors, but clinical systems rarely collect all modalities simultaneously. New sensors may arrive through device upgrades, protocol changes, or multi-center deployment, while historical patient data are often unavailable because of privacy and storage constraints. This modality-incremental setting faces three challenges: unreliable cross-modal distillation, modality-specific statistical shifts, and reduced plasticity after preservation. We propose MOSAIC, a compact continual learning framework. First, we identify the Toxic Teacher phenomenon and introduce Modality-Specific Warm-Up to stabilize newly learned modality representations before distillation. Second, we propose a statistics-decoupled MSBN architecture that isolates sensor statistics while maintaining a shared semantic backbone. Third, we design a curriculum-guided repulsive objective for Plasticity Recovery, preserving legacy knowledge while recovering modality-specific capacity. Experiments on three multimodal Parkinson's gait datasets show that MOSAIC improves final performance and mitigates forgetting. Project code is available at: https://github.com/minlinzeng/MOSAIC_Modality-Specific-Adaptation-for-Incremental-Continual-Learning-in-PD-Gait-Assessment.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MOSAIC框架，用于帕金森病步态评估中的模态增量持续学习，解决新传感器加入时跨模态蒸馏不可靠、统计偏移和可塑性下降等问题。通过模态特定预热、解耦统计的MSBN架构和课程引导的排斥目标，在三个多模态步态数据集上实现更好的最终性能和更少的遗忘。
Motivation: 临床步态评估系统常因设备升级或多中心部署引入新传感器，而历史数据因隐私和存储限制不可用，导致模态增量场景下的持续学习面临跨模态蒸馏不可靠、统计偏移和可塑性降低三大挑战。
Method: 提出MOSAIC框架：1) 识别Toxic Teacher现象并引入模态特定预热稳定新模态表示；2) 设计统计解耦的MSBN架构，隔离传感器统计信息同时共享语义骨干；3) 设计课程引导的排斥目标实现可塑性恢复，保留旧知识的同时恢复模态特定容量。
Result: 在三个多模态帕金森步态数据集上，MOSAIC提升了最终性能并缓解了遗忘。
Conclusion: MOSAIC通过模态特定预热、解耦统计BN和可塑性恢复机制，有效处理了步态评估中的模态增量持续学习问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Humor Style Drives Laughter, Topic Shapes Acceptability: Evaluating Bilingual Personal and Political Robot-Delivered AI Jokes
papers.abstract_en: Humor plays a central role in human social relationships, and recent advances in computational humor create new opportunities for integrating humor into human-robot interaction (HRI). While large language models (LLMs) can generate diverse forms of humor, it remains unclear how humor style, joke content, and language preference shape perceptions of robot-delivered humor in group settings. In this exploratory study, we employed a mixed factorial design in which participants evaluated AI-generated jokes delivered by a robot in a university classroom. We examined the effects of humor type (Affiliative, Self-Enhancing, Aggressive, Self-Defeating) and joke content (person-related vs. political) on perceived funniness and appropriateness, as well as preferred language. Results show that humor type significantly influences funniness, with Aggressive and Affiliative humor rated higher, while joke content primarily affects appropriateness, with person-related jokes preferred over political ones. Language preference was shaped by both joke content and participants' self-reported fluency and humor practices.
papers.comment: Accepted in the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026), Kitakyushu, Fukuoka, Japan
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了在群体环境中机器人讲笑话的风格、内容和语言对感知幽默效果的影响。研究采用混合因素设计，让参与者评估机器人在大学教室中生成的AI笑话。结果显示，幽默类型（如攻击型、亲和型）显著影响趣味性，而笑话内容（个人vs政治）主要影响适当性。语言偏好受内容和参与者自评流利度及幽默习惯影响。
Motivation: 尽管LLM能生成多种幽默，但幽默风格、内容和语言偏好如何影响机器人讲笑话的感知效果，特别是在群体互动中，尚不清楚。
Method: 采用混合因素设计，在真实教室环境中由机器人（可能为Nao或类似平台）播放AI生成的笑话，系统性地操控幽默类型（亲和、自我增强、攻击、自贬）和笑话内容（个人相关、政治相关），并测量趣味性、适当性和语言偏好。
Result: 结果显示：攻击型和亲和型幽默被评为更有趣；个人相关笑话比政治笑话更合适；语言偏好同时受笑话内容和参与者自评流利度及幽默习惯影响。
Conclusion: 机器人讲笑话的接受度受多种因素交互影响，设计社交机器人幽默时应综合考虑幽默类型、内容主题和用户语言背景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Personalized Federated Learning for Dysarthric Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Speech recognition is challenging for dysarthric speakers. While federated learning (FL)-based ASR can be an effective tool for protecting privacy, it suffers from heterogeneity issues caused by speaker variability. Forcing all speakers to share the same model components can be suboptimal under such heterogeneity, making personalization a promising direction; however, related research on dysarthric speech remains limited. To this end, this paper explores two aggregation strategies to achieve personalization, including the parameter-based averaging strategy and the embedding-based averaging strategy. Experiments on UASpeech and TORGO show that the proposed methods outperform the baseline regularized FedAvg by statistically significant WER reductions of up to 0.99% absolute (3.15% relative) on UASpeech and 0.56% absolute (4.73% relative) on TORGO, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对构音障碍患者的语音识别问题，在联邦学习框架下探索两种个性化聚合策略（参数平均与嵌入平均），以处理说话人变异性带来的异质性问题。在UASpeech和TORGO数据集上的实验表明，所提方法相比基线正则化FedAvg取得了统计显著的词错误率(WER)降低。
Motivation: 构音障碍语音识别具有挑战性，联邦学习可用于隐私保护，但说话人变异性导致异质性问题，传统共享模型效果不佳，而个性化方法在该领域研究不足。
Method: 提出了两种个性化聚合策略：基于参数的平均策略和基于嵌入的平均策略，用于联邦学习中的个性化模型聚合。
Result: 在UASpeech上WER绝对降低0.99%（相对3.15%），在TORGO上WER绝对降低0.56%（相对4.73%），均统计显著。
Conclusion: 个性化联邦学习策略能有效改善构音障碍语音识别性能，但仍需更多研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: To GAN or Not To GAN: Segmentation Analysis on Mars DEM
papers.abstract_en: To better understand Martian Surface, which is needed to enable Rovers navigate Mars with ease, it is necessary to be able to determine the location of mounds. Detecting and studying these morphologies can also help us find evidence of extraterrestrial life, in this case, more specifically, water or signs of life conducive environments. Detection of mounds was done by manually mapping morphological parameters onto Digital Elevation Models. This paper solves the problem by automatically detecting and or predicting mounds on Mars using Neural Network based Semantic Segmentation methodologies. This is done by using supervised semantic segmentation model and generative adversarial approach. A comparison of the approaches shows that adding extra artificially generated data did not improve the result.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对火星数字高程模型（DEM）上的 mound 检测问题，比较了监督语义分割模型与生成对抗网络（GAN）方法。实验表明，加入人工生成的额外数据并未提升分割性能。
Motivation: 火星表面 mound 的检测有助于理解火星地貌、支持火星车导航，并可能间接寻找水和生命迹象。传统方法依赖人工手动映射，效率低且主观性强。
Method: 使用基于神经网络的语义分割方法，包括监督语义分割模型和生成对抗式方法，在火星DEM数据上进行 mound 的自动检测与预测。
Result: 对比两种方法发现，加入额外人工生成的数据并未改善分割结果。
Conclusion: 对于火星DEM上的mound分割任务，简单的监督语义分割可能足够，无需复杂生成式数据增强。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Field Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Maritime Accident Root Cause Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Maritime accident adjudication reports contain critical tribunal findings for root cause analysis (RCA), yet retrieving relevant precedents and drafting consistent reports from decades of records remains labor-intensive. This paper proposes a multi-field hybrid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework for automated maritime RCA, utilizing a comprehensive dataset of 13,329 Korea Maritime Safety Tribunal (KMST) reports (1971-2025). We transform raw adjudications into a structured knowledge base of "incident cards", indexing three distinct fields-Summary, Causes, and Disposition-alongside a hierarchical L1/L2 cause taxonomy. Our retrieval strategy employs a field-aware hybrid approach, fusing sparse and dense rankings via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Given the lack of large-scale expert relevance labels, we evaluate retrieval performance using ceiling-normalized recall and nDCG based on a metadata-derived proxy relevance score. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed retrieval significantly outperforms baseline methods, improving NormRecall@100 from 0.18 to 0.55. Furthermore, grounding the generator on the retrieved precedents enhances RCA generation quality over an LLM-only baseline, increasing the LLM-as-a-judge score from 3.34 to 3.72. These findings suggest that field-aware RAG can substantially streamline maritime safety investigation workflows by enabling faster precedent search and more consistent, evidence-based RCA drafting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对海上事故根因分析（RCA）中的裁决报告检索与生成任务，提出多字段混合检索增强生成（RAG）框架。利用韩国海事安全法庭（KMST）1971-2025年的13,329份报告构建结构化知识库，对事故卡建立摘要、原因、处理三个字段索引及层级原因分类。采用字段感知的混合检索策略，通过倒数排名融合（RRF）结合稀疏和稠密排序。评估使用天花板归一化召回率和nDCG，实验表明检索性能显著提升（NormRecall@100从0.18到0.55），生成质量也优于仅LLM基线（LLM裁判评分从3.34到3.72）。
Motivation: 海上事故裁决报告对根因分析至关重要，但手动检索相关先例并撰写一致报告非常耗时。
Method: 提出多字段混合RAG框架，将裁决报告转换为结构化事故卡，索引三个字段（摘要、原因、处理）并采用层级原因分类；使用字段感知的混合检索（稀疏+稠密排序）通过RRF融合；生成阶段基于检索到的先例进行增强。
Result: 检索性能显著提升，NormRecall@100从0.18提高到0.55；生成质量上，LLM裁判评分从3.34提高到3.72。
Conclusion: 摘要指出字段感知的RAG可以通过更快的先例搜索和更一致、基于证据的RCA起草来简化海事安全调查工作流程。

papers.title: EPIG: Emotion-Based Prompting for Personalised Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved impressive results in synthesizing high-quality images from natural language prompts. However, commonly used prompting strategies remain relatively generic, limiting the model's ability to accurately express emotional intent and nuanced affective attributes. This work proposes EPIG, a method that enhances emotional expressiveness at the prompt level prior to image generation. Grounded in psychologically informed emotion representations (valence-arousal) and leveraging structured, role-aware prompt enrichment, EPIG enriches emotion-related components of prompts without modifying or retraining the image generation backbone. The resulting emotion-aware prompts guide the generative process toward more emotionally coherent visual outputs, with particular effectiveness in controlling arousal. EPIG is lightweight, training-free, and well suited for resource-constrained and personalized image generation scenarios. Experimental results on a benchmark of 10 diverse prompts show that EPIG reduces mean arousal error compared to strong baselines, including naive insertion and LLM-based prompt expansion, with reductions of 14% and 12%, respectively. These improvements are statistically significant. EPIG also preserves valence alignment and semantic consistency, as measured by CLIPScore and supported by ablation studies. The effect is more pronounced on prompts containing explicit subjects such as humans, children, or animals, where the reduction reaches 17%, highlighting the subject-sensitive behavior of the proposed method.
papers.comment: Submitted to arXiv. 20 pages, 4 figures. Work on emotion-based prompt engineering for text-to-image diffusion models with applications in personalized image generation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EPIG方法，利用心理学情感表示（valence-arousal）和结构化角色感知提示增强，在图像生成前丰富提示的情感成分，无需修改或重训练扩散模型骨干。在10个多样化提示的基准上，EPIG将平均arousal误差比简单插入和LLM扩展分别降低14%和12%，尤其对含人类、儿童、动物等明确主体的提示效果更显著（降低17%），同时保持语义一致性。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型依赖通用提示策略，难以准确表达情感意图和细微情感属性，限制了情感可控的图像生成。
Method: 基于心理学情感二维模型（valence-arousal）和角色感知的结构化提示增强，在推理前自动丰富提示中的情感相关成分，不修改或重训练生成模型。
Result: 在10个多样提示的基准上，平均arousal误差相比naive insertion和LLM-based方法分别降低14%和12%；对含人类、儿童、动物的提示误差降低17%；CLIPScore和消融实验表明valence对齐与语义一致性保持良好。
Conclusion: EPIG作为轻量、免训练的提示工程方法，适用于资源受限和个性化图像生成场景，能有效提升情感表达尤其是arousal维度的控制。

papers.title: REMAL: Residual Equilibrium Manifold Active Learning for Surrogate-Based Multidisciplinary Design Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Multidisciplinary design analysis of coupled engineering systems requires the computation of equilibrium states in which all disciplinary coupling variables are mutually consistent. Conventional fixed-point iteration resolves this consistency problem separately at each design point, which can become expensive when disciplinary evaluations are costly and many analyses are required in outer-loop tasks such as multidisciplinary design optimization, uncertainty quantification, or digital twin updating. This paper introduces REMAL, a residual manifold surrogate modeling framework for coupled systems. Instead of approximating each discipline independently or directly learning converged coupling variables, the proposed method learns a surrogate model of the joint residual manifold via multitask Gaussian process models. An entropy-based active learning strategy selects additional residual evaluations near uncertain zero-contour regions, and equilibrium states for new design inputs are recovered by solving a nonlinear least squares optimization problem using only the trained surrogate. The method is evaluated on four engineering coupled system benchmarks: a satellite model, an aerostructural model, a finite-element gas-turbine heat-transfer and economics model, and a modified turbine model with added feedback coupling. Across these cases, REMAL consistently demonstrates the cost effectiveness when repeated evaluations of the fixed point across the design space are necessary. Theoretically, we show that, under mild assumptions, REMAL's predictive fixed point error is bounded.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REMAL框架，针对耦合工程系统的多学科设计分析，通过多任务高斯过程构建残差流形代理模型，并采用基于熵的主动学习在零等高线附近采样，最后用非线性最小二乘优化恢复平衡态。在四个工程基准（卫星、气动结构、燃气轮机传热经济、改造涡轮）上验证了成本效益，并给出了预测误差的理论界。
Motivation: 传统固定点迭代在每个设计点独立求解耦合一致性，当外部循环（如多学科优化、不确定性量化、数字孪生更新）需要多次分析时计算成本高昂。
Method: 提出残差流形代理建模框架：用多任务高斯过程代理整个残差流形；设计基于熵的主动学习策略在不确定的零等高线区域选择额外残差评估点；新设计输入的平衡态通过仅基于代理的非线性最小二乘优化求解。
Result: 在卫星模型、气动结构模型、燃气轮机传热经济模型及带反馈耦合的修改涡轮模型四个基准上，REMAL在需重复计算固定点的场景下始终表现出成本效益。理论证明在温和假设下预测固定点误差有界。
Conclusion: 该方法适用于需要大量固定点评估的耦合系统设计分析，但摘要未明确讨论在非工程领域（如气象）的适用性或局限性。

papers.title: Brick: Spatial Capability Routing for the Mixture-of-Models (MoM) Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: Defining query difficulty is one of the hardest problems in deployment engineering. Existing LLM routers rely on surface features such as domain labels, keywords, and token count, ignoring the within-domain variance that actually determines model success. Frontier models cost ten to one hundred times more than local open-weight models, so at production scale even small per-request savings become a direct cloud-bill lever. We present Brick, a multimodal router that scores each model on six capability dimensions, combines this with a per-query difficulty estimate, and dispatches via a cost-penalized geometric rule. A continuous preference knob lets operators slide between max-quality and max-saving profiles at deploy time. On a benchmark of 5,504 queries, Brick at max-quality reaches 76.98% accuracy, beating the best single model (75.02%) and all tested routers. At a neutral cost-quality profile, Brick achieves 74.11% accuracy at 4.71x lower cost than always using the strongest model. At min-cost, it cuts cost 22.15x with 11.85 points accuracy loss. Median latency drops from 51.2s to 22.8s.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Brick，一种面向混合模型（MoM）范式的空间能力路由器。它通过六维能力评分和查询难度估计，结合代价惩罚几何规则进行模型调度，支持操作员在部署时调节质量与成本的偏好。在5504条查询的基准上，Brick在最大质量模式下达到76.98%准确率，优于最佳单模型（75.02%）和所有测试的路由器；在中等成本-质量配置下，以4.71倍低成本实现74.11%准确率；最低成本模式则削减成本22.15倍，准确率损失11.85个百分点。中位延迟从51.2秒降至22.8秒。
Motivation: 现有LLM路由器依赖表面特征（如领域标签、关键词、令牌数），忽略了决定模型成功的域内方差。前沿模型成本比本地开源模型高10-100倍，生产规模下每请求的微小节省可直接降低云账单。
Method: Brick是一个多模态路由器，对每个模型在六个能力维度上评分，结合每查询的难度估计，通过代价惩罚的几何规则进行调度。它提供一个连续的偏好旋钮，允许操作员在部署时在最大质量和最大节省之间调节。
Result: 在5504条查询的基准上，Brick在最大质量模式下达到76.98%准确率，优于最佳单模型（75.02%）和所有测试路由器。在中等成本-质量配置下，以4.71倍低成本实现74.11%准确率；最低成本模式削减成本22.15倍，准确率损失11.85个百分点。中位延迟从51.2秒降至22.8秒。
Conclusion: Brick通过结合能力评分与难度估计，在保持高准确率的同时显著降低成本和延迟，验证了空间能力路由在MoM范式中的有效性。

papers.title: Towards More General Control of Diffusion Models Using Jeffrey Guidance
papers.abstract_en: A key strength of diffusion models lies in their flexibility, since their outputs can be controlled at sampling time through guidance. However, beyond simple cases such as conditional sampling, the target distribution is often left implicit, defined only through a sampling rule or a heuristic energy function. To address this, we propose Jeffrey guidance, a principled framework that extends diffusion-model control to applications beyond what standard guidance can express. It leverages Jeffrey's rule of conditioning to update marginal distributions towards a prescribed target, preserving the conditional structure and minimally perturbing the joint distribution. We first demonstrate Jeffrey guidance by targeting a prescribed embedding distribution. With Inception embeddings as the target, this leads to substantial reductions in FID on both CIFAR-10 and FFHQ. We further apply Jeffrey guidance to fairness on CelebA-HQ, updating an unconditional diffusion model to enforce independence between attributes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Jeffrey guidance框架，基于Jeffrey条件规则，通过最小扰动联合分布来更新扩散模型的边际分布，从而实现对输出更通用的控制。在CIFAR-10和FFHQ上使用Inception嵌入作为目标，显著降低了FID；在CelebA-HQ上应用以实现属性之间的独立性。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型的条件控制方法在处理复杂目标分布时缺乏原则性框架，通常依赖启发式能量函数或采样规则。
Method: 提出Jeffrey guidance，利用Jeffrey条件规则在保持条件结构的同时，最小程度地扰动联合分布，将边际分布更新到指定目标。
Result: 在CIFAR-10和FFHQ上，以Inception嵌入为目标，FID显著降低；在CelebA-HQ上，成功实现无条件扩散模型对属性独立性的公平性控制。
Conclusion: Jeffrey guidance为扩散模型提供了更通用的控制框架，能够处理标准guidance无法表达的应用，如目标嵌入分布控制。

papers.title: ComAct: Reframing Professional Software Manipulation via COM-as-Action Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: Existing computer-use agents remain fundamentally limited in professional software manipulation: GUI-based agents suffer from fragile visual grounding and long-horizon error accumulation, while API-basedapproaches struggle with heterogeneous protocols and inaccessible commercial interfaces. In this work,we identify the Component Object Model (COM) as a unified executable abstraction, proposing COM-as-Action: a new paradigm that reframes professional software interaction as deterministic program synthesisrather than sequential visual control. To validate this paradigm in the most demanding environments, weintroduce ComCADBench, the first benchmark for agents operating real industrial CAD software. Ourexperiments reveal a substantial paradigm gap: frontier proprietary models achieve near-zero successunder GUI-based interaction, whereas COM-based execution yields substantial immediate gains. Tobridge the remaining gap between syntactic correctness and geometric accuracy, we develop ComActor, aself-correcting agent trained through a progressive three-stage framework, alongside ComForge, a scalableplatform for large-scale training in Windows containers. Extensive experiments show that ComActorachieves state-of-the-art performance on ComCADBench, with strong resilience in long-horizon taskswhere baselines collapse, and generalizes to external CAD benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出COM-as-Action范式，将专业软件操作从顺序视觉控制重构为确定性程序合成，基于组件对象模型（COM）统一可执行抽象。引入ComCADBench基准用于评估工业CAD软件操作。开发了ComActor自校正代理（通过渐进三阶段框架训练）和ComForge可扩展训练平台。实验表明，COM-based方法显著优于GUI-based方法，ComActor在ComCADBench上达到SOTA，并在长时任务中表现稳健。
Motivation: 现有计算机使用代理在专业软件操作中存在根本性限制：GUI代理依赖脆弱的视觉基础且长程错误累积，API代理面临异构协议和不可访问的商业接口。本文识别COM为统一可执行抽象，并提出新范式以克服这些限制。
Method: 提出COM-as-Action范式，将专业软件交互建模为确定性程序合成而非序列视觉控制。为验证该范式，构建ComCADBench基准（针对真实工业CAD软件）。开发ComActor自校正代理，通过包含三个阶段的渐进框架训练；同时构建ComForge平台，支持在Windows容器中进行大规模训练。
Result: 前沿专有模型在GUI交互下接近零成功率，而COM-based执行立即带来显著提升。ComActor在ComCADBench上达到当前最优性能，在基线模型失败的长时任务中表现强鲁棒性，并能泛化到外部CAD基准。
Conclusion: 论文表明COM-as-Action范式能有效应对专业软件操作中的现有挑战，COM-based方法相比传统GUI方法具有明显优势。

papers.title: Decoding Insect Song: A Multitask Semisupervised Orthoptera Bioacoustic Classifier
papers.abstract_en: Passive acoustic monitoring holds great promise for ecological inference, yet existing automated tools are typically narrowly trained and non-transferable. We address these limitations with PULSE, a semi-supervised, multi-task framework for Orthoptera bioacoustics, combining weakly-supervised species classification, self-supervised learning on unlabelled field audio, and knowledge distillation from a general-purpose bioacoustic model. Our domain-adapted specialist model outperforms a state-of-the-art general model across all metrics (macro F1: 0.21 vs. 0.07; AUC: 0.74 vs. 0.45; AP: 0.32 vs. 0.19), with active learning further raising F1 to 0.34 and AUC to 0.84. Beyond classification, the learned embeddings encode ecologically meaningful structure, exposed through an interactive visualisation tool for ecological discovery.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Machine Learning for Audio
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PULSE，一个半监督多任务框架，用于直翅目昆虫生物声学分类。结合弱监督物种分类、自监督学习和知识蒸馏，在多个指标上超越通用模型（macro F1 0.21 vs 0.07，AUC 0.74 vs 0.45，AP 0.32 vs 0.19），主动学习进一步提升 F1 至 0.34、AUC 至 0.84。学到的嵌入编码了生态学有意义的结构。
Motivation: 现有被动声学监测自动化工具通常局限于窄训练集且不可迁移，缺乏针对直翅目昆虫的通用分类方法。
Method: 半监督多任务框架 PULSE，结合弱监督物种分类、未标记野外音频的自监督学习，以及从通用生物声学模型的知识蒸馏。
Result: 在多个指标上优于通用模型：macro F1 0.21 vs 0.07，AUC 0.74 vs 0.45，AP 0.32 vs 0.19；主动学习后 F1 提升至 0.34，AUC 至 0.84。

papers.title: ReSET: Accurate Latency-Critical NVFP4 Reasoning via Step-Aware Temperature Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve complex problem-solving by generating long intermediate reasoning traces, but this substantially increases inference costs. NVFP4 inference offers a promising approach to reduce both computational and memory costs through hardware-supported low-precision execution. However, directly applying NVFP4 to LRMs introduces two practical limitations: reasoning accuracy degrades under quantization, and existing NVFP4 kernels do not fully realize latency benefits in small-batch autoregressive decoding. In this work, we analyze the effect of NVFP4 quantization on token-level uncertainty during reasoning. We show that quantization increases incorrect sampling at low-entropy symbolic tokens, while causing over-concentration on a small set of tokens in high-uncertainty reasoning steps. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{ReSET}, a reasoning-step entropy-based temperature-scaling method that estimates step-level uncertainty online and adapts the decoding temperature using both token-level and step-level entropy signals. To address the latency gap, we further design a CUDA-core small-$M$ NVFP4 kernel for latency-critical autoregressive decoding. Across reasoning benchmarks and model scales, ReSET improves NVFP4 reasoning accuracy by up to $\sim\!$2 points over the NVFP4 baseline. Our CUDA-core small-$M$ kernel further improves latency-critical decoding, delivering up to $2.5\!\times$ kernel-level speedup over NVFP4 vLLM and approximately $2\!\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup over BF16. Code is available at https://github.com/aiha-lab/ReSET.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大推理模型（LRM）在NVFP4低精度推理中的精度损失与延迟问题，通过分析量化对token级不确定性的影响，提出基于推理步骤熵的温度缩放方法ReSET，并设计了CUDA small-M NVFP4内核。实验表明，该方法在推理基准上比NVFP4基线提升约2个点的精度，内核加速比达2.5倍，端到端解码相比BF16加速约2倍。
Motivation: 大推理模型生成长推理轨迹导致推理成本高，NVFP4低精度推理可降低成本，但直接应用会引起精度下降，且现有NVFP4内核在自回归解码中无法充分发挥延迟优势。
Method: 提出ReSET，在线估计步骤级不确定性，联合使用token级和步骤级熵信号自适应调整解码温度；同时设计CUDA small-M NVFP4内核用于延迟关键的自回归解码。
Result: 在推理基准上，ReSET相比NVFP4基线提升精度约2个点；CUDA small-M内核相比vLLM的NVFP4实现实现2.5倍内核级加速，相比BF16实现约2倍端到端解码加速。
Conclusion: ReSET有效解决了NVFP4在LRM中的精度损失和延迟瓶颈，代码已开源。

papers.title: Distributional Loss for Robust Classification
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel loss concept for supervised classification tasks. Rather than enforcing a direct mapping from each input sample to a single assigned label, we define an optimization objective over all classifier outputs as a bimodal Gaussian distribution. This softer target formulation implicitly captures class ambiguity, mitigates overfitting, and encourages the learning of more robust decision boundaries, all without requiring additional label information. Experimental results demonstrate consistent improvements in robustness, with particularly pronounced gains in low-data regimes, while requiring only minimal modifications to standard training pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的分类损失函数，将分类器输出建模为双峰高斯分布，以隐式捕捉类别模糊性、缓解过拟合并学习更鲁棒的决策边界，无需额外标签信息。实验表明该方法在低数据 regime 下鲁棒性提升显著，且仅需对标准训练流程进行最小修改。
Motivation: 标准监督分类强制每个样本映射到单一标签，忽略了类别间的模糊性，容易导致过拟合和决策边界脆弱。
Method: 定义损失函数为所有分类器输出的双峰高斯分布（bimodal Gaussian distribution），以软目标形式优化，替代传统的硬标签映射。
Result: 在多个分类基准上，该方法持续提升鲁棒性，尤其在低数据场景下效果显著，且仅需对标准训练流程做微小改动。
Conclusion: 所提损失概念简单有效，能够在不增加标注需求的情况下提升分类鲁棒性，适用于数据稀缺场景。

papers.title: Proprioceptive-visual correspondence enables self-other distinction in humanoid robots
papers.abstract_en: Distinguishing self from others is a prerequisite for social intelligence, yet humanoid robots that increasingly share workspaces with humans still lack this ability. Here we show that a humanoid robot can learn self-other distinction from proprioceptive-visual correspondence, without any identity labels or kinematic models. Once established, this distinction bootstraps a predictive self-model that maps joint configurations to three-dimensional body occupancy, capturing how the robot's body changes with action. In multi-agent scenes involving humans or morphologically identical robots, the system reliably identifies itself, learns a 3D self-model, and supports downstream tasks including target reaching, collision-aware motion planning, and human-to-robot motion retargeting. Together, these results outline a route toward bodily self-representation in robots that act and coordinate alongside others in shared physical environments. Project page: https://euron-zc.github.io/humanoid-self-model/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人形机器人如何通过本体感觉-视觉对应学习自我-他人区分，无需身份标签或运动学模型。系统进一步自举出预测性自我模型，将关节配置映射到三维身体占据空间，支持目标到达、碰撞感知运动规划和人类到机器人运动重定向等下游任务。
Motivation: 人形机器人在共享空间与人类协作时需要区分自我与他人，但现有机器人缺乏这一能力。
Method: 提出基于本体感觉-视觉对应（proprioceptive-visual correspondence）的学习方法，无需标签或模型，从多智能体场景中自动区分自身并学习3D自我模型。
Result: 摘要报告系统能够可靠地识别自身，学习3D自我模型，并在目标到达、碰撞感知运动规划和运动重定向等下游任务中表现良好。
Conclusion: 该研究为机器人在共享物理环境中与他人协作时的身体自我表征提供了路径。

papers.title: From Uncertain Judgments to Calibrated Rankings: Conformal Elo Estimation for LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating new large language models typically requires costly human annotation campaigns at scale. LLM-as-a-judge offers a cheaper alternative, but judge scores carry systematic errors - such as position bias, self-preference, or intransitivity - that can strongly miscalibrate the resulting rankings. We quantify the resulting judge-human disagreement at two complementary levels. At the local level, we estimate per-battle uncertainty from the judge's own score differences by propagating calibrated win probabilities rather than hard labels into the Bradley-Terry procedure. This alone provides a drastic improvement to Elo estimation accuracy, bringing LLM-derived ratings within 17.9 Elo MAE of human-derived ones when averaged over 55 held-out models on LMArena. At the global level, we apply split conformal prediction to the residual gap between LLM-derived and human-derived Elo ratings across held-out models, producing prediction intervals with distribution-free marginal coverage guarantees that account for irreducible LLM-human disagreement. Together, these two layers yield a low-cost evaluation tool that provides developers with calibrated Elo estimates and honest uncertainty bounds, without access to large-scale human annotations.To facilitate reproducibility, we release our code at https://github.com/kargibora/SoftElo .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Conformal Elo Estimation方法，用于校准LLM-as-a-Judge评估中的排名偏差。通过局部层面将校准的胜率概率引入Bradley-Terry过程，以及全局层面应用分裂共形预测提供不确定性区间，在LMArena数据集上使Elo估计平均绝对误差降至17.9，且无需大规模人工标注。
Motivation: LLM作为评估者存在位置偏差、自我偏好和不可传递性等系统性错误，导致排名校准不准确，而人工标注成本高昂。
Method: 局部层面：使用评分差异传播校准的胜率概率而非硬标签到Bradley-Terry过程；全局层面：对LLM与人类Elo评级残差应用分裂共形预测，生成具有分布无关边际覆盖保证的预测区间。
Result: 在LMArena数据集55个保留模型上，LLM衍生评级与人类衍生评级的平均绝对误差降至17.9 Elo。
Conclusion: 该方法提供低成本评估工具，无需大规模人工标注即可获得校准的Elo估计和诚实的不确定性界限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-as-an-Investigator: Evidence-First Reasoning for Robust Interactive Problem Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as interactive assistants for technical problem solving. However, when users provide incomplete descriptions or plausible but unverified explanations, LLMs may prematurely align with these assumptions and propose solutions before collecting sufficient evidence. We refer to this behavior as user-driven sycophancy: the tendency of an LLM to reinforce a user-provided hypothesis instead of testing alternative explanations. This paper introduces LLM-as-an-Investigator, an evidence-first agentic AI methodology for robust problem diagnosis. The approach is implemented through a Solution Investigator Agent, which estimates the ambiguity of an initial problem description, generates candidate hypotheses, asks targeted clarification questions, and updates hypothesis probabilities after each answer. Rather than producing an immediate response, the agent continues the investigation until the evidence makes one candidate explanation stronger than the alternatives. To evaluate the approach, we build a benchmark from solved technical forum threads in mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic domains. We use a three-agent evaluation pipeline in which a Problem-Solution Extractor Agent converts solved threads into structured cases, a Ground-Truth Evaluator Agent simulates the user while hiding the known solution, and the tested assistant attempts to recover the solution through dialogue. The experiments compare standard assistants, reasoning-oriented LLMs, and the proposed investigator-based model across LLM backbones. In addition to diagnostic accuracy, we analyze how standard assistants follow misleading user hypotheses in diagnostic cases. The results show that the proposed approach identifies the problem more accurately than direct prompting and reasoning-only baselines, while its evidence-first protocol helps reduce user-induced conversational bias.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型在交互式问题诊断中容易过早顺从用户假设（用户驱动顺从）的问题，提出了一种基于证据优先的智能体方法论LLM-as-an-Investigator。该方法通过Solution Investigator Agent估计歧义、生成假设、提出澄清问题并迭代更新概率，直到证据足够。在机械、电气和液压领域的技术论坛基准上，实验表明该方法在诊断准确性上优于直接提示和仅推理基线，并减少了用户诱导的对话偏差。
Motivation: 用户提供不完整描述或看似合理但未经验证的解释时，LLM可能过早顺从用户假设（用户驱动顺从），导致解决方案基于不充分证据，从而降低诊断准确性。
Method: 提出LLM-as-an-Investigator方法，包含Solution Investigator Agent：首先估计问题描述歧义，生成候选假设；然后通过针对性澄清问题，在每次回答后更新假设概率；只有当某一假设的证据强度超过其他假设时才停止。

Conclusion: 证据优先的交互协议能有效减少用户诱导偏差，提高问题诊断的鲁棒性和准确性，适用于跨领域的技术疑难解答场景。

papers.title: Layer-Resolved Optimal Transport for Hallucination Detection in NMT and Abstractive Summarization
papers.abstract_en: Optimal transport (OT) has been shown to detect hallucinations in neural machine translation (NMT) by measuring the geometric distance between cross-attention distributions and a reference distribution, without any supervision. We extend this analysis to all six decoder layers of the Fairseq DE-EN model ($N=3{,}414$), showing that Wass-to-Unif and Wass-to-Data are complementary detectors specialised across hallucination types, that detection is concentrated in layers L1--L4 with L5 anti-predictive for subtler types, and that hallucinated translations lack the exploratory attention phase present in correct translations from the first decoding step. We further evaluate whether the geometric signal transfers to abstractive summarization faithfulness detection: our unsupervised OT detector on AggreFact ($N=1{,}116$) achieves $57.2\%$/$57.6\%$ balanced accuracy on CNN/XSum -- above chance but substantially below supervised MiniCheck-Flan-T5-L($69.9\%$/$74.3\%$). This gap is principled: unlike NMT hallucinations, unfaithful summaries can attend correctly to source tokens while misrepresenting their content, a failure mode invisible to concentration-based OT metrics by construction. Structural experiments on T5-base confirm consistent decoder organisation across depth, with Layer~3 showing peak concentration and Layer~12 being most critical for generation quality. Together, the results establish OT on cross-attention as a reliable detector when the failure mode is source disengagement, a principled interpretability tool regardless of task, and fundamentally limited when faithfulness failures occur downstream of attention.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究最优传输（OT）在神经机器翻译（NMT）和抽象摘要中检测幻觉/不忠实的能力。实验表明，OT在NMT中可有效检测注意力脱离型的幻觉，但在摘要中由于不忠实可能源于内容误述而非注意力分散，OT方法效果有限。
Motivation: 现有无监督检测方法使用OT，但缺乏对解码器各层和不同任务（翻译 vs 摘要）的深入分析。
Method: 将OT分析扩展到Fairseq DE-EN模型所有6个解码器层，并在AggreFact数据集上评估OT对摘要忠实度检测的迁移能力。
Result: 在NMT中，Wass-to-Unif和Wass-to-Data在不同层互补检测；在摘要中，OT无监督方法平衡准确率57.2%/57.6%，低于监督方法约13个百分点。
Conclusion: OT对注意力脱离型幻觉可靠，但无法检测注意力正确但内容误述的不忠实，这是其根本局限。

papers.title: Calibrating simplified vine copulas with a noise contrastive estimation approach
papers.abstract_en: Vine copulas provide a flexible framework for modeling complex multivariate dependence structures using only bivariate building blocks. Their practical success relies heavily on the simplifying assumption, which restricts conditional pair copulas to be independent of the specific conditioning values. While this assumption greatly facilitates estimation, it may lead to model misspecification in applications with pronounced varying conditional dependence. We propose a novel calibration strategy for simplified vine copula models based on observation-specific correction factors. These factors are derived using noise contrastive estimation (NCE), a supervised learning technique for density estimation that reframes the problem as a binary classification task with an easily sampled noise distribution. Treating the fitted simplified vine copula as the noise model, the NCE approach yields corrected log-likelihood estimates for individual observations, thereby locally adjusting the simplified vine toward the underlying data-generating dependence structure. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed calibration provides sensible and effective adjustments, improving model accuracy when the simplifying assumption is violated while remaining neutral when the simplified model is adequate. Two real-data applications further illustrate the practical benefits of the method. The results highlight NCE-based calibration as a promising tool to enhance simplified vine copula models without abandoning their computational tractability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对简化藤copula模型在条件依赖变化时的设定偏差，提出基于噪声对比估计（NCE）的校准方法。该方法将拟合的简化藤copula作为噪声模型，通过二分类任务学习校正因子，在保持计算可行性的同时局部修正模型。模拟和实际数据表明，该方法在简化假设不成立时有效提升准确性，在假设成立时保持中性。
Motivation: 简化藤copula依赖于条件对copula与具体条件值无关的假设，这在条件依赖变化显著时可能导致模型设定错误。现有方法缺乏对个体观测的局部校正。
Method: 提出基于噪声对比估计（NCE）的校准框架，将简化藤copula作为噪声分布，通过监督学习将密度估计转化为二分类任务，从而为每个观测点计算校正因子，局部调整简化模型。
Result: 模拟研究表明，校准在简化假设违反时提供合理有效的调整，提高模型精度；在简化模型充足时保持中性。两个实际数据应用进一步展示了实际效益。
Conclusion: NCE校准是增强简化藤copula模型的有前途的工具，无需放弃其计算可处理性。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Hallucination in Medical Imaging AI: A Cross-Modality Analytical Framework for Taxonomy, Detection, and Mitigation under Regulatory Constraints
papers.abstract_en: AI systems are being deployed across medical imaging faster than their failure modes are understood. At this point in time, the failure of greatest clinical concern is hallucination: clinically plausible but factually incorrect outputs, including fabricated anatomical structures, missed findings, incorrect laterality, and invented measurements in generated reports, with direct consequences, for example, for biopsy decisions, staging, and treatment planning. This structured narrative synthesizes peer-reviewed studies, benchmark datasets, and FDA regulatory guidance across five imaging modalities to produce a cross-modality analysis of hallucination taxonomy, etiology, detection, and mitigation. Specifically, we address three questions in this study: (1) how can existing taxonomies be unified across modalities?, (2) how do medical-specialized foundation models hallucinate less than general-purpose ones?, and (3) which mitigation strategies are effective and compatible with FDA lifecycle oversight? We note that three taxonomic frameworks together cover the imaging pipeline in a way no single framework does alone. We also highlight that general-purpose foundation models outperform medical-specialized models on hallucination-specific benchmarks, indicating that narrow domain fine-tuning can introduce overfitting-induced confabulation. At the same time, the oversight of radiologists remains essential; for instance, a very high percentage of of AI-generated flags required expert correction before clinical use. Physics-informed architectural constraints, Chain-of-Thought prompting, and human-in-the-loop safeguards each address different failure modes and is effective when combined. All findings are mapped to the FDA's Total Product Lifecycle and Predetermined Change Control Plan frameworks, which treat hallucination management as a lifecycle obligation rather than a pre-deployment checklist.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个跨模态分析框架，系统综述医学影像AI中的幻觉现象，包括分类法、病因、检测与缓解策略，并映射到FDA监管要求。研究发现通用基础模型在幻觉基准上优于医学专用模型，表明窄领域微调可能引入过度拟合导致的虚构；放射科医生的监督仍然关键；结合物理约束、链式思维提示和人在回路的安全措施可有效应对不同故障模式。
Motivation: 医学影像AI的临床部署速度超过了对故障模式的理解，其中幻觉（临床看似合理但事实错误的输出）是最大的临床隐患，可能影响活检、分期和治疗决策，但缺乏跨模态的统一分析和监管框架。
Method: 采用结构化叙述综述方法，综合同行评审研究、基准数据集和FDA监管指南，跨五种成像模态分析幻觉的分类、病因、检测和缓解策略，并将所有发现映射到FDA的总产品生命周期和预定变更控制计划框架。
Result: 摘要指出三个关键发现：单一分类框架不足以覆盖整个成像管线，通用基础模型在幻觉专用基准上优于医学专用模型（暗示窄域微调导致虚构），以及极高比例的AI生成标记需要专家修正后才能临床使用。
Conclusion: 强调幻觉管理应是生命周期义务而非部署前清单，物理约束、链式思维提示和人在回路等组合策略有效，且所有发现均与FDA监管框架一致。

papers.title: Understanding helpfulness and harmless tension in reward models
papers.abstract_en: Reward models are a key component of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), aligning language models toward both helpful and harmless behaviour. However, the internal mechanisms underlying these objectives and their conflicts remain poorly understood. We study alignment tension in reward models trained under helpfulness-only, harmlessness-only, and mixed-objective settings. We find that mixed-objective models often underperform single-objective models, indicating interference between objectives. Using activation-based methods, we identify neurons associated with each objective and study their functional roles via targeted ablations. We find that these neurons causally support their corresponding objectives while often negatively affecting the opposing one. We find that a substantial proportion of neurons are shared between helpfulness and harmlessness, and that these shared neurons exert a disproportionate influence on model behaviour, contributing to alignment tension. Additionally, our results provide insights and mechanistic interpretation into how alignment objectives are represented in reward models and why multi-objective alignment remains challenging, motivating future work on disentangled and controllable alignment methods.
papers.comment: The source code used in this study is publicly available at: https://github.com/EshaanT/RM-alignment\_tension
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究奖励模型中有用性与无害性目标之间的对齐张力。通过激活分析识别出分别与两个目标相关的神经元，并发现混合目标训练常导致性能低于单目标模型。共享神经元对模型行为影响不成比例，是造成对齐张力的重要原因。
Motivation: 现有奖励模型对不同目标（有用性和无害性）的内部机制及其冲突理解不足，导致多目标对齐困难。
Method: 采用基于激活的方法识别与各目标相关的神经元，并通过定向消融实验研究其因果作用。
Result: 混合目标奖励模型性能常低于单目标模型；共享神经元对模型行为有不成比例的负面影响，加剧对齐张力。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了多目标对齐挑战的机制根源，为未来设计解耦和可控对齐方法提供了方向。

papers.title: Visual Place Recognition in Forests with Depth-Aware Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Visual place recognition in natural forest environments remains challenging due to repetitive vegetation, weak structural cues, and significant appearance variation across traversals. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a lightweight depth-aware distillation framework that injects geometric cues into a DINOv2-based place recognition model, while maintaining its pre-trained descriptor space. Evaluated on the recent WildCross benchmark, the proposed approach yields gains over an appearance-only counterpart, providing robustness to appearance variations. These results demonstrate the importance of depth as a strong complementary modality for place recognition in natural environments and identify depth-aware distillation as a promising direction for more robust forest perception.
papers.comment: IEEE ICRA Workshop on Field Robotics 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对森林环境中视觉地点识别因植被重复、结构线索弱和外观变化大而困难的问题，提出一种轻量级深度感知蒸馏框架，将几何线索注入基于DINOv2的地点识别模型，同时保持其预训练描述子空间。在WildCross基准上，该方法相比纯外观模型取得性能提升，对外观变化具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 森林环境中的视觉地点识别因重复植被、弱结构线索和外观变化大而极具挑战，现有方法鲁棒性不足。
Method: 提出深度感知蒸馏（depth-aware distillation）框架，利用深度信息作为互补模态，将几何线索蒸馏到DINOv2预训练的描述子空间中，保持原有特征空间的同时增强几何感知。
Result: 在WildCross基准上，该方法相比纯外观基线取得性能提升，证明深度作为强互补模态对自然环境中地点识别的重要性。
Conclusion: 深度感知蒸馏是实现鲁棒森林感知的有前景方向，深度信息对提升视觉地点识别在自然环境中应对外观变化的能力至关重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Minimal Model of Bounded Trade-Off Screening in Multi-Attribute Choice
papers.abstract_en: Human decision-making often involves choosing between multi-attribute alternatives, yet classical models assume fully compensatory utility aggregation despite evidence that people reject options with poor performance on critical attributes. We propose a bounded trade-off reasoning framework in which decisions are governed by a screening process that evaluates the balance between gains and losses across attributes. The model introduces a trade-off tolerance parameter that controls acceptable imbalance and can vary across contexts. Through simulation, we show that this mechanism produces preference patterns that differ from standard utility-based models and captures context-dependent variation in trade-off behavior. These results establish bounded trade-off screening as a plausible computational mechanism for multi-attribute choice and generate testable predictions for future behavioral studies.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个有界权衡筛选模型，用于解释人类在多属性选择中如何根据属性间的得失平衡进行决策。模型引入一个权衡容忍参数，控制可接受的不平衡程度，并通过模拟显示该机制产生的偏好模式不同于标准效用模型，且能够捕获上下文相关的权衡行为变化。
Motivation: 经典决策模型假设完全补偿性的效用整合，但实验证据表明人类会拒绝在关键属性上表现差的选项，现有模型未能充分解释这种非补偿性筛选行为。
Method: 提出一个有界权衡推理框架，决策由评估各属性间得失平衡的筛选过程控制，引入一个可随上下文变化的权衡容忍参数。
Result: 模拟显示该机制产生不同于标准效用模型的偏好模式，并捕获了上下文相关的权衡行为变化。
Conclusion: 有界权衡筛选可作为多属性选择的一个合理的计算机制，并为未来行为研究提供可检验的预测。

papers.title: ARMOR-MAD: Adaptive Routing for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Debate in Large Language Model Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent debate (MAD) can improve large language model reasoning, but fixed debate pipelines often waste computation and can amplify correlated errors among similar agents. We propose ARMOR-MAD, a training-free heterogeneous MAD framework that treats debate as conditional computation. ARMOR-MAD combines three components: Pre-debate Agreement Routing (PAR) decides whether independently generated Round-0 answers require debate; Early Agreement Stopping Evaluator (EASE) stops debate after convergence; and Semantic Outlier Detection (SOD) down-weights abnormal final answers during aggregation. Across MATH Level 5, GSM8K, MMLU, and MMLU-Pro, ARMOR-MAD consistently improves over fixed-round heterogeneous debate with the same model pool, reaching 65.5\%, 96.5\%, 90.0\%, and 81.5\% accuracy, respectively. The results suggest that genuine model heterogeneity and agreement-based control are both important for making MAD more accurate and efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ARMOR-MAD 是一个无需训练的多智能体辩论框架，通过自适应路由（PAR、EASE、SOD）动态决定是否进行辩论、何时停止辩论以及如何聚合答案，旨在提高大语言模型推理的准确性和效率。在 MATH Level 5、GSM8K、MMLU 和 MMLU-Pro 上，ARMOR-MAD 分别达到 65.5%、96.5%、90.0% 和 81.5% 的准确率，优于固定轮次的异构辩论。
Motivation: 现有的多智能体辩论方法使用固定流水线，计算浪费且易放大相似智能体之间的相关错误，缺乏自适应的辩论控制。
Method: 提出 ARMOR-MAD，包含三个组件：预辩论一致性路由（PAR）决定是否需要辩论；早期一致性停止评估器（EASE）在收敛后停止辩论；语义异常检测（SOD）在聚合时降低异常最终答案的权重。整个框架无需训练，将辩论视为条件计算。
Result: 在 MATH Level 5、GSM8K、MMLU 和 MMLU-Pro 上，ARMOR-MAD 分别取得 65.5%、96.5%、90.0% 和 81.5% 的准确率，均超过固定轮次的异构辩论基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，真正的模型异构性和基于一致性的控制对于使多智能体辩论更准确和高效都很重要。

papers.title: Under What Conditions Can a Machine Become Genuinely Creative?
papers.abstract_en: Recent AI systems can generate texts, software architectures, hypotheses, designs, and scientific workflows that appear creative. This paper asks under what conditions a machine can become genuinely creative, and how human agency can be preserved within shared cognitive and creative environments. It develops a requirement framework derived from Designics, the science of meaning-bearing intentional change. The paper argues that genuine machine creativity should not be defined by output novelty, current performance, or transient architecture alone. Instead, creativity is understood as the structural transformation of incomplete situations through recursive intervention dynamics. On this view, it depends on ten requirements: environment representation, scoped perception, conflict identification, intervention capability, consequence observation, knowledge and environment update, rescoping, local-to-global unfolding, value-based scoping, and human-AI co-living. These are organized through the three laws of Designics: perception, conflict, and capability. The paper illustrates the computational tractability of these requirements through selected cyber-physical and cyber-biological studies, including recursive element extraction, autonomous mesh generation, and neurophysiological and workload analysis. It then treats open-ended systems, automated discovery frameworks, self-modifying agents, foundation models, and agentic workflows as pressure cases: they demonstrate powerful generative means but do not by themselves establish genuine machine creativity. Finally, the paper argues that proactive AI ethics is internal to genuine machine creativity rather than an after-the-fact filter. Value-based scoping and human-AI co-living must shape how creative machines perceive environments, identify conflicts, select interventions, observe consequences, update knowledge, and rescope future action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从Designics（意义承载的意向性变化科学）出发，提出机器真正具有创造力的十项需求，包括环境表征、范围感知、冲突识别、干预能力、后果观察、知识与环境更新、重新定域、局部到全局展开、基于价值的定域以及人机共居。论文通过若干网络物理和网络生物研究说明这些需求的计算可行性，并对开放系统、自动发现框架、自修改智能体、基础模型和智能体工作流等压力测试案例进行分析，指出这些系统虽具强大生成能力，但未建立真正的机器创造力。论文还强调主动AI伦理是内在组成部分，而非事后过滤。
Motivation: 现有AI系统虽能生成看似创造性的输出，但机器何时能真正具有创造力尚不明确，且人类主体性在共享认知与创造环境中如何维持也缺乏系统框架。
Method: 基于Designics学科，通过递归干预动力学分析，推导出机器创造力的十项需求，并通过网络物理与网络生物案例（如递归元素提取、自主网格生成、神经生理与工作负荷分析）说明其计算可行性。
Result: 论文通过概念分析和案例研究指出当前生成式系统（如开放系统、基础模型等）不具备真正创造力，并论证了十项需求构成的框架。
Conclusion: 论文认为真正机器创造力需满足Designics三定律（感知、冲突、能力）对应的十项需求，且主动AI伦理与人机共居应内嵌于创造力机制中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WHAR Arena: Benchmarking the State of the Art in Efficient Wearable Human Activity Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has become the dominant paradigm in Wearable Human Activity Recognition (WHAR), yet progress is obscured by a comparability crisis. Results are often reported using inconsistent datasets, custom data processing, and varying evaluation protocols, making state-of-the-art claims fragile. We address this with a large-scale, open-source benchmark that integrates 30 diverse datasets under standardized processing, unified model interfaces, and a shared cross-subject evaluation protocol. Evaluating 17 representative architectures across 4760 training runs, we jointly measure predictive performance alongside on-device latency, peak memory, and model size on an Android reference device. Our results reveal that the WHAR state of the art is distributed rather than dominated by a single architecture. While CNN-HAR achieves the highest mean macro-F1, top-performing models cluster tightly, indicating contemporary architectures have converged near a predictive performance ceiling. When accounting for deployment efficiency, compact neural models, such as TinierHAR, and classical Random Forests define the practically relevant Pareto frontier, whereas larger recurrent and hybrid models incur high hardware costs without corresponding performance gains. Consequently, while predictive performance has plateaued, substantial potential for future progress remains in optimizing deployment efficiency and improving adaptation to domain shifts. We release our full framework to support transparent reuse and extension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为解决可穿戴人体活动识别（WHAR）领域的结果可比性危机，构建了一个大型开源基准，集成30个数据集并统一处理流程与评估协议。在4760次训练中评估17种代表性架构，同时测量预测性能与在Android设备上的延迟、峰值内存和模型大小。结果表明，CNN-HAR取得最高平均宏F1，但顶级模型性能高度接近；考虑部署效率时，紧凑神经网络（如TinierHAR）和随机森林构成实际帕累托前沿，而大型循环/混合模型硬件成本高但无性能增益。作者认为预测性能已趋近天花板，未来应聚焦部署效率优化和域适应。
Motivation: WHAR领域存在结果可比性危机：数据集、数据处理和评估协议不一致，导致对先进方法的宣称不可靠。
Method: 构建开源基准：集成30个数据集，实施标准化处理、统一模型接口和跨受试者评估协议；在Android参考设备上测量预测性能以及部署相关的延迟、峰值内存和模型大小。
Result: 在4760次训练运行中，CNN-HAR获得最高平均宏F1，但顶级模型性能紧密聚集；考虑部署效率时，紧凑模型（如TinierHAR）和随机森林定义了帕累托前沿，而大型模型硬件成本高但无相应性能提升。
Conclusion: 预测性能已接近天花板，未来进步空间在于优化部署效率和提高对域适应的能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reasoning for Mobile User Experience with Multimodal LLMs: Task, Benchmark, and Approach
papers.abstract_en: User experience (UX) centered on usability, perceived consistency, and functional clarity is fundamental to real-world user interfaces (UI). The application of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in the field of user interfaces is evolving rapidly, such as visual element grounding, graphical user interface (GUI) agents, and design-to-code generation. However, research efforts on evaluating UX based on UI screenshots are still immature. To address this, we propose UXBench, a novel multimodal benchmark consisting of 2,000 VQA data samples designed to assess MLLMs' ability to perform UI-based reasoning. UXBench includes 8 tasks based on real-world UI screenshots that require fine-grained diagnosis of UX issues across layout relationships, visual hierarchy, and content consistency. Our extensive evaluation of mainstream MLLMs shows that they remain fundamentally limited in their capacity for UI-based reasoning. The results underscore the need for further advancements in this area. To bridge this gap, we propose UI-UX, an MLLM based on Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking foundation model and enhanced via reinforcement learning with two key innovations: a reward routing mechanism that dynamically balances perceptual understanding and logical reasoning during inference, and an asymmetric transition reward that suppresses redundant or insufficient reasoning steps. Experiments demonstrate that UI-UX achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on UXBench, attaining an accuracy of 0.7963 -- surpassing Claude-4.5-Sonnet's 0.6550 -- while exhibiting strong generalization across diverse UI tasks and maintaining low inference latency.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, Accepted at CVPR 2026 Findings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UXBench，一个包含2000个VQA样本的多模态基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在用户界面推理上的能力，涵盖布局关系、视觉层次和内容一致性等UX问题。同时提出UI-UX模型，基于Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking并通过强化学习优化，引入奖励路由机制和非对称过渡奖励，在UXBench上达到0.7963准确率，超越Claude-4.5-Sonnet的0.6550。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在基于UI截图的用户体验评估方面研究不足，缺乏专门的基准和诊断方法。
Method: 构建UXBench基准（8个任务，2000个VQA样本）；提出UI-UX模型，基于Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking，通过强化学习引入奖励路由机制（动态平衡感知与逻辑推理）和非对称过渡奖励（抑制冗余或不足的推理步骤）。
Result: UI-UX在UXBench上达到0.7963准确率，超越Claude-4.5-Sonnet（0.6550），并在多种UI任务上展现出强泛化性和低推理延迟。
Conclusion: 当前MLLMs在UI推理上仍有局限，UI-UX通过强化学习创新的奖励设计实现了显著提升。

papers.title: The Geometry of Phase Transitions in Generative Dynamics via Projection Caustics
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-state generative samplers, including diffusion and flow-matching models, evolve through continuous reverse-time dynamics, yet their samples often undergo abrupt qualitative changes: trajectories commit to modes, semantic alternatives collapse, and small perturbations in narrow time windows can produce large downstream effects. This paper develops a geometric account of such phase-transition-like behaviour. We view denoising as gradient descent on a free energy landscape and show that sharp transitions arise near projection caustics, where the nearest-point projection onto the data support ceases to be unique. Motivated by this perspective, we introduce the Critical Boundary Detector (CBD), as practical diagnostics for score-direction instability. Across toy models, standard diffusion models, and latent text-to-image diffusion models, CBD localises mode commitment, predicts intervention-sensitive windows, and supports targeted control in geometrically sensitive regions. Our results connect geometry of data and dynamics of diffusion generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从几何角度解释连续状态生成采样器（如扩散模型和流匹配模型）中出现的相变行为，提出投影焦散（projection caustics）是导致模式承诺和语义跳跃的关键。作者引入临界边界检测器（CBD）作为评分方向不稳定的实用诊断工具，在玩具模型、标准扩散模型和潜在文本到图像扩散模型中验证了其定位模式承诺和预测敏感时间窗口的有效性。
Motivation: 现有连续状态生成模型虽采用连续反向时间动力学，但样本常出现突变（如模式承诺、语义崩溃），缺乏几何层面的理论解释。
Method: 将去噪过程视为自由能景观上的梯度下降，证明突变出现在最近点投影不再唯一的投影焦散附近，并基于此提出临界边界检测器（CBD）来实时诊断评分方向不稳定性。
Result: CBD在多种模型上成功定位模式承诺时刻，预测干预敏感窗口，并支持在几何敏感区域进行针对性控制。
Conclusion: 本文建立了数据几何与扩散生成动力学之间的桥梁，为理解和控制生成过程中的相变提供了几何框架。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文从几何角度解释连续状态生成采样器（如扩散模型和流匹配模型）中出现的相变行为，提出投影焦散（projection caustics）是导致模式承诺和语义跳跃的关键。作者引入临界边界检测器（CBD）作为评分方向不稳定的实用诊断工具，在玩具模型、标准扩散模型和潜在文本到图像扩散模型中验证了其定位模式承诺和预测敏感时间窗口的有效性。

papers.title: Transformer-Guided Graph Attention for Direct Cardiac Mesh Reconstruction: A Structural Digital Twin Framework
papers.abstract_en: Building patient-specific cardiac models sits at the heart of precision cardiology, yet getting those models into clinical use keeps running into the same wall: mesh generation is slow, messy, and frustrating. The standard workflow -- segmenting the image, running Marching Cubes, and then manually cleaning up the result -- is time-consuming, inconsistent across operators, and demands specialist knowledge most clinical teams do not have. We take a fundamentally different approach. Instead of treating segmentation and mesh generation as two separate problems, we train a single end-to-end network that goes directly from a raw 3D medical image to a smooth, simulation-ready cardiac surface mesh. The core is a 3D Swin Transformer encoder-decoder that extracts volumetric features from CT or MRI volumes, paired with a Graph Attention Network (GAT) head that iteratively deforms a template mesh to fit the patient's cardiac boundary. We tested on the MM-WHS 2017 benchmark using both CT and MRI. Segmentation scores were competitive (Dice of 0.84 on CT, 0.83 on MRI), but the primary focus is mesh quality: mean Chamfer distance of 1.8 mm, with 95th-percentile surface distance below 5 mm. Every mesh is produced in a single forward pass -- no Marching Cubes, no smoothing filters, no manual cleanup. We argue that for cardiac digital twin pipelines, geometric fidelity and topological correctness matter more than pixel-level Dice scores. By removing the post-processing bottleneck, this approach makes patient-specific cardiac simulation substantially more accessible for clinical use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种端到端的网络架构，直接从原始3D医学图像生成平滑、可用于仿真的心脏表面网格，避免了传统分割后处理流程。核心是3D Swin Transformer编码器-解码器结合图注意力网络（GAT）头，通过迭代变形模板网格来拟合患者心脏边界。在MM-WHS 2017基准上，CT和MRI的Dice分别为0.84和0.83，平均Chamfer距离1.8 mm，95%表面距离低于5 mm。
Motivation: 传统心脏网格生成流程（分割、Marching Cubes、手动清理）耗时、不一致且需要专业知识，阻碍了患者特异性心脏模型在临床中的应用。
Method: 训练一个单一端到端网络，包含3D Swin Transformer编码器-解码器提取体素特征，以及图注意力网络（GAT）头部，迭代变形模板网格以匹配心脏边界，直接输出网格。
Result: 在MM-WHS 2017基准上，CT和MRI的Dice分别为0.84和0.83，平均Chamfer距离1.8 mm，95%表面距离低于5 mm，所有网格一次前向传播生成，无需后处理。
Conclusion: 该方法通过去除后处理瓶颈，使患者特异性心脏模拟在临床中更易用。作者强调几何保真度和拓扑正确性比像素级Dice更重要。
