papers.title: Self-Guidance: Enhancing Neural Codecs via Decoder Manifold Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Neural speech codecs based on Vector-Quantized VAEs (VQ-VAEs) are core audio tokenizers for speech LLMs, yet their reconstruction fidelity is bottlenecked by quantization error. Modifying the quantizer or increasing model capacity are common fixes, but they complicate downstream language modeling. Our core idea is to align the decoder's internal feature manifolds when processing both the quantized tokens and their original continuous embeddings, using a lightweight feature-mapping loss. This requires minimal training overhead and no inference-time changes. Applied to XCodec2, self-guidance improves all reconstruction metrics, achieving state-of-the-art low-bitrate performance. Notably, it enables a 4x codebook reduction without fidelity loss, which downstream TTS experiments show significantly improves LLM-based synthesis by simplifying the token modeling space. Multiple statistical observations and visualizations corroborate the enhanced internal manifold alignment in the decoder. Extensive experiments confirm its generality across various inductive biases. Self-guidance thus establishes an efficient, broadly applicable method for high-fidelity neural audio coding.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, accepted to ICML 2026, demo website available at https://sgvqvae.github.io/sgvqvae-demo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经语音编解码器（如VQ-VAE）中量化误差导致的重建保真度瓶颈，提出一种轻量级的自引导方法（self-guidance），通过解码器内部特征流形对齐来改进重建质量。该方法仅需在训练时添加一个特征映射损失，无需修改模型架构或增加推理开销。在XCodec2上应用后，所有重建指标均提升，实现低比特率下的最优性能，并能在不损失保真度的情况下将码本大小缩减4倍。下游TTS实验表明，简化的令牌空间显著改善了基于LLM的语音合成。大量统计和可视化结果验证了解码器内部流形对齐的增强效果。
Motivation: 现有神经语音编解码器的重建质量受限于量化误差，常见的改进方案（修改量化器或增加容量）会复杂化下游语言建模。本文目标是在不增加下游复杂度的前提下提升保真度。
Method: 提议自引导（self-guidance）：在训练中，对解码器处理量化令牌和原始连续嵌入时的内部特征图施加特征映射损失，使两者在特征空间中对齐。该方法仅增加少量训练开销，推理时无需改动。
Result: 在XCodec2上，该方法在所有重建指标上达到SOTA低比特率性能；实现了4倍码本缩减而无保真损失；下游TTS实验表明LLM合成质量显著提升。
Conclusion: 自引导是一种高效、通用的方法，适用于各种归纳偏好的神经音频编码器，为高保真神经音频编码提供了新方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MAMVI: 3D Test-Time Adaptation via Masked Multi-View Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: 3D point cloud models suffer significant performance degradation under distribution shifts caused by sensor noise, occlusions, and environmental changes. Test-time adaptation (TTA) has emerged as a practical paradigm for mitigating this issue during inference. Recently, leveraging multi-view augmentation has shown promise in improving 3D TTA performance. However, existing multi-view approaches are often constrained by sequential optimization that treats each view independently. This sequential optimization leads to substantial inference latency due to repetitive optimization steps, making real-time adaptation impractical. To address this, we propose Masked Multi-View Test-Time Adaptation (MAMVI), which replaces sequential optimization with a unified single-step adaptation. Specifically, MAMVI utilizes a hybrid masking strategy that combines fixed ratios for stability with Beta-distributed sampling for diversity. By aggregating losses across multiple views, MAMVI performs adaptation through a single backward pass based on multi-view consensus. Additionally, a confidence-based adaptive learning rate is used to dynamically adjust the adaptation intensity for each sample. Extensive experiments on ModelNet-40C, ShapeNet-C, and ScanObjectNN-C demonstrate that MAMVI achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on ShapeNet-C and ScanObjectNN-C. Moreover, it remains competitive on ModelNet-40C while delivering 4.9-8.9 times faster inference, making it highly suitable for real-time applications. Our code is available at https://github.com/Inseok-kong/MAMVI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAMVI，一种用于 3D 点云测试时自适应 (TTA) 的掩码多视图方法。通过混合掩码策略和置信度自适应学习率，将原本的顺序多视图优化替换为单步反向传播，在保持精度的同时大幅降低推理延迟。
Motivation: 现有 3D TTA 的多视图方法通常顺序优化每个视图，导致推理延迟高，难以满足实时应用需求。
Method: MAMVI 使用固定比率与 Beta 分布采样的混合掩码策略生成多视图，并通过单步反向传播聚合多视图损失；同时采用基于置信度的自适应学习率动态调整每个样本的适应强度。
Result: 在 ShapeNet-C 和 ScanObjectNN-C 上达到 SOTA 准确率，在 ModelNet-40C 上具有竞争力，推理速度提升 4.9–8.9 倍。
Conclusion: MAMVI 凭借单步适应机制和速度优势，适合实时 3D 点云自适应场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Embodied Simulation Platform, Benchmark, and Data-Efficient Augmentation Framework for Wet-Lab Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Wet-lab robots can improve the reproducibility, throughput, and safety of biomedical experiments, but scaling their learning requires customizable simulators for safe and reproducible task generation, open editable laboratory assets, and efficient pipelines that turn limited demonstrations into usable training data. We present Pipette, an embodied simulation platform, benchmark, and data-efficient augmentation framework for wet-lab robot learning. Pipette releases over 43 open-source and re-editable wet-lab assets, together with an extensible asset-building pipeline. A key component of Pipette is its simulation-based data augmentation pipeline, replaying human demonstrations in simulation, applies lighting, camera, speed, and action perturbations, and filters generated episodes with automatic task success checks, rapidly expanding usable training data from limited manual demonstrations. We further introduce an 11-task wet-lab embodied benchmark covering sample handling, culture-ware manipulation, device operation, and precision placement. With only 30 demonstrations per task, ACT achieves 65.5% average success rate, while simulation augmentation improves SmolVLA from 44.1% to 74.7% and π0 from 40.4% to 46.5%, validating the effectiveness of Pipette for data-efficient VLA training and evaluation. Pipette also supports natural-language-driven scene construction and task registration, lowering the barrier for non-expert users to define new wet-lab robotic tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Pipette，一个用于湿实验室机器人学习的仿真平台、基准测试和数据高效增强框架。平台包含43个开源可编辑的湿实验室资产、11个任务基准，以及一个基于仿真的数据增强管道，通过重放人类演示并施加扰动来扩展训练数据。实验表明，仅30个演示每任务，ACT基线达到65.5%平均成功率，仿真增强将SmolVLA从44.1%提升至74.7%，π0从40.4%提升至46.5%。
Motivation: 湿实验室机器人（wet-lab robots）的规模化学习需要可定制的仿真器、开放可编辑的实验室资产以及高效的数据利用管道，现有工作在这些方面存在不足。
Method: Pipette包含三个核心组件：超过43个开源可编辑的湿实验室资产及可扩展的资产构建管道；基于仿真的数据增强管道，通过重放人类演示并施加光照、相机、速度和动作扰动，结合自动任务成功检查过滤生成的有效轨迹；11个湿实验室任务基准，涵盖样品处理、培养皿操作、设备操作和精密放置。
Result: 在每任务仅30个人类演示的条件下，ACT基线平均成功率为65.5%；仿真增强将SmolVLA从44.1%提升至74.7%，π0从40.4%提升至46.5%。
Conclusion: Pipette通过仿真增强和数据高效训练范式，显著提升了湿实验室机器人学习的样本效率，并支持自然语言驱动的场景构建和任务注册，降低了非专家用户定义新任务的门槛。

papers.title: MARS: Margin-Adversarial Risk-controlled Stopping for Parallel LLM Test-time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Parallel test-time scaling samples many reasoning traces and majority-votes their answers, improving LLM accuracy but requiring traces to run to completion, incurring substantial computational overhead. We observe that probing partial traces at intermediate checkpoints can extract current answers without disrupting generation, revealing an evolving aggregate vote. Based on this observation, we introduce MARS, a margin-adversarial stopping rule that estimates which active traces are likely to change their answers and stops once the leader remains safe under a conservative bound on future vote movement. The rule separates two sources of uncertainty. It learns the trace-level switch probabilities that determine how much of the current margin is likely to be retained, while handling the harder question of where switching traces land through an adversarial bound calibrated from warmup traces. With true switch probabilities, MARS guarantees with high probability that the early-stopped answer matches the full-budget vote. In practice, a five-feature logistic model closely matches oracle switching behavior. Across three reasoning models and three competition-math benchmarks, MARS saves 25-47% of self-consistency tokens and 14-29% on top of DeepConf Online, a strong confidence-weighted baseline that already filters and truncates weak traces, while matching the accuracy of the corresponding full-budget baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MARS，一种针对并行LLM测试时扩展的边界对抗停止规则。通过探测部分推理轨迹的中间检查点，MARS在不中断生成的情况下提取当前答案，并在未来投票变动的保守界下提前停止。实验表明，在三个推理模型和三个竞赛数学基准上，MARS节省25-47%的自一致性token，并在强基线DeepConf Online之上再节省14-29%，同时匹配完全预算投票的准确率。
Motivation: 并行测试时扩展需要所有推理轨迹运行至结束，导致大量计算开销。观察发现，通过中间检查点可以提取当前答案，从而设计提前停止规则以节省计算。
Method: MARS分离两种不确定性：学习轨迹级切换概率，并通过对抗界（从预热轨迹校准）处理切换轨迹的落点。采用五特征逻辑回归模型近似最优切换行为，当领先者在其边界下保持安全时停止。
Result: 在三个推理模型和三个竞赛数学基准上，MARS节省25-47%的自一致性token，并在DeepConf Online基础上再节省14-29%，同时准确率匹配完全预算基线。

papers.title: Is Spurious Correlation Removal Always Learnable?
papers.abstract_en: Invariant learning can fail even when the invariant structure is statistically identifiable. We show a conditional computational barrier: under a black-box samplable supervised sparse recovery primitive motivated by average-case sparse-recovery reductions, there exist \emph{samplable} multi-environment instances with a one-dimensional predictive invariant subspace ($k=1$) that are learnable with polynomial samples by exhaustive search, while any polynomial-time constant-accuracy recovery algorithm would contradict the primitive. We further quantify environment diversity by a separation parameter $γ$, which controls identifiability and the curvature of invariance objectives. Under sufficient diversity and local Gaussian regularity, the minimax risk is $\mathbb{E}[\dist(\hat{V},V_{\mathrm{inv}})^2]=Θ(k(d-k)/(n|\mathcal{E}|))$, and under label-induced shifts a phase transition occurs at $n^*\propto k(d-k)/(|\mathcal{E}|γ^2)$ with refined estimation error scaling proportional to $1/γ^2$. Synthetic and real datasets illustrate the predicted gaps and transitions and motivate simple diversity diagnostics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不变性学习中虚假相关性去除的可学习性，证明即使不变结构在统计上可识别，也存在计算障碍：在平均情况稀疏恢复假设下，存在可采样的多环境实例（一维不变子空间），其多项式样本可被穷举搜索学习，但任何多项式时间的常数精度恢复算法都会与假设矛盾。进一步量化环境多样性参数γ，给出最小化风险界和相变点。
Motivation: 不变性学习在统计可识别时仍可能失败，现有理论未充分揭示计算复杂性与环境多样性的关系，缺乏对虚假相关性去除可学习性的计算条件理解。
Method: 基于黑箱可采样监督稀疏恢复原语，构造多环境实例并分析其计算复杂性；推导最小化风险界（与k, d, n, |ε|相关），揭示标签偏移下的相变行为。
Result: 证明在计算假设下，存在一维不变子空间实例使得多项式时间算法无法达到常数精度；给出风险上界Θ(k(d-k)/(n|ε|))和相变点n* ∝ k(d-k)/(|ε|γ²)，并在合成/真实数据上验证。
Conclusion: 虚假相关性去除的可学习性受计算与环境多样性双重约束，γ²是控制估计精度的关键参数，建议使用简单的多样性诊断。

papers.title: Multi-Label Test-Time Adaptation with Bayesian Conditional Priors
papers.abstract_en: Multi-label recognition with frozen Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is brittle under distribution shift: standard zero-shot inference scores labels independently, ignoring co-occurrence structure and producing incoherent label sets where dominant concepts suppress weaker but compatible labels. We introduce Bayesian Conditional Priors (BCP) Estimation, a gradient-free test-time adaptation method that injects label dependency without tuning the backbone. BCP views zero-shot logits as a proxy for marginal posteriors under a fixed image-text likelihood and attributes shift-induced errors mainly to a mismatched label prior. For each test image, it selects a high-confidence anchor label and applies an anchor-conditioned Bayesian refinement. This update is closed-form in logit space and admits a pointwise mutual information (PMI) interpretation, explicitly promoting compatible labels and suppressing incompatible ones. BCP operates without target annotations by estimating anchor-conditioned priors online from the unlabeled test stream via lightweight second-order co-occurrence statistics, adding negligible overhead beyond a single forward pass. Across standard multi-label benchmarks and multiple CLIP backbones, BCP consistently outperforms strong TTA baselines, e.g., improving RN50 average mAP from 57.31 to 69.22 and ViT-B/16 from 62.61 to 71.79.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分布漂移下冻结视觉语言模型（VLM）的多标签识别脆弱性问题，提出了一种无梯度的测试时自适应方法——贝叶斯条件先验（BCP）估计。BCP无需微调骨干网络，通过在线估计条件先验注入标签依赖关系，在多个多标签基准和CLIP骨干上显著提升了平均mAP。
Motivation: 标准零样本推理独立打分，忽略了标签共现结构，导致优势概念抑制兼容标签，产生不连贯的标签集。
Method: 提出贝叶斯条件先验估计，对每个测试图像选择高置信度锚定标签，应用锚定条件的贝叶斯更新，在logit空间有闭式解，可解释为点互信息（PMI）。通过轻量级二阶共现统计在线估计条件先验，无需目标标注。
Result: 在多个标准多标签基准和CLIP骨干上，BCP一致优于强TTA基线，例如将RN50的平均mAP从57.31提升到69.22，ViT-B/16从62.61提升到71.79。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过注入标签依赖性有效提升了分布漂移下的多标签识别性能，且计算开销小。

papers.title: Iterating Toward Better Search: A Two-Agent Simulation Framework for Evaluating Agentic Search Architectures in E-Commerce
papers.abstract_en: We present a modular two-agent simulation framework for evaluating conversational shopping assistant architectures. An independent buyer agent, configured with personas, missions, and patience levels, is paired with an interchangeable responder that integrates with a real e-commerce search API. Holding the buyer constant across experiments enables controlled comparison of responder designs on identical scenarios. Using 2011 conversations across 14 persona buckets, we establish four empirical findings. First, rolling-window memory outperforms intent-extraction memory on all quality metrics while being 35% faster per query. Second, illustrating rapid evidence-driven iteration, a systematic failure analysis of a responder version enables targeted fixes that reduce failure and near-failure rates by 62% across the full dataset. Third, swapping the responder LLM backbone from Gemini~2.5 to Llama~3.3~70B costs 0.16--0.45 points despite identical architecture. Finally, we document systematic philosophical disagreement between frontier LLM judges: Gemini rewards process correctness while Claude demands concrete outcomes, despite using the same evaluation prompt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个模块化的双智能体模拟框架，用于评估电商环境中会话购物助手的架构。通过固定买家智能体并交换响应器，实现了对不同设计的受控比较。基于2011次对话的实验揭示了四个实证发现：滚动窗口记忆优于意图提取记忆且速度更快；系统性故障分析使故障率降低62%；更换LLM骨干会带来性能下降；不同LLM评判者存在哲学分歧。
Motivation: 现有电商搜索助手缺乏标准化评估框架，难以对不同架构设计进行公平比较。
Method: 构建双智能体模拟框架：一个独立的买家智能体（配置人物、任务和耐心）与一个可互换的响应器（接入真实电商搜索API），通过固定买家、更换响应器来比较不同设计。
Result: 滚动窗口记忆在所有质量指标上优于意图提取记忆，且每查询快35%；故障分析使故障/近故障率降低62%；将LLM骨干从Gemini 2.5换成Llama 3.3 70B导致0.16-0.45点下降；不同前沿LLM评判者对同一提示存在系统性分歧。
Conclusion: 框架支持快速迭代验证，并揭示了评估中关键的设计选择和评判者偏差。

papers.title: Order Is Not Control
papers.abstract_en: AI alignment, interpretability, steering, and neural perturbation studies identify order-inducing objects. We argue that order is not control. Control requires a receiver-gated response law: a denominator-indexed operator mapping material state, action/drive, bath, and receiver state to response displacement, sinks, effort, and basin projection. We identify it across biological, LLM, adapter, and stochastic-operator panels. The laws are local: an intervention can be admitted, saturated, sign-changing, leaky, or overdriven depending on medium, bath, receiver state, action port, and comparator. Control is assigned when finite effort moves a target or outcome-readout class under the same denominator while damage, null/evasive, invalid format, overdrive, and unnecessary effort stay bounded. Mouse ALM, C. elegans, and zebrafish panels provide physical response-operator evidence while excluding coordinate identity and controller conclusions. LLM panels show generated-output response laws: across four material conditions, response vectors are predictable at 72.8-73.7% component-sign accuracy, rising to 84.3-84.8% on nonzero components; held-out observers predict system-effect and target/oracle families at 93.6% and 91.7% accuracy. Constitution-conditioned adapters reshape susceptibility as prepared media, and stochastic-operator panels separate measured opportunity from deployable action policies. This gives a driven-dissipative response-system account at the mesoscopic control level: drives act through prepared media, baths, and receivers, producing admitted movement, impedance, sinks, or overdrive. The evidence supports local admitted control and measurable stochastic response operators, while leaving deployable pre-generation control, hidden/logit causal sufficiency, biological-to-LLM coordinate identity, and literal thermodynamic quantities outside scope.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“秩序不等于控制”的观点，定义控制为需要接收器门控响应律的机制。通过生物（小鼠ALM、线虫、斑马鱼）和LLM实验，展示了响应算子的局部性特征。LLM实验显示响应向量在多种条件下成分符号预测准确率达72.8-73.7%，非零成分上达84.3-84.8%，并且外推观察器能够高精度预测系统效应和目标/oracle族（93.6%和91.7%）。该工作支持局部容许控制和可测随机响应算子的概念，但排除了可部署的预生成控制等范畴。
Motivation: 当前AI对齐、可解释性、神经扰动研究识别出秩序诱导对象，但作者指出秩序并不等于控制，需要明确控制的定义和条件。
Method: 提出接收器门控响应律的定义框架，并在多个系统（生物神经元、LLM、适配器、随机算子）中进行实证验证。
Result: LLM实验中，响应向量在四种物质条件下成分符号预测准确率达72.8-73.7%，非零成分上达84.3-84.8%；外推观察器预测系统效应准确率93.6%，目标/oracle族准确率91.7%。
Conclusion: 实验结果支持局部容许控制和可测随机响应算子的存在，但指出可部署的预生成控制、隐藏/logit因果充分性、生物到LLM坐标同一性以及字面热力学量均不在本文范围。

papers.title: LoRA-Muon: Spectral Steepest Descent on the Low-Rank Manifold
papers.abstract_en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) significantly reduces compute and memory costs for finetuning Deep Learning models but is often harder to tune than dense training: when using factor-wise optimizers such as AdamW, it is sensitive to initialization choices, its optimal learning rates transfer poorly across ranks, and it often fails to beat dense baselines. We derive LoRA-Muon by applying the Muon optimizer's spectral steepest-descent rule to the low-rank setting. Along with our split weight-decay rule, our main claim is that LoRA-Muon is a good low-rank proxy for full-rank Muon and Shampoo-family optimizers. Its optimal learning rates transfer across rank, width, depth, and factor-rescaling. In our compute-matched TinyShakespeare study, a rank-$2$ proxy recovers the dense best tested learning rate, and a rank-$32$ LoRA-Muon run attains lower mean validation loss than the dense baseline in the seed-averaged sweep. We further show that the Spectron optimizer depends on arbitrary factor scaling, so it would likely be a poor fit when finetuning starts from badly imbalanced factors, and that LoRA-RITE's simplified QR-coordinate core implements the same spectral update. LoRA-Muon computes that update without QR-decomposition and avoids storing second moments, making it more accelerator-friendly and memory-efficient.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LoRA-Muon，将Muon优化器的谱最速下降规则应用于低秩微调（LoRA）。作者声称LoRA-Muon是满秩Muon和Shampoo族优化器的良好低秩代理，其最优学习率可跨秩、宽度、深度和因子缩放转移。在TinyShakespeare实验中，秩2的代理恢复了密集训练的最佳学习率，秩32的LoRA-Muon在平均种子扫描中达到比密集基线更低的验证损失。此外，作者指出Spectron优化器依赖任意因子缩放，而LoRA-Muon无需QR分解且不存储二阶矩，更节省内存。
Motivation: LoRA微调在使用因子级优化器（如AdamW）时对初始化敏感，最优学习率跨秩迁移性差，且常无法超越密集基线。本文目标是为低秩微调设计一个鲁棒且高效的优化器。
Method: 将Muon优化器的谱最速下降规则适配到低秩设置，提出LoRA-Muon，并引入分裂权重衰减规则。
Result: 在TinyShakespeare上秩2的LoRA-Muon恢复了密集训练的最佳学习率，秩32达到比密集基线更低的平均验证损失。学习率跨秩、宽度、深度和因子缩放可迁移。
Conclusion: LoRA-Muon是满秩Muon和Shampoo族优化器的有效低秩代理，具有更好的内存效率和学习率迁移性。

summary_sections.motivation: LoRA微调在使用因子级优化器（如AdamW）时对初始化敏感，最优学习率跨秩迁移性差，且常无法超越密集基线。本文目标是为低秩微调设计一个鲁棒且高效的优化器。
summary_sections.method: 将Muon优化器的谱最速下降规则适配到低秩设置，提出LoRA-Muon，并引入分裂权重衰减规则。
summary_sections.result: 在TinyShakespeare上秩2的LoRA-Muon恢复了密集训练的最佳学习率，秩32达到比密集基线更低的平均验证损失。学习率跨秩、宽度、深度和因子缩放可迁移。
summary_sections.conclusion: LoRA-Muon是满秩Muon和Shampoo族优化器的有效低秩代理，具有更好的内存效率和学习率迁移性。

papers.title: MAStrike: Shapley-Guided Collusive Red-Teaming on Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical multi-agent systems (MAS) are rapidly being deployed in high-stakes workflows across domains such as finance and software engineering. In these systems, safety and security are inherently distributed across role-specialized agents, significantly expanding the attack surface, particularly under coordinated adversarial behaviors such as privilege escalation and cross-agent collusion. Existing red-teaming approaches for MAS remain limited: they rely on heuristic selection of target agents and perturb isolated message streams, leaving critical questions unanswered as which agents are most responsible for system safety, and how compromised agents can coordinate to bypass defenses. We propose MAStrike, a closed-loop framework for collusive red-teaming in hierarchical MAS. We propose the first agent-level Shapley value analysis for MAS, quantifying each agent's marginal contribution to system robustness under task-specific distributions. GGuided by this attribution, MAStrike identifies vulnerable agent coalitions and generates coordinated, role-aware adversarial manipulations. These attacks are iteratively refined through structured causal diagnosis, attributing failure cases to uncompromised agents that block adversarial attempts. We further build a comprehensive MAS red-teaming benchmark and controllable environments spanning diverse hierarchical topologies and domains, including finance, software engineering, and CRM. Extensive experiments across MAS built on multiple frontier models show that MAStrike substantially outperforms heuristic baselines. Our analysis further uncovers non-trivial Shapley value distributions and higher-order interaction structures among agents, revealing critical vulnerabilities and coordination patterns that are overlooked by prior single-agent or template-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MAStrike，一个针对层级多智能体系统（MAS）的合谋式红队测试框架。通过首次在MAS中引入智能体级别的Shapley值分析，量化每个智能体对系统鲁棒性的边际贡献，并据此识别脆弱智能体联盟，生成协调的角色感知对抗操作。实验在金融、软件工程、CRM等多个领域的MAS基准上验证，MAStrike显著优于启发式基线，并揭示了被先前方法忽略的智能体高阶交互结构。
Motivation: 现有红队测试方法在MAS中依赖启发式选择目标智能体并扰动孤立消息流，无法回答哪些智能体对系统安全最重要以及被攻破的智能体如何协同绕过防御的问题，导致攻击面评估不完整。
Method: 提出MAStrike框架，包含三个关键组件：基于Shapley值的智能体贡献归因、脆弱智能体联盟识别与角色感知对抗生成、以及结构化因果诊断迭代优化攻击。
Result: 在多个前沿模型构建的MAS上，MAStrike在与不同层级拓扑和领域的基准测试中，攻击成功率等指标大幅优于启发式基线，并发现非平凡的Shapley值分布和智能体间高阶交互结构。
Conclusion: MAStrike为MAS合谋式红队测试提供了系统化方法，揭示了单智能体或模板方法忽略的关键漏洞与协调模式，有助于提升MAS安全性。

papers.title: Where Computation Lives Inside TabPFN: Causal Localisation of Attention Head Function
papers.abstract_en: We present the first causal mechanistic analysis of a tabular foundation model, investigating how TabPFN 2.5's feature wise attention heads distribute computation across layers. Using activation patching, ablation, and attention entropy across two synthetic regression datasets, we find clear temporal specialisation: one head's causal necessity dominates that of the others by 2 to 5 times at peak layer, with its dominant layer shifting across tasks of different complexity, while the remaining heads exhibit symmetric late layer profiles. Attention entropy and patching provide convergent evidence for the computationally active layers of the dominant head. We additionally investigate inference time steerability via contrastive activation steering, which fails to transfer across samples. We attribute this result to TabPFN's in context learning mechanism, which encodes task structure through context dependent attention rather than the stable parametric directions that make steering tractable in language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对表格基础模型TabPFN 2.5进行因果机制分析，研究其逐特征注意力头在不同层间的计算分布。通过激活修补、消融和注意力熵在合成回归数据集上的实验，发现一个注意力头在特定层的主导因果必要性比其他头高出2-5倍，且该主导层随任务复杂度变化，其余头呈现对称的后期层特征。此外，对比激活引导的推理时可控性在样本间无法迁移，归因于TabPFN的上下文学习机制。
Motivation: 理解表格基础模型内部的计算机制，特别是注意力头的功能特异性和层间分工，以及推理时的可控性。
Method: 使用激活修补（activation patching）、消融（ablation）和注意力熵（attention entropy）对TabPFN 2.5的注意力头进行因果分析，并在两个合成回归数据集上评估。
Result: 发现一个主导注意力头在峰值层的因果必要性比其他头高2-5倍，主导层随任务复杂度变化；其余头具有对称的后期层轮廓；对比激活引导的可控性在样本间失效。
Conclusion: TabPFN的计算依赖于上下文相关的注意力编码任务结构，而非类似语言模型的稳定参数方向，导致基于激活引导的可控性难以跨样本迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MDForge: Agentic Molecular Dynamics Pipeline Design under Sparse Simulator Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Molecular dynamics (MD) is the canonical in-silico method for atomistic molecular science, simulating molecular behavior from first-principle physics. Designing an MD pipeline for a new system requires substantial expert knowledge: running it on even one molecule is expensive, ruling out trial-and-error. We automate this expert pipeline-design process with an LLM agent. Unlike existing MD agents that orchestrate a predefined tool set, we treat pipeline design as open-ended code generation in which the agent's behavior is reshaped online by verbal reward. Specifically, we build MDForge, an LLM agent whose in-context update rule densifies the sparse reward via a multi-agent debate among physics experts. On three SAMPL host-guest binding free-energy benchmarks, MDForge automatically designs MD pipelines competitive with human experts. Deployed on a library of unseen candidate guests, its CB[7] pipeline discovers a novel binder that wet-lab competition NMR confirms is a high-affinity, picomolar CB[7] binder. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/Zehong-Wang/MDForge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MDForge，一个基于 LLM 的智能体，通过多智能体辩论稠密化稀疏奖励，自动设计分子动力学 (MD) 流水线。在 SAMPL 宿主-客体结合自由能基准上，其性能与人类专家相当，并成功发现新型高亲和力 CB[7] 结合剂。
Motivation: 手动设计 MD 流水线需要大量专家知识且运行成本高，无法试错，现有 MD 智能体仅编排预定义工具集，缺乏对开放性流水线设计的自动化。
Method: 将流水线设计视为开放代码生成，LLM 智能体通过口头奖励在线调整行为，并利用多智能体 (multi-agent) 辩论机制将稀疏模拟器反馈稠密化。
Result: 在 SAMPL 基准上，MDForge 自动设计的 MD 流水线达到与人类专家竞争的性能；在未见客体库上，其 CB[7] 流水线发现一个经湿实验验证的高亲和力 (picomolar) 新型结合剂。
Conclusion: 论文表明 LLM 智能体可有效自动化 MD 流水线设计，但方法对模拟器反馈的稀疏性依赖较强，可能限制其直接迁移到其他领域。

papers.title: Selecting Samples on Graphs: A Unified Dataset Pruning Framework for Lossless Training Acceleration
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of modern training datasets has significantly increased computational cost, motivating dataset pruning~(DP) methods which retain only a subset of informative samples to reduce training cost. Existing pruning criteria typically rely on either intrinsic signals that assess samples independently or extrinsic signals that promote diversity via pairwise relations. While effective in their own specific regimes, each captures only one aspect of sample utility and lacks robustness across different pruning ratios or data distribution. In this work, we present a unified graph-based DP framework. By modeling the dataset as a weighted graph, where node weights encode intrinsic value and edge weights encode extrinsic value, DP can be cast as a Maximum Weight Clique Problem (MWCP). Although MWCP is NP-hard, its structure admits a principled greedy solution based on sample-wise marginal gains. Under a few mild conditions, we further prove that this unified objective enjoys a formal approximation guarantee, which applies to a broad family of importance metrics and provides practical design guidelines. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms existing DP methods while substantially reducing training cost, reducing training time by over 40\% without sacrificing accuracy on ImageNet-1k with ResNet-50.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的基于图的样本剪枝框架，通过将数据集建模为加权图（节点权重表示样本内在价值，边权重表示样本间外在价值），将数据集剪枝问题转化为最大权团问题（MWCP），并设计基于边际增益的贪心算法求解。在温和条件下证明了近似保证，并在ImageNet-1k上使用ResNet-50将训练时间减少40%以上而不牺牲准确率。
Motivation: 现有数据集剪枝（DP）方法通常只关注样本独立的内在信号或基于成对关系的外在信号，各自只捕捉样本效用的一个方面，在不同剪枝率或数据分布下缺乏鲁棒性。
Method: 将数据集建模为加权图，节点权重编码内在价值（如训练损失），边权重编码外在价值（如多样性度量）；将剪枝目标形式化为最大权团问题（NP-hard），并推导出基于样本边际增益的贪心算法，在弱假设下具有近似保证。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法优于现有DP方法；在ImageNet-1k上用ResNet-50训练时间减少超过40%且不牺牲准确率。
Conclusion: 该统一图框架能够同时捕捉样本内在和外在价值，并具有理论近似保证，为实际剪枝提供了设计指导。

papers.title: Bounding Boxes as Goals: Language-Conditioned Grasping via Neuro-Symbolic Planning
papers.abstract_en: For robotics to be effectively integrated into household or industrial environments, machines must adapt to natural-language prompts in real time. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled zero-shot generalization in robot task and motion planning (TAMP), current state-of-the-art approaches often remain computationally "heavyweight" or require extensive training on thousands of demonstrations. We present GRASP (Grounded Reasoning and Symbolic Planning), a framework designed as a step toward open-vocabulary tabletop manipulation. Our approach leverages a pretrained VLM to translate natural-language queries into neuro-symbolic goal states, grounded in the physical world via a bounding-box detection pipeline. Unlike methods that rely on fixed color lists or hard-coded coordinates, GRASP enables robots to interpret abstract spatial concepts such as "top shelf" and execute tasks without additional fine-tuning. We achieve 73.3% overall success across 90 real-robot trials at three difficulty levels, requiring no task-specific training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRASP框架，利用预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）将自然语言查询转化为神经符号目标状态，并通过边界框检测管线实现物理世界中的接地。该方法无需任务特定训练，即可解释“顶层架子”等抽象空间概念，在90次真实机器人试验中达到73.3%的成功率。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在机器人任务与运动规划中虽能实现零样本泛化，但通常计算开销大或需要大量演示训练。
Method: GRASP框架使用预训练VLM将自然语言翻译为神经符号目标状态，通过边界框检测管线实现物理世界接地，避免固定颜色列表或硬编码坐标。
Result: 在三个难度等级的90次真实机器人试验中，整体成功率为73.3%，无需任务特定训练。
Conclusion: 摘要未明确讨论局限性，但强调该方法向开放词汇桌面操纵迈出了一步，并减少了计算开销。

papers.title: Zero-source LLM Hallucination Detection with Human-like Criteria Probing
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often hallucinate by generating factually incorrect or unfaithful content, posing significant risks to their safe use. Detecting such hallucinations is particularly challenging under the zero-source constraint, where no model internals or external references are available, and detection must rely solely on the textual query-answer pair. In this paper, we propose Human-like Criteria Probing for Hallucination Detection (HCPD), a paradigm that emulates the multi-faceted reasoning of human evaluators. Its core is a Human-like Criteria Probing (HCP) mechanism, in which a LLM agent adaptively decomposes its judgment into a weighted set of interpretable criteria and aggregates criterion-specific scores into a final truthfulness measure. To achieve this adaptive capability, we introduce a reward-based alignment scheme using only weak supervision from semantic consistency. At inference, we employ a multi-sampling aggregation strategy to ensure robust decisions while preserving full interpretability. We further provide theoretical analysis supporting the reliability of our approach. Extensive experiments show that HCPD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, offering an effective and explainable solution for zero-source hallucination detection. Code is available at https://github.com/TRISKEL10N/HCPD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为HCPD的零源幻觉检测方法，通过模拟人类评估者的多维度推理，将判断分解为可解释的加权标准集合，并聚合特定标准分数以衡量真实性。该方法仅使用来自语义一致性的弱监督进行奖励对齐，推理时采用多采样聚合策略确保鲁棒性，同时保持完全可解释性。实验表明，HCPD在零源幻觉检测中持续优于现有基线。
Motivation: 大语言模型常产生事实性错误或违背内容的幻觉，但现有检测方法在零源约束下（无法访问模型内部或外部参考，仅依赖文本问答对）面临挑战。
Method: 提出类人标准探测机制（HCP），由LLM代理自适应地将判断分解为加权可解释标准，并聚合标准特定分数为最终真实性度量。通过基于语义一致性的奖励对齐实现自适应能力，推理时采用多采样聚合策略。
Result: 在零源幻觉检测任务上，HCPD持续优于最先进的基线方法，并提供了理论分析支持其可靠性。
Conclusion: HCPD为零源约束下的幻觉检测提供了有效且可解释的解决方案，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Magnifying What Matters: Attention-Guided Adaptive Rendering for Visual Text Comprehension
papers.abstract_en: Visual Text Comprehension (VTC) renders text into images for a vision-language model (VLM) to read, sidestepping LLM context-window limits and powering applications from long-page OCR to multi-page memory QA. Yet existing VTC pipelines treat rendering and layout as a fixed, content-agnostic preprocessing step and offer little mechanistic understanding of how VLMs internally process visualized text. Through a focused empirical study on VTC QA tasks, we reveal that VLMs exhibit a localization-without-utilization regime: evidence-localizing attention emerges sharply in the middle-to-late layers and is largely decoupled from answer correctness, yet simply enlarging the localized spans on the rendered page recovers a large fraction of the failures. Building on these observations, we propose AGAR (Attention-Guided Adaptive Rendering), a training-free, model-agnostic method that leverages a VLM's own middle-to-late layer attention to identify the top-K important visual patches, maps them back to word spans, and re-renders the page with those spans enlarged before re-inferring the answer. Extensive experiments across nine VTC benchmarks (short-form, long-context, and multi-page memory QA) and four VLM backbones show that AGAR (i)consistently improves off-the-shelf VLMs as a plug-and-play enhancement, (ii)composes with VLM post-training to yield further gains, and (iii)remains robust under both visual- and text-side input degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉文本理解（VTC）中现有渲染方法内容无关、缺乏对VLM内部机制理解的问题，通过实证研究揭示VLM存在“定位而不利用”现象：中间至后层出现定位注意力但与答案正确性解耦，仅放大定位区域即可恢复大部分错误。基于此提出AGAR（Attention-Guided Adaptive Rendering），一种无需训练、模型无关的方法，利用VLM自身中间至后层注意力识别重要视觉块，映射回词跨度，重新渲染放大后再推理。在九个VTC基准和四个VLM骨干上，AGAR作为即插即用增强一致提升现成VLM，与后训练结合可进一步获益，且对输入退化鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有VTC流水线将渲染和布局视为固定、内容无关的预处理步骤，缺乏对VLM内部处理可视化文本的机制理解，导致性能受限。
Method: 提出AGAR，无需训练，通过VLM中间至后层注意力识别前K个重要视觉块，映射回单词跨度，重新渲染页面并放大这些跨度，然后重新推理答案。
Result: 在九个VTC基准（短形式、长上下文、多页记忆QA）和四个VLM骨干上，AGAR作为即插即用增强一致提升现成VLM性能，与后训练结合可进一步获益，且对视觉和文本侧输入退化保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: AGAR是一种简单有效的训练自由方法，通过注意力引导自适应渲染提升VLM的视觉文本理解能力，且易于集成。

papers.title: PolicyGuard: Towards Test-time and Step-level Adversary Defense for Reinforcement Learning Agent
papers.abstract_en: While real-world applications of reinforcement learning (RL) are becoming increasingly popular, the security of RL systems deserve more attention and exploration. In particular, recent work has revealed that RL agents are vulnerable to backdoor attacks, where a victim agent behaves normally under standard conditions but executes malicious actions when a specific trigger is activated. Existing backdoor defenses for RL either require access to the agent's internal parameters, operate only at the model or trajectory level, or are limited to specific attack types. To ensure the security of RL agents, we propose \texttt{PolicyGuard}, a \textit{test-time step-level} backdoor defense which leverages Gaussian Process (GP) posterior variance and adapts pseudo trajectories to enable uncertainty computation for individual time step. Besides, we also provide theoretical foundations to explain the efficacy of GP posterior variance. Extensive experiments across seven RL games demonstrate that PolicyGuard achieves state-of-the-art detection performance in most cases, with average AUROC of 0.856 for perturbation-based attacks and 0.859 for adversary-agent attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolicyGuard，一种测试时、步级别的后门防御方法，用于强化学习智能体。该方法利用高斯过程后验方差和伪轨迹计算每个时间步的不确定性，从而检测后门攻击。在七个 RL 游戏上的实验表明，PolicyGuard 在大多数情况下取得了最优检测性能，针对扰动攻击的平均 AUROC 为 0.856，针对对手智能体攻击的平均 AUROC 为 0.859。
Motivation: 强化学习智能体易受后门攻击，现有防御方法要么需要访问内部参数，要么仅在模型或轨迹级别操作，或局限于特定攻击类型。需要一种测试时、步级别的通用防御方法。
Method: 提出 PolicyGuard，利用高斯过程后验方差和自适应伪轨迹来计算单个时间步的不确定性，从而实现测试时、步级别的后门检测。
Result: 在七个 RL 游戏上，PolicyGuard 在大多数情况下达到最优检测性能，扰动攻击的平均 AUROC 为 0.856，对手智能体攻击的平均 AUROC 为 0.859。
Conclusion: PolicyGuard 提供了一种有效的测试时、步级别的后门防御方案，并具有理论支撑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LongSpike: Fractional Order Spiking State Space Models for Efficient Long Sequence Learning
papers.abstract_en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are well-regarded for their biological plausibility and energy efficiency in processing sequential data. However, dominant SNN architectures typically rely on first-order Ordinary Differential Equations (ODEs) to govern neuronal state transitions. This first-order assumption imposes a "memoryless" bottleneck, limiting the model's capacity to capture the complex, long-range dependencies inherent in long-sequence tasks. In this work, we propose LongSpike, a novel SNN framework that integrates fractional-order State-Space Modeling, or f-SSM, from control theory into the spiking domain. By extending traditional integer-order SSMs to the fractional-calculus regime, LongSpike enables the hierarchical integration of neuronal dynamics with long-memory kernels. To mitigate the computational overhead and parallelization challenges typically associated with fractional operators, we leverage a state-space formulation that supports efficient, parallel training. Empirical evaluations on challenging benchmarks, including Long Range Arena (LRA), large-scale WikiText-103, and Speech Commands, demonstrate that LongSpike outperforms state-of-the-art SNNs in accuracy while preserving sparse synaptic computation. The code is available at https://github.com/xinruihe389-commits/LongSpike.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LongSpike 是一种结合分数阶状态空间模型（f-SSM）的脉冲神经网络（SNN），旨在克服传统一阶 ODE 导致的‘无记忆’瓶颈，从而提升对长序列任务中复杂长程依赖的建模能力。在 Long Range Arena (LRA)、WikiText-103 和 Speech Commands 等基准上，LongSpike 在准确率上超越了现有的最先进 SNN，同时保持了稀疏突触计算的优势。
Motivation: 现有主流的 SNN 架构通常依赖一阶 ODE 控制神经元状态演化，这种一阶假设引入了‘无记忆’瓶颈，限制了模型对长序列任务中复杂长程依赖的表示能力。
Method: 将控制理论中的分数阶状态空间模型（f-SSM）扩展到脉冲域，通过分数阶微积分实现神经元动力学与长记忆核的分层集成，并采用状态空间公式实现高效并行训练，避免传统分数阶算子带来的计算开销。
Result: 在 Long Range Arena (LRA)、WikiText-103 和 Speech Commands 基准上，LongSpike 的准确率超过当前最先进的 SNN 方法，同时保持稀疏突触计算特性。
Conclusion: LongSpike 证明了分数阶状态空间模型在 SNN 中的有效性，为长序列学习提供了一种兼顾生物合理性与计算效率的新方案，并开源了代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prediction-Powered Causal Inference by Automatic Debiased Machine Learning and Semi-Supervised Riesz Regression
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates semiparametric efficient estimation of causal and structural parameters in a semi-supervised setting. In our setting, unlabeled auxiliary regressors are available in addition to labeled observations consisting of outcomes and regressors. Our goal is to construct estimators of causal and structural parameters whose asymptotic variances are smaller than those of estimators constructed using only labeled data. We refer to this framework as prediction-powered causal inference (PPCI). We first derive the efficient influence function and the efficiency bound, which imply that the use of auxiliary regressors can attain a smaller asymptotic variance than the efficiency bound attainable from labeled observations alone. Then, by combining the efficient influence function with the debiased machine learning (DML) framework, we propose methods that we call DML-PPCI. If we construct an estimating-equation estimator, we refer to the method as EE-DML-PPCI; if we construct a targeted-learning estimator, we refer to the method as TMLE-DML-PPCI. The asymptotic variances of both estimators match our derived efficiency bound. In the construction of the estimators, estimation of the efficient influence function plays an important role. In our study, the efficient influence function is also a Neyman orthogonal score, which depends on the Riesz representer and the regression function. For Riesz representer estimation, we develop semi-supervised generalized Riesz regression with convergence rate guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究半监督设置下因果参数和结构参数的半参数有效估计，利用未标记的辅助回归器来降低渐近方差，提出预测驱动因果推断（PPCI）框架，并通过去偏机器学习（DML）和半监督Riesz回归实现有效估计。
Motivation: 在因果推断中，通常只有少量标记数据可用，而大量未标记辅助数据包含有用信息。本文旨在利用这些辅助数据提高估计效率，降低仅使用标记数据时的渐近方差下界。
Method: 推导了半监督设置下的有效影响函数和效率界，并结合去偏机器学习框架提出两种估计方法：基于估计方程（EE-DML-PPCI）和基于目标学习（TMLE-DML-PPCI）。为估计Riesz表示，开发了半监督广义Riesz回归并保证收敛速度。
Result: 理论表明，使用辅助回归器可达到比仅用标记数据更小的渐近方差。所提两种估计量的渐近方差均匹配推导的效率界。
Conclusion: 本文为半监督因果推断提供了理论指导和实用方法，可广泛应用于经济学、流行病学等领域中辅助数据丰富的场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Bridging Modal Isolation in Interleaved Thinking: Supervising Modality Transitions via Stepwise Reinforcement
papers.abstract_en: Interleaved thinking, where a unified multimodal model alternates between textual reasoning and visual generation, has shown promise on spatial and physical tasks. However, in complex long-chain scenarios, we identify a fundamental failure mode: generated images diverge from the textual context while subsequent text ignores the visual evidence, causing the two modalities to alternate without genuinely informing each other. We term this Modal Isolation and attribute it to compounding information loss at modality boundaries. We decompose each reasoning cycle into atomic operations and define modality transition loss, quantifying cross-modal hallucination (text-to-image) and visual utilization deficit (image-to-text) at each boundary. We propose MoTiF (Modality Tiransition Fidelity), a two-stage training framework that directly optimizes these transitions: Reflective SFT trains the model to detect and recover from erroneous visual outputs; Flow-GRPO improves image generation fidelity via reinforcement learning. All training signals in MoTiF derive from transition-level fidelity rather than end-task accuracy. Across four visual puzzle benchmarks, this transition-level supervision substantially improves both cross-modal coherence and final task accuracy. The results demonstrate that effective interleaved reasoning requires explicit structural supervision at modality boundaries, not merely scaling or end-task optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态交错推理中模态隔离的问题，提出MoTiF框架，通过定义模态转换损失并采用两阶段训练（Reflective SFT和Flow-GRPO）直接优化转换保真度，在视觉谜题基准上显著提升了跨模态一致性与任务准确度。
Motivation: 交错推理中，生成的图像偏离文本上下文，后续文本又忽略视觉证据，导致模态交替却无法相互有效指导，这种模态隔离源于模态边界的信息累积丢失。
Method: MoTiF包含两阶段：Reflective SFT训练模型检测并恢复错误的视觉输出；Flow-GRPO通过强化学习提升图像生成保真度。所有训练信号来自转换级保真度而非端任务准确度。
Result: 在四个视觉谜题基准上，转换级监督显著改善了跨模态连贯性和最终任务准确度。
Conclusion: 有效的交错推理需要在模态边界施加显式结构监督，而非仅依靠规模或端任务优化。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: MoTiF包含两阶段：Reflective SFT训练模型检测并恢复错误的视觉输出；Flow-GRPO通过强化学习提升图像生成保真度。所有训练信号来自转换级保真度而非端任务准确度。
summary_sections.result: 在四个视觉谜题基准上，转换级监督显著改善了跨模态连贯性和最终任务准确度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 有效的交错推理需要在模态边界施加显式结构监督，而非仅依靠规模或端任务优化。

papers.title: The Hidden Power of Scaling Factor in LoRA Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), the scaling factor $α$ is often treated as a mere complement to the learning rate, yet its role in optimization remains poorly understood. In this paper, we reveal that the scaling factor $α$ and the learning rate function differently, with $α$ emerging as the dominant driver of effective optimization, delivering gains that cannot be replicated by learning rate scaling alone. Through the synergy of extensive empirical analysis and a theoretical Signal-Drift framework, we uncover three findings into LoRA's scaling mechanism: First, LoRA's spectral suppression smooths the optimization landscape, rendering standard hyperparameters overly conservative and creating an optimization gap. Second, when leveraging this smoothness to accelerate convergence, $α$ outperforms the learning rate by amplifying the task signal without increasing the drift ratio. Third, the optimal scaling factor follows a sublinear relationship with the rank, well characterized by a square-root law with an unexpectedly large coefficient, revealing the insufficient scaling of existing rank-tied heuristics. Based on these insights, we propose LoRA-$α$, a minimalist framework that restores $α$ to its principled regime, making LoRA compatible with standard small learning rates. Extensive evaluations across diverse tasks demonstrate that LoRA-$α$ consistently improves performance while streamlining hyperparameter search, unleashing the learning potential of LoRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LoRA中缩放因子α的作用，发现α和学习率功能不同，α是优化的主导因素，能够通过放大任务信号而不增加漂移比来加速收敛。基于信号-漂移理论框架和大量实证，提出LoRA-α框架，恢复α的合理范围，使LoRA兼容标准小学习率。实验表明该方法持续提升性能并简化超参数搜索。
Motivation: 现有LoRA中缩放因子α常被视为学习率的附属，其优化作用尚不明确，导致超参数调优复杂且性能受限。
Method: 通过信号-漂移（Signal-Drift）理论框架和广泛实证分析，揭示α的缩放机制：LoRA的频谱抑制使优化景观平滑，α能有效放大任务信号而不增加漂移比。基于此提出了LoRA-α框架，采用平方根定律确定最优α与秩的关系。
Result: 在多种任务上评估，LoRA-α持续提升性能，简化超参数搜索，释放LoRA的学习潜力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调α和学习率功能不同，α是主导因素，且最优缩放因子与秩遵循平方根定律，系数大于传统启发式，建议采用标准小学习率与适当α以提升LoRA效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HarnessBridge: Learnable Bidirectional Controller for LLM Agent Harness
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents for long-horizon tasks, yet their performance is shaped not only by model capability and environment design, but also by the harness that mediates agent--environment interaction. Existing harnesses are largely manually engineered, making them difficult to scale as trajectories grow longer and interactions become more complex. In this work, we ask whether harness can be generated by a learnable plug-in module that can be trained in an end-to-end fashion. We introduce HarnessBridge, a lightweight learnable harness controller that parameterizes the agent--environment interface as a bidirectional projection. HarnessBridge learns two bidirectional projections: observation projection, which distills raw trajectories into compact, decision-relevant states, and action projection, which converts proposed actions into executable transitions or trajectory-grounded rejections. We train HarnessBridge on a harness supervision dataset via unified instruction tuning. On Terminal-Bench~2.0 and SWE-bench Verified, HarnessBridge matches or surpasses strong specialized harnesses while substantially reducing token usage and trajectory length, and generalizes from smaller generators to larger commercial models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HarnessBridge，一种可学习的轻量级控制器，用于参数化LLM Agent与环境交互的接口。通过双向投影（观察投影和动作投影）对轨迹进行状态压缩和动作转换，在两项基准上匹配或超越专用harness，同时降低token消耗和轨迹长度。
Motivation: 现有harness依赖人工设计，难以随轨迹长度和交互复杂度扩展，限制了LLM Agent在长程任务中的性能。
Method: 提出HarnessBridge，包含两个可学习的双向投影模块：观察投影将原始轨迹蒸馏为决策相关的紧凑状态；动作投影将提议的动作转换为可执行的转移或基于轨迹的拒绝。通过统一指令微调在harness监督数据集上训练。
Result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.0和SWE-bench Verified上，HarnessBridge匹配或超过强专用harness，同时显著减少token使用量和轨迹长度，并能从小模型泛化到大型商业模型。
Conclusion: 摘要表明可学习的harness控制器可以替代人工设计，在保持性能的同时提高效率和泛化能力。局限性未明确提及，但可能依赖特定数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Direct Preference Optimization for Chatbot Fine-Tuning: An Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: We present an approach to fine-tuning large language models using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), a reinforcement learning technique. Our experimental results demonstrate that DPO simplifies the training pipeline, improves computational efficiency, and achieves competitive performance. The evaluation using BLEU, ROUGE, and cosine similarity metrics indicates effective learning and convergence, though further investigation is needed to address observed training instability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了使用直接偏好优化（DPO）对大型语言模型进行微调的实证研究，结果显示DPO简化了训练流程并提高了计算效率，在BLEU、ROUGE和余弦相似度指标上取得了有竞争力的性能，但训练稳定性仍需进一步研究。
Motivation: 现有强化学习微调方法（如RLHF）流程复杂、计算成本高，本文尝试探究更简洁的DPO方法在聊天机器人微调中的有效性。
Method: 采用直接偏好优化（DPO）作为微调技术，无需显式奖励模型，直接利用偏好数据优化策略。
Result: 在BLEU、ROUGE和余弦相似度指标上DPO取得有竞争力的性能，且训练效率更高；但观察到训练不稳定现象。
Conclusion: DPO是聊天机器人微调的有前景方案，但需进一步解决训练稳定性问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diffusion-Network Alignment: An Efficient Algorithm and Explicit Probability Bounds
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies a variation of the classic network alignment problem, named diffusion-network alignment. The goal is to align the vertices of a rooted diffusion tree to the vertices of a network, where the diffusion tree could be from a communication trace or contact tracing, and the network could be an online or offline social network. Different from the classic network alignment where both networks are fully observed, this model captures the information asymmetry of two networks. To solve this problem, this paper presents an efficient algorithm based on tree correlation tests to extract alignment information from local neighborhoods. We analyze the performance of the algorithm in the sparse graph regime and show that with high probability, all matched pairs are correct. Furthermore, for each vertex on the diffusion tree, this paper establishes an explicit lower bound on the probability that the vertex is correctly matched. These lower bounds are depth-dependent and increase as vertices get closer to the root.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散网络对齐问题，旨在将扩散树的顶点对齐到网络顶点，提出基于树相关性检验的高效算法，并在稀疏图情形下证明所有匹配对高概率正确，且给出了每个顶点正确匹配的显式概率下界，该下界随顶点靠近根节点而增大。
Motivation: 经典网络对齐假设两个网络完全观测，但实际中如通信追踪或接触追踪场景存在信息不对称，一方为扩散树，另一方为完整网络，现有方法不适用。
Method: 提出基于树相关性检验的算法，利用局部邻域提取对齐信息，并在稀疏图设定下分析性能。
Result: 理论分析表明算法以高概率保证所有匹配对正确，并为扩散树上每个顶点建立正确匹配的显式概率下界，该下界随深度增加而增大。
Conclusion: 本文为信息不对称场景下的网络对齐提供了高效算法与理论保证，下界深度依赖性表明靠近根节点的顶点更容易对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Bitwidth Quantization for LLMs Using Additive Codebooks
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across heterogeneous hardware with varying resource constraints, the ability to adaptively manage the trade-off between performance and efficiency without retraining is critical. We propose Drop-by-Drop, a novel multi-bitwidth post-training quantization framework that enables inference-time precision control over LLM weights from a single trained model. Our method is theoretically grounded in information theory and successive refinement. We establish that LLM weights, which commonly follow a Gaussian distribution, can be optimally reconstructed with increasing fidelity as additional bits are incorporated, under a weighted mean squared error distortion motivated by LLM loss functions. To realize this in practice, Drop-by-Drop incorporates Matryoshka-style supervision into the loss function, exploiting the structure of additive codebooks. Drop-by-Drop produces a single model where ordered subsets of codebooks yield accurate partial reconstructions at each precision level. This approach significantly reduces storage and memory overhead by allowing a single checkpoint to serve multiple bitwidths, while maintaining competitive perplexity and accuracy across major architectures, such as Qwen, LLaMA, Gemma, and Mistral.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Drop-by-Drop，一种多比特宽度的后训练量化框架，允许在推理时从单个训练好的模型中对LLM权重进行精度控制。该方法基于信息论和逐次细化理论，利用加性码本和Matryoshka式监督，在不同精度水平下实现准确的部分重建，显著减少存储和内存开销，并在Qwen、LLaMA、Gemma、Mistral等架构上保持竞争性的困惑度和准确度。
Motivation: LLM部署在异构硬件上需要自适应地管理性能与效率的权衡，而现有方法通常需要重新训练。本文旨在实现无需重训的推理时精度控制。
Method: 提出Drop-by-Drop框架，基于信息论和逐次细化，使用加性码本和Matryoshka式监督损失函数，训练单个模型支持多个比特宽度，通过有序子集码本实现精确部分重建。
Result: 在Qwen、LLaMA、Gemma、Mistral等主流架构上，该方法在保持竞争性困惑度和准确度的同时，显著减少了存储和内存开销，允许单个检查点服务多个比特宽度。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种从单一模型进行多比特宽度推理的有效方案，降低了存储和内存开销，并保持了模型性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DailyReport: An Open-ended Benchmark for Evaluating Search Agents on Daily Search Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Search Agents (SAs) typically leverage large language models (LLMs) to support complex information-seeking tasks by autonomously exploring web sources and synthesizing information into comprehensive responses. For SAs evaluation, prior benchmarks mainly focus on specialized tasks that are unlikely to arise in real-world user scenarios. Moreover, their reliance on coarse task-level rubrics often limits evaluation interpretability. To bridge this gap, we introduce DailyReport, an open-ended benchmark to evaluate SA capabilities on daily search tasks. It contains 150 open-ended tasks with 3,546 associated rubrics, capturing widely discussed and timely information demands of real-world users. Each task is decomposed into subtasks and evaluated with cascade rubrics across disentangled dimensions. Through cascade performance attribution and user-centric aggregation, we derive highly interpretable scores for each dimension, along with a user preference score. Our results on 17 agentic systems show that current systems still fall short of users' expectations. To facilitate future research, our dataset and code are made publicly available at https://github.com/AGI-Eval-Official/DailyReport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出了DailyReport，一个用于评估搜索代理（Search Agents）在日常搜索任务上能力的开放基准。包含150个开放式任务和3546个关联评分标准，通过级联评分和用户中心聚合提供可解释的维度分数和用户偏好分数。实验表明当前代理系统仍未能满足用户期望。
Motivation: 现有基准专注于专业任务且缺乏可解释性，无法反映真实用户搜索场景。
Method: 构建包含开放式日常搜索任务的基准，将任务分解为子任务，使用级联评分标准在解耦维度上评估，并通过级联性能归属和用户中心聚合得到可解释分数。
Result: 在17个代理系统上的评估显示当前系统未达到用户期望。
Conclusion: 该基准为评估搜索代理提供了更贴近真实用户需求的平台，代码和数据集已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Task-Aware Sampling with Shared Saliency through Density-Equalizing Mappings
papers.abstract_en: In image and surface-based learning tasks, convolutional features are typically extracted using receptive fields that are sampled uniformly across the entire domain. However, informative structures are rarely distributed uniformly in practice and are often concentrated in localized regions. Such phenomena are particularly common in medical imaging, where pathological changes are spatially confined. Consequently, uniform convolution allocates equal computational effort to both informative and uninformative regions, resulting in inefficient feature extraction and suboptimal utilization of model capacity. To address this issue, we propose a framework for task-adaptive sampling that dynamically redistributes computational attention according to the spatial importance of the data. Specifically, we introduce the Density-Equalizing Convolutional Neural Network (DECNN), which employs density-equalizing mappings to guide convolution through a learned density function. The density function encodes the relative importance of different regions and induces a transformation that enlarges informative areas while compressing less relevant ones. As a result, convolutional receptive fields are redistributed non-uniformly over the domain, enabling denser sampling in task-relevant regions. By coupling this importance-driven transformation with convolution, DECNN performs adaptive feature extraction that focuses computational resources on informative structures. This leads to more efficient use of model capacity, yielding a lightweight yet expressive architecture while simultaneously producing an interpretable saliency map. Experiments on image classification and craniofacial surface analysis demonstrate that DECNN achieves competitive or superior performance with fewer parameters, accurately identifies task-relevant regions, and remains robust under complex geometric variations.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: SMGFM: Spectral Multimodal Graph Pretraining for Multimodal-Attributed Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal-attributed graphs (MAGs) couple graph topology with node semantics from text, images, and other modalities. Traditional graph learning contextualizes node semantics by coupling topology with node features. However, this coupling design becomes troublesome in MAGs, where structure-induced and modality-intrinsic semantics may contribute differently to downstream tasks. Structure-induced semantics promote relational consistency through smooth topological variation, whereas modality-intrinsic semantics often encode local, fine-grained distinctions that should not be uniformly smoothed or aligned. Therefore, the key challenge is to identify semantic roles before cross-modal fusion. To this end, we leverage graph-frequency variation as a prior, where low-frequency components capture topology-consistent semantics and high-frequency components preserve modality-specific semantics. Based on this intuition, we propose SMGFM, a spectral multimodal graph pretraining framework that decomposes each modality-specific node signal into graph-frequency bands and assigns band-level semantic roles before cross-modal interaction. Concretely, SMGFM constructs frequency-resolved modality tokens with scalable Chebyshev filters, estimates their coupling reliability through topology-conditioned routing, and performs band-modality interaction before fusion. Its frequency-routed objectives align smooth consensus routes while preserving modality-specific routes, mitigating spatial-domain entanglement and uniform cross-modal alignment. Extensive experiments conducted on the MAG datasets demonstrate that SMGFM achieves state-of-the-art performance across graph-level and modality-level tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出SMGFM，一种面向多模态属性图（MAGs）的谱多模态图预训练框架。该方法利用图频率变化先验，将模态节点信号分解为低频（拓扑一致）和高频（模态特定）成分，通过可扩展的Chebyshev滤波器构建频率分解的模态令牌，并采用拓扑条件路由估计耦合可靠性，实现频带-模态交互后融合。在MAG数据集上，SMGFM在图级和模态级任务上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 多模态属性图中，结构诱导语义和模态内在语义对下游任务的贡献不同，现有耦合设计难以区分两者，导致跨模态融合时统一平滑或对齐不合理。
Method: 基于图频率变化先验，利用Chebyshev滤波器分解模态节点信号为低频（平滑、拓扑一致）和高频（局部细节、模态特定）成分；设计频带级语义角色分配、拓扑条件路由以及频带-模态交互机制，并采用频率路由目标分别对齐平滑共识路径和保留模态特定路径。
Result: 在多个MAG数据集上，SMGFM在图级和模态级任务上取得最先进性能，缓解了空间域纠缠和统一跨模态对齐问题。
Conclusion: SMGFM通过谱分解有效区分了结构语义和模态语义，为多模态图表示学习提供了新范式。

papers.title: Beyond Problem Solving: UOJ-Bench for Evaluating Code Generation, Hacking, and Repair in Competitive Programming
papers.abstract_en: Despite strong performance in competitive programming, the role of Large Language Models (LLMs) in supporting human learning in the same setting remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce UOJ-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate not only the problem-solving ability of LLMs, but also their ability to identify errors in human-written code -- a crucial educational activity traditionally supported by running test cases over online judge systems. UOJ-Bench consists of three distinct tasks: code generation, code hacking, and code repair, all constructed from real-world code submissions on the Universal Online Judge (UOJ) and evaluated through UOJ's native judging infrastructure. Our results show that under one-shot evaluation, even the strongest models fail to identify errors in more than 50% of a set of submissions that have been found to be incorrect by UOJ users. While test-time scaling improves success rates to above 90%, the substantial computational costs incurred from model inference limit its practicality for large-scale deployment. Despite these limitations, we find that the best-performing models under test-time scaling can uncover errors in over 5% of full-score submissions across roughly 30 problems, suggesting that frontier LLMs can already provide complementary signals beyond standard judging systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UOJ-Bench 基准，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在竞争性编程中的代码生成、代码攻击和代码修复能力。基于 UOJ 平台真实提交构建任务，发现即使最强模型在一次评估中识别错误的成功率不足50%，通过测试时扩展可提升至90%以上，但计算开销大。最优模型可发现约5%满分提交中的错误，表明 LLM 可补充传统评测系统的信号。
Motivation: 现有基准主要评估 LLM 的编程问题解决能力，忽略了其在识别人类代码错误方面的教育性应用，而后者在在线评测系统中依赖测试用例。
Method: 构建 UOJ-Bench，包含三个任务：代码生成、代码攻击（发现错误）、代码修复，均源于 UOJ 真实提交，并使用原评测基础设施评估。
Result: 一次评估下最强模型识别错误成功率低于50%；测试时扩展可提升至90%以上，但推理成本高。最优模型可发现约5%满分提交中的错误。
Conclusion: LLM 在代码错误识别上表现有限，但测试时扩展可显著提升性能，尽管计算成本限制大规模部署；前沿模型已能提供超越标准评测系统的补充信号。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multimodal Graph Negative Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal attributed graphs (MAGs) integrate graph topology with heterogeneous modality attributes, such as text and images, thereby enabling richer modeling of complex relational systems. However, such expressiveness also makes learning on MAGs depend on multiple semantic sources, including structural topology, textual and visual attributes, each of which can be regarded as a branch for node representation. Node-level branch semantic imbalance arises when these branches differ across nodes in semantic informativeness and reliability: a branch that provides discriminative semantics for one node may mislead another due to bias in modality quality or structural context. Existing methods often mitigate such heterogeneity through cross-branch agreement or alignment, implicitly treating the dominant prediction as reliable supervision. When the dominant branch is biased, forced imitation may propagate its bias to other branches and suppress original semantics that are useful for classification. We propose GraphMNL, a graph-aware multimodal negative learning framework that addresses this issue by using Negative Learning as cross-branch guidance. Instead of forcing inferior branches to imitate a teacher prediction, the model teaches them which classes a node is unlikely to belong to. GraphMNL builds a branch library, identifies dominant and inferior branches via graph-aware reliability arbitration, gates unstable transfer, and applies target-preserving negative learning over non-target classes. This design decouples target supervision from branch guidance so that supervised losses learn the correct class, while Negative Learning suppresses unlikely alternatives when branch agreement is unreliable. Through the comprehensive experimental evaluation, GraphMNL achieves the best performance on Grocery datasets with 72.47% accuracy and 76.60 F1 score on Reddit M datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态属性图（MAG）学习中不同模态分支（结构、文本、图像）存在的语义不平衡问题，提出图感知多模态负学习框架GraphMNL。该方法不强迫劣势分支模仿主导分支的预测，而是通过负学习告诉节点不可能属于哪些类别，从而避免偏差传播。实验在Grocery和Reddit M数据集上达到最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有MAG学习方法通过跨分支对齐或一致性损失来缓解模态异构性，但隐含地依赖主导分支作为可靠监督，当主导分支存在偏差时，强制模仿会传播偏差并抑制其他分支的有用语义。
Method: GraphMNL构建分支库，通过图感知可靠性仲裁识别主导和劣势分支，门控不稳定转移，并对非目标类别应用目标保持负学习，实现监督损失与分支指导的解耦。
Result: 在Grocery数据集上达到72.47%准确率，在Reddit M数据集上达到76.60% F1分数，均为最优性能。
Conclusion: 负学习作为跨分支指导能有效处理MAG中的分支语义不平衡，避免主导分支偏差的传播，提升多模态图学习的鲁棒性。

papers.title: JSCGC: Joint Source-Channel-Generation Coding for Wireless Generative Communications
papers.abstract_en: Conventional communication systems, including both separation-based coding and learning-based joint source-channel coding (JSCC), are typically designed under Shannon's rate-distortion theory. However, relying on generic distortion metrics fails to capture complex human visual perception, often resulting in blurred or unrealistic reconstructions. In this paper, we propose Joint Source-Channel-Generation Coding (JSCGC), a generative communication paradigm that replaces the conventional decoder with a generative model at the receiver. The received signal is treated as a condition that controls the sampling process into the learned conditional distribution, reformulating communication from deterministic reconstruction for distortion minimization to controlled generation for mutual information maximization under perceptual constraints. Based on this formulation, we develop a unified joint training and efficient stochastic sampling framework, and provide theoretical analysis of its effectiveness in both learning and inference stages. Extensive experiments on latent-space image transmission demonstrate that the JSCGC consistently improves feature-based, semantic-level, and distributional quality across diverse channel conditions, while exhibiting a distinct error behavior characterized by semantic inconsistency rather than distortion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出联合源信道生成编码（JSCGC），一种将接收端的生成模型替代传统解码器的无线通信范式。通过将接收信号视为条件，控制采样过程到学习到的条件分布，将通信从确定性重建转向感知约束下的受控生成。实验表明，在潜在空间图像传输中，该方法在不同信道条件下一致提升了特征级、语义级和分布质量，且表现出语义不一致而非失真。
Motivation: 传统通信系统基于通用失真度量，无法捕捉人类视觉感知，导致重建模糊或不真实。
Method: 提出JSCGC，使用联合训练和随机采样框架，将接收信号作为条件控制生成过程，最大化互信息而非最小化失真。
Result: 在潜在空间图像传输实验中，该方法在不同信道条件下一致提升了特征级、语义级和分布质量，误差表现为语义不一致而非失真。
Conclusion: JSCGC将通信重新定义为受控生成，理论分析和实验验证了其在学习和推理阶段的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WISE: A Long-Horizon Agent in Minecraft with Why-Which Reasoning
authors: Changhao Chen (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou))
papers.abstract_en: Rapid advances have been made in developing general-purpose embodied agent in environments like Minecraft through the adoption of LLM-augmented hierarchical approaches. Despite their promise, low-level controllers often become performance bottlenecks due to repeated execution failures. We argue that a key limitation is not only the lack of episodic memory, but also the decoupling of \textit{what-where-when} memory from \textit{which-why} reasoning. To address this, we propose \textbf{WISE} (Which-Why Informed Semantic Explorer), a long-horizon agent framework with an enhanced low-level controller equipped with a Causal Event Graph that augments episodic memory with explicit causal structure linking observations to task relevance. Unlike prior work such as MrSteve, which relies on feature similarity for retrieval, WISE enables robust recall under viewpoint changes and supports opportunistic task reordering through causal reasoning. Building on this memory, we propose an Opportunistic Task Scheduler that dynamically re-prioritizes subtasks when causally relevant opportunities are detected. We further equip WISE with a multi-scale progressive exploration strategy to provide spatially comprehensive observations for downstream reasoning. Experiments show that WISE largely improves task success and efficiency on long-horizon sparse tasks, particularly in settings requiring adaptive decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WISE（Which-Why Informed Semantic Explorer），一个针对Minecraft长程任务的智能体框架，通过因果事件图（Causal Event Graph）增强情景记忆，使低级控制器能更鲁棒地回忆和推理，并设计了机会主义任务调度器（Opportunistic Task Scheduler）和多尺度渐进探索策略。在长程稀疏任务上，WISE显著提升了任务成功率和效率，尤其是在需要适应性决策的场景中。
Motivation: 现有LLM增强分层方法中，低级控制器常因重复执行失败而成为性能瓶颈，原因不仅在于缺乏情景记忆，还在于“什么-哪里-何时”记忆与“哪个-为什么”推理的解耦。
Method: 提出WISE框架，包括：1）因果事件图，将观察与任务相关性显式链接；2）机会主义任务调度器，动态重新排序子任务；3）多尺度渐进探索策略，为下游推理提供空间全面的观察。
Result: 在长程稀疏任务上，WISE大幅提升了任务成功率和效率，特别是在需要适应性决策的环境中。
Conclusion: 摘要强调因果结构和机会主义调度对于提升长程代理任务性能的有效性。

papers.title: SemanticXR: Low Power and Real-time Queryable Semantic Mapping with an Object-Level Device-Cloud Architecture
papers.abstract_en: Semantic mapping is a core service that enables grounded interactions in emerging Extended Reality (XR) applications such as AI assistants and spatial object search. Deploying this capability on mobile XR devices requires a system that is open-vocabulary, real-time, and low-power. Existing approaches are compute-intensive and assume server-class resources. Cloud offloading offers a practical path, but no existing system splits semantic mapping across the device-cloud boundary or manages its communication, execution, and memory footprint. We present SemanticXR, the first device-cloud system for real-time, open-vocabulary semantic mapping and querying under XR power, bandwidth, and memory constraints. Our key insight is to elevate semantically identifiable objects to first-class units of communication, execution, and memory across the device and server. On the server, object-level parallelism and geometry downsampling improve mapping latency, while object-level depth-mapping co-design reduces upstream bandwidth. On the device, an object-level sparse local map with incremental updates and update prioritization enables network-robust querying with bounded memory and downstream bandwidth. Object-level configurable resource usage vs. quality trade-offs let applications and the system adapt mapping to application requirements and operating conditions, respectively. Against a device-cloud baseline with the same perception models, object-level organization improves server-side mapping latency by 2.2X at equal semantic quality. Depth-mapping co-design maintains upstream bandwidth under 2.5 Mbps. On the device, SemanticXR sustains sub-100 ms query latency for up to 10,000 objects even under network drops, supports tens of thousands of objects within 500 MB, and scales downstream bandwidth with map changes, not total scene size. The system adds only 2% device power during normal operation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SemanticXR，首个在XR设备上实现实时、开放词汇语义映射的device-cloud系统。通过将对象作为通信、计算和存储的一等单元，在服务器端利用对象级并行和几何下采样提升映射延迟，深度-映射协同设计降低上行带宽；在设备端利用对象级稀疏局部地图和增量更新实现网络鲁棒查询。系统在保持语义质量的同时，服务器映射延迟提升2.2倍，上行带宽低于2.5 Mbps，设备查询延迟低于100毫秒（最多10000物体），总体功耗仅增加2%。
Motivation: 现有语义映射方法计算密集，依赖服务器资源，无法在移动XR设备上实时低功耗运行，且无现有系统在设备-云边界拆分语义映射并管理通信、执行和内存。
Method: 提出SemanticXR，核心思想是将语义可识别对象作为设备与服务器之间的通信、执行和内存的一等单元。服务器端采用对象级并行和几何下采样改善映射延迟，对象级深度-映射协同设计降低上行带宽。设备端维护对象级稀疏局部地图，支持增量更新和更新优先级，实现网络鲁棒查询，并允许应用和系统根据需求调整资源使用与质量的权衡。
Result: 与使用相同感知模型的device-cloud基线相比，对象级组织使服务器映射延迟提升2.2倍且语义质量相同；深度-映射协同设计将上行带宽维持在2.5 Mbps以下；设备端支持最多10000物体时查询延迟低于100毫秒，在500 MB内存内支持数万物体，下游带宽与地图变更规模成比例而非整个场景大小；正常运行时设备功耗仅增加2%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SemanticXR是首个在XR功耗、带宽和内存约束下实现实时开放词汇语义映射和查询的设备-云系统，通过对象级架构有效平衡资源使用与质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: (Human) Attention Is (Still) All You Need: Human oversight makes AI-assisted social science reliable
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for tasks once reserved for trained researchers, including hypothesis generation, specification choice, and drafting conclusions. We argue that the reliability of AI-assisted research depends not only on model capability, but also on how cognitive labour is structured between humans and machines. We study this problem through Human-in-the-Loop Economic Research (HLER), a decision architecture based on pre-commitment, decision sequencing, accountability, and attention allocation. In a pre-specified 2*4 factorial experiment with 280 complete research runs across four datasets, an unconstrained multi-agent baseline produced critical failures in 72% of runs. Using the same underlying model, the same agent decomposition, and identical prompts for the shared reasoning agents, HLER reduced the failure rate to 16% by imposing three architectural commitments: LLMs reason but do not execute data work, data and estimation are handled deterministically, and three human decision gates bind the workflow. Fisher's exact test rejects equality of failure rates at p<0.001. Reliability gains were largest on the least publicly represented dataset, a Qing-dynasty population register, consistent with a task-based production model with Frechet-distributed output quality. An 80-run ablation suggests that deterministic computation and human gates contribute independently, with exploratory evidence of complementarity. We interpret HLER as a research harness rather than an autonomous AI scientist: it sharply reduces failures, makes residual weaknesses more visible, and prevents unreliable claims from being advanced as publication-ready outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI辅助社会科学研究的可靠性问题，提出人机协同决策架构HLER（Human-in-the-Loop Economic Research）。通过预注册的2×4因子实验，在280个完整研究流程中，无约束的多智能体基线有72%的失败率，而HLER将失败率降至16%（Fisher精确检验p<0.001）。HLER通过三项架构承诺实现：LLM仅推理不执行数据工作、数据与估计确定性处理、三个人工决策门约束工作流。
Motivation: LLM越来越多地用于假设生成、规范选择和结论起草等原本由训练有素的研究人员完成的任务，但AI辅助研究的可靠性不仅取决于模型能力，还取决于人机认知劳动的结构安排。现有方法缺乏对认知劳动分配的明确设计，导致高失败率。
Method: 提出HLER决策架构，基于预先承诺、决策排序、问责制和注意力分配。在实验中，对比无约束多智能体基线，HLER通过三个架构约束（LLM不执行数据工作、确定性计算、人工决策门）与相同底层模型、相同智能体分解和相同提示词，大幅降低研究失败率。
Result: 在四个数据集上的280个研究流程中，HLER将关键失败率从72%降至16%（Fisher精确检验p<0.001）。80次消融实验表明，确定性计算和人工门独立贡献效果，并存在互补性证据。
Conclusion: HLER被解释为研究工具而非自主AI科学家：它能大幅减少失败，使残余弱点更明显，并防止不可靠的声明被作为可发表的输出推进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Language-Guided Abstraction for Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) is viewed as a critical avenue to Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), as it enables models to learn abstract transformation rules from few-shot examples and then generalize to new tasks. However, prevalent ARC methodology is either pure language or vision-only (i.e., VARC). The former depends heavily on LLMs, consuming billions of parameters. The latter often struggles to capture high-level semantics, leading to overfitting on pixel-level patterns. To bridge this gap, we propose L-VARC, a novel framework that enhances visual reasoning via a language-guided Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI) branch. Specifically, we design a Semantic Compression Module by feeding a unified, task-agnostic prompt into DeepSeek-V3. In this way, the raw LARC (a crowd-sourced language description dataset) can be substantially refined and structured, fitting with the context length constraint of standard text encoders (e.g., CLIP). Moreover, we design a Cross-Attention Projector to align visual features with semantic embeddings, aiming to guide the training of the ARC model. Notably, the LUPI branch is taken in the training process and will be discarded during inference, thereby yielding a lightweight model with a mere 18 million parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our L-VARC effectively leverages linguistic priors to boost visual reasoning and outperforms state-of-the-art. Ablation studies further confirm the contribution of the two new designs towards the L-VARC framework. The code is available at https://github.com/GZHU-DVL/L-VARC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 L-VARC 框架，通过语言引导的 LUPI（Learning Using Privileged Information）分支增强视觉推理。该框架使用 DeepSeek-V3 对 LARC 语言描述进行语义压缩，并通过交叉注意力投影器对齐视觉与语义特征，在推理阶段丢弃语言分支以保持轻量（18M 参数）。在 ARC 任务上达到最新最优性能。
Motivation: 现有 ARC 方法要么依赖大规模语言模型（参数多），要么纯视觉方法难以捕获高层语义、易过拟合像素级模式，两者存在差距。
Method: 设计语义压缩模块（DeepSeek-V3 处理统一提示）精炼 LARC 语言描述；设计交叉注意力投影器对齐视觉与语义特征，将语言作为特权信息仅在训练阶段使用。
Result: L-VARC 在 ARC 任务上超越现有方法，消融实验验证了各模块贡献，模型仅 18M 参数。
Conclusion: 语言引导的特权信息能有效提升视觉推理能力，且不影响推理效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Privacy-Preserving Framework Using Remote Data Science for Inter-Institutional Student Retention Prediction
papers.abstract_en: This study explores privacy-preserving machine learning (PPML) techniques using the PySyft platform to enable collaborative prediction of student retention between institutions. We developed a remote data science (RDS) framework with a semi-air-gapped architecture consisting of high-side and low-side servers, allowing researchers from three universities to build predictive models on sensitive student data without direct data access. Using historical data from a small private university (N=720), we evaluated three synthetic data generation approaches and validated the framework through inter-institutional collaboration. The results demonstrate consistent classification performance across institutions (Macro F1: 0.690--0.695) while maintaining strict Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) compliance. We also propose Data-Type-Aware Templates, a novel synthetic data method that prioritizes privacy over distributional fidelity. Our findings confirm that RDS-based PPML is technically feasible for educational settings and offers a practical alternative to federated learning for small-scale inter-institutional collaborations. The code is available at https://github.com/jtfields/NAIRR240195-Privacy-Preserving-Machine-Learning.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Information Reuse and Integration (IEEE IRI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于PySyft的远程数据科学框架，采用半气隙架构（高低侧服务器），使三所大学的研究人员能在不直接访问敏感数据的情况下协作构建学生保留预测模型。使用一所小型私立大学的历史数据（N=720），评估了三种合成数据生成方法，并验证了跨机构协作的可行性。结果显示宏F1分数在0.690-0.695之间，同时符合FERPA合规要求。还提出了数据感知模板（Data-Type-Aware Templates），一种优先保护隐私而非分布保真度的合成数据方法。
Motivation: 教育机构间协作预测学生保留率需要保护学生隐私，但现有方法（如联邦学习）在小规模机构间协作中存在技术或成本障碍。
Method: 采用远程数据科学框架，结合PySyft实现隐私保护，使用半气隙架构隔离数据访问；评估了三种合成数据方法，包括提出的数据感知模板。
Result: 跨机构预测一致性宏F1为0.690-0.695，证明方法在保持分类性能的同时满足FERPA隐私要求。
Conclusion: 远程数据科学框架在小型教育机构间实现隐私保护机器学习是可行的，可作为联邦学习的实用替代方案；但隐私优先的合成数据方法可能牺牲分布保真度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interpretable Factor Decomposition for Decision Intelligence in Large-Scale Financial Markets: Evidence from China's A-Share Market
papers.abstract_en: We present an interpretable machine learning pipeline to decompose Cross-Sectional Equity Return Predictability into auditable factor contribution. We apply an XGBoost model with TreeSHAP attribution and conduct stress testing on 3632 Chinese A-share stocks from 2009 until 2019. Using 60-month, rolling windows over 55 months of out-of-sample data, XGBoost obtains a mean AUC of 0.547 and +2.38%/month (Newey-West t = 5.94; Annualized Sharpe 2.23) long-short spread for the top vs bottom quintiles. This alpha is persistent after adjusting for the Carhart four-factor model (+2.31%/month; t = 7.48). SHAP Decomposition indicates that behavioral signals (turnover and momentum) account for 58.2% of predictive attribution compared to 10.7% for valuation ratios, on average, across 55 industry groups. Ablation analysis serves to cross-validate this ranking and provides evidence that SHAP and ablation diverge in a manner that highlights feature substitutability structure that is largely invisible to either method used in isolation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个可解释的机器学习流水线，将横截面股票收益可预测性分解为可审计的因子贡献。使用XGBoost模型结合TreeSHAP归因，对2009年至2019年间3632只中国A股进行压力测试。在55个月滚动窗口的样本外数据上，XGBoost获得0.547的平均AUC和2.38%/月的多空价差（Newey-West t=5.94；年化夏普率2.23）。该alpha在调整Carhart四因子模型后仍然持续（2.31%/月；t=7.48）。SHAP分解显示，行为信号（换手率和动量）平均占预测归因的58.2%，而估值比率仅占10.7%。消融分析用于交叉验证排名，并揭示SHAP与消融在突出特征可替代性结构上存在分歧。
Motivation: 金融市场中，机器学习模型虽预测能力强但缺乏可解释性，难以满足监管和投资决策需求。现有因子模型往往黑箱化，需要将预测分解为可审计的因子贡献。
Method: 使用XGBoost模型结合TreeSHAP归因方法，对3632只中国A股2009-2019年数据，采用60个月滚动窗口进行55个月样本外测试。通过SHAP分解和消融分析交叉验证因子重要性，并分析特征可替代性结构。
Result: XGBoost获得0.547平均AUC和2.38%/月的多空价差（年化夏普率2.23），alpha在Carhart四因子调整后仍显著（2.31%/月；t=7.48）。SHAP分解显示行为信号贡献58.2%，估值比率贡献10.7%。
Conclusion: 提出的可解释因子分解方法能够有效识别因子贡献，并揭示SHAP与消融在特征可替代性上的差异，为金融决策提供透明度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TimeROME-DLM: Temporal Causal Tracing and Low-Rank Inference-Time Knowledge Editing for Masked Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) such as LLaDA now rival autoregressive (AR) LLMs, but every existing knowledge-editing and unlearning method (ROME, MEMIT, etc.) targets AR transformers and either makes assumptions that fail under iterative denoising, or requires gradient updates whose backward-pass activations cost tens of GB of extra VRAM and which collapse MDLMs at standard learning rates. We introduce TimeROME-DLM, the first training-free, gradient-free, inference-time knowledge-editing framework for MDLMs. It couples two components: a Temporal Indirect Effect (TIE) causal-tracing protocol that identifies, for each fact, the coordinate whose intervention most strongly drives the object prediction at later denoising steps; and a closed-form, low-rank residual edit memory that aggregates subject keys and target deltas across all forget facts and applies a single ridge-regularised update at that coordinate at every diffusion forward, with sparsification to limit utility spillover. Backbone weights stay frozen; only three hyperparameters (alpha, lambda, q) are tuned on a small validation split. On TOFU forget01 with TOFU-finetuned LLaDA-8B-Base, TimeROME-DLM cuts forget-set log-probability by roughly 83 nats. The same configuration transfers to LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-7B, MMaDA-8B, DiffuLLaMA-7B, and LLaDA-MoE-1.4B. It keeps retain-set log-probability nearly flat (within ~1 nat at the utility-safe operating point) across 50 sequentially inserted facts, delivers a four- to fourteen-fold wall-clock speedup with zero additional VRAM over the strongest converged training-time baseline, and scales sub-linearly to 400 facts. TimeROME-DLM closes the locate-then-edit gap between AR LLMs and MDLMs at a fraction of the computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TimeROME-DLM，首个无需训练、无需梯度的推理时知识编辑框架，适用于掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）。它结合了时间因果追踪（Temporal Indirect Effect）和低秩残差编辑记忆，在不修改模型权重的前提下实现事实编辑。在TOFU forget01任务上，该框架将遗忘集对数概率降低约83 nats，保持保留集几乎不变，且速度提升4-14倍，零额外VRAM开销，可扩展至400个事实。
Motivation: 现有知识编辑方法（如ROME、MEMIT）仅针对自回归Transformer设计，无法直接用于MDLM的迭代去噪过程，且需要梯度更新，消耗大量额外显存并导致MDLM在标准学习率下崩溃。因此需要一种针对MDLM的、高效且无需训练的知识编辑方法。
Method: TimeROME-DLM包含两个组件：1）时间间接效应（TIE）因果追踪协议，识别每一步去噪中对目标预测影响最大的坐标；2）闭式低秩残差编辑记忆，聚合所有遗忘事实的主体键和目标差值，在扩散前向过程的该坐标处应用一次岭正则化更新，并通过稀疏化限制效用溢出。骨干权重保持冻结，仅需调节三个超参数。
Result: 在TOFU forget01任务上，使用TOFU微调的LLaDA-8B-Base，TimeROME-DLM将遗忘集对数概率降低约83 nats。相同配置可迁移至LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Dream-7B、MMaDA-8B、DiffuLLaMA-7B、LLaDA-MoE-1.4B。保留集对数概率基本不变（约1 nat内），顺序插入50个事实后仍稳定。相比最强收敛训练基线，速度提升4-14倍，零额外VRAM，可扩展至400个事实。
Conclusion: TimeROME-DLM以极低的计算代价填补了自回归LLM与MDLM之间定位-编辑的差距，证明了无需训练、无需梯度的推理时知识编辑在MDLM上的可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CLARITree: Cholesky and Lookahead Accelerations for Regression with Interpretable Piecewise Linear Trees
papers.abstract_en: Regression trees are among the most interpretable yet expressive model classes in machine learning. Historically, greedy induction has been the dominant approach for constructing well-performing regression trees. While optimal methods based on dynamic programming and branch-and-bound exist, they are computationally prohibitive for general linear regression trees, despite often achieving substantially better performance than greedy approaches. Recent work has shown that specialized lookahead strategies can dramatically improve runtime while maintaining near-optimal performance, primarily in classification settings. In this work, we develop a novel algorithm for near-optimal, sparse, piecewise linear regression trees that combines a lookahead-style search strategy with efficient rank-one Cholesky updates of the Gram matrix. We demonstrate, both theoretically and empirically, that our method achieves a favorable trade-off between computational efficiency, predictive accuracy, and sparsity, and scales significantly better than the current state of the art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLARITree 算法，用于构建近最优、稀疏、分段线性回归树。该方法结合 lookahead 搜索策略和 Gram 矩阵的秩一 Cholesky 更新，在计算效率、预测准确性和稀疏性之间取得良好权衡，并显著优于当前最优方法的扩展性。
Motivation: 现有最优回归树方法（基于动态规划和分支定界）计算成本过高，而贪婪方法性能较差，需要一种在效率和性能之间取得更好平衡的算法。
Method: 提出 CLARITree 算法，融合 lookahead 搜索策略和 Gram 矩阵的秩一 Cholesky 更新，实现高效且近最优的分段线性回归树构建。
Result: 理论和实验表明，该方法在计算效率、预测准确性和稀疏性方面取得良好权衡，扩展性明显优于当前最优方法。
Conclusion: 该方法为可解释的分段线性回归树提供了一种高效且性能接近最优的解决方案。
Relevance: 5
