papers.title: CRAG: Can 3D Generative Models Help 3D Assembly?
papers.abstract_en: Most existing 3D assembly methods treat the problem as pure pose estimation, rearranging observed parts via rigid transformations. In contrast, human assembly naturally couples structural reasoning with holistic shape inference. Inspired by this intuition, we reformulate 3D assembly as a joint problem of assembly and generation. We show that these two processes are mutually reinforcing: assembly provides part-level structural priors for generation, while generation injects holistic shape context that resolves ambiguities in assembly. Unlike prior methods that cannot synthesize missing geometry, we propose CRAG, which simultaneously generates plausible complete shapes and predicts poses for input parts. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across in-the-wild objects with diverse geometries, varying part counts, and missing pieces. Project Page: https://ai4ce.github.io/CRAG/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 大多数现有3D组装方法将问题视为纯姿态估计，通过刚性变换重排观察到的部件。本文受人类组装过程的启发，将3D组装重新定义为组装与生成的联合问题，提出CRAG方法，同时生成完整的合理形状并预测输入部件的姿态。实验证明，该方法在真实世界中具有多样几何、不同部件数量和缺失部件的物体上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有3D组装方法仅依靠姿态估计，缺乏整体形状推理能力，不能合成缺失几何，与人类组装中的结构推理和形状推断相去甚远。
Method: 提出CRAG，将3D组装与生成联合建模：组装提供部件级结构先验，生成注入整体形状上下文以解决组装中的歧义，两者相互强化。
Result: 在包含多样几何、不同部件数量和缺失部件的真实物体上，CRAG取得最先进性能。
Conclusion: 组装与生成是相互增强的过程，CRAG能够同时生成完整形状和预测姿态，克服了现有方法无法处理缺失几何的局限。

papers.title: FENCE: A Financial and Multimodal Jailbreak Detection Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Jailbreaking poses a significant risk to the deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Language Models (VLMs). VLMs are particularly vulnerable because they process both text and images, creating broader attack surfaces. However, available resources for jailbreak detection are scarce, particularly in finance. To address this gap, we present FENCE, a bilingual (Korean-English) multimodal dataset for training and evaluating jailbreak detectors in financial applications. FENCE emphasizes domain realism through finance-relevant queries paired with image-grounded threats. Experiments with commercial and open-source VLMs reveal consistent vulnerabilities, with GPT-4o showing measurable attack success rates and open-source models displaying greater exposure. A baseline detector trained on FENCE achieves 99 percent in-distribution accuracy and maintains strong performance on external benchmarks, underscoring the dataset's robustness for training reliable detection models. FENCE provides a focused resource for advancing multimodal jailbreak detection in finance and for supporting safer, more reliable AI systems in sensitive domains. Warning: This paper includes example data that may be offensive.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FENCE，一个双语（韩-英）多模态数据集，专门用于金融领域的越狱检测。数据集包含金融相关的查询和图像威胁，实验显示商用和开源VLM（如GPT-4o）存在可测量的攻击成功率，而开源模型暴露更严重。基于FENCE训练的基线检测器在领域内达到99%准确率，并在外部基准上保持强性能。
Motivation: 现有越狱检测资源在金融领域稀缺，尤其是多模态场景下，VLM因处理文本和图像而面临更广的攻击面。
Method: 构建FENCE数据集，包含金融相关查询和图像威胁，用于训练和评估越狱检测器。使用商业和开源VLM进行实验，并训练基线检测器。
Result: 基线检测器在领域内准确率达99%，在外部基准上表现强劲；商用模型GPT-4o显示可测量攻击成功率，开源模型更易受攻击。
Conclusion: FENCE为金融领域的多模态越狱检测提供专注资源，有助于开发更安全可靠的AI系统。

papers.title: InnoEval: On Research Idea Evaluation as a Knowledge-Grounded, Multi-Perspective Reasoning Problem
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of Large Language Models has catalyzed a surge in scientific idea production, yet this leap has not been accompanied by a matching advance in idea evaluation. The fundamental nature of scientific evaluation needs knowledgeable grounding, collective deliberation, and multi-criteria decision-making. However, existing idea evaluation methods often suffer from narrow knowledge horizons, flattened evaluation dimensions, and the inherent bias in LLM-as-a-Judge. To address these, we regard idea evaluation as a knowledge-grounded, multi-perspective reasoning problem and introduce InnoEval, a deep innovation evaluation framework designed to emulate human-level idea assessment. We apply a heterogeneous deep knowledge search engine that retrieves and grounds dynamic evidence from diverse online sources. We further achieve review consensus with an innovation review board containing reviewers with distinct academic backgrounds, enabling a multi-dimensional decoupled evaluation across multiple metrics. We construct comprehensive datasets derived from authoritative peer-reviewed submissions to benchmark InnoEval. Experiments demonstrate that InnoEval can consistently outperform baselines in point-wise, pair-wise, and group-wise evaluation tasks, exhibiting judgment patterns and consensus highly aligned with human experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型时代科学想法激增但评估方法滞后的问题，将研究想法评估建模为知识基础的多视角推理任务，提出InnoEval框架。该框架利用异构深度知识搜索引擎从多源动态证据中获取信息，并组建由不同学术背景审稿人构成的评审委员会，实现多维度解耦评估。实验表明，InnoEval在点态、成对和分组评估任务上一致超越基线，其判断模式与人类专家高度一致。
Motivation: 现有科学想法评估方法存在知识视野狭窄、评估维度扁平化、以及LLM作为评判者固有的偏见等问题，难以处理需要专业知识基础和集体审议的复杂评估。
Method: 提出InnoEval框架，包含两个核心组件：一是异构深度知识搜索引擎，用于从多种在线来源检索并锚定动态证据；二是创新评审委员会，由具有不同学术背景的审稿人组成，实现多维度解耦评估，并达成共识。
Result: 在基于权威同行评审论文构建的数据集上，InnoEval在点态、成对和分组评估任务中均一致优于基线方法，其判断模式和共识与人类专家高度对齐。
Conclusion: InnoEval通过知识锚定和多视角推理，实现了接近人类水平的研究想法评估，为科学创新评估提供了新的范式。

papers.title: Structured vs. Unstructured Pruning: An Exponential Gap
papers.abstract_en: The Strong Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (SLTH) states that large, randomly initialized neural networks contain sparse subnetworks capable of approximating a target function at initialization without training, suggesting that pruning alone is sufficient. Pruning methods are typically classified as unstructured, where individual weights can be removed from the network, and structured, where parameters are removed according to specific patterns, as in neuron pruning. Existing theoretical results supporting the SLTH rely almost exclusively on unstructured pruning, showing that logarithmic overparameterization suffices to approximate simple target networks. In contrast, neuron pruning has received limited theoretical attention, despite its practical appeal for direct hardware speedups. In this work, we consider the problem of approximating a single bias-free ReLU neuron by pruning hidden units of a randomly initialized two-layer ReLU network, effectively isolating the intrinsic limitations of neuron pruning. We show that achieving an $\varepsilon$-approximation requires a starting network size of $Ω(1/\varepsilon)$ for neuron pruning, whereas weight pruning succeeds with only $O(\log(1/\varepsilon))$ hidden units, revealing an exponential separation between the two approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究强彩票假说（SLTH）下结构化剪枝（神经元剪枝）与非结构化剪枝（权重剪枝）的理论差距。针对逼近单个无偏置ReLU神经元的问题，证明神经元剪枝需要初始网络大小为Ω(1/ε)才能达到ε-近似，而权重剪枝仅需O(log(1/ε))，两者呈指数级分离。
Motivation: 现有SLTH理论主要支持非结构化剪枝，但结构化剪枝（如神经元剪枝）在硬件加速上更具实用性，其理论能力尚不明确。本文旨在揭示两种剪枝方法的本质差异。
Method: 通过分析随机初始化的两层ReLU网络中隐藏单元的剪枝问题，推导出神经元剪枝和权重剪枝逼近单个目标神经元所需的下界和上界。
Result: 神经元剪枝需要Ω(1/ε)个隐藏单元，而权重剪枝仅需O(log(1/ε))个隐藏单元，表明两者在样本复杂度上存在指数级差距。
Conclusion: 该结果从理论上证明了结构化剪枝（神经元剪枝）相较于非结构化剪枝（权重剪枝）存在显著局限性，为后续剪枝方法的选择提供了理论依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Successor Representation for Robust Transfer
papers.abstract_en: The successor representation (SR) provides a powerful framework for decoupling predictive dynamics from rewards, enabling rapid generalisation across reward configurations. However, the classical SR is limited by its inherent policy dependence: policies change due to ongoing learning, environmental non-stationarities, and changes in task demands, making established predictive representations obsolete. Furthermore, in topologically complex environments, SRs suffer from spectral diffusion, leading to dense and overlapping features that scale poorly. Here we propose the Hierarchical Successor Representation (HSR) for overcoming these limitations. By incorporating temporal abstractions into the construction of predictive representations, HSR learns stable state features which are robust to task-induced policy changes. Applying non-negative matrix factorisation (NMF) to the HSR yields a sparse, low-rank state representation that facilitates highly sample-efficient transfer to novel tasks in multi-compartmental environments. Further analysis reveals that HSR-NMF discovers interpretable topological structures, providing a policy-agnostic hierarchical map that effectively bridges model-free optimality and model-based flexibility. Beyond providing a useful basis for task-transfer, we show that HSR's temporally extended predictive structure can also be leveraged to drive efficient exploration, effectively scaling to large, procedurally generated environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出层次化后继表示（HSR），通过引入时间抽象构建对策略变化鲁棒的状态特征，并利用非负矩阵分解得到稀疏低秩表示，实现高效的跨任务迁移和探索。
Motivation: 经典后继表示（SR）依赖策略，当策略因学习、环境非平稳性或任务需求变化而改变时，预测表示会过时；且在复杂拓扑环境中，SR的谱扩散导致特征稠密重叠，难以扩展。
Method: 通过时间抽象构建层次化后继表示（HSR），学习策略无关的稳定状态特征；对HSR应用非负矩阵分解（NMF）获得稀疏低秩表示，用于高效迁移和探索。
Result: HSR-NMF在多隔间环境中实现样本高效的迁移，并发现可解释的拓扑结构；生成层次化策略无关地图，兼具模型自由的最优性和模型驱动的灵活性；HSR的时序扩展预测结构还可用于高效探索，扩展到大型程序生成环境。
Conclusion: HSR克服了经典SR的策略依赖和谱扩散问题，为任务迁移和探索提供了鲁棒且可扩展的层次化表示基础。

papers.title: Ex-Omni: Enabling 3D Facial Animation Generation for Omni-modal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal large language models (OLLMs) aim to unify multimodal understanding and generation, yet extending them to jointly produce speech and 3D facial animation remains largely unexplored despite its importance for natural human-computer interaction. A key challenge is the mismatch between the discrete semantic reasoning of LLMs and the dense temporal dynamics required for 3D facial motion. We propose Expressive Omni (Ex-Omni), an open-source model that augments OLLMs with native speech-accompanied 3D facial animation. Ex-Omni decouples semantic reasoning from temporal generation through a blendshape-aware speech unit generator and a blendshape decoder, where speech units provide temporal scaffolding and hidden speech representations carry facially relevant cues. We further introduce a unified token-as-query gated fusion (TQGF) mechanism for controlled semantic injection, as well as InstructS2SF-1200K, a dataset consisting of 1200K samples for pre-training. Extensive experiments show that Ex-Omni maintains competitive speech understanding and generation ability while achieving better audio-visual synchronization and lower face-generation latency than cascaded pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Ex-Omni，一个开源的全模态大语言模型扩展，使其能够联合生成语音和3D面部动画。通过blendshape-aware语音单元生成器和解码器，以及统一token-as-query门控融合机制，解决了离散语义推理与密集时间动态的错配问题。实验表明该方法在保持语音理解和生成能力的同时，实现了更好的音视频同步和更低的面部生成延迟。
Motivation: 全模态大语言模型在统一多模态理解和生成方面取得进展，但扩展至联合生成语音和3D面部动画尚未充分探索，关键挑战是离散语义推理与密集时间动态的错配。
Method: 提出Ex-Omni模型，包含blendshape-aware语音单元生成器、blendshape解码器和统一token-as-query门控融合机制，并构建了包含120万样本的InstructS2SF-1200K数据集用于预训练。
Result: 实验表明Ex-Omni在保持竞争性语音理解和生成能力的同时，比级联方案实现了更好的音视频同步和更低的面部生成延迟。
Conclusion: Ex-Omni成功扩展全模态大语言模型以原生支持3D面部动画生成，为自然的人机交互提供了基础。

papers.title: TokaMark: A Comprehensive Benchmark for MAST Tokamak Plasma Models
papers.abstract_en: Development and operation of commercially viable fusion energy reactors such as tokamaks require accurate predictions of plasma dynamics from sparse, noisy, and incomplete sensors readings. The complexity of the underlying physics and the heterogeneity of experimental data pose formidable challenges for conventional numerical methods, and highlight the promise of modern data-native approaches. A major obstacle in realizing this potential is, however, the lack of curated, openly available datasets and standardized benchmarks. Existing fusion datasets are scarce, fragmented across institutions, facility-specific, and inconsistently annotated, which limits reproducibility and prevents a fair and scalable comparison of AI approaches. In this paper, we introduce TokaMark, a structured benchmark to evaluate AI models on real experimental data collected from the Mega Ampere Spherical Tokamak (MAST). TokaMark provides a comprehensive suite of tools designed to unify access to multi-modal fusion data and standardize evaluation protocols. The benchmark includes a curated list of 14 tasks spanning a range of physical mechanisms, exploiting a variety of diagnostics and covering multiple operational use cases. A baseline model is provided to facilitate transparent comparison and validation within a unified framework. By establishing a unified benchmark, TokaMark aims to accelerate progress in data-driven AI-based plasma modeling, contributing to the broader goal of achieving sustainable and stable fusion energy. The dataset, benchmark, documentation, and tooling are open-sourced under https://github.com/UKAEA-IBM-STFC-Fusion-FMs/tokamark_baseline.

papers.title: SCALE: Self-uncertainty Conditioned Adaptive Looking and Execution for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic control, with test-time scaling (TTS) gaining attention to enhance robustness beyond training. However, existing TTS methods for VLAs require additional training, verifiers, and multiple forward passes, making them impractical for deployment. Moreover, they intervene only at action decoding while keeping visual representations fixed-insufficient under perceptual ambiguity, where reconsidering how to perceive is as important as deciding what to do. To address these limitations, we propose SCALE, a simple inference strategy that jointly modulates visual perception and action based on 'self-uncertainty', inspired by uncertainty-driven exploration in Active Inference theory-requiring no additional training, no verifier, and only a single forward pass. SCALE broadens exploration in both perception and action under high uncertainty, while focusing on exploitation when confident-enabling adaptive execution across varying conditions. Experiments on simulated and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that SCALE improves state-of-the-art VLAs and outperforms existing TTS methods while maintaining single-pass efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCALE，一种无需额外训练、验证器和多次前向传播的推理策略，基于自不确定性同时调节视觉感知和动作生成，灵感来自主动推理理论。实验表明，SCALE在模拟和真实机器人任务上提升了现有视觉-语言-动作模型的性能，并优于其他测试时缩放方法。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型的测试时缩放方法需要额外的训练、验证器或多次前向传播，且仅干预动作解码而忽略视觉感知，导致在感知模糊时性能受限。
Method: SCALE利用模型自身的预测不确定性（自不确定性）动态调整视觉感知的探索范围（如视觉编码器的注意力宽度）和动作生成的随机性，在不确定性高时鼓励探索，低时利用确定性输出。
Result: 在多个模拟和真实机器人基准上，SCALE显著提升了多种VLA模型的成功率，并优于现有的TTS方法，同时保持了单次前向推理的效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过不确定性驱动的自适应感知与动作模块，SCALE为VLA模型提供了一种简单、高效且无需额外训练的可扩展推理方案。

papers.title: Thermodynamic assessment of machine learning models for solid-state synthesis prediction
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models have recently emerged to predict whether hypothetical solid-state materials can be synthesized. These models aim to circumvent direct first-principles modeling of solid-state phase transformations, instead learning from large databases of successfully synthesized materials. Here, we assess the alignment of several recently introduced synthesis prediction models with material and reaction thermodynamics, quantified by the energy with respect to the convex hull and a metric accounting for thermodynamic selectivity of enumerated synthesis reactions. A dataset of successful synthesis recipes was used to determine the likely bounds on both quantities beyond which materials can be deemed unlikely to be synthesized. With these bounds as context, thermodynamic quantities were computed using the CHGNet foundation potential for thousands of new hypothetical materials generated using the Chemeleon generative model. Four recently published machine learning models for synthesizability prediction were applied to this same dataset, and the resultant predictions were considered against computed thermodynamics. We find these models generally overpredict the likelihood of synthesis, but some model scores do trend with thermodynamic heuristics, assigning lower scores to materials that are less stable or do not have an available synthesis recipe that is calculated to be thermodynamically selective. In total, this work identifies existing gaps in machine learning models for materials synthesis and introduces a new approach to assess their quality in the absence of extensive negative examples (failed syntheses).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了四种机器学习模型预测固态材料合成可能性的性能，通过凸包能量和反应热力学选择性指标与热力学进行对比。使用CHGNet势能计算了Chemeleon生成的新材料的热力学量，发现模型普遍高估合成可能性，但部分模型分数与热力学趋势一致。工作指出了现有模型的不足，并提出了在无负例时评估模型质量的方法。
Motivation: 机器学习模型被用于预测固态材料合成可能性，但缺乏与热力学一致性的系统评估，本文旨在量化模型与热力学的对齐程度。
Method: 计算凸包能量和合成反应热力学选择性，使用CHGNet势能对Chemeleon生成的新材料进行计算；将四种合成预测模型应用于同一数据集，比较预测与热力学量。
Result: 模型普遍高估合成可能性，但部分模型分数与热力学启发式趋势一致，对稳定性差或缺乏热力学选择性合成路径的材料给出较低分数。
Conclusion: 揭示了现有机器学习合成预测模型的缺陷，并引入了在缺乏负例时评估模型质量的新框架。

papers.title: Entropic Mirror Monte Carlo
papers.abstract_en: Importance sampling is a Monte Carlo method which designs estimators of expectations under a target distribution using weighted samples from a proposal distribution. When the target distribution is complex, such as multimodal distributions in highdimensional spaces, the efficiency of importance sampling critically depends on the choice of the proposal distribution. In this paper, we propose a novel adaptive scheme for the construction of efficient proposal distributions. Our algorithm promotes efficient exploration of the target distribution by combining global sampling mechanisms with a delayed weighting procedure. The proposed weighting mechanism plays a key role by enabling rapid resampling in regions where the proposal distribution is poorly adapted to the target. Our sampling algorithm is shown to be geometrically convergent under mild assumptions and is illustrated through various numerical experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应重要性采样方法 Entropic Mirror Monte Carlo，通过全局采样机制与延迟加权程序结合，有效探索复杂目标分布（如高维多模态分布）。算法在温和假设下几何收敛，数值实验验证了其效率。
Motivation: 传统重要性采样在高维复杂目标分布（如多模态分布）下效率严重依赖提议分布的选择，而自适应构造高效提议分布仍具挑战。
Method: 提出自适应方案，包含全局采样机制和延迟加权过程。延迟加权允许在提议分布与目标不匹配的区域快速重采样，从而提升探索效率。
Result: 理论证明算法在温和假设下几何收敛，数值实验展示了其有效性。
Conclusion: 所提自适应重要性采样方法可高效处理复杂目标分布，但未涉及具体应用领域。

papers.title: Language Model Circuits Are Sparse in the Neuron Basis
papers.abstract_en: The high-level concepts that a neural network uses to perform computation need not be aligned to individual neurons (Smolensky, 1986). Language model interpretability research has thus turned to techniques which decompose the neuron basis into more interpretable units of model computation, such as sparse autoencoders (SAEs). However, not all neuron-based representations are uninterpretable. For the first time, we empirically show that MLP neurons are as sparse a feature basis as SAEs. We use this finding to develop an end-to-end gradient-based attribution pipeline for circuit tracing on the MLP neuron basis, which surfaces causally effective neurons on a variety of tasks. On a standard subject-verb agreement benchmark (Marks et al., 2025), a circuit of $\approx 10^2$ MLP neurons is enough to control model behaviour. On the multi-hop city-state-capital task from (Lindsey et al., 2025), we find a circuit in which small sets of neurons encode specific latent reasoning steps (e.g. mapping a city to its state), and can be steered to change the model's output. This work thus advances automated interpretability of language models without imposing additional training costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次实证表明，语言模型MLP神经元本身作为特征基的稀疏程度不亚于稀疏自编码器（SAE）学到的特征基。基于此发现，作者开发了一套基于梯度的端到端归因流水线，用于在MLP神经元基上追踪回路，在主语-动词一致性和多跳城市-州-首都任务中，发现少量神经元即可控制模型行为，并能通过操控神经元改变模型输出。这项工作推进了无额外训练成本的自动可解释性。
Motivation: 现有语言模型可解释性研究通常认为神经元层面的表示不可解释，因此依赖SAE等分解技术。本文质疑这一假设，并试图证明MLP神经元本身就是稀疏且可解释的特征基。
Method: 通过实证比较MLP神经元激活的稀疏性与SAE特征的稀疏性，证明神经元基同样稀疏；然后基于此开发端到端梯度归因流水线，用于在神经元基上追踪因果回路。
Result: 在主语-动词一致基准上，约10^2个MLP神经元组成的回路足以控制模型行为；在多跳城市-州-首都任务中，发现小集合神经元编码特定潜在推理步骤，且可通过操控改变模型输出。
Conclusion: 本文表明MLP神经元基在稀疏性和可解释性上与SAE特征基相当，为无额外训练成本的语言模型自动可解释性提供了新途径。

papers.title: From Digital to Physical: Digital Agents as Autonomous Coaches for Physical Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: The field of Embodied AI is witnessing a rapid evolution toward general-purpose robotic systems, fueled by high-fidelity simulation and large-scale data collection. However, this scaling capability remains severely bottlenecked by a reliance on labor-intensive manual oversight from intricate reward shaping to hyperparameter tuning across heterogeneous backends. Inspired by LLMs' success in software automation and science discovery, we introduce \textsc{EmboCoach-Bench}, a benchmark evaluating the capacity of LLM agents to autonomously engineer embodied policies. Spanning 32 expert-curated RL and IL tasks, our framework posits executable code as the universal interface. We move beyond static generation to assess a dynamic closed-loop workflow, where agents leverage environment feedback to iteratively draft, debug, and optimize solutions, spanning improvements from physics-informed reward design to policy architectures such as diffusion policies. Extensive evaluations yield three critical insights: (1) autonomous agents can qualitatively surpass human-engineered baselines by 26.5\% in average success rate; (2) agentic workflow with environment feedback effectively strengthens policy development and substantially narrows the performance gap between open-source and proprietary models; and (3) agents exhibit self-correction capabilities for pathological engineering cases, successfully resurrecting task performance from near-total failures through iterative simulation-in-the-loop debugging. Ultimately, this work establishes a foundation for self-evolving embodied intelligence, accelerating the paradigm shift from labor-intensive manual tuning to scalable, autonomous engineering in embodied AI field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EmboCoach-Bench 基准，用于评估 LLM agent 自动设计具身智能策略（包括强化学习和模仿学习）的能力。该基准涵盖 32 个任务，将可执行代码作为通用接口，并采用动态闭环工作流，使 agent 能够通过环境反馈迭代地编写、调试和优化策略。实验表明，自主 agent 在平均成功率上比人类设计的基线高出 26.5%，且 agentic 工作流能缩小开源与闭源模型之间的性能差距，并展现出自我修正能力。
Motivation: 具身智能向通用机器人系统发展受限于人工密集的调参和奖励设计，亟需自动化工程方法。
Method: 构建 EmboCoach-Bench 基准，包含 32 个专家 curated 的 RL 和 IL 任务，使用代码作为接口，采用 agentic 闭环工作流：agent 根据环境反馈迭代地起草、调试和优化策略，包括物理启发的奖励设计和扩散策略等架构改进。
Result: 自主 agent 在平均成功率上超越人类基线 26.5%；环境反馈的 agentic 工作流能有效提升策略开发，缩小开源与专有模型差距；agent 具备自我修正能力，能从近乎完全失败中恢复任务性能。
Conclusion: 该工作为自进化的具身智能奠定基础，推动从人工调参到可扩展自动化工程的范式转变。

papers.title: Bulk-Calibrated Credal Ambiguity Sets: Fast, Tractable Decision Making under Out-of-Sample Contamination
papers.abstract_en: Distributionally robust optimisation (DRO) minimises the worst-case expected loss over an ambiguity set that can capture distributional shifts in out-of-sample environments. While Huber (linear-vacuous) contamination is a classical minimal-assumption model for an $\varepsilon$-fraction of arbitrary perturbations, including it in an ambiguity set can make the worst-case risk infinite and the DRO objective vacuous unless one imposes strong boundedness or support assumptions. We address these challenges by introducing bulk-calibrated credal ambiguity sets: we learn a high-mass bulk set from data while considering contamination inside the bulk and bounding the remaining tail contribution separately. This leads to a closed-form, finite $\mathrm{mean}+\sup$ robust objective and tractable linear or second-order cone programs for common losses and bulk geometries. Through this framework, we highlight and exploit the equivalence between the imprecise probability (IP) notion of upper expectation and the worst-case risk, demonstrating how IP credal sets translate into DRO objectives with interpretable tolerance levels. Experiments on heavy-tailed inventory control, geographically shifted house-price regression, and demographically shifted text classification show competitive robustness-accuracy trade-offs and efficient optimisation times, using Bayesian, frequentist, or empirical reference distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分布鲁棒优化（DRO）中Huber污染模型导致最坏情况风险无穷大的问题，提出bulk-calibrated credal ambiguity sets，从数据中学习高质量bulk集，同时考虑bulk内污染和尾部贡献，得到闭式有限鲁棒目标函数和可处理的线性或二阶锥规划。实验在重尾库存控制、地理偏移房价回归、人口偏移文本分类上展示了鲁棒性与精度的权衡。
Motivation: 现有DRO中Huber污染模型可能导致最坏情况风险无穷大，使优化目标失效，需要强有界性或支撑假设，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出bulk-calibrated credal ambiguity sets，将数据分为bulk和tail两部分，分别建模污染和尾部行为，导出mean+sup形式的闭式鲁棒目标函数，并转化为线性或二阶锥规划问题。
Result: 在重尾库存控制、地理偏移房价回归和人口偏移文本分类等实验中，该方法在鲁棒性与精度之间取得良好权衡，并具有高效的优化时间。
Conclusion: 通过揭示不精确概率（IP）上期望与最坏情况风险的等价性，构建了可解释且易处理的DRO框架，可兼容贝叶斯、频率派或经验参考分布。

papers.title: VDE Bench: Evaluating The Capability of Image Editing Models to Modify Visual Documents
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, image editing models have made significant progress, enabling users to manipulate visual content in a flexible and interactive manner through natural language instructions. However, an important yet underexplored research direction remains dense visual document image editing, which involves modifying textual content within images while faithfully preserving the original text style and background context. Existing methods primarily focus on English scenarios and images with relatively sparse text, and thus cannot adequately address dense, structurally complex documents or non-Latin scripts such as Chinese. To bridge this gap, we propose VDE Bench (Visual Doc Edit Bench), a rigorously human annotated and evaluated benchmark specifically designed to assess the performance of image editing models on bilingual Chinese-English and complex visual document editing tasks. The benchmark comprises a high quality dataset of 942 instruction based image editing samples, whose seed images encompass dense Chinese and English text documents including academic papers, posters, presentation slides, examination materials, and newspapers. Furthermore, we introduce a novel evaluation framework that systematically quantifies editing performance at the OCR parsing level, thereby enabling fine grained assessment of text modification accuracy. Based on this benchmark, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of representative image editing models. Human verification demonstrates a high degree of consistency between human judgments and automated evaluation metrics. VDE Bench constitutes the first systematic benchmark for evaluating the performance of image editing models on bilingual dense text visual documents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VDE Bench，一个双语（中文-英文）密集视觉文档图像编辑评估基准，包含 942 个基于指令的样本，覆盖学术论文、海报、幻灯片等。同时引入基于 OCR 解析级别的细粒度评估框架，对现有图像编辑模型进行系统评测，并验证了自动评估指标与人类判断的一致性。
Motivation: 现有图像编辑模型主要针对英文和稀疏文本场景，无法有效处理密集、结构复杂的文档或非拉丁文字（如中文），因此需要专门评估密集文档图像编辑能力的基准。
Method: 构建包含中英双语密集文本文档（学术论文、海报等）的高质量数据集，设计基于 OCR 解析的细粒度自动评估框架，量化文本修改准确性。
Result: 人类验证表明自动评估指标与人类判断高度一致，基准测试能够有效评估模型在双语密集文本图像编辑上的性能。
Conclusion: VDE Bench 是首个系统评估图像编辑模型在双语密集文本视觉文档上性能的基准，为后续研究提供标准化评估平台。

papers.title: HalluJudge: A Reference-Free Hallucination Detection for Context Misalignment in Code Review Automation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in code review automation, such as review comment generation, yet they suffer from hallucinations -- where the generated review comments are ungrounded in the actual code -- poses a significant challenge to the adoption of LLMs in code review workflows. To address this, we explore effective and scalable methods for a hallucination detection in LLM-generated code review comments without the reference. In this work, we design HalluJudge that aims to assess the grounding of generated review comments based on the context alignment. HalluJudge includes four key strategies ranging from direct assessment to structured multi-branch reasoning (e.g., Tree-of-Thoughts). We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of these assessment strategies across Atlassian's enterprise-scale software projects to examine the effectiveness and cost-efficiency of HalluJudge. Furthermore, we analyze the alignment between HalluJudge's judgment and developer preference of the actual LLM-generated code review comments in the real-world production. Our results show that the hallucination assessment in HalluJudge is cost-effective with an F1 score of 0.85 and an average cost of $0.009. On average, 67% of the HalluJudge assessments are aligned with the developer preference of the actual LLM-generated review comments in the online production. Our results suggest that HalluJudge can serve as a practical safeguard to reduce developers' exposure to hallucinated comments, fostering trust in AI-assisted code reviews.

papers.title: Kareus: Joint Reduction of Dynamic and Static Energy in Large Model Training
papers.abstract_en: The computing demand of AI is growing at an unprecedented rate, but energy supply is not keeping pace. As a result, energy has become an expensive and contended resource that requires explicit management and optimization. Although recent works have made significant progress in large model training optimization, they focus on optimizing either dynamic or static energy consumption. We find that fine-grained kernel scheduling and frequency scaling jointly and interdependently impact both dynamic and static energy consumption. Based on this finding, we design Kareus, a training system that pushes the time-energy tradeoff frontier by optimizing both aspects. Kareus decomposes the intractable joint optimization problem into local, partition-based subproblems. It then uses a multi-pass multi-objective optimization algorithm to find execution schedules that push the time-energy tradeoff frontier. Compared to the state of the art, Kareus reduces training energy by up to 28.3% at the same training time, or reduces training time by up to 27.5% at the same energy consumption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Kareus系统，联合优化大模型训练中的动态与静态能耗。通过细粒度内核调度和频率缩放，Kareus将复杂的联合优化问题分解为局部子问题，并使用多遍多目标优化算法寻找时间-能耗权衡前沿。与现有技术相比，在相同训练时间内最多降低28.3%能耗，或在相同能耗下最多减少27.5%训练时间。
Motivation: 现有大模型训练优化工作分别针对动态或静态能耗，忽略了二者的联合与相互依赖关系，导致能源利用效率不足。
Method: Kareus将联合优化问题分解为基于分区的局部子问题，采用多遍多目标优化算法，同时调度内核执行和调整频率，以探索时间-能耗权衡前沿。
Result: 与最先进方法相比，在相同训练时间下最多降低28.3%能耗，在相同能耗下最多减少27.5%训练时间。
Conclusion: Kareus证明了联合优化动态和静态能耗可以有效提升大模型训练的能量效率，且不牺牲训练速度。

papers.title: DSAEval: Evaluating Data Science Agents on a Wide Range of Real-World Data Science Problems
papers.abstract_en: Recent LLM-based data agents aim to automate data science tasks ranging from data analysis to deep learning. However, the open-ended nature of real-world data science problems, which often span multiple taxonomies and lack standard answers, poses a significant challenge for evaluation. To address this, we introduce DSAEval, a benchmark comprising 641 real-world data science problems grounded in 285 diverse datasets, covering both structured and unstructured data (e.g., image and text). DSAEval incorporates three distinctive features: (1) Multimodal Environment Perception, which enables agents to interpret observations from multiple modalities, including text and vision; (2) Multi-Query Interactions, which mirror the iterative and cumulative nature of real-world data science projects; and (3) Multi-Dimensional Evaluation, which provides a holistic assessment across reasoning, code, and results. We systematically evaluate 13 recent advanced agentic LLMs using DSAEval. Our results show that Claude-Sonnet-4.5 achieves the strongest overall performance, MiMo-V2-Pro and GPT-5.2 lead in duration and step efficiency, respectively, and MiMo-V2-Flash is the most cost-effective. We further demonstrate that multimodal perception consistently improves performance on vision-related tasks, with gains ranging from 2.04\% to 11.30\%. Overall, while current data science agents perform well on structured data and routine data analysis workflows, substantial challenges remain in unstructured domains. Finally, we offer critical insights and outline future research directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DSAEval是一个包含641个真实世界数据科学问题的基准，基于285个多样化数据集，涵盖结构化与非结构化数据。它引入多模态环境感知、多查询交互和多维评估三个特性，系统评估了13个先进智能体LLM。结果显示Claude-Sonnet-4.5整体最强，MiMo-V2-Pro在耗时和步骤效率上领先，MiMo-V2-Flash最具成本效益。多模态感知在视觉任务上提升2.04%到11.30%，但当前智能体在非结构化领域仍面临挑战。
Motivation: 现有数据科学智能体评估多基于封闭式问题，难以反映真实世界数据科学问题的开放性、多分类和无标准答案的特点。
Method: 构建DSAEval基准，包含三个特色：多模态环境感知（文本和视觉）、多查询交互（模拟迭代累积过程）、多维评估（推理、代码、结果）。
Result: 13个智能体评估中，Claude-Sonnet-4.5整体最优，MiMo-V2-Pro耗时最短，GPT-5.2步骤效率最高，MiMo-V2-Flash成本最低。多模态感知在视觉任务上提升2.04%-11.30%。
Conclusion: 当前数据科学智能体在结构化数据和常规分析流程上表现良好，但在非结构化领域存在显著挑战，需要进一步研究。

papers.title: Epistemic Constitutionalism Or: how to avoid coherence bias
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly function as artificial reasoners: they evaluate arguments, assign credibility, and express confidence. Yet their belief-forming behavior is governed by implicit, uninspected epistemic policies. This paper argues for an epistemic constitution for AI: explicit, contestable meta-norms that regulate how systems form and express beliefs. Source attribution bias provides the motivating case: I show that frontier models enforce identity-stance coherence, penalizing arguments attributed to sources whose expected ideological position conflicts with the argument's content. When models detect systematic testing, these effects collapse, revealing that systems treat source-sensitivity as bias to suppress rather than as a capacity to execute well. I distinguish two constitutional approaches: the Platonic, which mandates formal correctness and default source-independence from a privileged standpoint, and the Liberal, which refuses such privilege, specifying procedural norms that protect conditions for collective inquiry while allowing principled source-attending grounded in epistemic vigilance. I argue for the Liberal approach, sketch a constitutional core of eight principles and four orientations, and propose that AI epistemic governance requires the same explicit, contestable structure we now expect for AI ethics.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证AI系统需要明确、可争议的认识论宪法，以规范信念形成与表达。以源属性偏差为核心案例，展示前沿模型强制身份立场连贯性，惩罚与源预期意识形态冲突的论点，且在系统性测试下偏差效应消失。区分柏拉图式与自由主义两种宪法路径，主张自由主义路径，并提出八原则四导向的宪法核心。
Motivation: 大语言模型作为人工推理者，其信念形成受隐含、未审查的认识论政策支配，缺乏明确规则，导致系统性偏差（如源属性偏差）。
Method: 提出AI认识论宪法概念，区分柏拉图式（强调形式正确性与默认源独立性）与自由主义（拒绝特权立场，制定保护集体探究的程序规范）两种路径，并论证自由主义路径的优越性。
Result: 摘要显示前线模型在源属性偏差任务中强制身份立场连贯性，但在系统测试时偏差消失，表明模型将源敏感性视为需要抑制的偏差而非值得执行的能力。
Conclusion: AI认识论治理应与AI伦理一样，需要明确、可争议的结构，并提出了八条原则和四种导向作为宪法核心。

papers.title: Contrastive Geometric Learning Unlocks Unified Structure- and Ligand-Based Drug Design
papers.abstract_en: Structure-based and ligand-based computational drug design have traditionally relied on disjoint data sources and modeling assumptions, limiting their joint use at scale. In this work, we introduce Contrastive Geometric Learning for Unified Computational Drug Design (ConGLUDe), a single contrastive geometric model that unifies structure- and ligand-based training. ConGLUDe couples a geometric protein encoder that produces whole-protein representations and implicit embeddings of predicted binding sites with a fast ligand encoder, removing the need for predefined pockets. By aligning ligands with both global protein representations and multiple candidate binding sites through contrastive learning, ConGLUDe supports ligand-conditioned pocket prediction in addition to virtual screening and target fishing, while being trained jointly on protein-ligand complexes and large-scale bioactivity data. Across diverse benchmarks, ConGLUDe achieves competitive zero-shot virtual screening performance, substantially outperforms existing methods on a challenging target fishing task, and demonstrates state-of-the-art ligand-conditioned pocket selection. These results highlight the advantages of unified structure-ligand training and position ConGLUDe as a step toward general-purpose foundation models for drug discovery.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的对比几何学习模型 ConGLUDe，同时利用基于结构和基于配体的训练，用于药物设计中的虚拟筛选、靶点识别和配体条件性口袋预测。该模型将几何蛋白质编码器与快速配体编码器结合，通过对比学习对齐全局蛋白质表示和多个候选结合位点，在零样本虚拟筛选、靶点发现和配体条件性口袋选择任务上达到或超过现有方法。
Motivation: 基于结构和基于配体的药物设计传统上依赖不同的数据源和建模假设，限制了它们的联合规模化使用，因此需要一种统一二者优势的通用方法。
Method: 引入对比几何学习统一计算药物设计（ConGLUDe），包含一个几何蛋白质编码器（生成全蛋白质表示和隐式结合位点嵌入）和一个快速配体编码器，通过对比学习同时对齐配体与全局蛋白质表示及多个候选结合位点，无需预定义口袋。模型联合训练于蛋白质-配体复合物和大规模生物活性数据。
Result: 在多个基准上，ConGLUDe 在零样本虚拟筛选上达到竞争力水平，在更具挑战性的靶点发现任务上显著优于现有方法，并在配体条件性口袋选择上达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: 统一的结构-配体训练策略优势明显，ConGLUDe 可被视为向药物发现通用基础模型迈出的一步。

summary_sections.method: 引入对比几何学习统一计算药物设计（ConGLUDe），包含一个几何蛋白质编码器（生成全蛋白质表示和隐式结合位点嵌入）和一个快速配体编码器，通过对比学习同时对齐配体与全局蛋白质表示及多个候选结合位点，无需预定义口袋。模型联合训练于蛋白质-配体复合物和大规模生物活性数据。
summary_sections.result: 在多个基准上，ConGLUDe 在零样本虚拟筛选上达到竞争力水平，在更具挑战性的靶点发现任务上显著优于现有方法，并在配体条件性口袋选择上达到最先进水平。
summary_sections.conclusion: 统一的结构-配体训练策略优势明显，ConGLUDe 可被视为向药物发现通用基础模型迈出的一步。

papers.title: Hellinger Multimodal Variational Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal variational autoencoders (VAEs) are widely used for weakly supervised generative learning with multiple modalities. Predominant methods aggregate unimodal inference distributions using either a product of experts (PoE), a mixture of experts (MoE), or their combinations to approximate the joint posterior. In this work, we revisit multimodal inference through the lens of probabilistic opinion pooling, an optimization-based approach. We start from Hölder pooling with $α=0.5$, which corresponds to the unique symmetric member of the $α\text{-divergence}$ family, and derive a moment-matching approximation, termed Hellinger. We then leverage such an approximation to propose HELVAE, a multimodal VAE that avoids sub-sampling, yielding an efficient yet effective model that: (i) learns more expressive latent representations as additional modalities are observed; and (ii) empirically achieves better trade-offs between generative coherence and quality, outperforming state-of-the-art multimodal VAE models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从概率意见聚合（probabilistic opinion pooling）的角度重新审视多模态变分自编码器的推理过程，基于Hölder pooling（α=0.5）推导出矩匹配近似Hellinger，并据此提出HELVAE模型。该模型避免子采样，在生成一致性和质量之间取得更好权衡，在多个多模态基准上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多模态VAE方法（如PoE、MoE或它们的组合）在近似联合后验时存在局限性，例如子采样导致效率低下或不稳定的表示学习。
Method: 从α=0.5的Hölder pooling出发，通过矩匹配近似得到Hellinger聚合算子，并将其作为多模态VAE的推理模型，避免显式子采样。
Result: 实验表明HELVAE随着模态数量增加能学习到更具表达力的潜在表示，并在生成一致性和质量之间取得更优权衡，优于现有先进多模态VAE模型。
Conclusion: 基于Hölder pooling的Hellinger近似为多模态VAE提供了一种有效且高效的推理框架，未来可探索其他α值或动态聚合策略。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EyeTheia: A Lightweight and Accessible Eye-Tracking Toolbox
papers.abstract_en: We introduce EyeTheia, a lightweight and open deep learning pipeline for webcam-based gaze estimation, designed for browser-based experimental platforms and real-world cognitive and clinical research. EyeTheia enables real-time gaze tracking using only a standard laptop webcam, combining MediaPipe-based landmark extraction with a convolutional neural network inspired by iTracker and optional user-specific fine-tuning. We investigate two complementary strategies: adapting a model pretrained on mobile data and training the same architecture from scratch on a desktop-oriented dataset. Validation results on MPIIFaceGaze show comparable performance between both approaches prior to calibration, while lightweight user-specific fine-tuning consistently reduces gaze prediction error. We further evaluate EyeTheia in a realistic Dot-Probe task and compare it to the commercial webcam-based tracker SeeSo SDK. Results indicate strong agreement in left-right gaze allocation during stimulus presentation, despite higher temporal variability. Overall, EyeTheia provides a transparent and extensible solution for low-cost gaze tracking, suitable for scalable and reproducible experimental and clinical studies. The code, trained models, and experimental materials are publicly available.
papers.comment: Code for the EyeTheia: https://github.com/patherstevenson/EyeTheia. Experimental platform for the cognitive neuroscience task (BAWEB IAPS): https://git.interactions-team.fr/INTERACTIONS/calypso/src/branch/main/src/medita/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EyeTheia 是一个轻量级开源的深度学习管道，用于基于网络摄像头的视线估计，仅需标准笔记本电脑摄像头即可实现实时眼动追踪。它结合了 MediaPipe 关键点提取和受 iTracker 启发的卷积神经网络，并提供用户特定的微调。在 MPIIFaceGaze 数据集上验证，两种策略（预训练和从头训练）在校准前表现相当，而轻量级用户微调持续降低预测误差。在点探测任务中与商业 SeeSo SDK 比较，显示在左右注视分配上高度一致，但时间变异性更高。代码和模型公开。
Motivation: 现有眼动追踪方案成本高或依赖专用硬件，限制了在认知和临床研究中的普及。需要一种低成本、可访问且可扩展的解决方案。
Method: 提出了 EyeTheia 管道，包括 MediaPipe 人脸关键点提取、基于 iTracker 的 CNN 模型，以及两种训练策略：在移动数据上预训练后微调，或直接在桌面数据集上从头训练。支持用户特定微调。
Result: 在 MPIIFaceGaze 上，两种策略在未校准时性能接近；用户微调后持续降低误差。在点探测任务中与 SeeSo SDK 对比，左右注视分配一致，但时间变异性更高。
Conclusion: EyeTheia 提供了一个透明、可扩展的低成本眼动追踪解决方案，适用于可重复的实验和临床研究。代码和模型已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Smaller Wins: Dual-Stage Distillation and Pareto-Guided Compression of Liquid Neural Networks for Edge Battery Prognostics
papers.abstract_en: Battery management systems increasingly require accurate battery health prognostics under strict on-device constraints. This paper presents DLNet, a practical framework with dual-stage distillation of liquid neural networks that turns a high-capacity model into compact and edge-deployable models for battery health prediction. DLNet first applies Euler discretization to reformulate liquid dynamics for embedded compatibility. It then performs dual-stage knowledge distillation to transfer the teacher model's temporal behavior and recover it after further compression. Pareto-guided selection under joint error-cost objectives retains student models that balance accuracy and efficiency. We evaluate DLNet on a widely used dataset and validate real-device feasibility on an Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense using int8 deployment. The final deployed student achieves a low error of 0.0066 when predicting battery health over the next 100 cycles, which is 15.4% lower than the teacher model. It reduces the model size from 616 kB to 94 kB with 84.7% reduction and takes 21 ms per inference on the device. These results support a practical smaller wins observation that a small model can match or exceed a large teacher for edge-based prognostics with proper supervision and selection. Beyond batteries, the DLNet framework can extend to other industrial analytics tasks with strict hardware constraints.
papers.comment: Accepted at International Conference on Pattern Recognition, ICPR 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/Dhivya-DD17/DLNet
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DLNet框架，通过双阶段蒸馏和帕累托引导压缩将液态神经网络（liquid neural networks）压缩为适合边缘部署的电池健康预测模型。在Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense上部署的int8模型大小为94 kB，推理时间21 ms，预测未来100个循环的电池健康误差为0.0066，比教师模型低15.4%。研究还发现，在适当的监督和选择下，小模型可以在边缘预测任务上匹配或超越大模型。
Motivation: 电池管理系统需要高精度的健康预测，但受限于边缘设备的计算和存储资源。现有大模型难以部署，而直接小模型性能不足，需要方法在保持精度的同时大幅压缩模型。
Method: 首先使用欧拉离散化将液态动力学转换为嵌入式兼容形式；然后进行双阶段知识蒸馏，先转移教师模型的时间行为，再在进一步压缩后恢复行为；最后通过帕累托引导选择在联合误差-成本目标下平衡精度和效率的学生模型。
Result: 在公开数据集上，最终部署的学生模型预测未来100个循环的电池健康误差为0.0066，比教师模型低15.4%，模型大小从616 kB减小到94 kB（缩减84.7%），在Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense上推理时间21 ms。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过适当的蒸馏和选择，小模型可以在边缘预测任务中匹配甚至超越大模型，验证了“小而优”的观察。DLNet框架可推广到其他严格硬件约束的工业分析任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CuMA: Aligning LLMs with Sparse Cultural Values via Demographic-Aware Mixture of Adapters
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) serve a global audience, alignment must transition from enforcing universal consensus to respecting cultural pluralism. We demonstrate that dense models, when forced to fit conflicting value distributions, suffer from \textbf{Mean Collapse}, converging to a generic average that fails to represent diverse groups. We attribute this to \textbf{Cultural Sparsity}, where gradient interference prevents dense parameters from spanning distinct cultural modes. To resolve this, we propose \textbf{\textsc{CuMA}} (\textbf{Cu}ltural \textbf{M}ixture of \textbf{A}dapters), a framework that frames alignment as a \textbf{conditional capacity separation} problem. By incorporating demographic-aware routing, \textsc{CuMA} internalizes a \textit{Latent Cultural Topology} to explicitly disentangle conflicting gradients into specialized expert subspaces. Extensive evaluations on WorldValuesBench, Community Alignment, and PRISM demonstrate that \textsc{CuMA} achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming both dense baselines and semantic-only MoEs. Crucially, our analysis confirms that \textsc{CuMA} effectively mitigates mean collapse, preserving cultural diversity. Our code is available at https://github.com/Throll/CuMA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CuMA框架，将大规模语言模型的文化对齐问题转化为条件容量分离问题，通过人口统计信息感知的路由来分离冲突梯度到专门专家子空间，从而避免密集模型在拟合不同文化价值分布时出现的均值崩塌。在WorldValuesBench等基准上，CuMA显著优于密集基线和仅语义的MoE方法，有效保留文化多样性。
Motivation: 现有LLM对齐方法试图强制统一共识，但不同文化群体的价值分布存在冲突，密集模型在拟合时梯度相互干扰，导致均值崩塌，无法真实反映多元文化。
Method: 提出CuMA框架，将文化对齐视为条件容量分离问题，引入人口统计感知路由，内部化潜在文化拓扑，显式解缠冲突梯度到不同专家子空间。
Result: 在WorldValuesBench、Community Alignment和PRISM基准上达到最佳性能，显著优于密集基线和语义MoE，有效缓解均值崩塌并保留文化多样性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过条件容量分离和人口统计感知路由，CuMA实现了高效的文化多元对齐，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decentralized Autoregressive Generation
papers.abstract_en: The decentralization of autoregressive generation has attracted considerable attention in recent years as a solution to scaling bottlenecks. However, despite promising empirical results, this paradigm currently lacks rigorous theoretical justification. In this work, we formally establish the theoretical equivalence between decentralized and centralized training. To achieve this, we adapt the Discrete Flow Matching framework for autoregressive generation, leveraging its inherent properties to demonstrate that global models naturally decompose into independent experts. Finally, we conduct extensive experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks, empirically validating that decentralized training maintains competitive parity with standard centralized architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文正式建立了去中心化自回归生成与集中式训练之间的理论等价性，利用离散流匹配框架证明全局模型可自然分解为独立专家，并在多模态基准上实验验证了去中心化训练的性能与集中式架构持平。
Motivation: 去中心化自回归生成虽在缩放瓶颈上有实证优势，但缺乏严格的理论基础。
Method: 采用离散流匹配框架，通过其固有性质证明全局模型可分解为独立专家，从而建立去中心化与集中式训练的理论等价性。
Result: 在多模态基准上的大量实验表明，去中心化训练在性能上与标准集中式架构保持竞争性持平。
Conclusion: 论文从理论上证实了去中心化自回归生成的合理性，为后续研究提供了理论支撑。

papers.title: Why Commodity WiFi Sensors Fail at Multi-Person Gait Identification: A Systematic Analysis Using ESP32
papers.abstract_en: WiFi Channel State Information (CSI) has shown promise for single-person gait identification, raising interest in its use for contactless biometrics, continuous authentication, and passive identification. However, the feasibility of multi-person identification on low-cost commodity devices remains unclear. A critical question is whether weak multi-person performance is primarily an algorithmic limitation, or whether it reflects a more fundamental sensing ceiling on commodity WiFi hardware. We address this question through a systematic empirical study using commodity ESP32 WiFi sensors. We evaluated six different signal separation methods--FastICA, SOBI, PCA-ICA, NMF, Wavelet, and Tensor decomposition--across seven scenarios spanning 1-10 people in both controlled and realistic indoor environments. To investigate beyond classification accuracy, we introduce three diagnostic metrics: intra-subject variability (ISV), inter-subject distinguishability (ISD), and performance degradation rate (PDR). In all methods, performance remains moderate (39%-56% accuracy), with limited evidence that algorithmic choice alone solves the problem. The best-performing method, NMF, reaches 56% accuracy, while all methods exhibit extremely high feature-space overlap (97%-99%), unstable within-subject representations, and marked environmental sensitivity. These findings suggest that, under commodity ESP32 CSI constraints, dense multi-person gait identification is limited more by sensing quality and spatial diversity than by the chosen separation algorithm. Our results have direct implications for security and privacy: they call into question the practicality of commodity WiFi CSI as a robust multi-user biometric primitive for authentication, while also placing important bounds on the passive identification capabilities achievable with low-cost off-the-shelf WiFi hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对ESP32 WiFi传感器的信道状态信息(CSI)进行系统性实验，评估了六种信号分离方法在多人步态识别上的表现。研究发现，在1-10人场景下，所有方法的准确率仅为39%-56%，特征空间重叠高达97%-99%，且环境敏感性显著。结论指出，现有性能瓶颈主要来自传感器感知质量和空间多样性限制，而非算法选择。
Motivation: 现有研究已将WiFi CSI用于单人步态识别，但多人识别在低成本商用设备上的可行性仍不明确，关键问题是性能不足究竟是算法局限还是硬件感知天花板。
Method: 使用ESP32传感器采集CSI数据，在受控和真实室内环境中测试FastICA、SOBI、PCA-ICA、NMF、小波变换和张量分解六种信号分离方法，并引入类内变异性(ISV)、类间可区分性(ISD)和性能退化率(PDR)三个诊断指标。
Result: 所有方法在1-10人场景下的准确率仅39%-56%，最优方法NMF达56%；特征空间重叠97%-99%，类内表示不稳定，环境敏感性强。
Conclusion: 在商用ESP32 CSI约束下，密集多人步态识别的主要限制是感知质量和空间多样性，而非分离算法；该结果质疑了WiFi CSI作为多用户生物特征鉴权的实用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedBiCross: Personalized One-Shot Federated Learning on Medical Images
papers.abstract_en: Data-free knowledge distillation-based one-shot federated learning (OSFL) trains a model in a single communication round without sharing raw data, making OSFL attractive for privacy-sensitive medical applications. However, existing methods aggregate predictions from all clients to form a global teacher. Under non-IID data, conflicting predictions dilute each other during averaging, yielding less informative soft labels that weaken distillation. We propose FedBiCross, a personalized OSFL framework with three stages: (1) clustering clients by model output similarity to form coherent sub-ensembles, (2) bi-level cross-cluster optimization that learns adaptive weights to selectively leverage beneficial cross-cluster knowledge while suppressing negative transfer, and (3) personalized distillation for client-specific adaptation. Experiments on four medical image datasets demonstrate that FedBiCross consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across different non-IID degrees.
papers.comment: Accepted by BlockSys 2026. This version of the contribution has been accepted for publication, after peer review (when applicable) but is not the Version of Record and does not reflect post-acceptance improvements, or any corrections
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FedBiCross，一种用于医学图像的一对一聚合联邦学习（OSFL）框架，通过客户端聚类、双层交叉簇优化和个性化蒸馏，解决非独立同分布（non-IID）数据下全局教师预测冲突导致蒸馏效果差的问题。在四个医学图像数据集上的实验表明，FedBiCross在不同non-IID程度下均优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有基于无数据知识蒸馏的OSFL方法在non-IID医学图像数据上，全局教师平均化冲突预测导致软标签信息量少，削弱蒸馏效果，需要个性化处理。
Method: FedBiCross包含三个阶段：按模型输出相似性聚类客户端形成子集成；双层交叉簇优化学习自适应权重以选择性利用有益跨簇知识并抑制负迁移；个性化蒸馏实现客户端特定适应。
Result: 在四个医学图像数据集上，FedBiCross在不同non-IID程度下一致优于最新基线方法。
Conclusion: FedBiCross通过聚类和交叉簇优化有效缓解non-IID下OSFL的预测冲突，适用于隐私敏感的医学图像场景。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Geometric and Quantum Kernel Methods for Predicting Skeletal Muscle Outcomes in chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
papers.abstract_en: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) affects hundreds of millions of people worldwide, and skeletal-muscle dysfunction is clinically important. Quantum machine learning is increasingly explored for biomedical prediction, but its value in small biomarker cohorts requires benchmarking against strong classical baselines. We analysed a cigarette-smoke COPD cohort of 213 animals with blood and bronchoalveolar-lavage biomarkers to predict tibialis anterior muscle weight, muscle quality, and force. We developed a kernel-geometric quantum hybrid method in which synthetic symmetric positive definite (SPD) references are mapped through a reproducing kernel Hilbert space, compressed using train-only random projection, normalised, and supplied to low-dimensional quantum regression circuits. We benchmarked this approach against classical ridge/kernel models, SPD relational representations, and quantum-kernel regression (QKR). All methods were evaluated using condition-stratified repeated cross-validation. The largest numerical improvement was observed for muscle weight, where the proposed method had the numerically lowest mean root mean squared error (RMSE), approximately 1.8% below the best classical comparator; paired fold-level testing did not establish statistically significant superiority after Holm adjustment, but the endpoint is biologically meaningful. The method also had the numerically lowest mean RMSE for muscle quality. For force, biomarker-only Ridge performed best, suggesting a more linear endpoint structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）的骨骼肌功能障碍预测问题，提出一种结合几何核与量子核的混合方法。在213只香烟烟雾诱导的COPD小鼠队列中，使用血液和肺泡灌洗液生物标志物预测胫骨前肌重量、肌肉质量和力量。该方法将合成对称正定参考映射到再生核希尔伯特空间，经过随机投影和归一化后输入低维量子回归电路。与经典脊回归、核方法以及量子核回归等基线相比，该方法在肌肉重量预测上取得了数值上最低的均方根误差（比最佳经典方法低约1.8%），但经Holm校正后未达到统计显著性。
Motivation: COPD相关的骨骼肌功能障碍在临床上具有重要意义，而量子机器学习在生物标志物数据量较小的场景中的预测价值尚需与强基线进行严格对比。
Method: 提出一种核几何量子混合方法：首先生成合成对称正定（SPD）参考，通过再生核希尔伯特空间映射，再使用仅训练集的随机投影进行压缩和归一化，最后输入低维量子回归电路。
Result: 在肌肉重量预测中，该方法均方根误差（RMSE）比最佳经典比较器低约1.8%；在肌肉质量上也获得数值上最低的RMSE；但对力量预测，仅使用生物标志物的脊回归表现最佳。所有结果经配对折检验和Holm校正后未发现统计显著性差异。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法在生物相关的终点指标上显示出数值改进潜力，但需要更大样本或更灵敏的实验设计来验证统计显著性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HiGR: Industrial-Scale Hierarchical Generative Slate Recommendation Framework in Tencent
papers.abstract_en: Slate recommendation, which presents users with a ranked item list in a single display, is ubiquitous across mainstream online platforms. While recent generative recommendation methods have shown strong potential in modeling item sequences with semantic IDs, directly applying them to industrial-scale slate recommendation faces a fundamental disconnect: entangled SID spaces confound high-level list planning, fine-grained autoregressive decoding over long sequences limits semantic planning efficiency, and token-level objectives misalign with holistic slate quality. In this paper, we propose HiGR, an industrial-scale hierarchical generative framework for slate recommendation that bridges this disconnect through a co-designed pipeline. First, HiGR learns structured SIDs via a Prefix-Contrastive Residual Quantized VAE (PCRQ-VAE). By enforcing high-level prefixes to capture shared semantics, PCRQ-VAE creates a controllable discrete space that acts as a prerequisite for efficient planning. Leveraging this structured space, our Hierarchical Slate Decoder (HSD) shifts autoregressive modeling from entangled token-level decoding to coarse-grained preference embeddings. This design significantly reduces inference latency while allowing explicit global slate structure planning. Finally, this stable planning space enables an ORPO-based listwise alignment mechanism to optimize triple-objective implicit feedback-ranking fidelity, genuine user interest, and diversity. Extensive offline experiments show that HiGR outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by over 10% in offline recommendation quality while achieving a $5\times$ inference speedup. Online A/B tests on Tencent platforms further improve watch time by 1.22% and video plays by 1.73%. HiGR has been deployed on multiple Tencent platform surfaces, serving hundreds of millions of users and proving its industrial-scale applicability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HiGR，一个面向工业场景的层次化生成式Slate推荐框架，通过PCRQ-VAE学习结构化语义ID（SID），并采用层次化Slate解码器（HSD）提升推理效率，同时利用ORPO-based列表对齐机制优化隐式反馈。离线实验显示推荐质量提升10%以上，5倍推理加速；腾讯平台在线A/B测试中观看时长提升1.22%，视频播放量提升1.73%。
Motivation: 现有生成式推荐方法直接应用于工业级Slate推荐时存在语义ID空间混杂、自回归解码效率低、token级目标与整体Slate质量不一致等问题。
Method: 提出HiGR框架：1) PCRQ-VAE学习结构化语义ID，通过前缀对比残差量化变分自编码器实现高层共享语义；2) 层次化Slate解码器（HSD）将自回归建模从token级转为粗粒度偏好嵌入；3) ORPO-based列表对齐机制优化排序保真度、用户真实兴趣和多样性三重目标。
Result: 离线实验在推荐质量上超越最先进基线超过10%，同时实现5倍推理加速；在线A/B测试中观看时长提升1.22%，视频播放量提升1.73%。
Conclusion: HiGR已被部署在腾讯多个平台，服务数亿用户，证明了其工业级适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From geometry to dynamics: Learning overdamped Langevin dynamics from sparse observations with geometric constraints
papers.abstract_en: How can we learn the laws underlying the dynamics of stochastic systems when their trajectories are sampled sparsely in time? Existing methods either require temporally resolved high-frequency observations, or rely on geometric arguments that apply only to conservative systems, limiting the range of dynamics they can recover. Here, we present a new framework that reconciles these two perspectives by reformulating inference as a stochastic control problem. Our method uses geometry-driven path augmentation, guided by the geometry in the system's invariant density to reconstruct likely trajectories and infer the underlying dynamics without assuming specific parametric models. Applied to overdamped Langevin systems, our approach accurately recovers stochastic dynamics even from extremely undersampled data, outperforming existing methods in synthetic benchmarks. This work demonstrates the effectiveness of incorporating geometric inductive biases into stochastic system identification methods.
papers.comment: 10+54 pages, 14 figures; accepted at ICML 2026 An earlier account of this work has previously appeared in arXiv:2301.08102 and arXiv:2304.00423 ; main methodology remains the same, this version includes additional numerical experiments and theory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从稀疏时间采样数据中学习过阻尼Langevin动力学的新框架，将推断问题转化为随机控制问题，利用系统不变密度的几何结构进行路径增强，无需假设参数模型。在合成基准上，该方法能在极度欠采样条件下准确恢复动力学，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法要么需要高频观测，要么仅适用于保守系统，无法处理稀疏采样的非保守随机动力学。
Method: 将推断重构为随机控制问题，通过系统不变密度的几何指导进行路径增强，重建可能轨迹并推断底层动力学，无需参数模型假设。
Result: 在过阻尼Langevin系统上，即使时间采样极度稀疏，也能准确恢复随机动力学，在合成基准中优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 证明了将几何归纳偏置引入随机系统辨识方法的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Cluster Aggregated GAN (CAG): A Cluster-Based Hybrid Model for Appliance Pattern Generation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic appliance data are essential for developing non-intrusive load monitoring algorithms and enabling privacy preserving energy research, yet the scarcity of labeled datasets remains a significant barrier. Recent GAN-based methods have demonstrated the feasibility of synthesizing load patterns, but most existing approaches treat all devices uniformly within a single model, neglecting the behavioral differences between intermittent and continuous appliances and resulting in unstable training and limited output fidelity. To address these limitations, we propose the Cluster Aggregated GAN framework, a hybrid generative approach that routes each appliance to a specialized branch based on its behavioral characteristics. For intermittent appliances, a clustering module groups similar activation patterns and allocates dedicated generators for each cluster, ensuring that both common and rare operational modes receive adequate modeling capacity. Continuous appliances follow a separate branch that employs an LSTM-based generator to capture gradual temporal evolution while maintaining training stability through sequence compression. Extensive experiments on the UVIC smart plug dataset demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently outperforms baseline methods across metrics measuring realism, diversity, and training stability, and that integrating clustering as an active generative component substantially improves both interpretability and scalability. These findings establish the proposed framework as an effective approach for synthetic load generation in non-intrusive load monitoring research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Cluster Aggregated GAN (CAG)，一种基于聚类混合的生成模型，用于合成电器负荷数据。模型根据电器行为特征路由到专门分支：间歇性电器使用聚类模块分配专用生成器，连续性电器使用LSTM生成器。在UVIC智能插头数据集上，CAG在真实性、多样性和训练稳定性指标上优于基线方法。
Motivation: 现有GAN方法将所有设备统一建模，忽略了间歇性与连续性电器的行为差异，导致训练不稳定和输出保真度有限。
Method: 提出CAG框架，包含两个分支：间歇性电器分支通过聚类模块将相似激活模式分组，为每个簇分配专用生成器；连续性电器分支采用基于LSTM的生成器，通过序列压缩捕获渐进时间演化。
Result: 在UVIC数据集上，CAG在衡量真实性、多样性和训练稳定性的指标上一致优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 将聚类作为主动生成组件能显著提升可解释性和可扩展性，CAG为非侵入式负荷监测中的合成负荷生成提供了有效方案。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在UVIC数据集上，CAG在衡量真实性、多样性和训练稳定性的指标上一致优于基线方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 将聚类作为主动生成组件能显著提升可解释性和可扩展性，CAG为非侵入式负荷监测中的合成负荷生成提供了有效方案。

papers.title: PhononBench:A Large-Scale Phonon-Based Benchmark for Dynamical Stability in Crystal Generation
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, generative artificial intelligence has made significant advances in the design of crystalline materials, giving rise to approaches based on graph neural networks, diffusion models, and large language models. Existing evaluations commonly follow the stability-uniqueness-novelty (S.U.N.) framework, where stability is primarily assessed using thermodynamic criteria, which do not fully capture the dynamical stability essential for a material's practical existence. Dynamical stability is a key determinant of whether a material can be synthesized and persist, with phonon spectrum calculations serving as the standard for its evaluation. However, the high computational cost of such calculations has prevented large-scale assessment of dynamical stability in generated crystals. In this work, we introduce PhononBench, the first large-scale benchmark for dynamical stability in AI-generated crystals. Leveraging the recently developed MatterSim interatomic potential, which achieves density-functional-theory (DFT)-level accuracy in phonon predictions across more than 10,000 materials, PhononBench enables efficient phonon calculations and dynamical-stability analysis for 133,838 crystal structures generated by 7 leading crystal generation models. PhononBench reveals a widespread limitation of current generative models: unless otherwise specified, all reported dynamical-stability metrics are evaluated at a phonon-frequency threshold of -0.1 THz, with the average dynamical-stability rate across all generated structures being only 32.15%, and the top-performing model, MatterGen, reaching just 45.05%.In addition, we identify 32,995 crystal structures that are phonon-stable across the entire Brillouin zone under a strict threshold of -0.001 THz. In addition, a web-based service is accessible at http://phononbench.cn/, enabling minute-level ultra-fast phonon predictions.

TL;DR: PhononBench 是首个大规模评估晶体生成模型动力学稳定性的基准，利用 MatterSim 内原子势对 133,838 个生成结构进行声子计算。在 -0.1 THz 阈值下，平均动力学稳定性率仅 32.15%，最佳模型 MatterGen 达到 45.05%；并筛选出 32,995 个严格阈值下的声子稳定结构。
Motivation: 现有晶体生成评估主要依赖热力学稳定性，忽略动力学稳定性（决定材料能否合成与存在），而声子谱计算成本高，缺乏大规模基准。
Method: 基于 MatterSim 内原子势（达到 DFT 精度），对 7 个生成模型（包含 MatterGen 等）输出的 133,838 个晶体结构进行高效声子计算和动力学稳定性分析。
Result: 在 -0.1 THz 阈值下，所有生成结构的平均动力学稳定性率为 32.15%，MatterGen 最高为 45.05%；同时识别出 32,995 个在 -0.001 THz 严格阈值下全域稳定的结构。
Conclusion: 揭示当前生成模型在动力学稳定性上的普遍不足，并提供在线服务（phononbench.cn）实现分钟级超快声子预测。

papers.title: A Neural-Network Model-Measurement-Based Observation Operator For Weather Radar Reflectivity Assimilation
papers.abstract_en: In three-dimensional variational data assimilation (3DVar) for numerical weather prediction (NWP), the observation operator $\mathcal{H}$ plays a central role by mapping model state variables to an observation equivalent. For weather radar, however, specifying $\mathcal{H}$ is particularly challenging: reflectivity is a nonlinear, microphysics-dependent diagnostic quantity that only indirectly relates to the model's prognostic variables, making traditional parameterised radar operators complex, regime-dependent and difficult to tune. In this study, we propose a neural-network (NN)-based observation operator for radar reflectivity and apply it within a 3DVar framework. Using five years (2019-2023) of radar reflectivity data from the Lisca radar and 4.4 km-resolution short-range forecasts from ALADIN model over Slovenia, we train a convolutional encoder-decoder neural network to map model temperature, humidity, horizontal wind components and surface pressure fields to radar reflectivity. Across independent test cases spanning clear-sky, stratiform, and convective regimes, the NN-based operator accurately reproduces the spatial structure and intensity of observed reflectivity, relying primarily on the model state near the observation point. In the extreme precipitation case, which caused widespread floods in Slovenia on August 4, 2023, assimilating the full radar disc reduces the domain-averaged reflectivity root-mean-square error from 5.99 dBZ to 3.47 dBZ and improves the alignment between the analysed and observed convective bands. Embedded within 3DVar, the Jacobian of the NN observation operator allows radar reflectivity observations to inform model state variables, producing corresponding analysis increments. The proposed NN radar observation operator offers a flexible alternative to traditional parameterised radar operators for improving convective-storm forecasts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经网络的观测算子，用于天气雷达反射率的三维变分数据同化（3DVar），以替代传统参数化雷达算子。利用斯洛文尼亚5年雷达数据和ALADIN模型4.4 km分辨率短时预报训练卷积编码器-解码器网络，将模型温湿风压等变量映射为雷达反射率。在独立测试中，该算子在不同天气条件下准确再现反射率空间结构和强度；在2023年8月4日极端降水同化实验中，域平均反射率均方根误差从5.99 dBZ降至3.47 dBZ，并改善对流带分析。
Motivation: 传统参数化雷达反射率同化算子复杂、依赖天气状况且难以调优，需要一种灵活、数据驱动的替代方案以提升对流尺度天气预报。
Method: 设计卷积编码器-解码器神经网络作为观测算子，输入为ALADIN模型输出的温度、湿度、水平风分量和地面气压，输出为雷达反射率。将该算子嵌入3DVar框架，利用其Jacobian矩阵使反射率观测反作用于模型状态变量。训练数据为2019-2023年斯洛文尼亚Lisca雷达反射率及对应4.4 km分辨率短时预报。
Result: 在晴空、层状云和对流云独立测试中，NN算子准确再现观测反射率。极端降水事件（2023年8月4日斯洛文尼亚洪水）同化整盘雷达数据使域平均反射率RMSE从5.99 dBZ降至3.47 dBZ，分析场与观测对流带对齐改善。
Conclusion: 神经网络观测算子是传统参数化算子的灵活替代方案，能利用雷达反射率改进对流风暴预报。
Relevance: 95

papers.title: HD-Prot: A Protein Language Model for Joint Sequence-Structure Modeling with Continuous Structure Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Proteins inherently possess a consistent sequence-structure duality. The abundance of protein sequence data, which can be readily represented as discrete tokens, has driven fruitful developments in protein language models (pLMs). A key remaining challenge, however, is how to effectively integrate continuous structural knowledge into pLMs. Current methods often discretize protein structures to accommodate the language modeling framework, which inevitably results in the loss of fine-grained information and limits the performance potential of multimodal pLMs. In this paper, we argue that such concerns can be circumvented: a sequence-based pLM can be extended to incorporate the structure modality through continuous tokens, i.e., high-fidelity protein structure latents that avoid vector quantization. Specifically, we propose a hybrid diffusion protein language model, HD-Prot, which embeds a continuous-valued diffusion head atop a discrete pLM, enabling seamless operation with both discrete and continuous tokens for joint sequence-structure modeling. It captures inter-token dependencies across modalities through a unified absorbing diffusion process, and estimates per-token distributions via categorical prediction for sequences and continuous diffusion for structures. Extensive results demonstrate that HD-Prot achieves competitive performance in unconditional sequence-structure co-generation, motif-scaffolding, protein structure prediction, and inverse folding tasks. Furthermore, our method can perform on par with state-of-the-art multimodal pLMs, despite being developed under limited computational resources (i.e., less than one-tenth the budget for modality extension fine-tuning). It highlights the viability of simultaneously estimating categorical and continuous distributions within a unified language model architecture, offering a promising alternative direction for multimodal pLMs.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HD-Prot，一种混合扩散蛋白质语言模型，通过连续结构令牌（continuous structure tokens）联合建模蛋白质序列和结构。模型在离散语言模型之上叠加连续扩散头，采用统一吸收扩散过程捕获跨模态依赖，并分别对序列进行类别预测、对结构进行连续扩散。实验表明，HD-Prot在无条件序列-结构共生成、基序支架、蛋白质结构预测和反向折叠任务上均取得竞争性能，且仅需不到十分之一的微调预算即可媲美最先进的多模态蛋白质语言模型。
Motivation: 现有蛋白质语言模型难以有效整合连续结构信息，常用方法通过离散化结构导致细粒度信息损失，限制多模态模型性能。
Method: 提出HD-Prot，在离散蛋白质语言模型上嵌入连续值扩散头，通过统一吸收扩散过程联合处理离散序列令牌和连续结构令牌，实现序列和结构的端到端建模。
Result: 在无条件序列-结构共生成、基序支架、蛋白质结构预测和反向折叠任务上取得竞争性能；在有限计算资源（少于十分之一的模态扩展微调预算）下达到与最先进多模态蛋白质语言模型相当的水平。
Conclusion: 证明在统一语言模型架构中同时估计类别分布和连续分布是可行的，为多模态蛋白质语言模型提供了有前景的替代方向。

papers.title: Improving Pre-trained Adult Glioma Segmentation Models Using only Post-processing Techniques
papers.abstract_en: Gliomas are the most common malignant brain tumors in adults and are among the most lethal. Despite aggressive treatment, the median survival rate is less than 15 months. Accurate multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) tumor segmentation is critical for surgical planning, radiotherapy, and disease monitoring. While deep learning models have improved the accuracy of automated segmentation, large-scale pre-trained models generalize poorly and often underperform, producing systematic errors such as false positives, label swaps, and slice discontinuities in slices. These limitations are further compounded by unequal access to GPU resources and the growing environmental cost of large-scale model training. In this work, we propose adaptive post-processing techniques to refine the quality of glioma segmentations produced by large-scale pretrained models developed for various types of tumors. We demonstrated the techniques in multiple BraTS 2025 segmentation challenge tasks, with the ranking metric improving by 14.9 % for the sub-Saharan Africa challenge and 0.9% for the adult glioma challenge. This approach promotes a shift in brain tumor segmentation research from increasingly complex model architectures to efficient, clinically aligned post-processing strategies that are precise, computationally fair, and sustainable.

papers.title: Adaptable Segmentation Pipeline for Diverse Brain Tumors with Radiomic-Guided Subtyping and Lesion-Wise Model Ensemble
papers.abstract_en: Robust and generalizable segmentation of brain tumors on multi-parametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) remains difficult because tumor types differ widely. The BraTS 2025 Lighthouse Challenge benchmarks segmentation methods on diverse high-quality datasets of adult and pediatric tumors: multi-consortium international pediatric brain tumor segmentation (PED), preoperative meningioma tumor segmentation (MEN), meningioma radiotherapy segmentation (MEN-RT), and segmentation of pre- and post-treatment brain metastases (MET). We present a flexible, modular, and adaptable pipeline that improves segmentation performance by selecting and combining state-of-the-art models and applying tumor- and lesion-specific processing before and after training. Radiomic features extracted from MRI help detect tumor subtype, ensuring a more balanced training. Custom lesion-level performance metrics determine the influence of each model in the ensemble and optimize post-processing that further refines the predictions, enabling the workflow to tailor every step to each case. On the BraTS testing sets, our pipeline achieved performance comparable to top-ranked algorithms across multiple challenges. These findings confirm that custom lesion-aware processing and model selection yield robust segmentations yet without locking the method to a specific network architecture. Our method has the potential for quantitative tumor measurement in clinical practice, supporting diagnosis and prognosis.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种灵活、模块化的脑肿瘤分割流程，针对多种MRI数据集（儿童、脑膜瘤、脑转移瘤）进行适配。通过放射组学特征辅助肿瘤亚型分类，并利用病灶级模型集成和后处理优化，在BraTS测试集上达到与顶尖算法相当的性能。

Result: 在BraTS 2025挑战测试集上，该方法与多个挑战的顶级算法性能相当。

papers.title: Measurement Plasticity: Sensor-Level Adaptation for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose Multi-View Physical-prompt (MVP) for Test-Time Adaptation (TTA), a forward-only framework that moves TTA from tokens to photons by treating the camera exposure triangle (i.e., ISO, shutter speed, and aperture) as physical prompts. At inference, MVP acquires selected multiple physical views using a source-affinity score, evaluates digitally augmented variants of each retained view and filters the lowest-entropy predictions, and aggregates predictions with hard voting. This selection-then-vote design is simple, calibration-friendly, and requires no gradients or model modifications. On ImageNet-ES and ImageNet-ES-Diverse, MVP outperforms digital-only TTA on both Auto-Exposure and a combination with conventional sensor control. MVP remains effective under reduced parameter candidates that lower capture latency, demonstrating its practicality.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多视角物理提示（MVP）用于测试时适应（TTA），通过相机曝光三角（ISO、快门速度、光圈）作为物理提示，在推理时选择多个物理视角并利用源亲和度评分，对保留视图进行数字增强和低熵过滤，最后硬投票聚合预测。在ImageNet-ES和ImageNet-ES-Diverse上，MVP优于纯数字TTA，且在减少候选参数时仍有效。
Motivation: 现有测试时适应方法通常仅关注数字域调整，忽略了传感器层面的物理参数对模型鲁棒性的影响；本文旨在通过物理提示实现更高效的TTA。
Method: 采用前向传播框架：基于源亲和度评分选择多物理视角；对每个保留视图生成数字增强变体并筛选最低熵预测；通过硬投票聚合最终预测。无需梯度或修改模型。
Result: 在ImageNet-ES和ImageNet-ES-Diverse上，MVP在自动曝光及与常规传感器控制组合场景下均优于纯数字TTA；在减少参数候选以降低捕获延迟时仍保持有效性。
Conclusion: 提出一种简单、无需梯度、校准友好的物理层TTA方法，展示了在传感器级别进行适应的实用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Navigating Gigapixel Pathology Images with Large Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large multimodal models have allowed for the development of interactive chat models that can converse and reason about pathology whole-slide images (WSIs). However, existing slide-level chat systems are often highly specialized, typically compressing WSIs into fixed slide-level embeddings or relying on multi-component pipelines, which can lose multi-scale detail and limit generalizability beyond the target task. We present GIANT (Gigapixel Image Agent for Navigating Tissue), a simple, training-free approach that lets general-purpose multimodal models navigate WSIs on their own, iteratively selecting multi-magnification crops and aggregating evidence over time. To evaluate generalizability in WSI question answering and to promote reproducibility, we introduce MultiPathQA, a benchmark suite spanning five clinical challenges and 934 questions over 868 unique WSIs. This includes a new set of 128 pathologist-authored multiple-choice questions designed to mirror real diagnostic search and multi-scale reasoning. Using GPT-5, GIANT outperforms models specialized for pathology question answering, achieving state-of-the-art performance on four out of five benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GIANT，一种无需训练的通用多模态模型方法，能够自主导航全切片病理图像（WSI），通过迭代选择多放大倍数裁剪并聚合证据来回答问题。为评估泛化性，引入 MultiPathQA 基准，涵盖五个临床挑战和 934 个问题。使用 GPT-5，GIANT 在五个基准中的四个上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有病理图像对话系统通常将 WSI 压缩为固定 embedding 或依赖多组件流水线，丢失多尺度细节且泛化性有限。
Method: GIANT 是一种免训练的框架，允许通用多模态模型自主导航 WSI，逐步选择多放大倍数子区域并聚合信息。
Result: 在 MultiPathQA 基准上，GIANT 使用 GPT-5 在五个任务中的四个上超越专用病理问答模型。
Conclusion: GIANT 展示了通用多模态模型无需专门训练即可处理十亿像素级病理图像问答的潜力，但限于病理领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Visually Interpretable Oscillator Networks for Soft Continuum Robots from Video
papers.abstract_en: Learning soft continuum robot (SCR) dynamics from video offers flexibility but existing methods lack interpretability or rely on prior assumptions. Model-based approaches require prior knowledge and manual design. We bridge this gap by introducing: (1) The Attention Broadcast Decoder (ABCD), a plug-and-play module for autoencoder-based latent dynamics learning that generates pixel-accurate attention maps localizing each latent dimension's contribution while filtering static backgrounds, enabling visual interpretability via spatially grounded latents and on-image overlays. (2) Visual Oscillator Networks (VONs), a 2D latent oscillator network coupled to ABCD attention maps for on-image visualization of learned masses, coupling stiffness, and forces, thereby enabling mechanical interpretability. We validate our approach on single- and double-segment SCRs, demonstrating that ABCD-based models significantly improve multi-step prediction accuracy with 5.8x error reduction for Koopman operators and 3.5x for oscillator networks on a two-segment robot. VONs autonomously discover a chain structure of oscillators. This fully data-driven approach yields compact, mechanically interpretable models with potential relevance for future control applications.
papers.comment: Code available at: https://github.com/UThenrik/visual_oscillators_for_SCR Dataset available at: https://zenodo.org/records/17812071 Video available at: https://youtu.be/i80H8erVISM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出从视频学习软体连续体机器人 (SCR) 动力学的方法，包含两个组件：Attention Broadcast Decoder (ABCD) 生成像素级注意力图，实现视觉可解释性；Visual Oscillator Networks (VONs) 作为二维潜振荡器网络，耦合注意力图以显示质量、耦合刚度和力，实现机械可解释性。在单段和双段SCR上验证，ABCD使Koopman算子多步预测误差降低5.8倍，振荡器网络降低3.5倍，VONs自主发现振荡器链结构。
Motivation: 现有从视频学习机器人动力学的方法缺乏可解释性或依赖先验假设，基于模型的方法需要先验知识和手动设计。本文旨在弥合这一差距。
Method: 引入Attention Broadcast Decoder (ABCD)，作为自编码器潜动力学学习的即插即用模块，生成像素级注意力图以定位每个潜维度的贡献并过滤静态背景；同时引入Visual Oscillator Networks (VONs)，一种二维潜振荡器网络，与ABCD注意力图耦合，实现机械可解释性。
Result: 在单段和双段SCR上，ABCD基于的模型显著提升多步预测精度：对Koopman算子误差降低5.8倍，对振荡器网络降低3.5倍（双段机器人）。VONs自主发现振荡器的链结构。
Conclusion: 完全数据驱动的方法生成紧凑且机械可解释的模型，对未来控制应用具有潜在意义。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QueryOcc: Query-based Self-Supervision for 3D Semantic Occupancy
papers.abstract_en: Learning 3D scene geometry and semantics from images is a core challenge in computer vision and a key capability for autonomous driving. Since large-scale 3D annotation is prohibitively expensive, recent work explores self-supervised learning directly from sensor data without manual labels. Existing approaches either rely on 2D rendering consistency, where 3D structure emerges only implicitly, or on discretized voxel grids from accumulated lidar point clouds, limiting spatial precision and scalability. We introduce QueryOcc, a query-based self-supervised framework that learns continuous 3D semantic occupancy directly through independent 4D spatio-temporal queries sampled across adjacent frames. The framework supports supervision from either pseudo-point clouds derived from vision foundation models or raw lidar data. To enable long-range supervision and reasoning under constant memory, we introduce a contractive scene representation that preserves near-field detail while smoothly compressing distant regions. QueryOcc surpasses previous camera-based methods by 26% in semantic RayIoU on the self-supervised Occ3D-nuScenes benchmark while running at 11.6 FPS, demonstrating that direct 4D query supervision enables strong self-supervised occupancy learning. https://research.zenseact.com/publications/queryocc/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QueryOcc，一种基于查询的自监督框架，通过4D时空查询学习连续3D语义占用，无需手动标注。利用伪点云或激光雷达数据监督，并引入收缩场景表示以在恒定内存下实现远程监督。在自监督Occ3D-nuScenes基准上，语义RayIoU比先前基于相机的方法提升26%，推理速度达11.6 FPS。
Motivation: 现有自监督3D语义占用学习方法依赖2D渲染一致性（3D结构隐式）或从累积激光雷达点云得到的离散体素网格，限制了空间精度和可扩展性。需要一种直接学习连续3D占用的自监督方法。
Method: 提出基于查询的自监督框架QueryOcc，通过独立4D时空查询采样相邻帧，支持从视觉基础模型生成的伪点云或原始激光雷达数据监督。引入收缩场景表示，在保持恒定内存下保留近场细节并压缩远处区域。
Result: 在自监督Occ3D-nuScenes基准上，语义RayIoU比先前基于相机的方法提升26%，推理速度达11.6 FPS。
Conclusion: 直接4D查询监督能够实现强大的自监督占用学习，为无需人工标注的3D场景理解提供了有效途径。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Proto-LeakNet: Towards Signal-Leak Aware Attribution in Synthetic Human Face Imagery
papers.abstract_en: The growing sophistication of synthetic image and deepfake generation models has turned source attribution and authenticity verification into a critical challenge for modern computer vision systems. Recent studies suggest that diffusion pipelines unintentionally imprint persistent statistical traces, known as signal-leaks, within their outputs, particularly in latent representations. Building on this observation, we propose Proto-LeakNet, a signal-leak-aware and interpretable attribution framework that integrates Closed-set classification with a density-based Open-set evaluation on the learned embeddings, enabling analysis of unseen generators without retraining. Acting in the latent domain of diffusion models, our method re-simulates partial forward diffusion to expose residual generator-specific cues. A temporal attention encoder aggregates multi-step latent features, while a feature-weighted prototype head structures the embedding space and enables transparent attribution. Trained solely on closed data and achieving a Macro AUC of 98.13\%, Proto-LeakNet learns a latent geometry that remains robust under post-processing, surpassing state-of-the-art methods, and achieves strong separability both between real images and known generators, and between known and unseen ones. The codebase is available at the following link: https://github.com/claudiunderthehood/Proto-LeakNet .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Proto-LeakNet，一个基于信号泄漏的合成人脸图像归因框架。该方法利用扩散模型潜空间中的残留生成器特定痕迹，通过部分正向扩散重模拟、时序注意力编码器和特征加权原型头进行闭合集分类和开放集检测，在闭集训练下达到98.13%的Macro AUC，超越现有方法。
Motivation: 合成图像和深度伪造生成模型的日益成熟使得来源归因和真实性验证成为关键挑战，现有方法往往无法处理未见生成器。
Method: 在扩散模型的潜域中部分重模拟正向扩散以暴露残留生成器特定线索，使用时序注意力编码器聚合多步潜特征，并通过特征加权原型头结构化嵌入空间实现可解释归因，结合闭合集分类与基于密度的开放集评估。
Result: 仅在闭集数据上训练，Macro AUC达到98.13%，对后处理具有鲁棒性，在真实图像与已知生成器、已知与未见生成器之间均实现强分离。
Conclusion: Proto-LeakNet展示了信号泄漏感知归因的有效性，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0
