papers.title: Efficient Solvers for SLOPE in R, Python, Julia, and C++
papers.abstract_en: We present a suite of packages in R, Python, Julia, and C++ that efficiently solve the Sorted L-One Penalized Estimation (SLOPE) problem. The packages feature a highly efficient hybrid coordinate descent algorithm that fits generalized linear models (GLMs) and supports a variety of loss functions, including Gaussian, binomial, Poisson, and multinomial logistic regression. Our implementation is designed to be fast, memory-efficient, and flexible. The packages support a variety of data structures (dense, sparse, and out-of-memory matrices) and are designed to efficiently fit the full SLOPE path as well as handle cross-validation of SLOPE models, including the relaxed SLOPE. We present examples of how to use the packages and benchmarks that demonstrate the performance of the packages on both real and simulated data and show that our packages outperform existing implementations of SLOPE in terms of speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了在R、Python、Julia和C++中高效求解SLOPE（有序L1惩罚估计）问题的软件包。这些包采用高效的混合坐标下降算法，支持多种损失函数（高斯、二项、泊松、多项逻辑回归）和数据结构（稠密、稀疏、外存矩阵），能够拟合完整的SLOPE路径并进行交叉验证，包括松弛SLOPE。
Motivation: SLOPE方法在统计建模中具有优势，但现有实现速度较慢，限制了其应用。
Method: 提出一套混合坐标下降算法的高效实现，支持多种广义线性模型和数据结构，并优化了内存使用。
Result: 在真实和模拟数据上的基准测试表明，这些包在速度上优于现有的SLOPE实现。
Conclusion: 这些软件包为SLOPE提供了高效、灵活的计算工具，有助于推广其应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Toward General Digraph Contrastive Learning: A Dual Spatial Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) has emerged as a powerful tool for extracting consistent representations from graphs, independent of labeled information. However, existing methods predominantly focus on undirected graphs, disregarding the pivotal directional information that is fundamental and indispensable in real-world networks (e.g., social networks and recommendations).In this paper, we introduce S2-DiGCL, a novel framework that emphasizes spatial insights from complex and real domain perspectives for directed graph (digraph) contrastive learning. From the complex-domain perspective, S2-DiGCL introduces personalized perturbations into the magnetic Laplacian to adaptively modulate edge phases and directional semantics. From the real-domain perspective, it employs a path-based subgraph augmentation strategy to capture fine-grained local asymmetries and topological dependencies. By jointly leveraging these two complementary spatial views, S2-DiGCL constructs high-quality positive and negative samples, leading to more general and robust digraph contrastive learning. Extensive experiments on 7 real-world digraph datasets demonstrate the superiority of our approach, achieving SOTA performance with 4.41% improvement in node classification and 4.34% in link prediction under both supervised and unsupervised settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出S2-DiGCL框架，用于有向图的对比学习。从复域角度，在磁拉普拉斯中引入个性化扰动来自适应调节边相位和方向语义；从实域角度，采用基于路径的子图增强策略捕捉局部非对称性和拓扑依赖性。在7个有向图数据集上，节点分类和链接预测分别提升4.41%和4.34%。
Motivation: 现有图对比学习主要针对无向图，忽略了有向图的方向信息，这在社交网络和推荐系统中至关重要。
Method: 提出S2-DiGCL框架，包含复域视角（个性化扰动磁拉普拉斯）和实域视角（基于路径的子图增强），联合利用两种空间视角构建高质量正负样本。
Result: 在7个真实世界有向图数据集上达到SOTA，节点分类提升4.41%，链接预测提升4.34%（监督和无监督设置下）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用互补的复域和实域空间视角可以提升有向图对比学习的通用性和鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GAE: Unleashing Physical Potential of VLM with Generalizable Action Expert
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models demonstrate strong reasoning and planning abilities, yet grounding these predictions into precise robot actions remains a central challenge. Existing Vision-Language-Action methods typically entangle reasoning and action generation, leading to limited generalization. We propose Generalizable Action Expert (GAE), a task-agnostic model that converts sparse geometric plans into dense robot actions. Our approach introduces a sparse geometric interface: the VLM predicts sparse 3D waypoints representing high-level intention, while GAE maps these waypoints together with real-time point cloud observations to continuous action trajectories. GAE is pretrained on a large-scale pointcloud-trajectory dataset comprising 150k trajectories from both simulation and real-world robots. To further improve efficiency and generalization, we introduce an Action Pre-training, Pointcloud Fine-tuning (APPF) scheme that decouples learning action dynamics from geometry grounding. After pretraining, GAE is frozen and reused across downstream tasks, requiring only lightweight fine-tuning of the VLM to produce the sparse interface. Experiments show that our method achieves strong performance and generalization across diverse visual domains, camera viewpoints, and natural language instructions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Generalizable Action Expert (GAE)，一个任务无关的模型，将稀疏几何规划（VLM 预测的 3D 路径点）与实时点云观测结合，生成连续机器人动作。在包含 15 万条轨迹的大规模点云-轨迹数据集上预训练，采用动作预训练、点云微调 (APPF) 方案，冻结 GAE 后仅需轻量微调 VLM。实验表明在多种视觉领域、视角和自然语言指令下具有强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作方法将推理和动作生成纠缠在一起，导致泛化能力有限。需要将两者解耦以提升泛化性。
Method: 引入稀疏几何接口：VLM 预测稀疏 3D 路径点作为高层意图，GAE 将这些路径点与实时点云观测映射到连续动作轨迹。采用 APPF 方案，先在大规模点云-轨迹数据上预训练动作动力学，再通过点云微调几何接地。预训练后 GAE 冻结，仅需微调 VLM 以产生稀疏接口。
Result: 在包含 15 万条轨迹（仿真与真实机器人）的数据集上预训练，在多种视觉域、不同相机视角和自然语言指令下实现强性能和泛化。
Conclusion: GAE 通过解耦推理与动作生成，结合大规模预训练和冻结重用，提升了机器人动作生成的泛化性与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Evolving Vision-Language Models for Image Quality Assessment via Voting and Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Improving vision-language models (VLMs) in the post-training stage typically relies on supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning, methods that necessitate costly, human-annotated data. While self-supervised techniques have proven effective for enhancing reasoning capabilities, their application to perceptual domains such as image quality assessment (IQA) remains largely unexplored. In this work, we introduce EvoQuality, a novel framework that enables a VLM to autonomously refine its quality perception capabilities without any ground-truth labels. EvoQuality adapts the principle of self-consistency to the ranking-based nature of IQA. It generates pseudo-labels by performing pairwise majority voting on the VLM's own outputs to establish a consensus on relative quality. These pseudo-rankings are then formulated into a fidelity reward that guides the model's iterative evolution through group relative policy optimization (GRPO). By iteratively leveraging its own predictions, EvoQuality progressively refines the VLM's perceptual capability. Extensive experiments show that EvoQuality boosts the base VLM's zero-shot performance by 31.8% on PLCC across diverse IQA benchmarks. Remarkably, despite being entirely self-supervised, EvoQuality achieves performance that is competitive with, or even surpasses, state-of-the-art supervised VLM-based IQA models, outperforming these models on 5 out of 7 IQA benchmarks. Furthermore, the framework demonstrates significant flexibility, allowing it to be stacked with pre-trained IQA models to bolster generalization on unseen datasets. Codes and checkpoints will be available at https://github.com/bytedance/EvoQuality.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoQuality 框架，使视觉语言模型（VLM）无需人工标注即可自主提升图像质量评估能力。通过自一致性原则生成伪排名标签，利用组相对策略优化（GRPO）迭代优化模型感知能力。在多个 IQA 基准上，零样本 PLCC 提升 31.8%，性能可与有监督的 SOTA VLM 模型竞争或超越。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 后训练依赖昂贵的人工标注数据，而自监督方法在感知领域（如图像质量评估）尚未充分探索。
Method: 提出 EvoQuality，基于自一致性原则对 VLM 自身输出进行成对多数投票以建立相对质量共识作为伪标签，通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）迭代优化模型。
Result: 在 7 个 IQA 基准上零样本 PLCC 提升 31.8%，在 5 个基准上超越有监督 VLM 模型，且可与预训练 IQA 模型堆叠提升泛化性。
Conclusion: EvoQuality 表明无需人工标注即可通过自监督方式显著提升 VLM 在图像质量评估中的感知能力，且具有良好的灵活性和泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BrainPro: Towards Large-scale Brain State-aware EEG Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Electroencephalography (EEG) reflects underlying brain states, whose activities are distributed across brain regions and manifest as spatial patterns on the scalp. Learning these spatially structured, state-related patterns requires consistent spatial representations across datasets. However, existing EEG foundation models are typically based on self-attention, which does not preserve location-specific information and struggles to align signals recorded with different channel configurations. Moreover, brain states contain both shared and state-specific regional activity, suggesting that learning neurophysiologically plausible, state-aware representations can complement the shared representations targeted by current models and improve downstream decoding. To address these limitations, we propose BrainPro, a large EEG model that combines a retrieval-based spatial learning mechanism for cross-layout spatial alignment with a brain state-decoupling module that learns both shared and state-specific representations through parallel encoders and region-aware reconstruction. Pre-trained on a large EEG corpus, BrainPro achieves state-of-the-art performance across nine public BCI datasets spanning emotion, motor, speech, stress, mental disease, and attention tasks. Analyses of spatial filters, channel-drop robustness, and encoder contributions further validate the effectiveness of its spatial alignment and state-aware pathways. These results show that BrainPro achieves improved interpretability of learned spatial patterns and produces representations that benefit diverse EEG decoding tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BrainPro，一个大规模脑电图（EEG）基础模型，通过检索式空间学习机制实现跨通道布局的空间对齐，并引入脑状态解耦模块学习共享和状态特定的表示。在九个公共BCI数据集上，涉及情绪、运动、语音、压力、心理疾病和注意力任务，BrainPro取得最先进性能，并展示了更好的可解释性。
Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型通常基于自注意力机制，无法保持位置特定信息且难以对齐不同通道配置的信号；此外，脑状态包含共享和状态特定的区域活动，现有模型只学习共享表示，限制了下游解码性能。
Method: BrainPro包含两个核心组件：（1）检索式空间学习机制，用于跨布局空间对齐；（2）脑状态解耦模块，通过并行编码器和区域感知重建学习共享和状态特定表示。在大规模EEG语料库上预训练。
Result: 在九个公共BCI数据集上，BrainPro在情绪、运动、语音、压力、心理疾病和注意力任务中取得最先进性能。空间滤波器分析、通道丢失鲁棒性和编码器贡献验证了空间对齐和状态感知路径的有效性。
Conclusion: BrainPro通过学习神经生理学上合理的、状态感知的表示，改进了脑电空间模式的可解释性，并为多样化的EEG解码任务提供了有益的表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Skeleton Sparsification and Densification Scale-Spaces
papers.abstract_en: The Hamilton-Jacobi skeleton, also known as the medial axis, is a powerful shape descriptor that represents binary objects in terms of the centres of maximal inscribed discs. Despite its broad applicability, the medial axis suffers from sensitivity to noise: Minor boundary variations can lead to disproportionately large and undesirable expansions of the skeleton. Classical pruning methods mitigate this shortcoming by systematically removing extraneous skeletal branches. This sequential simplification of skeletons resembles the principle of sparsification scale-spaces that embed images into a family of reconstructions from increasingly sparse pixel representations. We combine both worlds by introducing skeletonisation scale-spaces: They leverage sparsification of the medial axis to achieve hierarchical simplification of shapes. Unlike conventional pruning, our framework inherently satisfies key scale-space properties such as hierarchical architecture, controllable simplification, and equivariance to geometric transformations. We provide a rigorous theoretical foundation in both continuous and discrete formulations and extend the concept further with densification. By growing the skeleton successively instead of shrinking it, we allow inverse progression from coarse to fine scales. Densification scale-spaces can even reach beyond the original skeleton to produce overcomplete shape representations with relevancy for practical applications. Through proof-of-concept experiments, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework for practical tasks including robust skeletonisation, shape compression, and stiffness enhancement for additive manufacturing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出骨架化尺度空间 (skeletonisation scale-spaces)，通过中轴 (medial axis) 的稀疏化实现形状的分层简化，并引入稠密化尺度空间实现从粗到细的逆过程。理论框架涵盖连续和离散形式，实验展示了在鲁棒骨架化、形状压缩和增材制造刚度增强中的应用。
Motivation: 经典中轴对噪声敏感，边界微小变化会导致骨架过度扩展；现有剪枝方法虽能简化但缺乏尺度空间性质。
Method: 将图像稀疏化尺度空间的思想推广到骨架，通过稀疏化中轴实现层次化简化；同时引入稠密化，通过逐步生长骨架实现逆尺度空间。
Result: 通过概念验证实验，框架在鲁棒骨架化、形状压缩和增材制造刚度增强等任务中有效。
Conclusion: 方法天然满足层次结构、可控简化和几何变换等变性等尺度空间性质，并提供了连续与离散的理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Metriplectic Conditional Flow Matching for Dissipative Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Metriplectic conditional flow matching (MCFM) learns dissipative dynamics without violating first principles. Neural surrogates often inject energy and destabilize long-horizon rollouts; MCFM instead builds the conservative-dissipative split into both the vector field and a structure preserving sampler. MCFM trains via conditional flow matching on short transitions, avoiding long rollout adjoints. In inference, a Strang-prox scheme alternates a symplectic update with a proximal metric step, ensuring discrete energy decay; an optional projection enforces strict decay when a trusted energy is available. We provide continuous and discrete time guarantees linking this parameterization and sampler to conservation, monotonic dissipation, and stable rollouts. On a controlled mechanical benchmark, MCFM yields phase portraits closer to ground truth and markedly fewer energy-increase and positive energy rate events than an equally expressive unconstrained neural flow, while matching terminal distributional fit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出度量条件流匹配（MCFM），用于学习耗散动力学而不违反第一原理。MCFM将保守-耗散分解同时构建到向量场和结构保持采样器中，通过短过渡的条件流匹配训练，避免长展开伴随。在推理时，Strang-prox方案交替辛更新和近端度量步骤，确保离散能量衰减。在受控机械基准上，MCFM产生的相轨迹更接近真实，且能量增加和正能量率事件显著少于无约束神经流。
Motivation: 神经替代模型常注入能量并导致长期展开不稳定；现有方法缺乏对保守-耗散结构的内在保持。
Method: 提出Metriplectic条件流匹配（MCFM），将保守-耗散分解融入向量场和采样器。训练使用短过渡的条件流匹配，推理使用Strang-prox方案（辛更新+近端度量步骤），可选投影强制严格衰减。
Result: 在受控机械基准上，MCFM的相轨迹更接近真实，能量增加和正能量率事件显著少于同等表达能力的无约束神经流，同时匹配终端分布拟合。
Conclusion: 提供了连续和离散时间保证，证明了参数化和采样器与守恒、单调耗散和稳定展开的关联。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structuring The Future: Diffusion LLM Speculative Decoding via Calibrated Draft Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a powerful alternative to autoregressive LLMs (AR-LLMs) with the potential to operate at significantly higher token-generation rates. To unlock this potential, we present Spiffy, a speculative decoding algorithm to accelerate dLLM inference while provably preserving the model's output distribution. This work addresses the unique challenges involved in applying ideas from speculative decoding of AR-LLMs to dLLMs. Spiffy performs auto-speculation to eliminate the overheads of an independent draft model, structuring draft states in the form of a novel directed draft graph to take advantage of the bidirectional, blockwise nature of dLLM generation. These draft graphs are calibrated offline to maximize acceptance rates and are dynamically pruned during inference for improved computational efficiency. We present a detailed formulation of Spiffy and demonstrate its ability to accelerate LLaDA, Dream, and SDAR models in combination with KV caching and threshold-based dynamic unmasking leading to up to $8.6\times$ reduction in model inferences and $6.3\times$ acceleration in token rate.

papers.title: PLaID++: A Preference Aligned Language Model for Targeted Inorganic Materials Design
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising approach to improve correctness in LLMs, however, in many scientific problems, the objective is not necessarily to produce the correct answer, but instead to produce a diverse array of candidates which satisfy a set of constraints. We study this challenge in the context of materials generation. To this end, we introduce PLaID++, an LLM post-trained for stable and property-guided crystal generation. We find that performance hinges on our crystallographic representation and reward formulation. First, we introduce a compact, symmetry-informed Wyckoff text representation which improves computational efficiency and encourages generalization from physical priors. Second, we demonstrate that temperature scaling acts as an entropy regularizer which counteracts mode collapse and encourages exploration. By encoding symmetry constraints directly into text and guiding model outputs towards desirable chemical space, PLaID++ generates structures that are thermodynamically stable, unique, and novel at a $\sim$50\% greater rate than prior methods and conditionally generates structures with desired space group properties. Our work demonstrates the potential of adapting post-training techniques from natural language processing to materials design, paving the way for targeted and efficient discovery of novel materials.
papers.comment: Code available at https://github.com/andaero/PLaID, model weights at https://huggingface.co/HOPE-Lab-HMC/PLaID
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PLaID++，一个基于强化学习从可验证奖励（RLVR）后训练的语言模型，用于目标无机材料设计。通过引入对称感知的Wyckoff文本表示和温度缩放熵正则化，该模型在生成稳定、唯一且新颖的晶体结构方面比先前方法提高约50%，并能按空间群属性条件生成结构。
Motivation: 在材料生成等科学问题中，目标不是单一正确答案，而是满足约束的多样化候选集；现有后训练技术主要针对正确性，缺乏对多样性和约束满足的引导。
Method: 采用RLVR后训练流程，结合紧凑的Wyckoff文本表示（编码对称性约束）和温度缩放作为熵正则化，防止模式崩溃并鼓励探索。
Result: 生成的晶体结构在热力学稳定性、唯一性和新颖性方面比先前方法提高约50%，并能条件生成具有所需空间群属性的结构。
Conclusion: 证明了将自然语言处理的后训练技术迁移到材料设计领域的潜力，为定向高效发现新材料铺平道路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DiffCoord: Differentiable Coordination for Distributed Multi-Agent Trajectory Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Integrating the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) with Differential Dynamic Programming (DDP) provides a scalable framework for distributed multi-agent trajectory optimization. In practice, ADMM is typically truncated for computational efficiency, tightly coupling parameters that would otherwise separately govern coordination quality and task performance. In this paper, we propose Differentiable Coordination (DiffCoord), a unified framework that jointly meta-learns these coupled parameters for the truncated ADMM-DDP pipeline. These parameters are generated by agent-wise neural networks for task adaptation, and the same networks are shared among isomorphic agents to enable scalability to varying agent counts. We achieve efficient meta-learning by differentiating the ADMM-DDP pipeline end-to-end. Notably, this yields an auxiliary ADMM-LQR distributed gradient solver that computes and coordinates meta-gradients with respect to these parameters. This solver inherits the computational structure of the pipeline, enabling reuse of key computation results and efficient parallelization over agents and along trajectory horizons. We validate DiffCoord through numerical and physical experiments on a cooperative aerial transport system, where it reconfigures quadrotor formations for safe 6-DoF load manipulation in tight spaces. It adapts robustly to varying team sizes and load dynamics, while reducing per-agent gradient computation time by up to 70% compared with state-of-the-art trajectory-gradient methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DiffCoord，一个将ADMM和DDP结合的可微协调框架，用于分布式多智能体轨迹优化。通过端到端元学习，联合优化截断ADMM-DDP流水线中的耦合参数，由智能体神经网络生成，并在同构智能体间共享。在协作空中运输系统中，该方法实现了对四旋翼编队的鲁棒重新配置，并降低了梯度计算时间。
Motivation: 现有的ADMM与DDP结合在分布式多智能体轨迹优化中，由于计算效率常被截断，导致原本应分别控制协调质量和任务性能的参数耦合在一起，难以独立优化。
Method: 提出可微协调（DiffCoord）框架，通过端到端微分ADMM-DDP流水线，元学习生成耦合参数的智能体神经网络。利用辅助ADMM-LQR分布式梯度求解器计算和协调元梯度，该求解器重用流水线中的关键计算结果，实现高效并行化。
Result: 在协作空中运输系统中，该方法实现了四旋翼编队在狭小空间内进行6自由度负载操纵的编队重配置，鲁棒适应不同团队规模和负载动力学，与最先进的轨迹梯度方法相比，每个智能体的梯度计算时间减少了高达70%。
Conclusion: DiffCoord通过可微元学习有效解耦了截断ADMM-DDP中的协调与任务参数，提升了分布式多智能体轨迹优化的效率和适应性。

papers.title: Adaptive generative moment matching networks for improved learning of dependence structures
papers.abstract_en: An adaptive bandwidth selection procedure for the mixture kernel in the maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) for fitting generative moment matching networks (GMMNs) is introduced, and improved learning of copula random number generators is demonstrated. Based on the relative error of the training loss, the number of kernels is increased during training; additionally, the relative error of the validation loss is used as an early stopping criterion. While training time remains similar, adaptively training GMMNs (AGMMNs) significantly increases training performance, which is shown based on validation MMD trajectories, samples and validation MMD values. Superiority of AGMMNs over GMMNs and parametric copula models is also demonstrated in terms of three applications. First, convergence rates of estimators based on quasi-random versus pseudo-random samples from copulas are investigated in dimensions as large as 100 for the first time. Second, replicated validation MMDs, as well as Monte Carlo and quasi-Monte Carlo applications demonstrate the improved training of AGMMNs for a copula model implied by the 50 constituents of the S&P 500 index after deGARCHing. Last, both the latter dataset and 50 constituents of the FTSE 100 are used to demonstrate that the improved training of AGMMNs indeed translates to an improved model prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应带宽选择方法用于混合核最大均值差异（MMD），以改进生成矩匹配网络（GMMN）的训练。通过在训练过程中根据训练损失相对误差增加核数量，并利用验证损失相对误差作为早停准则，所提自适应GMMN（AGMMN）在保持训练时间相似的情况下显著提升了训练性能。实验表明，AGMMN在copula随机数生成及多个应用中优于标准GMMN和参数copula模型，包括高达100维的copula样本收敛率研究、S&P 500成分去GARCH后的copula建模等。
Motivation: 标准GMMN在拟合copula等依赖结构时，混合核的带宽选择固定，可能限制模型的适应性。本文旨在通过自适应选择核数量来提升GMMN的学习能力。
Method: 引入自适应带宽选择：基于训练损失相对误差动态增加混合核的数量，并基于验证损失相对误差实施早停。该方法称为自适应生成矩匹配网络（AGMMN）。
Result: 实验显示AGMMN在验证MMD轨迹、样本质量和验证MMD值上显著优于标准GMMN和参数copula模型。在高达100维的copula收敛率研究、S&P 500和FTSE 100成分数据上均验证了改进效果。
Conclusion: 自适应核数量增加和早停策略可以提升GMMN对依赖结构的拟合能力，且不增加训练时间，在实际金融数据中展示了更好的模型预测。

papers.title: The Urysohn Machine: A Metric-Topological Model of Computation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Urysohn Machine, an effective model of classification-oriented computation in which metric separation, frontier structure, and contraction are explicit parts of the computational state. Its basic object is a \emph{Urysohn Triple}: a support region, a target partition, and a separating classifier stored in a reusable Metric Library. The topological foundation is a constructive Urysohn Realization theorem for finite simplicial settings. It builds separators from dyadic ladders of nested polyhedral regions and equips their frontiers with a chain-level calculus: frontiers are cycles, and shells between levels have boundaries given by differences of frontiers. This construction yields two related complexity measures: decision-boundary width, the geometric measure of a single classifier's boundary, and Urysohn width, the total frontier mass represented by a library or realization. We prove an Amortized Separation Theorem showing that approximating a boundary of width to accuracy requires a number of simple basis triples proportional to boundary width and inversely proportional to resolution, under explicit boundary-footprint assumptions. We also introduce a contrastive separation operator whose graph-cut functional consistently estimates decision-boundary width from sampled metric data, while its Laplacian spectrum certifies class-component structure and conductance. Finally, we analyze the dynamic Urysohn ladder and prove four guarantees: separability under quotient collapse, stability of committed frontiers, bounded capacity under contraction, and scalability with quotient distance. Together, these results give a metric-topological account of classification complexity, amortized inference, and compositional reuse that preserves classical computability while exposing geometric structure hidden by purely symbolic descriptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Urysohn Machine，一种基于度量拓扑的分类计算模型。通过Urysohn三元组（支持区域、目标分区、分离分类器）、度量库和dyadic ladder构造，显式建模度量分离、前沿结构和收缩。证明了摊销分离定理，并引入了对比分离算子估计决策边界宽度。动态Urysohn ladder满足四个保证：商塌缩可分离性、稳态边界稳定性、收缩有界容量、商距离可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有分类计算模型忽略度量分离、前沿结构和收缩等几何拓扑结构，需要一种显式刻画这些要素的模型。
Method: 构造Urysohn Machine，其基础对象为Urysohn三元组，通过dyadic ladder嵌套多面体区域构建分离器，并赋予前沿链式微积分。引入对比分离算子和图割函数估计决策边界宽度，Laplacian谱认证类结构。
Result: 证明摊销分离定理：逼近给定宽度和精度的边界所需简单三元组数量与边界宽度成正比、与分辨率成反比。动态Urysohn ladder满足可分离性、稳定性、有界容量和可扩展性四个保证。
Conclusion: 该模型为分类复杂性、摊销推理和组合重用提供了度量拓扑解释，在保留经典可计算性的同时暴露了纯符号描述隐藏的几何结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Model-Predictive Control of a Soft Continuum Robot Using a Physics-Informed Neural Network Based on Cosserat Rod Theory
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic control of soft continuum robots (SCRs) holds great potential for expanding their applications, but remains a challenging problem due to the high computational demands of accurate dynamic models. While data-driven approaches like Koopman-operator-based methods have been proposed, they typically lack adaptability and cannot reconstruct the full robot shape, limiting their applicability. This work introduces a real-time-capable nonlinear model-predictive control (MPC) framework for SCRs based on a domain-decoupled physics-informed neural network (DD-PINN) with adaptable bending stiffness. The DD-PINN serves as a surrogate for the dynamic Cosserat rod model with a speed-up factor of up to 44,000. It is also used within an unscented Kalman filter for estimating the model states and bending compliance from end-effector position measurements. We implement a nonlinear evolutionary MPC running at 70 Hz on the GPU. In simulation, it demonstrates accurate tracking of dynamic trajectories and setpoint control with end-effector position errors below 3 mm (2.3\% of the actuator's length). In real-world experiments, the controller achieves similar accuracy and accelerations up to 3.55 m/s2.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics, 20 pages, 14 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于领域解耦物理信息神经网络（DD-PINN）的实时非线性模型预测控制（MPC）框架，用于软连续体机器人。DD-PINN作为动态Cosserat杆模型的代理模型，加速比高达44,000倍，并集成于无迹卡尔曼滤波器以估计模型状态和弯曲柔度。在仿真中，末端执行器位置误差低于3 mm（执行器长度的2.3%）；真实实验中达到类似精度，加速度达3.55 m/s²。
Motivation: 软连续体机器人的动态控制因精确动态模型计算成本高而困难，现有数据驱动方法（如Koopman算子）缺乏适应性且无法重建完整机器人形状。
Method: 引入DD-PINN作为Cosserat杆动态模型的代理，结合无迹卡尔曼滤波器从末端执行器位置测量估计状态和弯曲柔度，并实现基于GPU的70 Hz非线性进化MPC。

Conclusion: 该方法验证了结合物理信息神经网络与非线性MPC可有效实现软连续体机器人的高精度实时控制。

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Foundation Models for Water Level Prediction in the Everglades
papers.abstract_en: Accurate water level forecasting in the Everglades is essential for flood mitigation, drought management, water resource planning, and biodiversity conservation. While recent time-series foundation models have shown strong performance on generic tasks (represented in their pre-training), their effectiveness in domain-specific applications remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we curate a domain-specific dataset for water-level forecasting in the Everglades and observe that the performance of current state-of-the-art models remains limited. To address this gap, we leverage a retrieval-augmented mechanism that retrieves analogous multivariate hydrological episodes from an external archive of historical observations to enrich the input context of those pre-trained models. We study two retrieval strategies, statistical similarity-based retrieval and mutual information-based retrieval, and analyze how incorporating retrieved historical contexts affects predictive performance. Extensive experiments show that retrieval augmentation consistently improves long-horizon water level forecasts and yields disproportionately larger gains during extreme events, which is particularly critical for environmental decision-making. Our study provides empirical evidence that analog-based retrieval can benefit pretrained time-series foundation models in environmental science, offering practical insights into their strengths, limitations, and failure modes when applied to hydrological forecasting in the Everglades. Although evaluated in the Everglades, the proposed framework is general and can be applied to other hydrological systems given time series data. The code and data have been made publicly available at https://github.com/rahuul2992000/WaterRAF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Everglades 地区水位预测，发现现有时间序列基础模型在领域特定任务上性能有限，提出检索增强机制，从历史观测中检索类似多变量水文事件以丰富预训练模型的输入上下文。实验表明检索增强一致提升长周期水位预测，尤其在极端事件中增益更大。
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型在通用任务上表现良好，但在 Everglades 水位预测领域特定应用中效果不足，需要提升预测准确性。
Method: 构建领域特定的水位预测数据集，采用两种检索策略——基于统计相似性和基于互信息，从外部历史观测档案中检索类似水文事件，丰富预训练时间序列基础模型的输入上下文。
Result: 检索增强一致提升长周期水位预测性能，并在极端事件中带来不成比例的更大增益。
Conclusion: 模拟类比检索有益于环境科学中的预训练时间序列基础模型，框架通用但仅在 Everglades 评估，可扩展至其他水文系统。

papers.title: Decoding the Multimodal Maze: A Systematic Review on the Adoption of Explainability in Multimodal Attention-based Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal learning has witnessed remarkable advancements in recent years, particularly with the integration of attention-based models, leading to significant performance gains across a variety of tasks. Parallel to this progress, the demand for explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) has spurred a growing body of research aimed at interpreting the complex decision-making processes of these models. This systematic literature review analyzes research published between January 2020 and early 2024 that focuses on the explainability of multimodal models. Framed within the broader goals of XAI, we examine the literature across multiple dimensions, including model architecture, modalities involved, explanation algorithms and evaluation methodologies. Our analysis reveals that most studies are concentrated on vision-language and language-only models, with attention-based techniques being the most commonly employed for explanation. However, these methods often fall short in capturing the full spectrum of interactions between modalities, a challenge further compounded by the architectural heterogeneity across domains. Importantly, we find that evaluation methods for XAI in multimodal settings are largely non-systematic, lacking consistency, robustness, and consideration for modality-specific cognitive and contextual factors. To address these gaps, we not only synthesize findings from the surveyed works but also incorporate a complementary analysis that integrates recent and emerging advances driving multimodal explainability. Based on these insights, we provide a comprehensive set of recommendations aimed at promoting rigorous, transparent, and standardized evaluation and reporting practices in multimodal XAI research. Our goal is to support future research in more interpretable, accountable, and responsible multimodal AI systems, with explainability at their core.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对2020年1月至2024年初期间关于多模态注意力模型可解释性的研究进行了系统综述。分析显示大多数研究集中于视觉-语言和纯语言模型，注意力机制是最常用的解释方法，但评估方法缺乏系统性和一致性。作者提出了促进多模态XAI标准化评估与报告的建议。
Motivation: 多模态注意力模型的性能提升带来了可解释性需求，但现有可解释性研究在模态交互捕捉、评估方法一致性方面存在不足。
Method: 采用系统文献综述方法，分析模型架构、模态类型、解释算法和评估方法等多个维度，并结合近期进展提出建议。
Result: 研究发现注意力机制是最常用的解释方法，但多数研究未充分捕捉模态间交互；评估方法缺乏系统性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 呼吁多模态XAI领域采用更严格、透明和标准化的评估与报告实践，以推动可解释、负责任的多模态AI系统发展。

papers.title: The KG-ER Conceptual Schema Language
papers.abstract_en: We propose KG-ER, a conceptual schema language for knowledge graphs that describes the structure of knowledge graphs independently of their representation (relational databases, property graphs, RDF) while helping to capture the semantics of the information stored in a knowledge graph.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KG‑ER，一种面向知识图谱的概念模式语言，能够独立于具体表示形式（关系数据库、属性图、RDF）描述知识图谱的结构，并帮助捕获知识图谱中存储信息的语义。
Motivation: 现有知识图谱缺乏一种高层、与表示无关的模式语言来精确描述结构并表达语义，阻碍了跨系统互操作与数据理解。
Method: 设计了一套概念模式语言KG‑ER，专注于知识图谱的结构与语义捕获，不绑定特定实现。
Result: 论文提出了语言定义，但未在摘要中报告实验或定量结果。
Conclusion: KG‑ER为知识图谱提供了一种独立于表示的语义建模工具，有望促进不同知识图谱系统间的互操作与语义一致性。

papers.title: Authorship Attribution in Multilingual Machine-Generated Texts
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) have reached human-like fluency and coherence, distinguishing machine-generated text (MGT) from human-written content becomes increasingly difficult. While early efforts in MGT detection have focused on binary classification, the growing landscape and diversity of LLMs require a more fine-grained yet challenging authorship attribution (AA), i.e., being able to identify the precise generator (LLM or human) behind a text. However, AA remains nowadays confined to a monolingual setting, with English being the most investigated one, overlooking the multilingual nature and usage of modern LLMs. In this work, we introduce the problem of Multilingual Authorship Attribution, which involves attributing texts to human or multiple LLM generators across diverse languages. Focusing on 18 languages -- covering multiple families and writing scripts -- and 8 generators (7 LLMs and the human-authored class), we investigate the multilingual suitability of monolingual AA methods in terms of their cross-lingual transferability, and the impact of generators on attribution performance. Our results reveal that while certain monolingual AA methods can be adapted to multilingual settings, significant limitations and challenges remain, particularly in transferring across diverse language families, underscoring the complexity of multilingual AA and the need for more robust approaches to better match real-world scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多语言机器生成文本的作者归属（Multilingual Authorship Attribution）问题，旨在识别文本是由人类还是特定LLM生成的。实验涵盖18种语言（多语系和文字系统）和8个生成器（7个LLM+人类），评估单语言归属方法的多语言迁移能力。结果显示方法在跨语言族转移时存在显著局限，表明多语言作者归属的复杂性。
Motivation: 现有作者归属研究主要局限于英语单语言环境，忽略了LLM的多语言特性。本文首次系统研究多语言场景下的细粒度归属问题，以更贴近现实应用中LLM的多样性。
Method: 构建包含18种语言（涵盖多个语系和文字系统）和8个生成器（7个LLM和人类）的实验框架，测试单语言归属方法在跨语言设置下的迁移表现。
Result: 部分单语言方法可适应多语言设置，但跨语言族（如不同语系间）的迁移性能显著下降，揭示了现有方法的局限性。
Conclusion: 多语言作者归属面临跨语言迁移挑战，需要开发更鲁棒的方法以匹配真实世界的多语言LLM使用场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Modality-Aware Feature Matching in Visual and Vision-Language Applications: A Comprehensive Survey
papers.abstract_en: Feature matching is a cornerstone task in computer vision, essential for applications such as image retrieval, stereo matching, 3D reconstruction, and SLAM. This survey comprehensively reviews modality-based feature matching, exploring traditional handcrafted methods and emphasizing contemporary deep learning approaches across various modalities, including RGB images, depth images, 3D point clouds, LiDAR scans, medical images, and vision-language interactions. Traditional methods, leveraging detectors like Harris corners and descriptors such as SIFT and ORB, demonstrate robustness under moderate intra-modality variations but struggle with significant modality gaps. Contemporary deep learning-based methods, exemplified by detector-free strategies like CNN-based SuperPoint and transformer-based LoFTR, substantially improve robustness and adaptability across modalities. We highlight modality-aware advancements, such as geometric and depth-specific descriptors for depth images, sparse and dense learning methods for 3D point clouds, attention-enhanced neural networks for LiDAR scans, and specialized solutions like the MIND descriptor for complex medical image matching. Cross-modal applications, particularly in medical image registration and vision-language tasks, underscore the evolution of feature matching to handle increasingly diverse data interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文全面综述了基于模态的特征匹配方法，涵盖传统手工设计方法和当代深度学习方法，涉及RGB图像、深度图像、3D点云、LiDAR扫描、医学图像和视觉-语言交互等多种模态。传统方法如Harris角点和SIFT在中等模态内变化下鲁棒，但在大模态差距下表现不佳；深度学习方法如SuperPoint和LoFTR显著提升了跨模态的鲁棒性和适应性。文章重点介绍了模态感知的进展，如深度图像的几何和深度特定描述符、3D点云的稀疏和密集学习方法、LiDAR的注意力增强网络以及医学图像匹配的MIND描述符，并讨论了跨模态应用如医学图像配准和视觉-语言任务。
Motivation: 特征匹配是计算机视觉的基础任务，已有方法在处理大模态差距时存在局限，迫切需要系统综述基于模态的特征匹配方法。
Method: 本文采用综述方法，系统分类并比较了传统和深度学习特征匹配方法，涵盖了多种模态和跨模态场景，突出模态感知的专门技术。
Result: 深度学习特征匹配方法在跨模态鲁棒性和适应性上显著优于传统方法，尤其在图像检索、立体匹配、3D重建和SLAM等应用中表现突出。
Conclusion: 模态感知特征匹配正从单一模态向多模态和跨模态发展，未来需进一步处理不同数据交互中的挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Emergence of Hierarchical Emotion Organization in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) increasingly power conversational agents, understanding how they model users' emotional states is critical for ethical deployment. Inspired by emotion wheels, i.e., a psychological framework that argues emotions organize hierarchically, we analyze probabilistic dependencies between emotional states in model outputs. We find that LLMs naturally form hierarchical emotion trees that align with human psychological models, and larger models develop more complex hierarchies. We also uncover systematic biases in emotion recognition across socioeconomic personas, with compounding misclassifications for intersectional, underrepresented groups. Human studies reveal striking parallels, suggesting that LLMs internalize aspects of social perception. Beyond highlighting emergent emotional reasoning in LLMs, our results hint at the potential of using cognitively-grounded theories for developing better model evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）中情感组织的涌现现象。作者发现LLMs自然形成与人类心理学模型一致的层次化情感树，更大模型产生更复杂的层次结构。同时揭示了跨社会经济身份的情感识别系统偏差，以及交叉性群体错误分类的累积效应。人类研究显示了惊人的相似性，表明LLMs内化了社会感知的某些方面。结果暗示了利用认知理论开发更好的模型评估方法的潜力。
Motivation: 理解LLMs如何建模用户情感状态对于伦理部署至关重要，而现有研究缺乏对情感组织层次结构的分析。
Method: 基于情感轮心理学框架，通过分析模型输出中情感状态之间的概率依赖关系，构建层次化情感树，并在不同模型规模和不同社会经济身份上进行评估。
Result: LLMs自然形成与人类情感轮一致的情感树；更大模型具有更复杂的层次结构；情感识别中存在系统偏差，交叉性群体错误分类更严重；人类研究显示类似模式。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了LLMs中涌现的情感推理能力，并展示了使用认知理论改进模型评估的潜力。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）中情感组织的涌现现象。作者发现LLMs自然形成与人类心理学模型一致的层次化情感树，更大模型产生更复杂的层次结构。同时揭示了跨社会经济身份的情感识别系统偏差，以及交叉性群体错误分类的累积效应。人类研究显示了惊人的相似性，表明LLMs内化了社会感知的某些方面。结果暗示了利用认知理论开发更好的模型评估方法的潜力。
summary_sections.motivation: 理解LLMs如何建模用户情感状态对于伦理部署至关重要，而现有研究缺乏对情感组织层次结构的分析。
summary_sections.method: 基于情感轮心理学框架，通过分析模型输出中情感状态之间的概率依赖关系，构建层次化情感树，并在不同模型规模和不同社会经济身份上进行评估。
summary_sections.result: LLMs自然形成与人类情感轮一致的情感树；更大模型具有更复杂的层次结构；情感识别中存在系统偏差，交叉性群体错误分类更严重；人类研究显示类似模式。
summary_sections.conclusion: 研究揭示了LLMs中涌现的情感推理能力，并展示了使用认知理论改进模型评估的潜力。

papers.title: One Token to Fool LLM-as-a-Judge
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trusted as automated judges, assisting evaluation and providing reward signals for training other models, particularly in reference-based settings like Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). However, we uncover a critical vulnerability even in this reference-based paradigm: generative reward models are systematically susceptible to reward hacking. We find that superficial inputs, which we term ''master keys'' such as non-word symbols (e.g., '':'' or ''.'') or generic reasoning openers (e.g., ''Thought process:'' or ''Let's solve this problem step by step.''), can consistently elicit false positive rewards without any substantive reasoning. Our systematic evaluation demonstrates this is a widespread failure affecting a diverse range of models, including leading proprietary systems such as GPT-o1 and Claude-4. These results challenge the assumed robustness of LLM judges and pose a significant threat to their reliability. To address this, we propose a simple yet effective data augmentation strategy using truncated model outputs as adversarial negative examples. The resulting Master Reward Models (Master-RMs) demonstrate state-of-the-art robustness against these ''master key'' attacks while maintaining high performance in standard evaluation settings. We supplement these findings with a comprehensive analysis of the vulnerability across model scales, prompt variations, and common inference-time strategies, offering insights to guide future research on robust LLM evaluation. We release our robust, general-domain reward models and the synthetic training data at https://huggingface.co/sarosavo/Master-RM and https://huggingface.co/datasets/sarosavo/Master-RM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示LLM作为裁判时存在的系统性漏洞：即使有参考答案，添加无意义的符号或推理提示也能欺骗模型给出错误的高分。该问题在GPT-o1、Claude-4等模型上普遍存在。作者提出用截断模型输出作为对抗负例的数据增强方法，训练出鲁棒的Master Reward Models。
Motivation: LLM被广泛用作自动化裁判，但即使是基于参考答案的评估范式（如RLVR）也存在奖励篡改漏洞。
Method: 通过在训练数据中加入截断模型输出作为对抗负例，增强裁判模型对表面输入攻击的鲁棒性。
Result: 系统评估表明，无意义符号或通用推理提示能稳定获得假阳性奖励，攻击成功率在多种模型上很高；提出的Master-RM在保持标准性能的同时显著提升了对抗鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 结果挑战了LLM裁判的可靠性假设，并提供了切实可行的防御策略，同时分享了公开的模型和训练数据。

papers.title: Reconstructing Template-Memorized Images from Natural Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in generative models, such as diffusion models, have raised concerns related to privacy, copyright infringement, and data stewardship. To better understand and control these risks, prior work has introduced techniques and attacks that reconstruct images, or parts of images, from training data. While these results demonstrate that training data can be recovered, existing methods often rely on high computational resources, partial access to the training set, or carefully engineered prompts. In this work, we present a new attack that requires low resources, assumes little to no access to the training data, and identifies seemingly benign prompts that can lead to potentially risky image reconstruction. We further show that such reconstructions may occur unintentionally, even for users without specialized knowledge. For example, we observe that for one existing model, the prompt ``blue Unisex T-Shirt'' generates the face of a real individual. Moreover, by combining the identified vulnerabilities with real-world prompt data, we discover prompts that reproduce memorized visual elements. Our approach builds on insights from prior work and leverages domain knowledge to expose a fundamental vulnerability arising from the use of scraped e-commerce data, where templated layouts and images are closely tied to pattern-like textual prompts. The code for our attack is publicly available at https://github.com/TheSolY/lr-tmi.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种低资源攻击方法，无需大量训练数据访问即可通过看似自然的提示重建扩散模型训练集中的模板记忆图像。作者发现，对于现有模型，简单的提示如"蓝色中性T恤"能生成真实人脸，并证明结合真实世界提示数据可重现记忆的视觉元素。该攻击利用电商数据中模板布局与模式化文本提示的紧密关联。
Motivation: 现有图像重建攻击需要高计算资源、部分访问训练集或精心设计的提示，本文旨在降低攻击门槛，识别可能无意中导致风险的自然提示。
Method: 基于前期工作洞察，利用从电商数据中爬取的模板布局与模式化文本提示之间的关联，通过低资源方式识别看似无害但能触发记忆重建的提示。
Result: 摘要显示，对于现有模型，提示如"蓝色中性T恤"能生成真实人脸；结合真实世界提示数据可重现记忆的视觉元素。
Conclusion: 该工作暴露了使用爬取电商数据训练生成模型时模板记忆的基本漏洞，并强调此类重建可能无意发生。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Meta-Learning Transformers to Improve In-Context Generalization
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning enables transformer models to generalize to new tasks based solely on input prompts, without any need for weight updates. However, existing training paradigms typically rely on large, unstructured datasets that are costly to store, difficult to evaluate for quality and balance, and pose privacy and ethical concerns due to the inclusion of sensitive information. Motivated by these limitations and risks, we propose an alternative training strategy where we leverage a collection of multiple, small-scale, and domain-specific datasets. We empirically demonstrate that the increased quality and diversity of such data improve the generalization abilities of in-context learners beyond their training domain, while achieving comparable performance with models trained on a single large-scale dataset. We investigate this paradigm by leveraging meta-learning to train an in-context learner on the Meta-Album collection under several settings. Firstly, we show the performance in a controlled environment, where the test domain is completely excluded from the training knowledge. Secondly, we explore the robustness of these models to forgetting in a continual scenario where the information is accessible for a limited time. Finally, we explore the more challenging unsupervised scenario. Our findings demonstrate that transformers still generalize for in-context prediction when trained on a curated dataset collection while offering advantages in modularity and replaceability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用多个小型、领域特定的数据集替代单个大型非结构化数据集来训练Transformer的上下文学习能力。通过元学习在Meta-Album集合上训练，实验表明增加数据质量和多样性可提升泛化能力，超越训练领域，并与大型数据集性能相当。论文在控制环境、持续学习和无监督场景下验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有训练范式依赖大型非结构化数据集，存储成本高、质量难以评估且存在隐私和伦理风险。
Method: 利用元学习在Meta-Album集合上训练上下文学习器，在三种设置下评估：测试领域完全排除的控制环境、信息有限时间内的持续学习以及无监督场景。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多个设置下达到与使用单个大型数据集训练相当的性能，同时提高了泛化能力。
Conclusion: 在精选数据集集合上训练的Transformer仍能进行有效的上下文预测，并带来模块化和可替换性的优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Reliable are Fairness Audits with Unreliable Data?
papers.abstract_en: Fairness audits are a key component of responsible machine-learning deployment. Yet, audit-recommendation reliability under incomplete protected-label access is still poorly understood. In this work, we focused on protected-label missingness in fairness mitigation audits. We introduced a seed-calibrated stress test to separate missingness effects from seed-to-seed movement already present under complete labels. Across ACS/Folktables tasks, missingness settings that retain some protected labels usually do not move selected mitigation methods beyond a complete-label seed-to-seed baseline. At $0%$ protected-label access, candidates collapse to an empirical-risk-minimization baseline and deterministic tie-breaking rather than revealing a broad missingness effect. We also found that threshold optimization can turn fairness gains on a single protected axis into intersectional harm above a seed baseline, and this threshold-optimizer finding persists under random-forest validation. Overall, our results highlight that protected-label missingness should be reported with seed-null calibration, candidate-set context, and intersectional consequences before it is treated as evidence of audit fragility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究公平性审计中受保护标签缺失对审计建议可靠性的影响。通过种子校准压力测试，发现在部分标签缺失时，大多数缓解方法不会偏离完全标签下的基线；但当受保护标签完全缺失时，候选方法退化为经验风险最小化基线。此外，阈值优化可能在单轴公平性上带来收益，但会导致交叉轴伤害。
Motivation: 公平性审计是负责任机器学习部署的关键，但在受保护标签不完整的情况下，审计建议的可靠性尚不清楚。本文旨在量化标签缺失对审计结果的影响。
Method: 引入种子校准压力测试，以区分缺失效应与完全标签下已存在的种子间波动。在ACS/Folktables数据集上，针对不同标签缺失设置评估多种缓解方法。
Result: 部分标签缺失时，多数方法未显著偏离完全标签基线；0%标签时，方法退化为经验风险最小化基线。阈值优化可在单轴提升公平性，但会带来交叉轴伤害。
Conclusion: 受保护标签缺失的审计结果应报告种子校准、候选集上下文和交叉影响，而不应直接视为审计脆弱性的证据。

papers.title: PlaceRep: Geospatial Place Representation Learning from Large-Scale Point-of-Interest Data
papers.abstract_en: Learning effective representations of urban environments requires capturing spatial structure beyond fixed administrative boundaries. Existing geospatial representation learning approaches typically aggregate Points of Interest (POIs) into pre-defined administrative regions such as census units or ZIP code areas, assigning a single embedding to each region. However, POIs often form semantically meaningful groups that extend across, within, or beyond these boundaries, defining places that better reflect human activity and urban function. To address this limitation, we propose PlaceRep, a geospatial representation learning method that constructs place-level representations by clustering spatially and semantically related POIs. PlaceRep summarizes large-scale POI graphs from U.S. Foursquare data to produce general-purpose urban region embeddings while automatically identifying places across multiple spatial scales. By eliminating model pre-training, PlaceRep provides a scalable and efficient solution for multi-granular geospatial analysis. Experiments using the tasks of population density estimation and housing price prediction as downstream tasks show that PlaceRep outperforms most state-of-the-art graph-based geospatial representation learning methods and achieves up to a x100 speedup in generating region-level representations on large-scale POI graphs. The implementation of PlaceRep is available at https://github.com/mohammadhashemii/PlaceRep.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PlaceRep，一种从大规模 POI 数据中学习地理空间表示的方法。通过聚类空间和语义相关的 POI，自动识别多尺度区域，避免对固定行政边界的依赖。在美国 Foursquare 数据上的实验表明，在人口密度估计和房价预测任务中，PlaceRep 优于多数基于图的表示学习方法，且生成区域表示的速度提升达 100 倍。
Motivation: 现有地理空间表示学习方法通常将 POI 聚合到预定义的行政区域（如 census units 或 ZIP code），忽略了 POI 形成的跨边界语义分组，无法准确反映人类活动与城市功能。
Method: PlaceRep 通过聚类空间和语义相关的 POI 构建层级区域表示，利用大规模 POI 图自动识别多尺度区域，无需模型预训练。
Result: 在人口密度估计和房价预测下游任务中，PlaceRep 优于大多数现有基于图的表示学习方法，并且生成区域表示的速度提升最高达 100 倍。
Conclusion: PlaceRep 提供了一种可扩展、高效的多粒度地理空间分析方案，通过消除预训练需求，适用于大规模 POI 图。

papers.title: ShowFlow: From Robust Single Concept to Condition-Free Multi-Concept Generation
papers.abstract_en: Customizing image generation remains a core challenge in controllable image synthesis. For single-concept generation, maintaining both identity preservation and prompt alignment is challenging. In multi-concept scenarios, relying solely on a prompt without additional conditions like layout boxes or semantic masks, often leads to identity loss and concept omission. In this paper, we introduce ShowFlow, a comprehensive framework designed to tackle these challenges. We propose ShowFlow-S for single-concept image generation, and ShowFlow-M for handling multiple concepts. ShowFlow-S introduces a KronA-WED adapter, which integrates a Kronecker adapter with weight and embedding decomposition, and together with a novel Semantic-Aware Attention Regularization (SAR) training objective to enhance single-concept generation. Building on this foundation, ShowFlow-M directly reuses robust models learned by ShowFlow-S to support multi-concept generation without extra conditions, incorporating a Subject-Adaptive Matching Attention (SAMA) and a Layout Consistency guidance as the plug-and-play module. Extensive experiments and user studies validate ShowFlow's effectiveness, highlighting its potential in real-world applications like advertising and virtual dressing. Our source code will be publicly available at: https://htrvu.github.io/showflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ShowFlow 框架，用于鲁棒的单概念到无条件的多概念图像生成。ShowFlow-S 通过 KronA-WED 适配器和语义感知注意力正则化 (SAR) 增强单概念生成；ShowFlow-M 复用单概念模型，结合主题自适应匹配注意力 (SAMA) 和布局一致性引导实现多概念生成，无需额外条件。实验验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 单概念生成中身份保持与提示对齐困难；多概念场景下仅靠提示易导致身份丢失和概念遗漏，需要额外条件如布局框或语义掩码。
Method: 提出 ShowFlow，包含单概念模块 ShowFlow-S (KronA-WED 适配器 + SAR 训练目标) 和多概念模块 ShowFlow-M (重用单概念模型，加入 SAMA 和布局一致性引导作为即插即用模块)。
Result: 大量实验和用户研究验证了 ShowFlow 在单概念和多概念图像生成中的有效性，并展示了在广告和虚拟试穿等实际应用中的潜力。
Conclusion: ShowFlow 通过 KronA-WED、SAR、SAMA 等技术，从单概念扩展到多概念生成，无需额外条件，为可控图像生成提供了统一框架。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 ShowFlow 框架，用于鲁棒的单概念到无条件的多概念图像生成。ShowFlow-S 通过 KronA-WED 适配器和语义感知注意力正则化 (SAR) 增强单概念生成；ShowFlow-M 复用单概念模型，结合主题自适应匹配注意力 (SAMA) 和布局一致性引导实现多概念生成，无需额外条件。实验验证了其有效性。
summary_sections.motivation: 单概念生成中身份保持与提示对齐困难；多概念场景下仅靠提示易导致身份丢失和概念遗漏，需要额外条件如布局框或语义掩码。
summary_sections.method: 提出 ShowFlow，包含单概念模块 ShowFlow-S (KronA-WED 适配器 + SAR 训练目标) 和多概念模块 ShowFlow-M (重用单概念模型，加入 SAMA 和布局一致性引导作为即插即用模块)。
summary_sections.result: 大量实验和用户研究验证了 ShowFlow 在单概念和多概念图像生成中的有效性，并展示了在广告和虚拟试穿等实际应用中的潜力。
summary_sections.conclusion: ShowFlow 通过 KronA-WED、SAR、SAMA 等技术，从单概念扩展到多概念生成，无需额外条件，为可控图像生成提供了统一框架。

papers.title: CPAM: Context-Preserving Adaptive Manipulation for Zero-Shot Real Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Editing natural images using textual descriptions in text-to-image diffusion models remains a significant challenge, particularly in achieving consistent generation and handling complex, non-rigid objects. Existing methods often struggle to preserve textures and identity, require extensive fine-tuning, and exhibit limitations in editing specific spatial regions or objects while retaining background details. This paper proposes Context-Preserving Adaptive Manipulation (CPAM), a novel zero-shot framework for complicated, non-rigid real image editing. Specifically, we propose a preservation adaptation module that adjusts self-attention mechanisms to preserve and independently control the object and background effectively. This ensures that the objects' shapes, textures, and identities are maintained while keeping the background undistorted during the editing process using the mask guidance technique. Additionally, we develop a localized extraction module to mitigate the interference with the non-desired modified regions during conditioning in cross-attention mechanisms. We also introduce various mask-guidance strategies to facilitate diverse image manipulation tasks in a simple manner. CPAM can be seamlessly integrated with multiple diffusion backbones, including SD1.5, SD2.1, and SDXL, demonstrating strong generalization across different model architectures. Extensive experiments on our newly constructed Image Manipulation BenchmArk (IMBA), a robust benchmark dataset specifically designed for real image editing, demonstrate that our proposed method is the preferred choice among human raters, outperforming existing state-of-the-art editing techniques. The source code and data will be publicly released at the project page: https://vdkhoi20.github.io/CPAM
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia. Project page: https://vdkhoi20.github.io/CPAM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CPAM，一种无需微调的零样本真实图像编辑框架，通过保持上下文的自适应操作，在复杂非刚性物体编辑中保持纹理、身份和背景不变。方法包括保持适应模块（调整自注意力）和局部提取模块（减轻交叉注意力干扰），支持多种扩散骨干（SD1.5, SD2.1, SDXL）。在新构建的 IMBA 基准上，该方法被人类评估者偏好，性能优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有文本驱动图像编辑方法在保持纹理、身份和背景一致性方面存在局限，尤其在复杂非刚性物体编辑中需要大量微调，且难以独立控制前景和背景。
Method: 提出保持适应模块（Preservation Adaptation Module），通过调整自注意力机制独立控制物体和背景；开发局部提取模块（Localized Extraction Module），减少交叉注意力中非目标区域的干扰；引入多种掩码引导策略，实现多样化编辑任务。方法为零样本，无需微调。
Result: 在新构建的 IMBA 基准上，CPAM 被人类评估者选为首选，性能优于现有最先进编辑技术。
Conclusion: CPAM 是一个通用、零样本的编辑框架，可无缝集成多种扩散骨干，并有效保持物体和背景的一致性。

papers.title: ReFoCUS: Reinforcement-guided Frame Optimization for Contextual Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in Large Multi-modal Models (LMMs) has enabled effective vision-language reasoning, yet the ability to video understanding remains constrained by suboptimal frame selection strategies, albeit with the rapid development of video-specialized LMMs. Prior works attempted to solve this with static heuristics or external retrieval modules to feed frame-level information, but these approaches often fail to capture visual cues grounded to the given user queries conflating raw visual dynamics with true semantic relevance. In this paper, we introduce ReFoCUS (Reinforcement-guided Frame Optimization for Contextual UnderStanding), the first framework to integrate online policy-gradient reinforcement learning into frame-level optimization for video-LLMs. ReFoCUS aims to learn a frame selection policy, leveraging reward signals derived from reference models to capture their underlying scoring behavior over frame combinations that best support temporally grounded responses. To efficiently explore the large combinatorial frame space, we employ an autoregressive and query-conditional selection architecture that ensures contextual consistency while reducing complexity. Our policy learning removes the need for explicit frame-level supervision, as it implicitly discovers optimal and semantically consistent frame compositions. ReFoCUS consistently improves reasoning accuracy across multiple video QA benchmarks, demonstrating the advantage of aligning frame selection with model-internal utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReFoCUS，首个将在线策略梯度强化学习集成到视频大型多模态模型（LMMs）帧级优化的框架。通过自回归查询条件选择架构，学习帧选择策略，无需显式帧级监督，在多个视频问答基准上提升推理准确性。
Motivation: 现有视频LMMs的帧选择策略依赖静态启发式或外部检索模块，无法捕获与用户查询相关的视觉线索，导致语义关联不足。
Method: 提出ReFoCUS框架，使用在线策略梯度强化学习训练帧选择策略，从参考模型获取奖励信号以学习最佳帧组合；采用自回归查询条件选择架构降低组合空间复杂度。
Result: 在多个视频问答基准上，ReFoCUS一致提升了推理准确性。
Conclusion: 将帧选择与模型内部效用对齐可有效提升视频理解性能。

papers.title: LLM-ODDR: A Large Language Model Framework for Joint Order Dispatching and Driver Repositioning
papers.abstract_en: Ride-hailing platforms face significant challenges in optimizing order dispatching and driver repositioning operations in dynamic urban environments. Traditional approaches based on combinatorial optimization, rule-based heuristics, and reinforcement learning often overlook driver income fairness, interpretability, and adaptability to real-world dynamics. To address these gaps, we propose LLM-ODDR, a novel framework leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) for joint Order Dispatching and Driver Repositioning (ODDR) in ride-hailing services. LLM-ODDR framework comprises three key components: (1) Multi-objective-guided Order Value Refinement, which evaluates orders by considering multiple objectives to determine their overall value; (2) Fairness-aware Order Dispatching, which balances platform revenue with driver income fairness; and (3) Spatiotemporal Demand-Aware Driver Repositioning, which optimizes idle vehicle placement based on historical patterns and projected supply. We also develop JointDR-GPT, a fine-tuned model optimized for ODDR tasks with domain knowledge. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets from Manhattan taxi operations demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms traditional methods in terms of effectiveness, adaptability to anomalous conditions, and decision interpretability. To our knowledge, this is the first exploration of LLMs as decision-making agents in ride-hailing ODDR tasks, establishing foundational insights for integrating advanced language models within intelligent transportation systems. While the current framework incurs higher computational costs than traditional methods, we show that parallel decomposition and model distillation can reduce latency to production-viable levels for deployment.
papers.comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems (TITS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLM-ODDR框架，利用大语言模型联合优化网约车订单分配和司机重定位。框架包括多目标导向的订单价值细化、公平感知的订单分配和时空需求感知的司机重定位，并开发了微调模型JointDR-GPT。在曼哈顿出租车真实数据集上，该方法在有效性、异常适应性和决策可解释性方面优于传统方法，但计算成本较高，可通过并行分解和模型蒸馏降低延迟。
Motivation: 传统方法（组合优化、规则启发式、强化学习）在动态环境中忽略了司机收入公平性、可解释性和适应性，本文旨在弥补这些不足。
Method: 提出LLM-ODDR框架，包含三个关键组件：多目标导向的订单价值细化、公平感知的订单分配、时空需求感知的司机重定位，并微调JointDR-GPT模型用于ODDR任务。
Result: 在曼哈顿出租车真实数据集上，框架在有效性、异常条件适应性和决策可解释性上显著优于传统方法。
Conclusion: 本文首次探索将LLM作为决策智能体用于网约车ODDR任务，为智能交通系统集成语言模型奠定基础。当前框架计算成本较高，但可通过并行分解和模型蒸馏降低至可部署水平。

papers.title: ExPLAIND: Unifying Model, Data, and Training Attribution to Study Model Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc interpretability methods typically attribute a model's behavior to its components, data, or training trajectory in isolation, and are often tied to a particular level of granularity along the local-to-global spectrum. This leads to explanations that lack a unified view and may miss key interactions. We present ExPLAIND, a theoretically grounded, unified framework that integrates model components, data, and training trajectory while supporting explanations across granularities. We generalize recent work on gradient path kernels, reformulating models trained by AdamW as kernel machines. From the resulting kernel feature maps, we derive novel parameter-wise and step-wise influence scores. We empirically validate the resulting decomposition of model behavior in several settings and apply ExPLAIND to two case studies. Our findings on a Transformer exhibiting Grokking support previously proposed learning phases, while refining the final phase as one in which outer layers align around a representation pipeline learned after memorization. For EuroLLM pretraining, ExPLAIND reveals a two-phase dynamic, with the first characterized by outer-layer MLP learning and the second by increased relative influence of intermediate attention layers. These results establish ExPLAIND as a unified framework for interpreting model behavior and training dynamics.
papers.comment: published at ICML 2026, code at https://github.com/mainlp/explaind
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ExPLAIND 提出一个统一的后验可解释性框架，整合模型组件、数据和训练轨迹，支持不同粒度级别的解释。通过将 AdamW 训练的模型视为核机器，推导参数级和步骤级影响分数，并在 Transformer Grokking 和 EuroLLM 预训练案例中验证其有效性。
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法通常孤立地归因于模型组件、数据或训练轨迹，且局限于特定粒度，缺乏统一视角，可能遗漏关键交互。
Method: 基于梯度路径核的泛化，将 AdamW 训练的模型重写为核机器，从核特征映射中推导参数级和步骤级影响分数，构建统一框架。
Result: 在 Transformer Grokking 案例中，支持先前提出的学习阶段，并精化最后阶段为外层在记忆后围绕表示管道对齐；在 EuroLLM 预训练中揭示两阶段动态：首先是外层 MLP 学习，然后是中间注意力层相对影响增加。
Conclusion: ExPLAIND 作为统一框架可用于解释模型行为和训练动态，但本文未讨论其他优化器或大规模应用的效率。

papers.title: Mixing times of data-augmentation Gibbs samplers for high-dimensional probit regression
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the convergence properties of popular data-augmentation samplers for Baye\-sian probit regression. Leveraging recent results on Gibbs samplers for log-concave targets, we provide simple and explicit non-asymptotic bounds on the associated mixing times (in Kullback-Leibler divergence). The bounds depend explicitly on the design matrix and the prior precision, while they hold uniformly over the vector of responses. We specialize the results for different regimes of statistical interest, when both the number of data points $n$ and parameters $p$ are large: in particular we identify scenarios where the mixing times remain bounded as $n,p\to\infty$, and ones where they do not. The results are shown to be tight (in the worst case with respect to the responses) and provide guidance on choices of prior distributions that provably lead to fast mixing. An empirical analysis based on coupling techniques suggests that the bounds are effective in predicting practically observed behaviours.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了贝叶斯probit回归中数据增强吉布斯采样器的混合时间，利用对数凹目标采样的最新结果，提供了显式的非渐近混合时间界（KL散度）。这些界依赖于设计矩阵和先验精度，并对响应向量一致；作者识别了混合时间随n,p→∞保持有界和无界的场景，证明了界的紧性，并给出先验选择的指导。
Motivation: 数据增强吉布斯采样器在高维贝叶斯probit回归中广泛应用，但其收敛速度缺乏理论保证，尤其是在参数维度和样本量都很大时。
Method: 基于对数凹目标Gibbs采样的已有理论，推导出依赖于设计矩阵和先验精度的显式非渐近KL混合时间界，并针对大n大p的不同统计场景进行特化分析。
Result: 识别了混合时间有界（如当p增长但设计矩阵具有良好的谱性质时）和无界的条件；结果关于响应变量是紧的，并可用于指导先验分布的选择以促进快速混合。
Conclusion: 提供的非渐近界能够有效预测实际观察到的混合行为，为实践中的先验选择提供了理论依据。

papers.title: Lightweight and Interpretable Transformer via Mixed Graph Algorithm Unrolling for Traffic Forecast
papers.abstract_en: Unlike conventional "black-box" transformers with classical self-attention mechanism, we build a lightweight and interpretable transformer-like neural net by unrolling a mixed-graph-based optimization algorithm to forecast traffic with spatial and temporal dimensions. We construct two graphs: an undirected graph $\mathcal{G}^u$ capturing spatial correlations across geography, and a directed graph $\mathcal{G}^d$ capturing sequential relationships over time. We predict future samples of signal $\mathbf{x}$, assuming it is "smooth" with respect to both $\mathcal{G}^u$ and $\mathcal{G}^d$, where we design new $\ell_2$ and $\ell_1$-norm variational terms to quantify and promote signal smoothness (low-frequency reconstruction) on a directed graph. We design an iterative algorithm based on alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), and unroll it into a feed-forward network for data-driven parameter learning. We periodically insert graph learning modules for $\mathcal{G}^u$ and $\mathcal{G}^d$ that play the role of self-attention. Experiments show that our unrolled networks achieve competitive traffic forecast performance as state-of-the-art prediction schemes, while reducing parameter counts drastically.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级可解释Transformer，通过展开混合图优化算法进行交通预测。构建无向空间图和有向时间图，利用L2和L1范数变分项促进信号平滑，将ADMM迭代展开为前馈网络，并插入图学习模块替代自注意力。实验表明参数数量大幅减少，预测性能与现有最优方法相当。
Motivation: 传统Transformer自注意力机制黑箱且参数量大，本文旨在构建轻量级可解释模型用于时空交通预测。
Method: 构建无向空间图和有向时间图，设计L2和L1范数变分项度量信号平滑性；采用ADMM迭代算法并展开为前馈网络，周期性插入图学习模块替代自注意力。
Result: 在交通预测任务上达到与SOTA相当的预测性能，同时参数量显著减少。
Conclusion: 提出的展开网络实现了轻量级和可解释性，为交通预测提供了一种高效替代方案。

papers.title: Learning on a Razor's Edge: Identifiability and Singularity of Polynomial Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We study function spaces parametrized by neural networks, referred to as neuromanifolds. Specifically, we focus on deep Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with an activation function that is a sufficiently generic polynomial. First, we address the identifiability problem, showing that, for almost all functions in the neuromanifold of an MLP, there exist only finitely many parameter choices yielding that function. For CNNs, the parametrization is generically one-to-one. As a consequence, we compute the dimension of the neuromanifold. Second, we describe singular points of neuromanifolds. We characterize singularities completely for CNNs, and partially for MLPs. In both cases, they arise from sparse subnetworks. For MLPs, we prove that these singularities often correspond to critical points of the mean-squared error loss, which does not hold for CNNs. This provides a geometric explanation of the sparsity bias of MLPs. All of our results leverage tools from algebraic geometry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多项式激活函数的深层MLP和CNN所参数化的函数空间（neuromanifolds）的可识别性和奇异性。利用代数几何工具，证明MLP中几乎每个函数仅有有限个参数表示，而CNN的参数化是单射的，并给出维度。同时刻画了CNN的完全奇异性和MLP的部分奇异性，发现奇异点源于稀疏子网络，MLP的奇异点常对应均方误差损失的临界点，为MLP的稀疏偏好提供了几何解释。
Motivation: 理解神经网络参数化函数空间的结构，特别是可识别性（不同参数是否对应同一函数）和奇异点（导致梯度消失或极小值）对于优化和泛化至关重要，现有研究多针对线性或ReLU激活，对多项式激活的分析不足。
Method: 采用代数几何中的维数理论和奇点理论，分析多项式激活的MLP和CNN的neuromanifolds；通过映射的微分和代数簇的维数计算，证明参数化的单射性或有限性，并刻画奇异点集。
Result: MLP的参数化是局部有限对一的（generically finite-to-one），CNN的参数化是generically injective；两种网络的neuromanifold维数得以计算。CNN的奇异性完全由稀疏子网络引起，MLP的奇异点常对应于均方误差损失的临界点，而CNN则不然。
Conclusion: 该工作从代数几何角度为神经网络的稀疏性偏好提供了理论基础，并指出了CNN与MLP在奇异性结构上的差异。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Visual enhancement and 3D representation for underwater scenes: a review
papers.abstract_en: Underwater visual enhancement (UVE) and underwater 3D reconstruction pose significant challenges in computer vision and AI-based tasks due to complex imaging conditions in aquatic environments. Despite the development of numerous enhancement algorithms, a comprehensive and systematic review covering both UVE and underwater 3D reconstruction remains absent. To advance research in these areas, we present an in-depth review from multiple perspectives. First, we introduce the fundamental physical models, highlighting the peculiarities that challenge conventional techniques. We survey advanced methods for visual enhancement and 3D reconstruction specifically designed for underwater scenarios. The paper assesses various approaches from non-learning methods to advanced data-driven techniques, including Neural Radiance Fields and 3D Gaussian Splatting, discussing their effectiveness in handling underwater distortions. Finally, we conduct both quantitative and qualitative evaluations of state-of-the-art UVE and underwater 3D reconstruction algorithms across multiple benchmark datasets. Finally, we highlight key research directions for future advancements in underwater vision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了水下场景的视觉增强与3D重建方法，涵盖物理模型、非学习方法到数据驱动技术（包括NeRF和3D Gaussian Splatting），并在多个基准数据集上进行了定量与定性评估，最后指出了未来研究方向。
Motivation: 目前缺乏同时涵盖水下视觉增强（UVE）和3D重建的系统性综述，阻碍了该领域的发展。
Method: 从物理模型出发，分类介绍非学习与数据驱动方法（包括NeRF和3D Gaussian Splatting），并在多个基准数据集上进行定量与定性评估。
Result: 评估了多种方法处理水下畸变的有效性，但未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 指出了水下视觉领域的关键未来研究方向，如更鲁棒的物理模型和数据驱动融合等。

papers.title: Iterative Tool Usage Exploration for Multimodal Agents via Step-wise Preference Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents, which integrate a controller e.g., a vision language model) with external tools, have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tackling complex multimodal tasks. Existing approaches for training these agents, both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, depend on extensive human-annotated task-answer pairs and tool trajectories. However, for complex multimodal tasks, such annotations are prohibitively expensive or impractical to obtain. In this paper, we propose an iterative tool usage exploration method for multimodal agents without any pre-collected data, namely SPORT, via step-wise preference optimization to refine the trajectories of tool usage. Our method enables multimodal agents to autonomously discover effective tool usage strategies through self-exploration and optimization, eliminating the bottleneck of human annotation. SPORT has four iterative components: task synthesis, step sampling, step verification, and preference tuning. We first synthesize multimodal tasks using language models. Then, we introduce a novel trajectory exploration scheme, where step sampling and step verification are executed alternately to solve synthesized tasks. In step sampling, the agent tries different tools and obtains corresponding results. In step verification, we employ a verifier to provide AI feedback to construct step-wise preference data. The data is subsequently used to update the controller for tool usage through preference tuning, producing a SPORT agent. By interacting with real environments, the SPORT agent gradually evolves into a more refined and capable system. Evaluation in the GTA and GAIA benchmarks shows that the SPORT agent achieves 6.41% and 3.64% improvements, underscoring the generalization and effectiveness introduced by our method. The project page is https://SPORT-Agents.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SPORT方法，一种无需预收集数据的迭代式工具使用探索方法，通过逐步偏好优化来精炼多模态智能体的工具使用轨迹。该方法在GTA和GAIA基准测试上分别提升了6.41%和3.64%的性能，证明了其泛化性和有效性。
Motivation: 现有的多模态智能体训练方法（如监督微调和强化学习）依赖大量人工标注的任务-答案对和工具轨迹，对于复杂多模态任务而言成本过高且不切实际。本文旨在消除这一瓶颈。
Method: SPORT包含四个迭代组件：任务合成、步骤采样、步骤验证和偏好调优。首先使用语言模型合成多模态任务，然后交替执行步骤采样（智能体尝试不同工具）和步骤验证（使用验证器提供AI反馈构建逐步偏好数据），最后通过偏好调优更新控制器，使智能体在真实环境中逐渐进化。
Result: 在GTA和GAIA基准上，SPORT分别取得6.41%和3.64%的性能提升。
Conclusion: 所提出的迭代式自探索与优化方法能够使多模态智能体自主发现有效的工具使用策略，避免了人工标注的瓶颈，且具有良好的泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WildIFEval: Instruction Following in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Recent LLMs have shown remarkable success in following user instructions, yet handling instructions with multiple constraints remains a significant challenge. In this work, we introduce WildIFEval - a large-scale dataset of 7K real user instructions with diverse, multi-constraint conditions. Unlike prior datasets, our collection spans a broad lexical and topical spectrum of constraints, extracted from natural user instructions. We categorize these constraints into eight high-level classes to capture their distribution and dynamics in real-world scenarios. Leveraging WildIFEval, we conduct extensive experiments to benchmark the instruction-following capabilities of leading LLMs. WildIFEval clearly differentiates between small and large models, and demonstrates that all models have a large room for improvement on such tasks. We analyze the effects of the number and type of constraints on performance, revealing interesting patterns of model constraint-following behavior. We release our dataset to promote further research on instruction-following under complex, realistic conditions.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 5th Workshop on Generation, Evaluation and Metrics (GEM) at ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WildIFEval是一个包含7000条真实用户指令的大规模数据集，每条指令带有多种约束条件，涵盖广泛的词汇和主题范围。论文将约束分为八类，并对主流大语言模型的指令遵循能力进行基准测试，发现所有模型在复杂约束下仍有较大提升空间。
Motivation: 现有指令遵循数据集通常约束类型有限且人工构造，无法反映真实用户指令中多样且多约束的复杂场景。
Method: 从自然用户指令中提取多约束条件，构建包含7K条指令的数据集，并划分八类约束以分析其分布和动态。
Result: WildIFEval能清晰区分小模型和大模型的指令遵循能力，且所有模型在复杂约束任务上表现仍有显著提升空间；不同数量和类型的约束对性能有不同影响。
Conclusion: 该数据集为研究复杂真实条件下的指令遵循提供了资源，并揭示了当前模型的不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Central Limit Theorems for Stochastic Gradient Descent Quantile Estimators
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops asymptotic theory for quantile estimation via stochastic gradient descent (SGD) with a constant learning rate. The quantile loss function is neither smooth nor strongly convex. Beyond conventional perspectives and techniques, we view quantile SGD iteration as an irreducible, periodic, and positive recurrent Markov chain, which cyclically converges to its unique stationary distribution regardless of the arbitrarily fixed initialization. To derive the exact form of the stationary distribution, we analyze the structure of its characteristic function by exploiting the stationary equation. We also derive tight bounds for its moment generating function (MGF) and tail probabilities. Synthesizing the aforementioned approaches, we prove that the centered and standardized stationary distribution converges to a Gaussian distribution as the learning rate $η\rightarrow0$. This finding provides the first central limit theorem (CLT)-type theoretical guarantees for the quantile SGD estimator with constant learning rates. We further propose a recursive algorithm to construct confidence intervals of the estimators with statistical guarantees. Numerical studies demonstrate the effective finite-sample performance of the online estimator and inference procedure. The theoretical tools developed in this study are of independent interest for investigating general SGD algorithms formulated as Markov chains, particularly in non-strongly convex and non-smooth settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对常学习率随机梯度下降（SGD）下的分位数估计，建立了渐近理论。将SGD迭代视为不可约、周期、正递归的马尔可夫链，推导其平稳分布和特征函数，并证明当学习率趋于0时，中心标准化平稳分布收敛到高斯分布。这是首个针对常学习率分位数SGD估计的中心极限定理（CLT）。
Motivation: 分位数损失函数非光滑且非强凸，现有SGD渐近理论不适用；需要为常学习率下的分位数估计建立正确的渐近分布。
Method: 将SGD迭代视为马尔可夫链，通过特征函数和平稳方程推导平稳分布的显式形式，推导矩母函数和尾部概率的紧界，然后证明学习率趋于0时中心标准化平稳分布趋于高斯分布。
Result: 首个CLT型理论保证，并提出了递归算法构建置信区间；数值实验验证了有限样本性能。
Conclusion: 所发展的理论工具对一般非强凸和非光滑设置下的SGD算法具有独立价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fourier Multi-Component and Multi-Layer Neural Networks: Unlocking High-Frequency Potential
papers.abstract_en: The architecture of a neural network and the choice of its activation function are both fundamental to its performance. Equally important is ensuring that these two elements are well matched, as their alignment is key to effective representation and learning. In this paper, we introduce the Fourier Multi-Component and Multi-Layer Neural Network (FMMNN), a model that combines sine-type activations with the multi-component and multi-layer structure of MMNNs. In an FMMNN, each component is represented as a trainable linear combination of fixed random sine-type basis functions, while multi-layer composition generates more complex and adaptive high-frequency features. We establish that FMMNNs retain exponential expressive power for function approximation even under a low-rank architectural structure. We also analyze the optimization landscape of FMMNNs and find it to be substantially more favorable than that of standard fully connected neural networks, especially for high-frequency targets. In addition, we propose a scaled random initialization method for the first-layer weights in FMMNNs, which accelerates training and improves final performance when sufficient samples are available. Extensive numerical experiments support our theoretical insights, showing that FMMNNs achieve strong accuracy and favorable convergence behavior on oscillatory function-approximation benchmarks.
papers.comment: Our code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/ShijunZhangMath/FMMNN
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合正弦激活函数与多分量多层结构（MMNN）的傅里叶神经网络（FMMNN），每个分量由固定随机正弦基函数的可训练线性组合表示，通过多层组合生成自适应高频特征。理论证明FMMNN在低秩架构下仍保持指数级函数逼近能力，且优化景观比标准全连接网络更有利于高频目标。提出针对首层权重的缩放随机初始化方法，加速训练。数值实验表明FMMNN在振荡函数逼近基准上取得高精度和良好收敛性。
Motivation: 标准神经网络在逼近高频振荡函数时面临困难，且激活函数与网络架构的匹配对性能至关重要，但现有研究缺乏对两者协同设计的深入分析。
Method: FMMNN将MMNN的多分量多层结构与正弦类型激活函数结合，每个分量为随机正弦基的线性组合，通过多层组合生成高频特征；并采用缩放随机初始化策略改善首层权重训练。

papers.title: Is Stochastic Gradient Descent Effective? A PDE Perspective on Machine Learning processes
papers.abstract_en: In this paper we analyze the behaviour of the stochastic gradient descent (SGD), a widely used method in supervised learning for optimizing neural network weights via a minimization of non-convex loss functions. Since the pioneering work of E, Li and Tai (2017), the underlying structure of such processes can be understood via parabolic PDEs of Fokker-Planck type, which are at the core of our analysis. Even if Fokker-Planck equations have a long history and a extensive literature, almost nothing is known when the potential is non-convex or when the diffusion matrix is degenerate, and this is the main difficulty that we face in our analysis. We identify two different regimes: in the initial phase of SGD, the loss function drives the weights to concentrate around the nearest local minimum. We refer to this phase as the drift regime and we provide quantitative estimates on this concentration phenomenon. Next, we introduce the diffusion regime, where stochastic fluctuations help the learning process to escape suboptimal local minima. We analyze the Mean Exit Time (MET) and prove upper and lower bounds of the MET. Finally, we address the asymptotic convergence of SGD, for a non-convex cost function and a degenerate diffusion matrix, that do not allow to use the standard approaches, and require new techniques. For this purpose, we exploit two different methods: duality and entropy methods. We provide new results about the dynamics and effectiveness of SGD, offering a deep connection between stochastic optimization and PDE theory, and some answers and insights to basic questions in the Machine Learning processes: How long does SGD take to escape from a bad minimum? Do neural network parameters converge using SGD? How do parameters evolve in the first stage of training with SGD?
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过 Fokker-Planck 型抛物型 PDE 分析随机梯度下降（SGD）在非凸损失函数下的行为，识别出漂移和扩散两个阶段，给出了平均逃逸时间（MET）的上下界，并利用对偶和熵方法在非凸势和退化扩散矩阵下证明了渐近收敛性。
Motivation: 尽管 Fokker-Planck 方程历史悠久，但在势非凸或扩散矩阵退化时几乎无已知结果，而 SGD 的动力学理解恰好面临这一核心困难。
Method: 区分 SGD 的漂移阶段（损失驱动权重向局部最小集中）和扩散阶段（随机波动帮助逃离次优局部最小），通过量化漂移阶段的集中现象，并分析平均逃逸时间的上下界；采用对偶方法和熵方法处理非凸成本函数和退化扩散矩阵下的渐近收敛。
Result: 提供了漂移阶段权重集中现象的定量估计，证明了平均逃逸时间的上下界，并在非凸和退化扩散条件下证明了 SGD 的渐近收敛。
Conclusion: 建立了随机优化与 PDE 理论之间的深层联系，回答了 SGD 从坏局部最小逃逸时间、参数是否收敛、训练初期演化等基本问题。

papers.title: Competition and Diversity in Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Recent evidence, both in the lab and in the wild, suggests that the use of generative artificial intelligence reduces the diversity of content produced. The use of the same or similar AI models appears to lead to more homogeneous behavior. Our work begins with the observation that there is a force pushing in the opposite direction: competition. When producers compete with one another (e.g., for customers or attention), they are incentivized to create novel or unique content. We explore the impact competition has on both content diversity and overall social welfare. Through a formal game-theoretic model, we show that competitive markets select for diverse AI models, mitigating monoculture. We further show that a generative AI model that performs well in isolation (i.e., according to a benchmark) may fail to provide value in a competitive market. Our results highlight the importance of evaluating generative AI models across the breadth of their output distributions, particularly when they will be deployed in competitive environments. We validate our results empirically by using language models to play Scattergories, a word game in which players are rewarded for answers that are both correct and unique. Overall, our results suggest that homogenization due to generative AI is unlikely to persist in competitive markets, and instead, competition in downstream markets may drive diversification in AI model development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过博弈论模型和实证实验（Scattergories游戏）研究竞争对生成式AI内容多样性的影响。结果表明，竞争市场会促使AI模型多样化，缓解同质化现象，而单独表现良好的模型在竞争环境中可能失效。
Motivation: 已有证据表明生成式AI的使用会降低内容多样性，但竞争机制可能产生相反作用。本文旨在探究竞争对内容多样性和社会福利的影响。
Method: 建立形式化博弈论模型，分析竞争市场对AI模型多样性的选择；并通过语言模型进行Scattergories游戏实验验证。
Result: 竞争市场倾向于选择多样化的AI模型，缓解单一文化；在孤立环境中表现良好的模型在竞争市场中可能无法提供价值。
Conclusion: 生成式AI导致的同质化在竞争市场中不太可能持续，下游市场的竞争可能推动AI模型开发的多样化。评估生成式AI模型时需考虑其输出分布的广度，特别是在竞争环境中。

papers.title: Quasi-Bayes empirical Bayes: a sequential approach to the Poisson compound decision problem
papers.abstract_en: The Poisson compound decision problem is a long-standing problem is statistics, for which empirical Bayes methods are commonly used to estimate Poisson means in static or batch settings. We consider this problem in a streaming, or online, framework. Building on a quasi-Bayesian approach based on Newton's algorithm, we develop a sequential estimate that is easy to evaluate, computationally efficient, and has constant per-observation cost as the data accrue. We establish frequentist guarantees for the proposed estimate, including consistency and asymptotic optimality, with optimality understood as vanishing excess Bayes risk, or regret. Empirical performance is assessed through simulation studies and comparisons with benchmark procedures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对泊松复合决策问题（Poisson compound decision problem）提出了一种在线（流式）框架下的顺序估计方法。基于Newton算法的准贝叶斯方法（quasi-Bayesian approach），作者开发了易于评估、计算高效且每观测成本恒定的序贯估计量，并建立了包括一致性和渐近最优性（以超额贝叶斯风险或遗憾度量的最优性）在内的频率学派保证。模拟研究验证了其性能。
Motivation: 泊松复合决策问题是统计学中的经典问题，传统经验贝叶斯方法适用于静态或批处理设置。实际应用中数据常以流式方式到达，需要在线估计方法，但现有方法存在计算瓶颈或性能损失。
Method: 基于Newton算法的准贝叶斯经验贝叶斯方法，构建序贯估计量。该估计量每步更新仅需常数时间，不依赖历史数据总量，且易于实现。理论分析证明其一致性和渐近最优性（贝叶斯风险趋近于最优）。
Result: 模拟研究表明，所提方法在参数设置下优于或可比于基准程序，且计算效率显著提升。摘要未提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该工作为流式数据下的泊松均值估计提供了一种实用且理论保证的序贯方法，扩展了经验贝叶斯在在线场景中的应用。未来可探索将方法推广到更复杂模型或依赖结构。
