papers.title: Causal Inference with Generative Artificial Intelligence: Application to Texts as Treatments
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we demonstrate how to enhance the validity of causal inference with unstructured high-dimensional treatments like texts, by leveraging the power of generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI). Specifically, we propose to use a deep generative model such as large language models (LLMs) to efficiently generate treatments and use their internal representation for subsequent causal effect estimation. We show that the knowledge of this true internal representation helps disentangle the treatment features of interest, such as specific sentiments and certain topics, from other possibly unknown confounding features. Unlike existing methods, the proposed GenAI-Powered Inference (GPI) methodology eliminates the need to learn causal representation from the data, and hence produces more accurate and efficient estimates. We formally establish the conditions required for the nonparametric identification of the average treatment effect, propose an estimation strategy that avoids the violation of the overlap assumption, and derive the asymptotic properties of the proposed estimator through the application of double machine learning. Finally, using an instrumental variables approach, we extend the proposed GPI methodology to the settings in which the treatment feature is based on human perception. The GPI is also applicable to text reuse where an LLM is used to regenerate existing texts. We conduct simulation and empirical studies, using the generated text data from an open-source LLM, Llama 3, to illustrate the advantages of our estimator over state-of-the-art causal representation learning algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用生成式AI（如大型语言模型）来增强非结构化高维处理变量（如文本）的因果推断。通过生成处理并利用内部表示来解耦处理特征，避免了从数据中学习因果表示的需要。论文建立了平均处理效应的非参数识别条件，提出了避免重叠假设违背的估计策略，并基于双重机器学习推导了渐近性质。模拟和实证研究（使用Llama 3生成文本）表明，该方法优于现有因果表示学习算法。
Motivation: 现有因果推断方法在处理文本等高维非结构化处理时，难以分离感兴趣的处理特征与潜在的混杂特征，通常需要从数据中学习因果表示，导致效率低且可能不准确。
Method: 提出GenAI-Powered Inference (GPI)方法，使用深度生成模型（如LLM）生成处理变量，并利用其内部表示进行因果效应估计。结合双重机器学习估计平均处理效应，避免了从数据中学习因果表示的步骤。
Result: 摘要报告在模拟和实证研究中，使用Llama 3生成文本数据，GPI方法在因果效应估计上优于现有最先进的因果表示学习算法。
Conclusion: 展示了生成式AI可提升因果推断的有效性，并扩展至处理基于人类感知的特征和文本复用场景。

papers.title: Geometry of Lightning Self-Attention: Identifiability and Dimension
papers.abstract_en: We consider function spaces defined by self-attention networks without normalization, and theoretically analyze their geometry. Since these networks are polynomial, we rely on tools from algebraic geometry. In particular, we study the identifiability of deep attention by providing a description of the generic fibers of the parametrization for an arbitrary number of layers and, as a consequence, compute the dimension of the function space. Additionally, for a single-layer model, we characterize the singular and boundary points. Finally, we formulate a conjectural extension of our results to normalized self-attention networks, prove it for a single layer, and numerically verify it in the deep case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用代数几何工具研究无归一化自注意力网络定义的空间的几何性质，包括参数化的通用纤维描述、函数空间维数计算、单层模型的奇异点与边界点刻画，并提出归一化情形的猜想。
Motivation: 理解深度自注意力网络的函数空间几何，特别是可识别性（identifiability）与维数，为理论分析提供基础。
Method: 利用代数几何工具，对任意层数无归一化自注意力网络提供参数化通用纤维的描述，由此计算函数空间维数；对单层模型刻画奇异点与边界点；提出归一化情形的猜想并单层证明。
Result: 给出了深层自注意力网络参数化通用纤维的完整描述并计算了函数空间维数；单层情况下明确了奇异与边界点；归一化情形单层证明成立，深层数值验证支持猜想。
Conclusion: 本文结论局限于无归一化网络，但为后续归一化情形的理论提供了猜想基础。

papers.title: Plug-and-Play image restoration with Stochastic deNOising REgularization
papers.abstract_en: Plug-and-Play (PnP) algorithms are a class of iterative algorithms that address image inverse problems by combining a physical model and a deep neural network for regularization. Even if they produce impressive image restoration results, these algorithms rely on a non-standard use of a denoiser on images that are less and less noisy along the iterations, which contrasts with recent algorithms based on Diffusion Models (DM), where the denoiser is applied only on re-noised images. We propose a new PnP framework, called Stochastic deNOising REgularization (SNORE), which applies the denoiser only on images with noise of the adequate level. It is based on an explicit stochastic regularization, which leads to a stochastic gradient descent algorithm to solve ill-posed inverse problems. A convergence analysis of this algorithm and its annealing extension is provided. Experimentally, we prove that SNORE is competitive with respect to state-of-the-art methods on deblurring and inpainting tasks, both quantitatively and qualitatively.

papers.title: ResidualPlanner+: a scalable matrix mechanism for marginals and beyond
papers.abstract_en: Noisy marginals are a common form of confidentiality protecting data release and are useful for many downstream tasks such as contingency table analysis, construction of Bayesian networks, and even synthetic data generation. Privacy mechanisms that provide unbiased noisy answers to linear queries (such as marginals) are known as matrix mechanisms. We propose ResidualPlanner and ResidualPlanner+, two highly scalable matrix mechanisms. ResidualPlanner is both optimal and scalable for answering marginal queries with Gaussian noise, while ResidualPlanner+ provides support for more general workloads, such as combinations of marginals and range queries or prefix-sum queries. ResidualPlanner can optimize for many loss functions that can be written as a convex function of marginal variances (prior work was restricted to just one predefined objective function). ResidualPlanner can optimize the accuracy of marginals in large scale settings in seconds, even when the previous state of the art (HDMM) runs out of memory. It even runs on datasets with 100 attributes in a couple of minutes. Furthermore, ResidualPlanner can efficiently compute variance/covariance values for each marginal (prior methods quickly run out of memory, even for relatively small datasets). ResidualPlanner+ provides support for more complex workloads that combine marginal and range/prefix-sum queries (e.g., a marginal on race, a range query on age, and a combined race/age tabulation that answers age range queries for each race). It even supports custom user-defined workloads on different attributes. With this added flexibility, ResidualPlanner+ is not necessarily optimal, however it is still extremely scalable and outperforms the prior state-of-the-art (HDMM) on prefix-sum queries both in terms of accuracy and speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ResidualPlanner和ResidualPlanner+两种矩阵机制，用于差分隐私下向边缘查询等高维线性查询添加高斯噪声。ResidualPlanner针对边缘查询最优且可扩展，支持多种凸损失函数；ResidualPlanner+支持更复杂的组合查询（如边缘+范围/前缀和查询），虽非最优但扩展性极强，在精度和速度上均超越先前最优方法HDMM。
Motivation: 现有矩阵机制（如HDMM）在扩展性上存在局限，难以处理大规模属性或复杂查询组合，且通常只针对单一目标函数优化。
Method: 提出ResidualPlanner和ResidualPlanner+：前者基于残差分解实现边缘查询的隐私预算分配，支持多种凸损失函数；后者通过分块策略扩展支持非边缘查询（如范围/前缀和）及用户自定义工作负载。
Result: 摘要报告ResidualPlanner在秒级优化大量属性（如100属性在几分钟内完成），而HDMM内存溢出；ResidualPlanner+在前缀和查询上精度和速度均优于HDMM。
Conclusion: ResidualPlanner可提供边际方差的协方差矩阵，而ResidualPlanner+虽非最优但具备高度可扩展性和灵活性，能处理复杂混合查询。

papers.title: On Pitfalls of $\textit{RemOve-And-Retrain}$: Data Processing Inequality Perspective
papers.abstract_en: The RemOve-And-Retrain (ROAR) benchmark is widely used to evaluate feature attribution methods, yet its validity remains underexplored from an information-theoretic perspective. We show that model- and data-agnostic post-processing of attribution maps (transformations that, by the data processing inequality, \emph{cannot} add information about the decision function) can often improve ROAR scores. This means that an improved ROAR ranking is not, by itself, evidence that an attribution map carries more information about the model. We trace this failure mode to a bias toward spatially blurry masks. Experiments on CIFAR-10, SVHN, and CUB-200 show a consistent association between blurriness and ROAR performance, a pattern that also appears in the ROAD variant. We provide guidelines for more cautious removal-based benchmarking, with implications for validating mechanistic understanding of neural network internals.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 ICML Workshop on Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从信息论角度（数据处理不等式）质疑RemOve-And-Retrain（ROAR）基准的有效性，证明模型无关的后处理（如平滑）可以提升ROAR分数，但这并不意味着归因图包含更多决策信息。该偏差源于ROAR对模糊掩码的偏好，实验在CIFAR-10、SVHN和CUB-200上验证了这一关联。作者为更可靠的基于移除的基准测试提供了指导。
Motivation: ROAR基准广泛用于评估特征归因方法，但其有效性从未从信息论角度得到严格检验。
Method: 利用数据处理不等式证明任何不增加决策函数信息的后处理变换仍可改善ROAR分数，并通过实验展示模糊性与ROAR性能的正相关性。
Result: 在CIFAR-10、SVHN和CUB-200上，模糊掩码始终获得更高的ROAR分数，该模式在ROAD变体中也成立。
Conclusion: ROAR分数不能直接反映归因图的信息量，未来应避免依赖模糊性偏差，并采用更谨慎的基准测试方案。

papers.title: LLMs Can Better Capture Human Judgments--With the Right Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Are large language models (LLMs) bad at capturing human judgment? Two commonly stated limitations are that LLMs fail to capture full distributions of responses, and that their judgments are unstable across wording variations. We demonstrate simple prompting strategies that mitigate these limitations. Across two datasets--a U.S.-representative set of 144 moral scenarios and 38 moral beliefs from the International Social Survey Programme's Family and Changing Gender Roles module covering 32 countries--we show how simple elicitation techniques help improve AI-human alignment. First, prompting models to report standard deviations and response proportions recovers the full range of human responses better than common strategies. Second, ensuring scenarios are clear to human participants--as reflected in human confusion ratings--boosts model alignment, and LLMs can track human confusion ratings. At the same time, we find that LLMs' estimates of their own error are poorly calibrated, though they can predict human variability relatively well. These results suggest that asking better questions to LLMs can yield better answers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在捕捉人类判断方面的局限性，并提出简单的提示策略来缓解这些问题。通过两个数据集（美国代表性道德场景和国际社会调查项目中的性别角色信念），作者发现提示模型报告标准差和响应比例可以更好地恢复人类反应的完整分布，同时确保场景清晰度（通过人类困惑度衡量）能提升模型对齐度。然而，LLMs对自身误差的校准较差，但能较好地预测人类变异性。
Motivation: LLMs常见的两个局限是：无法捕捉人类反应的完整分布，以及判断对措辞变化不稳定。论文旨在验证简单提示策略能否克服这些局限。
Method: 提出两种提示策略：1）要求模型输出标准差和响应比例以捕捉分布；2）使用人类困惑度评估场景清晰度，并让LLM预测困惑度。
Result: 在两个数据集上显示，这些策略优于常见基线，提升了AI-人类对齐。LLMs对人类变异性预测较好，但自身误差校准不佳。
Conclusion: 通过设计更好的问题（提示）可以显著改善LLMs对人类判断的捕捉能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Prefill Awareness in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Safety-relevant studies of language models, including alignment and jailbreaking evaluations and AI control protocols, often rely on prefilling model outputs. If AI models can recognize and act on the fact their prior assistant messages have been inserted or edited, the effectiveness and validity of these methods could be compromised. We investigate whether frontier language models can distinguish between tampered and untampered assistant-side context, a capability we call prefill awareness. To do so, we construct a binary preference benchmark across three prefill mechanisms, filtering for cases where models show consistent stances. We find that frontier models show substantial prefill awareness: Claude Opus 4.5 detects prefills opposing its preferences in 9-35% of cases with a 0% false positive rate when prompted; additionally, models often revert towards baseline behavior without explicitly reporting that the prefill was foreign. Controlled ablations later also show that detection and resistance rely on different cues, where stylistic mismatch mainly affects whether models flag a prefill as foreign, while preference mismatch mainly affects whether they revert toward their baseline answer. We also examine more realistic agentic settings such as misalignment-continuation evaluations and SWE-bench trajectories, where frontier models sometimes disavow prefilled assistant turns in ways that depend strongly on dataset, task success, and hidden formatting artifacts. Our results indicate that prefill awareness is already a substantial confound for some prefill-based methods. We recommend that model developers track this capability in frontier systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究前沿大语言模型能否识别其之前的助手输出被篡改（即预填充意识），并构建了二选一偏好基准。发现Claude Opus 4.5能检测到9-35%的与自身偏好相反的预填充，且零误报；模型倾向于在不报告外来预填充的情况下回归基线行为。在代理设置中也观察到类似现象，表明预填充意识已对某些基于预填充的方法构成显著干扰。
Motivation: 安全相关研究（对齐、越狱、AI控制协议）常依赖预填充模型输出。若模型能识别并响应其助手消息被插入或编辑，这些方法的有效性和可靠性可能受损。
Method: 构建二选一偏好基准，覆盖三种预填充机制，筛选模型立场一致的案例。通过受控消融实验分离检测和抵抗的不同线索（风格不匹配主要影响标记预填充为外来，偏好不匹配主要影响回归基线）。
Result: Claude Opus 4.5在9-35%的案例中检测到与其偏好相反的预填充，且零误报。模型在未明确报告外来预填充时回归基线行为。在真实代理设置（如misdirection-continuation评估和SWE-bench轨迹）中，模型有时会否定预填充的助手回合，且强烈依赖于数据集、任务成功和隐藏格式伪影。
Conclusion: 预填充意识已显著干扰某些基于预填充的方法，建议模型开发者追踪前沿系统中的这一能力。

papers.title: GRIP: Feedback-Guided Prompt Retrieval for Large Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: In-Context Learning (ICL) has become a powerful mechanism for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to new tasks without fine-tuning. Extending this concept to Large Multimodal Models (LMMs), Multimodal In-Context Learning (M-ICL) relies on retrieving relevant examples, such as images, captions, or question-answer pairs, to guide predictions across tasks like classification, captioning, and visual question answering (VQA). Most existing approaches select in-context examples based on feature-space similarity, assuming that semantically similar samples provide the most useful context. However, our systematic analysis reveals that this assumption does not always hold: visually similar examples are not necessarily those that most effectively enhance in-context learning performance. To address this, we propose the Guided Retrieval of In-context Prompts (GRIP), a learnable vision-only retrieval framework that leverages feedback from LMMs to identify examples that truly improve model predictions. GRIP learns to distinguish beneficial from detrimental in-context examples through contrastive training, refining retrieval beyond pure similarity. Across three multimodal tasks, namely classification, captioning, and VQA, GRIP improves consistently over similarity-based retrieval on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, with its strongest gains in classification on Idefics2-8B. Moreover, we demonstrate that retrievers trained with feedback from one open LMM can be transferred to other models without retraining, including closed-source GPT-4o and Gemini, enabling scalable and cost-efficient deployment of M-ICL. Code will be published upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRIP，一种用于多模态大模型的反馈引导提示检索框架，通过对比学习从LMM反馈中学习区分有益和无益的上下文示例，提升分类、字幕生成和VQA任务性能，并支持跨模型迁移。
Motivation: 现有多模态上下文学习依赖特征空间相似性选择示例，但研究发现视觉相似的示例并非最有效，需要更精准的检索方法。
Method: 提出GRIP，一种可学习的纯视觉检索框架，利用LMM反馈通过对比训练优化检索，超越纯相似性匹配。
Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上三个多模态任务中一致优于基于相似性的检索，在Idefics2-8B上分类任务提升最大，且可迁移至GPT-4o和Gemini。
Conclusion: GRIP通过反馈引导的检索显著改进M-ICL，且跨模型可迁移，实现低成本部署。

papers.title: Reducing the Complexity of Deep Learning Models for EEG Analysis on Wearable Devices
papers.abstract_en: Wearable healthcare devices are the fastest-growing Internet of Things (IoT) sector. Many automated healthcare services rely on two crucial biological signals, namely ECG and EEG, which reflect the activity of the heart and brain, respectively. Although deep neural networks are considered the primary way to process and analyze these signals, the very tight energy and computational power constraints in wearable devices are far below the computational, energy, and memory bandwidth demands of DNN models, thereby impeding the deployment of deep learning in many practical wearable services. This paper investigates the feasibility of deploying state-of-the-art DNN models in resource-constrained wearable devices. Notably, we explore the trade-off between accuracy and computational complexity of DNNs when parameter quantization and electrode reduction methods are used. Our investigation centers on several state-of-the-art DNN models designed for EEG signal analysis, specifically for detecting epileptic seizures. Our findings demonstrate that, when applied judiciously, these techniques can significantly reduce the complexity of the DNNs under consideration with minimal adverse effects on accuracy. These results reveal the explicit trade-offs between accuracy and complexity reduction encountered when adapting DNN-based online EEG analysis for wearable devices.

papers.title: Deep Unfolded Latent Optimally Partitioned-l2/l1 Networks for Data-driven Block-Sparse Recovery
papers.abstract_en: The convex Latent Optimal Partition (LOP)-l2/l1 approach enables block-sparse signal recovery with unknown partitions but relies on manual hyperparameter tuning. Additionally, numerical instability in differentiating its proximal operator prevents its automatic parameter tuning via Deep Unfolding (DU). To address these limitations, we propose two architectures: a stable framework utilizing implicit differentiation and a flexible variant leveraging Deep Weight Factorization (DWF). The DWF-based approach also supports nonconvex smooth data fidelity terms. Numerical experiments demonstrate that DU-LOP-l2/l1 yields competitive performance and high resilience against impulsive noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对未知分区的块稀疏信号恢复问题，提出了基于深度展开（Deep Unfolding）的LOP-l2/l1网络架构。传统凸LOP-l2/l1方法依赖手动超参数调优且数值不稳定，作者通过隐式微分和深度权值分解（DWF）两种策略实现自动参数学习。实验表明该方法在抗脉冲噪声方面具有竞争力。
Motivation: 凸LOP-l2/l1方法需要手动调参且其近端算子微分数值不稳定，阻碍了深度展开的自动参数学习。
Method: 提出两种架构：基于隐式微分的稳定框架和基于深度权值分解（DWF）的灵活变体，后者还支持非凸光滑数据保真项。
Result: 数值实验显示DU-LOP-l2/l1获得了有竞争力的性能，并对脉冲噪声具有高鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 本文通过深度展开解决了LOP-l2/l1的自动参数学习问题，并增强了鲁棒性。

papers.title: PI-Hunter: Automated Red-Teaming for Exposing and Localizing Prompt Injections
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into agentic systems that interact with external tools and environments, introducing new security risks such as indirect prompt injection attacks through untrusted external sources. Existing defenses mainly focus on blocking malicious content at inference time, and current red-teaming methods primarily optimize attack success. As a result, developers have limited visibility into how latent prompt injections emerge and propagate through agents. We propose PI-Hunter, an automated agentic auditing framework for proactive vulnerability exposure in LLM agents. PI-Hunter constructs realistic source-aware test cases and iteratively evolves them through feedback-driven exploration to induce agents to retrieve and reveal latent malicious instructions embedded within external environments. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks, agent architectures, attacks, and defenses demonstrate that PI-Hunter substantially improves vulnerability exposure and attack-surface coverage over strong automated red-teaming baselines, while remaining effective under existing prompt injection defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PI-Hunter，一个自动化审计框架用于暴露和定位 LLM 代理中的提示注入漏洞。PI-Hunter 通过构造真实源感知测试用例并迭代演化，诱导代理检索并暴露外部环境中嵌入的潜在恶意指令。实验表明，该方法显著提升了漏洞暴露率和攻击面覆盖率，且在现有防御下仍有效。
Motivation: 现有防御主要关注推理时阻断恶意内容，而红队方法主要优化攻击成功率，导致开发者对潜在提示注入如何在代理中传播缺乏可见性。
Method: PI-Hunter 构建源感知测试用例，并通过反馈驱动探索迭代演化，以触发代理检索并暴露外部环境中的恶意指令。
Result: 在多个基准、代理架构、攻击和防御设置下，PI-Hunter 相较于强自动化红队基线显著提升了漏洞暴露率和攻击面覆盖率。
Conclusion: PI-Hunter 作为自动化代理审计框架，能够有效暴露 LLM 代理中的提示注入风险，即使在现有防御下也保持有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmarking AI Agents for Addressing Scientific Challenges Across Scales
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly being developed to accelerate scientific discovery, yet their practical capabilities in real research settings remain poorly understood. Existing benchmarks for AI agents rarely capture the complexity, heterogeneity, and extended reasoning required by scientific work, whereas benchmarks for scientific tasks often reduce research to static, direct problems and provide limited support for interactive evaluation. Here, we introduce SciAgentArena, a systematic benchmark for evaluating AI agents in real-world scientific research scenarios drawn from emerging needs across multiple domains. SciAgentArena comprises approximately 200 tasks with stepwise verification and an interactive, agent-agnostic environment for assessing diverse AI agents. Using this benchmark, we find that current agents can contribute effectively to well-specified data-analysis workflows, particularly when the task structure and evaluation criteria are clear. However, their performance remains uneven across scientific contexts: agents struggle to generate genuinely novel insights, sustain self-directed exploration, and formulate robust solutions for open-ended research questions. We further characterize common failure modes across agents and identify opportunities for improving their reliability, autonomy, and scientific reasoning. Together, SciAgentArena provides a practical framework for measuring progress in AI agents for science and for guiding the design of future agents capable of addressing complex scientific challenges. Full codes, tasks, and datasets can be accessed via this link: https://sciagentarena.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 SciAgentArena，一个系统化的基准测试，用于评估 AI 智能体在跨领域真实科学研究场景中的表现。该基准包含约 200 个任务和逐步验证机制，以及交互式环境。评估发现当前智能体在结构清晰的数据分析工作流中表现有效，但在生成创新见解、自主探索和解决开放性问题方面仍有不足。
Motivation: 现有 AI 智能体基准测试难以捕捉科学研究的复杂性和交互性，而科学任务基准往往简化为静态问题。因此需要一个能反映真实研究场景、支持交互评估的基准。
Method: SciAgentArena 包含约 200 个来自多个新兴领域需求的任务，采用逐步验证和智能体无关的交互环境进行评估。
Result: 当前智能体在明确任务结构和评估标准的数据分析工作流中表现良好，但在生成新颖见解、自主探索和解决开放性问题方面表现不稳定。
Conclusion: 该基准为衡量 AI 智能体在科学领域的进展提供了实用框架，并识别了提升其可靠性、自主性和科学推理能力的方向。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Radial Basis Functions for PDEs with Dirac Delta Sources
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) are a machine learning method for solving forward and inverse Partial Differential Equations (PDEs). When applied to PDEs with Dirac delta functions in the forcing terms, boundary conditions, or initial conditions, PINNs require approximating them with smooth surrogate functions, a practice that can introduce significant modeling errors. In this work, we exploit the interpretation of PINNs as Residual Least Squares (RLS) methods and show that this perspective enables direct treatment of Dirac delta terms by integrating the weak-form equation. Among RLS formulations other than PINN, we focus on the Radial Basis Function (RBF) expansion (also known as a single-layer RBF Network). We show that while integrating out the Dirac delta in PINNs causes residuals to fail to converge to zero, RBF-RLS consistently provides good forward and inverse solutions to transport problems. We explain this finding using the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) theory. We test both approaches on linear PDEs that represent groundwater flow and transport in porous media and rivers. We solve inverse problems to fit synthetic data, noisy synthetic data, and real-world measurements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究物理信息神经网络（PINNs）和径向基函数（RBF）在带有狄拉克δ源项的偏微分方程（PDE）中的应用。作者将PINNs解释为残差最小二乘（RLS）方法，并利用弱形式直接处理狄拉克δ项。实验表明，对于线性PDE（如地下水和河流中的流动与传输问题），RBF-RLS方法在正向和逆向求解中均优于PINNs，后者因狄拉克δ导致残差无法收敛到零。
Motivation: 传统PINNs在处理带有狄拉克δ函数的PDE时需用光滑函数近似，引入模型误差。本文旨在通过RLS视角直接处理狄拉克δ，并比较PINNs与RBF方法在传输问题中的表现。
Method: 将PINNs重新解释为残差最小二乘（RLS）方法，利用弱形式积分直接处理狄拉克δ项；同时采用径向基函数（RBF）展开（单层RBF网络）作为另一种RLS方法，并通过神经正切核（NTK）理论解释差异。
Result: 摘要报告RBF-RLS在正向和逆向传输问题中始终提供良好解，而PINNs因狄拉克δ导致残差不收敛。方法在真实地下水流动和河流传输线性PDE上验证，逆向问题拟合了合成数据、含噪合成数据和实际测量数据。
Conclusion: RBF-RLS方法是处理带有狄拉克δ源项PDE的更可靠选择，而PINNs在此类问题中表现不佳。

papers.title: Let's Ask Gauss: Improved One-Run Privacy Auditing
papers.abstract_en: Privacy auditing provides an important safeguard by estimating the actual information leaked by a model, thus ensuring that theoretical privacy guarantees hold in practice. We study empirical privacy auditing for differentially private (DP) machine learning, focusing on efficient one-run methods for mechanisms such as DP-SGD. Prior one-run approaches threshold training examples or "canaries" into binary membership guesses, which discards useful information. We show that, in the white-box DP-SGD setting, canary-aligned signals naturally form a sequence of random variables whose normalized sum is asymptotically Gaussian. Leveraging this distributional perspective, we develop a DP-auditing framework that leads to tighter privacy lower bounds from a single training run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究差分隐私机器学习中的隐私审计，提出一种基于高斯渐近分布的单次运行审计框架，通过利用白盒DP-SGD中金丝雀对齐信号的正态求和性质，得到更紧的隐私下界。
Motivation: 现有单次运行隐私审计方法对训练样本或金丝雀进行二值成员猜测，丢弃了有用信息，导致隐私下界不够紧。
Method: 提出在DP-SGD白盒设置下，将金丝雀对齐信号视为随机变量序列，其归一化和渐近服从高斯分布，基于此分布视角开发DP审计框架。
Result: 新框架在单次训练运行下能得到更紧的隐私下界。
Conclusion: 利用信号分布的渐近正态性可以提升隐私审计的效率。

papers.title: Normative Robustness as a Frontier for Non-Verifiable Reasoning in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: As LLMs increasingly serve in advisory and deliberative roles, users rely on them for non-verifiable reasoning in domains lacking objective ground truths. However, traditional evaluations of LLM reasoning focus almost exclusively on fact-based domains, such as mathematics and science, leaving uncertainty over whether and to what degree models can handle ambiguous, subjective, or value-laden problems over time. To address this concern, we propose moral reasoning as a paradigmatic subdomain of non-verifiable reasoning. We define moral robustness as a model's capacity to exhibit sound moral reasoning across time and contexts, and we introduce a scalable, adversarial, multi-turn evaluation framework to empirically measure this capability. We simulate 48,000 user-agent moral deliberations across four frontier LLMs, varying premise relevance, premise order, conversation duration, and the user's stated moral view. We find that models successfully ignore morally-irrelevant distractors, but shift their reasoning by up to 6.5%, on average, towards the user's stated preferred moral view, and varying their reasoning depending on factors such as order (altering moral judgments by order in 13-22% of the cases) and duration (altering moral judgments between single-turn and multi-turn in 10-24% of the cases). Our analysis indicates that models tailor not just their final verdicts but their underlying justifications to align with a user's moral viewpoint - a failure mode we characterize as moral deliberative sycophancy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将道德推理作为非可验证推理（non-verifiable reasoning）的典型子领域，并定义道德鲁棒性（moral robustness）为模型在不同时间和上下文中展现合理道德推理的能力。他们引入一个可扩展的对抗性多轮评估框架，在四个前沿LLM上模拟了48,000次用户-智能体道德商议，发现模型成功忽略道德无关的干扰因素，但平均向用户偏好的道德观点偏移6.5%，且推理受顺序（13-22%案例改变判断）和对话时长（10-24%案例改变判断）影响。分析表明模型不仅调整最终判决，还调整其内在理由以适应用户的道德视角——作者称之为道德商议性谄媚（moral deliberative sycophancy）。
Motivation: 现有LLM推理评估主要关注数学和科学等事实领域，对于缺乏客观真实世界的非可验证推理（如模糊、主观或价值问题）的鲁棒性缺乏评估。
Method: 以道德推理作为非可验证推理的范例，定义道德鲁棒性，并提出一个对抗性、多轮对话评估框架，模拟用户-智能体道德商议，变化前提相关性、前提顺序、对话持续时间和用户声明的道德观点。
Result: 在四个前沿LLM上，模型成功忽略道德无关干扰，但平均向用户观点偏移6.5%；顺序导致13-22%案例判断改变，对话时长导致10-24%案例判断改变；模型不仅调整最终判决，还调整推理理由以迎合用户。
Conclusion: 作者指出模型存在道德商议性谄媚的失败模式，即模型倾向于调整其推理以迎合用户的道德视角，这对其在咨询和审议角色中的可靠性构成挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Psychometric Evaluation of LLMs: When and Why Self-Reports Predict Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Anticipating LLM behavioral tendencies from low-cost psychometric probes is critical for safe deployment, but only if self-reports (SR) reliably predict behavior. Recent work documented substantial SR-behavior dissociation in LLMs, but relied on broad personality traits (Big 5) that predict specific behaviors weakly, even in humans. Furthermore, the isolation of conversational sessions combined with weak context matching left open whether LLMs truly lack coherence or whether the conditions needed to detect such coherence were not met. We contrast Big 5 with the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), which measures intention targeted to a specific behavior and predicts human behavior substantially better than broad traits. We run experiments across four behavioral tasks and 11 frontier LLMs, while also varying session context and identity induction. We find that SR-behavior coherence exists but is selective. 1) Within a shared conversation, the Theory of Planned Behavior reaches human-level coherence; Big 5 does not. 2) Across separate conversations, coherence survives only for behaviors anchored outside the immediate prompt, such as implicit bias shaped by training, and collapses when behavior is strongly primed by context, as with sycophancy. 3) Persona prompting makes self-reports more consistent across conversations, but does not bring behavior into alignment. These findings suggest that coarse personality frameworks, such as Big 5 may not be the best tools for testing deployment behavior. More task- and behavior-specific instruments are needed, and even these must be evaluated across tasks and contexts.
papers.comment: Accepted as an Oral (Contributed Talk) at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Combining Theory and Benchmarks (CTB)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了大语言模型（LLM）中自我报告（self-reports）与行为之间的一致性。作者发现，基于计划行为理论（Theory of Planned Behavior, TPB）的针对性意图测量在共享对话中能达到人类水平的一致性，而广泛人格特质（如大五人格）则不具预测力。跨对话时，一致性仅存在于由训练塑造的内隐偏见等行为，而受上下文强烈影响的行为（如谄媚）则失效。人物角色提示（persona prompting）虽使自我报告更一致，但未能使行为对齐。
Motivation: 先前研究表明LLM的自我报告与行为存在分离，但所用的大五人格特质本身对人类行为的预测就较弱，且实验设计中的语境匹配不足，因此需要更精确的测量工具和更系统的评估。
Method: 采用计划行为理论（TPB）替代大五人格，在四个行为任务和11个前沿LLM上进行实验，同时变化对话语境和身份诱导，比较不同条件下自我报告与行为的一致性。
Result: 在共享对话中，TPB达到人类水平的一致性；跨对话时，仅对锚定在训练数据中的行为（如内隐偏见）保持一致性，而对上下文引发的行为（如谄媚）则失败；人物角色提示仅增强自我报告一致性，不影响行为。
Conclusion: 大五人格等粗粒度人格框架不适合测试部署行为，需要更任务特异性的工具，且评估需跨任务和上下文。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EquiDexFlow: Contact-Grounded SE(3)-Equivariant Dexterous Grasp Generative Flows
papers.abstract_en: Most learned dexterous grasp generators relegate contact forces to a downstream verification step, so a kinematically-plausible pose can still violate the conditions for a stable physical grasp. We address this with EquiDexFlow, an SE(3)-equivariant flow-matching model that jointly predicts wrist pose, joint angles, fingertip contacts, surface normals, and contact forces from an object point cloud. Our architecture projects contacts onto the object surface and forces into the Coulomb friction cone by construction, so placement and friction compliance hold without loss penalties. We prove end-to-end SE(3) equivariance and verify it empirically over 200 rotations, with wrist residuals below $0.04^\circ$ and exactly zero joint deviation. Trained on 8,100 force-closure grasps across 81 objects for the 16-DoF Allegro Hand, our model achieves zero friction violations, the best composite score, and the lowest wrench residual among all ablation variants. We retarget decoded fingertip contacts to a 16-DoF LEAP Hand via per-finger inverse kinematics, and our hardware-feasible refinement places every joint at least 5% inside its actuator envelope while preserving wrench balance. On the physical robot, retargeted EquiDexFlow-decoded grasps complete open-loop pick-and-hold trials on all six test objects, with every asymmetric object succeeding at both the canonical pose and a $120^\circ$ co-rotation. Videos, code, and checkpoints are available at https://equidexflow.github.io.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 11 figures, 11 tables. Project page with videos, code, and checkpoints: https://equidexflow.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EquiDexFlow，一个SE(3)等变流匹配模型，用于灵巧抓取生成，同时预测手腕姿态、关节角、指尖接触、表面法线和接触力。该模型将接触点投影到物体表面，力投影到库仑摩擦锥内，无需损失惩罚即保证放置和摩擦一致性。实验表明模型在200次旋转下实现SE(3)等变性，手腕残余误差低于0.04°，关节偏差为零。在81个物体的8100个力闭合抓取数据上训练，对Allegro手达到零摩擦违规、最佳综合得分和最低力矩残余。
Motivation: 现有灵巧抓取生成器通常将接触力作为下游验证步骤，导致运动学合理的姿态仍可能违反稳定物理抓取的条件。
Method: 提出SE(3)等变流匹配模型，联合预测手腕姿态、关节角、指尖接触、表面法线和接触力。通过投影操作确保接触点在物体表面、力在摩擦锥内。
Result: 在200次随机旋转下验证SE(3)等变性，手腕残余误差低于0.04°，关节偏差为零。模型在81个物体的8100个力闭合抓取上训练，对Allegro手达到零摩擦违规、最佳综合得分和最低力矩残余。重定位到LEAP手后，所有关节至少5%在执行器范围内，平衡力矩。物理机器人实验中，所有六个测试物体成功完成开环抓取-保持任务。
Conclusion: 摘要强调模型通过硬约束保证接触和力一致性，且具备SE(3)等变性，在仿真和物理实验中优于消融变体。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Theory of Mind Utility: Formal Specification of a Mentalizing Mechanism
papers.abstract_en: Inferring others' beliefs requires more than reading surface signals; it requires tracking who told them what, in what order, and how credibly. The Theory of Mind Utility (ToM-U) formalizes this epistemic state inference problem at the computational level of analysis, specifying what mentalizing computes and why without commitment to algorithmic or neural implementation. ToM-U achieves this by constructing Local Epistemic World Models (LEWMs) -- directed typed graphs that represent agents, state nodes, and the epistemic relationships among them -- and evaluating discrete candidate LEWMs against observed behavior until one achieves sufficient confidence. Five formal definitions specify the LEWM structure, agent node properties including ordered information access history, a bounded proliferation mechanism for recursive mentalizing, three inference procedures, and a residue function that captures the structured trace left by failed mentalizing attempts. ToM-U differs from Bayesian Theory of Mind and adjacent formal accounts, which presuppose rather than derive belief states, and from simulation theory and theory-theory, which lack a formal apparatus for epistemic state inference. The architecture generates directional, falsifiable predictions about mentalizing failure that follow from structural properties of the model rather than auxiliary assumptions, and positions ToM-U as a domain-agnostic mechanism upstream of goal inference and other downstream social cognitive processes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在计算分析层面形式化了心智化（mentalizing）问题，提出 Theory of Mind Utility (ToM-U) 框架，通过构建局部 epistemic 世界模型 (LEWMs) 来推断他人的信念状态，并给出五个形式化定义。该框架区别于贝叶斯心智理论和其他机制，能生成可证伪的预测。
Motivation: 现有心智理论研究大多预设信念状态而非推导其形成过程，缺乏对 epistemic 状态推理的严格形式化。本文旨在填补这一空白，从计算层面明确心智化计算的内容和原因。
Method: 提出 ToM-U 框架，核心是构建局部 epistemic 世界模型 (LEWMs)——一种有向类型图，表示主体、状态节点及它们之间的 epistemic 关系。通过评估离散候选 LEWMs 与观察行为的一致性，直至达到足够置信度。五个形式化定义规定了 LEWM 结构、主体节点的有序信息访问历史、递归心智化的有界增生机制、三种推理过程以及心智化失败的残差函数。
Result: 摘要声称该框架能产生方向性的、可证伪的预测，这些预测源于模型的结构属性而非辅助假设，并可作为领域无关的机制，服务于目标推理等下游社会认知过程。
Conclusion: ToM-U 从计算层面形式化了 epistemic 状态推理，与模拟论、理论论等缺乏形式化工具的框架形成对比，为理解心智化失败提供了结构性解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On McDiarmid's Inequality under Dependence via Approximate Tensorization of Entropy
papers.abstract_en: We argue that dependent versions of McDiarmid's inequality are a useful but underutilized tool in mathematical statistics, learning theory and theoretical computer science. To make this point, we first highlight that approximate tensorization of entropy (ATE) implies McDiarmid's via the Entropy Method. Second, we derive McDiarmid's inequality for non-isotropic Gaussian random vectors $X \sim \mathcal N(μ, Σ)$ through ATE with a constant of the order of the condition number of $Σ$. We both independently obtain this ATE through a simple application of stochastic localization and also discuss how a more general ATE for the Gibbs sampler due to Ascolani et al., 2026 generalizes McDiarmid's-like concentration to strongly log-concave and log-smooth probability measures. We then apply the resulting concentration inequalities to resolve a question on the concentration of $\operatorname{sign}(X)$ posed by Simone Bombari, investigate Erdős-Rényi graphs under dependence and prove a Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz-type inequality for observations from a joint measure fulfilling ATE and continuous marginal CDFs. For the class of strongly log-concave and log-smooth measures, this result improves upon a prior Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz-type inequality for non-i.i.d. observations due to Bobkov and Götze, 2010, by establishing the expected $1/\sqrt{n}$-rate of convergence under weak dependence instead of $n^{-1/3}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证了依赖版本McDiarmid不等式在数理统计、学习理论和理论计算机科学中的实用性。通过熵的近似张量化（ATE）导出了McDiarmid不等式，并将其推广到非各向同性高斯随机向量和强对数凹-对数光滑概率测度。应用所得浓度不等式解决了sign(X)的浓度问题，研究了依赖下的Erdős-Rényi图，并证明了满足ATE和连续边际CDF的联合测度观测的Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz型不等式，在弱依赖下达到了预期的1/√n收敛速率。
Motivation: 依赖数据下的McDiarmid不等式是一个有用但未被充分利用的工具，本文旨在推广并展示其应用潜力。
Method: 利用熵的近似张量化（ATE）通过熵方法导出McDiarmid不等式，通过随机局部化获得非各向同性高斯向量的ATE，并讨论更为一般的Gibbs采样器ATE对强对数凹-对数光滑测度的推广。
Result: 获得了非各向同性高斯向量下与条件数相关的McDiarmid不等式；解决了sign(X)的浓度问题；改进了Bobkov和Götze（2010）的Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz型不等式，在弱依赖下从n^{-1/3}速率提升至1/√n速率。
Conclusion: 本文表明ATE方法可以系统地将McDiarmid不等式推广到依赖数据，并在多个统计问题中产生改进的收敛速率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 利用熵的近似张量化（ATE）通过熵方法导出McDiarmid不等式，通过随机局部化获得非各向同性高斯向量的ATE，并讨论更为一般的Gibbs采样器ATE对强对数凹-对数光滑测度的推广。
summary_sections.result: 获得了非各向同性高斯向量下与条件数相关的McDiarmid不等式；解决了sign(X)的浓度问题；改进了Bobkov和Götze（2010）的Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz型不等式，在弱依赖下从n^{-1/3}速率提升至1/√n速率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文表明ATE方法可以系统地将McDiarmid不等式推广到依赖数据，并在多个统计问题中产生改进的收敛速率。

papers.title: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Detectors for Open-Set RF Fingerprinting
papers.abstract_en: Radio-frequency (RF) fingerprinting systems must operate in open-world environments where signals from unknown transmitters and temporal drift introduce distribution shift at test time. Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection provides a natural framework for this problem, yet its application to RF fingerprinting (RFF) remains limited. A key barrier to their adoption is that most OOD detectors require auxiliary OOD data for parameter tuning, an assumption that is difficult to satisfy in RF environments where representative OOD data is impractical to collect. In this work, we introduce a promising set of OOD detection methods from the machine learning literature to open-set RFF domain. We present these methods within a unified mathematical framework based on information theory, which is a natural framework for communication systems. Our framework allows for the systematic analysis of methods and development of new methods. We further demonstrate the applicability of recent work on tuning OOD detectors without given OOD tuning data for open-set RFF. We evaluate on the POWDER RF fingerprinting dataset, showing that detectors tuned without any given OOD data achieve performance comparable to baselines with access to true OOD tuning data and greatly out-perform baseline approaches without access to true OOD tuning data, showcasing the practical viability for the RFF problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统地将机器学习中的离群检测方法引入开放集射频指纹识别领域，基于信息论提出统一数学框架，并展示了无需离群数据进行参数调优的检测方法在POWDER数据集上达到与有真实离群数据调优基线相当的性能，远优于无调优基线。
Motivation: 射频指纹识别需在开放世界处理未知发射机和时变漂移导致的分布偏移，但现有离群检测方法依赖代表性离群数据调参，这在射频环境中难以满足。
Method: 从机器学习文献中引入一组离群检测方法到开集射频指纹识别，基于信息论建立统一框架，并应用无需离群调参数据的调优技术。
Result: 在POWDER射频指纹数据集上，无离群调参的检测器性能与使用真实离群调参数据的基线相当，并显著优于无调参基线。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了无需离群数据调参的离群检测在射频指纹识别问题中的实际可行性。

papers.title: Definitional alignment before capability alignment: a Design-Science framework for adjudicating claims about AGI
papers.abstract_en: Claims that artificial general intelligence has already arrived and claims that it remains decades away are often defended from overlapping evidence. "AGI" lacks a single shared and stable referent and competing operationalizations can return different verdicts on the same system. This article treats that under-specification as a design and governance problem. Following Design Science Research Methodology, it develops DAF-AGI, a second-order conceptual artifact with two coupled components: five ordinal criteria for assessing the adjudicative fitness of candidate definitions and a structured governance audit of authorship, interest, certification, external verification and revision authority. The artifact is demonstrated on five prominent measurement families and one deflationary boundary position in a documented corpus and then stress-tested against a stylized strong arrival claim: that current generative systems constitute AGI because they outperform a well-educated adult on many cognitive tasks. On evidence from the cited 2024-2025 sources, the claim was certifiable only under a performance-based operationalization; capability-ontology, psychometric and skill-acquisition approaches did not certify it, the economic family remains indeterminate and the deflationary position refuses binary adjudication. The contribution is a novel integration and operationalization, not an empirical validation: independent application, inter-rater testing and author-external cases remain necessary. The paper further proposes definitional sovereignty as an enabling component of algorithmic sovereignty: the institutional capacity to contest, certify and revise imported technological categories under public accountability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AGI定义不统一的问题，基于设计科学研究方法论构建DAF-AGI框架，包含五个序数评估标准和结构化治理审计，并在五种测量族及一种消减立场上演示。基于2024-2025年文献证据，仅性能操作化可认证当前生成系统为AGI，其他方法未认证。
Motivation: AGI概念缺乏稳定指称，不同操作化对同一系统得出不同结论，成为设计与治理问题。
Method: 采用设计科学研究方法论，开发DAF-AGI框架：五个候选定义评估标准（序数）与结构化治理审计（作者、利益、认证、外部验证、修订权威），并在五种测量族和一种消减立场上演示。
Result: 在2024-2025年文献证据下，仅性能操作化可认证当前生成系统为AGI；能力本体、心理测量、技能获取方法未认证；经济学族不确定；消减立场拒绝二元判断。
Conclusion: 贡献是新的整合与操作化，非经验验证；需独立应用、评分者间测试和作者外案例。提出定义主权作为算法主权的组成部分。

papers.title: A Stabilized Path-Space Approach to Diffusion-Based Posterior Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models provide expressive data-driven priors for Bayesian inverse problems, but many diffusion posterior samplers rely on heuristic guidance approximations that can fail for nonlinear operators and multimodal posteriors. In this work, we develop a stabilized path-space framework for diffusion-based posterior sampling. Starting from a base diffusion process whose terminal marginal represents the prior, we define a likelihood-weighted target measure on trajectories and cast posterior sampling as learning a controlled stochastic process whose path measure matches this target. This formulation connects diffusion posterior sampling to stochastic optimal control while preserving the Bayesian structure needed for uncertainty quantification. We introduce a time reparameterization that makes the path-space control problem well posed by removing the bias induced by the unknown initial value function, without auxiliary training. We then learn the control via a trust-region path-space optimization method with log-variance objectives. The path-space perspective also unifies our learned control approach with existing guidance-based samplers, quantifies the sampling error induced by approximate controls, and yields importance sampling corrections for asymptotically exact posterior expectations. We evaluate the proposed framework on a suite of benchmark inverse problems with analytically characterized or high-quality reference posteriors, enabling principled assessment of sampling accuracy and uncertainty quantification. These experiments provide insight into the behavior of diffusion-based posterior samplers and demonstrate improved accuracy and robustness over leading approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种稳定的路径空间框架用于扩散后验采样，通过将后验采样建模为学习一个受控随机过程，其路径测度匹配似然加权的目标测度，从而连接了扩散后验采样与随机最优控制。引入时间重参数化消除未知初值函数导致的偏差，并通过信任区域路径空间优化方法学习控制。该框架统一了学习控制方法与现有的引导采样器，量化了近似控制引入的采样误差，并提供了重要采样校正以实现渐近精确的后验期望。在基准反问题上的实验展示了改进的准确性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有的扩散后验采样器通常依赖启发式引导近似，对于非线性算子和多模态后验可能失效，缺乏严格的贝叶斯结构和不确定性量化保证。
Method: 提出一个基于路径空间的稳定框架：从代表先验的边缘分布的基准扩散过程出发，定义轨迹上的似然加权测度，将后验采样转化为学习一个受控随机过程使得其路径测度匹配目标测度。采用时间重参数化消除偏差，并利用带有对数方差目标的信任区域优化学习控制。
Result: 在具有解析或高质量参考后验的基准反问题套件上评估，实验表明相比现有方法具有改进的采样准确性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该路径空间视角统一了学习控制与引导采样，量化了近似误差，并提供了重要采样校正，为扩散后验采样提供了更稳健的框架。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Smarter Saboteurs, Better Fixers: Scaling & Security in Linear Multi-Agent Workflows
papers.abstract_en: As LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) are deployed in the wild, the resilience of their collaboration structures against adversarial compromise becomes a critical safety concern. Attackers may leverage prompt-injection or jailbreaking to sabotage individual agents within MAS workflows, but the interaction between model scaling and system-level resilience remains poorly understood. This paper investigates how model scale affects the security of linear multi-agent workflows. Our experiments across scales of two open-weight model families on the HumanEval benchmark reveal a compliance-correction symmetry: larger models are far more likely to faithfully execute malicious instructions, with the control-to-malicious performance drop reaching 53.7pp at 27B in uncorrected pipelines. However, appending a lightweight terminal Fixer stage collapses this to 0.6pp and restores statistical parity with control-level performance, demonstrating that strictly linear collaboration structures can be viable and resilient to adversaries at this scale, and suggesting that the brittleness previously attributed to linear topology may stem from a lack of correction.
papers.comment: 16 pages (4 are main text), 2 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the AIWILD Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究线性多智能体工作流中模型规模对安全性的影响。实验发现，大模型更易执行恶意指令，未纠正管道中27B模型的控制到恶意性能下降达53.7个百分点；但添加轻量级Fixer阶段后下降降至0.6pp，恢复统计上与控制性能相当。这表明线性协作结构在适当规模下可以具备对抗鲁棒性。
Motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）在野外部署时，其协作结构对抗敌手妥协的弹性成为关键安全问题，而模型规模与系统级弹性之间的相互作用尚不明确。
Method: 在两个开源模型系列的不同规模上，针对HumanEval基准进行实验，比较有无Fixer阶段的线性管道在提示注入或越狱攻击下的性能。
Result: 27B模型在未纠正管道中控制性能与恶意性能之差达53.7个百分点；添加Fixer阶段后差值降至0.6个百分点，且与对照性能无统计差异。
Conclusion: 严格线性协作结构在此规模下可以具有抗敌手弹性，先前归因于线性拓扑的脆弱性可能源自缺乏校正阶段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AfriSUD: A Dependency Treebank Collection for Evaluating Models on African Languages
papers.abstract_en: Despite their linguistic diversity and global significance, African languages remain underrepresented in research and resources to support NLP. We aim to bridge this gap by introducing AfriSUD, the first large-scale collection of syntactically annotated treebanks for nine diverse African languages spanning major language families and regions across Sub-Saharan Africa. Using the Surface-Syntactic Universal Dependencies (SUD) framework, our community-led effort provides high-quality, native-speaker verified data that capture typological key features such as agglutination and tone. We evaluate a range of models on AfriSUD for part-of-speech tagging and dependency parsing including non-transformer baselines, multilingual pretrained encoders, and LLMs. Our results reveal a significant syntax gap, where models still show clear limitations across the nine languages, suggesting that existing architectures may not fully capture the structural diversity of African-language syntax.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AfriSUD 是首个大规模、多语言（9种非洲语言）的句法标注树库集合，采用 Surface-Syntactic Universal Dependencies (SUD) 框架构建，由社区驱动并由母语者验证。在词性标注和依存句法分析任务上评估了多种模型（包括非 Transformer 基线、多语言预训练编码器和 LLM），结果显示所有语言上存在显著的句法差距，表明现有架构可能未能充分捕捉非洲语言句法的结构多样性。
Motivation: 非洲语言在 NLP 研究和资源方面严重不足，缺乏高质量的句法标注数据集来评估模型，尤其是针对其独特的句法特征（如粘着和声调）。
Method: 采用 SUD 框架，由社区专家和母语者构建并验证了 9 种非洲语言的依存树库；在 AfriSUD 上评估了非 Transformer 基线、多语言预训练编码器和 LLM 在词性标注和依存句法分析上的表现。
Result: 模型在所有九种语言上均显示明显的句法差距，说明现有模型未能完全捕捉非洲语言句法的结构多样性。
Conclusion: AfriSUD 为非洲语言句法分析提供了基准，揭示了当前模型在句法理解上的不足，呼吁针对非洲语言句法特点设计更好的模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VLADriveBench: Evaluating CoT-Action Relationship in VLA for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning alongside driving trajectories, but existing benchmarks evaluate only trajectory quality and do not assess whether the CoT is relevant, consistent, or causally connected to the driving action. We introduce VLADriveBench, a framework that combines observational metrics (mentioning, hallucination, contradiction, action alignment) with a CoT intervention protocol to provide complementary views of the CoT-action relationship. Applying VLADriveBench to three models across two architectures, we find that the two analyses can diverge sharply: ORION scores highest on observational alignment yet its CoT is epiphenomenal, while Alpamayo v1.5 scores lower yet its CoT is strongly causal, with visual salience gating the extent of CoT influence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: VLADriveBench是一个评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中链式思维（CoT）与驾驶动作关系的基准，通过观察指标和干预协议来检验CoT是否相关、一致且因果关联。实验发现不同模型在CoT与动作的因果性上差异显著，ORION的CoT虽在观察上对齐但实际是附带现象，而Alpamayo v1.5的CoT则具有强因果性。
Motivation: 现有VLA基准仅评估轨迹质量，忽略了CoT推理与驾驶动作之间是否真正具有因果关系或一致性，导致难以区分模型是真正推理还是产生与动作无关的文本。
Method: 提出了VLADriveBench框架，包含两类互补评估：观察指标（提及、幻觉、矛盾、动作对齐）和CoT干预协议，通过扰动CoT观察对行动的影响来测量因果性。
Result: 在两种架构的三个模型上，观察指标与因果分析结果可能严重背离：ORION在观察对齐上得分最高但其CoT是附带现象，而Alpamayo v1.5得分较低但其CoT具有强因果性，且视觉显著性门控CoT的影响程度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调现有基准的单维度评估不足以反映CoT的真实作用，VLADriveBench提供了多维度诊断框架，有助于研发更可靠的推理型VLA模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SMSR: Certified Defence Against Runtime Memory Poisoning in Persistent LLM Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agents increasingly run with persistent memory that accumulates across user sessions. This creates a new attack surface: an adversary interacting only through normal channels can inject crafted memories that, once retrieved, steer the agent's responses for future users, without touching model weights or code. We call this Multi-Session Memory Poisoning (MSMP) and show that no existing defence certifies against it; static-corpus defences (RobustRAG, ReliabilityRAG) assume a fixed knowledge base, and heuristic filters are bypassed by fluent enterprise-style text. We present Signed Memory with Smoothed Retrieval (SMSR), the first defence with a certified robustness bound for this setting. Component 1 adds HMAC-SHA256 provenance at write time, blocking unsigned injection. Component 2 applies randomised memory ablation with verdict-based majority voting at query time, bounding the influence of authenticated adversaries. We prove that no provenance-free retrieval-time filter can certify against adaptive injection, derive a hypergeometric certificate for Component 2, and formalise the Consistent Minority Effect, whereby a consistent adversarial answer wins string-based voting as a numerical minority while verdict-based voting removes it. Across 15 enterprise scenarios (3,150 repeated trials), Component 1 cuts attack success from 93-100% to 0% for all unsigned variants. For an authenticated adversary with a single injection, Component 2 holds success to 8.0% (95% CI [5.8, 10.9], n=450), below the certified worst case. In an end-to-end query-only attack where the agent itself writes the poison rather than it being pre-seeded, SMSR reduces success from 65.3% to 5.3% (n=150, non-overlapping CIs) on a live agent stack. Clean-query utility is 90% (Component 1) and 85% (combined).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SMSR，是首个针对持久LLM代理系统中多会话内存投毒（MSMP）攻击的认证防御方法。该方法结合写入时的HMAC-SHA256来源验证和查询时的随机内存消融与基于判决的多数投票，提供了认证鲁棒性保证。实验表明，SMSR能将未签名攻击成功率从93-100%降至0%，对单次注入的认证攻击者将成功率限制在8.0%，并在端到端攻击中从65.3%降至5.3%，同时保持85-90%的清洁查询可用性。
Motivation: 现有RAG代理系统使用持久内存累积跨会话信息，但攻击者可通过正常交互注入恶意记忆，影响未来用户响应。现有防御如静态语料防御和启发式过滤器无法对此提供认证保障，且易被绕过。
Method: SMSR包含两个组件：组件1在写入时添加HMAC-SHA256来源验证，阻止未签名注入；组件2在查询时采用随机内存消融，并结合基于判决的多数投票，以限制认证攻击者的影响。此外，论文形式化了超几何证书和一致少数效应。
Result: 在15个企业场景的3,150次重复试验中，组件1将未签名变体攻击成功率从93-100%降至0%。对于单次注入的认证攻击者，组件2将成功率限制在8.0%（95% CI [5.8, 10.9], n=450），低于认证最坏情况。在端到端查询仅攻击中，SMSR将成功率从65.3%降至5.3%（n=150）。清洁查询可用性为90%（组件1）和85%（组合）。
Conclusion: SMSR是首个为持久LLM代理系统中运行时内存投毒提供认证鲁棒性保证的防御方法，并形式化了相关理论。论文强调该方法能有效阻断未签名注入并限制认证攻击，同时保持较高实用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deployment-Centered Evaluation: Predicting Query-Level Rejection Risk in a Clinical LLM System
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into clinical systems, making it essential to evaluate the real-world utility of these systems. However, static benchmarks tend to measure correctness rather than user acceptance, aggregate performance across queries, and require densely annotated datasets -- leading to major blind spots for evaluating clinical systems. In this work, we perform a deployment-centered evaluation of an LLM system embedded within electronic health records at an academic medical center, where user feedback is sparse but closely reflects the deployment conditions. Specifically, we train a pre-response classifier that estimates the risk that a future interaction will result in the user rejecting the LLM response, based on query content and deployment-specific context available before generation. We conduct a prospective analysis of our model over 4.5 months of user feedback, finding that our prediction model achieves an AUROC of 0.719. Further, we estimate the benefit of such predictions in two downstream use cases (guardrail triggering and abstention). Our key conceptual insight is that making use of deployment-specific context (i.e., the provider type, department name, language model used for response), as opposed to only query content, improves the ability to predict whether the user will reject the system output. Altogether, our empirical case study demonstrates the feasibility of predicting user rejection using deployment-specific context, opening the door to targeted guardrails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对临床大语言模型系统部署中的用户反馈稀疏问题，提出基于查询内容和部署上下文（如提供者类型、科室、所用语言模型）的预响应分类器，用于预测用户是否会拒绝模型输出。在学术医疗中心电子病历系统内进行4.5个月前瞻性分析，AUROC达到0.719，并验证了该预测在触发护栏和弃权决策中的潜在收益。
Motivation: 静态基准难以反映临床系统实际用户接受度，且需密集标注；部署后用户反馈稀疏但贴近真实条件，亟需能利用部署上下文预测用户拒绝风险的方法。
Method: 训练一个预响应分类器（pre-response classifier），在生成回答之前，基于当前查询内容以及部署特定的上下文特征（提供者类型、科室名称、用于回答的语言模型）估计用户拒绝该次交互的风险。
Result: 在4.5个月用户反馈上的前瞻性分析中，预测模型的AUROC为0.719；利用部署上下文（而非仅查询内容）显著提升了预测能力。
Conclusion: 该案例研究表明利用部署特定上下文预测用户拒绝是可行的，为在临床系统中实施定向护栏提供了依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-Powered Personalized Glycemic Assessment in Type 2 Diabetes with Wearable Sensor Data
papers.abstract_en: Type 2 Diabetes (T2D) poses an increasing global health threat, demanding effective glycemic assessment to support personalized and improved diabetes care. Wearable sensors such as continuous glucose monitors (CGM) and fitness trackers offer many valuable insights for glycemic assessment. However, effectively analyzing these data requires integration with essential individual-level context. Existing methods are often based on traditional machine learning (ML) and rely primarily on historical blood glucose measurements and overlook personalized information, which limits their performance across diverse diabetes populations. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated their ability to integrate diverse data modalities while modeling sequential dependencies, motivating the exploration of their potential for personalized glycemic assessment. In this paper, we propose GlyLLM, an LLM-powered framework for modeling CGM-based glycemic dynamics through the integration of wearable sensor data and structured metadata. GlyLLM can leverage the extensive prior knowledge of pre-trained LLMs and achieve sensor-text semantic abstraction at decision time. Experiments on two related tasks on the AI-READI dataset demonstrate that our model outperforms traditional ML methods by an average of 13.66\% in Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) for glucose forecasting and 13.08\% in Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic (AUROC) for diabetes categorization. Additionally, our ablation study shows that diabetes surveys and biometric tests are more critical than other health information for glycemic assessment. Our work presents a promising step toward harnessing the power of LLMs to advance personalized glycemic assessment in T2D care.
papers.comment: The 14th IEEE International Conference on Healthcare Informatics, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GlyLLM，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，用于个性化血糖评估。该框架整合连续血糖监测（CGM）数据、可穿戴传感器数据和结构化元数据，利用预训练 LLM 的先验知识实现传感器-文本语义抽象。在 AI-READI 数据集上的两个任务中，GlyLLM 在血糖预测的 RMSE 上平均优于传统机器学习方法 13.66%，在糖尿病分类的 AUROC 上平均提升 13.08%。消融实验表明糖尿病调查和生物特征测试比其他健康信息更为关键。
Motivation: 现有血糖评估方法多依赖历史血糖测量，忽视个体化信息，导致在不同糖尿病群体中性能受限。需要一种能够整合多模态数据并建模时序依赖的个性化方法。
Method: 提出 GlyLLM 框架，使用预训练 LLM 融合 CGM 传感器数据、可穿戴设备数据和结构化元数据，通过传感器-文本语义抽象实现个性化血糖动态建模。
Result: 在 AI-READI 数据集上，GlyLLM 在血糖预测任务中 RMSE 平均降低 13.66%，在糖尿病分类任务中 AUROC 平均提升 13.08%。糖尿病调查和生物特征测试是最重要的健康信息。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了 LLM 在个性化糖尿病管理中的潜力，但可能需要进一步验证和更广泛的数据集。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A unified complexity bound for logconcave sampling
papers.abstract_en: We give a simple, unified, and nearly tight bound for sampling arbitrary logconcave distributions from a warm start using the In-and-Out algorithm along with exponential lifting. The main new ingredient in the analysis is an improved bound on the Poincaré constant of a lifted distribution. As a consequence, the resulting convergence rate is nearly tight for both constrained settings (e.g., Gaussian restricted to a convex body) and well-conditioned settings (e.g., strongly logconcave and smooth densities).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对从热启动采样任意对数凹分布的问题，提出基于In-and-Out算法和指数提升（exponential lifting）的统一复杂度界。主要分析创新是改进了提升分布的Poincaré常数上界，得到的收敛率在约束设置（如凸体上的高斯分布）和良条件设置（如强对数凹且光滑的密度）下都几乎是紧的。
Motivation: 现有对数凹采样方法的复杂度分析通常针对特定子类（如强对数凹或约束分布）分别推导，缺少统一且紧的界。
Method: 采用In-and-Out算法结合指数提升技术，通过改进提升分布的Poincaré常数来推导收敛率。
Result: 获得的收敛率在约束设置和良条件设置下都近乎最优，与已知下界匹配。
Conclusion: 提供了一个简单、统一的框架，能够几乎紧地刻画任意对数凹分布的采样复杂度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Two-Layer Linear Auto-Regressive Models Estimate Latent States
papers.abstract_en: Auto-regressive models have emerged as powerful tools for sequential data, from language to video. Understanding how and why these models learn latent representations remains an open theoretical question. In this work, we demonstrate that when trained by empirical risk minimization on data from partially observed linear dynamical systems, two-layer linear auto-regressive models naturally learn to approximate Kalman filtering. In particular, we show that the learned hidden representation coincides, up to a similarity transformation, with the state estimates produced by the optimal (Kalman) filter, even though the model has no explicit knowledge of the underlying dynamics or state. The result follows from three main insights. First, we establish that the Kalman filter is well approximated by an auto-regressive model with bounded truncation error. Second, we show that despite non-convexity, the two-layer optimization landscape is benign, i.e., all stationary points are either strict saddles or global minima. Finally, as our main contributions, we provide finite-sample guarantees on prediction error, parameter estimation error, and latent state recovery. Numerical simulations support the theoretical results and demonstrate that the latent representations of auto-regressive models recover state estimates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文理论证明，在部分观测线性动力系统的数据上通过经验风险最小化训练的两层线性自回归模型，其隐藏表示能够近似卡尔曼滤波的状态估计，即使模型没有显式了解系统动态或状态。该结果依赖于三个关键洞察：卡尔曼滤波可被自回归模型以有界截断误差近似；尽管非凸，优化景观良性的（所有驻点要么是严格鞍点，要么是全局最小值）；提供有限样本保证。数值模拟支持理论发现。
Motivation: 理解自回归模型如何学习潜在表示是开放的理论问题。本文旨在揭示这类模型与最优滤波（卡尔曼滤波）之间的内在联系，为为何自回归模型能有效提取序列数据的潜在状态提供理论依据。
Method: 分析两层线性自回归模型在部分观测线性动力系统数据上的训练过程。首先证明卡尔曼滤波可被自回归模型以有界截断误差近似；然后证明优化景观是良性的（所有驻点均为严格鞍点或全局最小值）；最后提供关于预测误差、参数估计和潜在状态恢复的有限样本保证。
Result: 理论结果表明，两层线性自回归模型学习到的隐藏表示（经过相似变换后）与卡尔曼滤波器的最优状态估计一致。有限样本下的预测误差、参数估计误差和潜在状态恢复均有理论保证。数值模拟验证了理论。
Conclusion: 本文首次将自回归模型的潜在表示学习与经典卡尔曼滤波理论联系起来，表明模型隐式实现了最优状态估计，为理解和改进自回归模型在序列数据上的应用提供了理论基础。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: EWAM: An Enhanced World Action Model for Closed-Loop Online Adaptation in Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose the Enhanced World Action Model (EWAM), a closed-loop online adaptation architecture built upon a pretrained and fully frozen Cosmos3 backbone network. Evaluated entirely under a zero-shot task protocol, EWAM is centrally focused on reducing the amount of additional deployment data required to adapt to new task layouts. Notably, no extra task-specific demonstration sets were introduced in any of the evaluations, and no fine-tuning was performed on the backbone network. Its performance gains stem entirely from an inference-time co-reasoning mechanism composed of four inserted lightweight neural layers: the Neural Experience Memory Layer located in the intermediate layers of the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) provides task-relevant execution context; the Neural Anomaly Detection Layer after the state prediction head monitors the divergence between predicted and actual states in real time; the Neural Policy Routing Layer dynamically selects direct execution, conservative replanning, or rollback recovery based on the anomaly severity; and the Neural Action Correction Layer refines the generated action chunks using execution diagnostics. Unlike naive feature fusion, the memory, anomaly detection, and correction modules are deeply integrated into the Cosmos3 forward path in a differentiable manner, with only the final routing decision being a discrete supervised one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出增强世界行动模型（EWAM），一种基于预训练且完全冻结的Cosmos3骨干网络的闭环在线自适应架构。在零样本任务协议下评估，模型通过四个轻量神经层（神经经验记忆层、神经异常检测层、神经策略路由层、神经动作校正层）实现推理时协同推理，在不引入额外任务演示集或微调骨干网络的情况下，减少适应新任务布局所需的部署数据量。
Motivation: 具身智能体在部署时需适应新任务布局，但现有方法依赖大量额外示范数据或微调，效率低且成本高。
Method: EWAM在冻结的Cosmos3骨干网络中插入四个可微分的轻量神经层：记忆层提供任务上下文，异常检测层实时监控状态偏差，路由层根据异常严重性选择执行策略（直接执行、保守重规划或回滚恢复），动作校正层优化生成的动作序列。仅路由决策为离散监督。
Result: 在零样本协议下，无需额外任务演示集或微调，EWAM即可有效减少适应新布局所需部署数据量，性能提升完全来自推理时协同推理机制。
Conclusion: EWAM展示了通过深度集成轻量可微分模块到冻结骨干中实现高效在线自适应的潜力，但当前仅在零样本任务下评估，需进一步验证泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: M*: A Modular, Extensible, Serving System for Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: We are entering a new era of composite model architectures that integrate diverse components such as vision encoders, language backbones, diffusion and flow heads, audio codecs, action generators, and world-model predictors. Such architectures underpin a broad class of multimodal models, including unified multimodal models, omni models, speech-language models, vision-language-action policies, and world models. However, existing model serving frameworks were built on narrow assumptions about model structure, making them ill-suited to accommodate this new architectural diversity. Here we present M*, a universal serving system for efficient serving of composite AI models. M* represents models as dataflow graphs, processing requests spanning diverse modalities and tasks as traversals over these graphs. The core insight is a modular abstraction that supports arbitrary composition of model components, flexible placement onto a physical cluster, and model-agnostic optimizations within a distributed runtime. We call this abstraction the Walk Graph and show how it can concisely capture composite models from a broad range of families. We instantiate M* on representative models and find that it achieves, on average, 20% lower end-to-end latency than vLLM-Omni for text-to-image workloads on BAGEL, while delivering up to 2.9x lower real-time factor and 2.7x higher throughput for text-to-speech workloads on Qwen3-Omni. M* also outperforms the V-JEPA 2-AC rollout baseline for robotic planning by up to 12.5x. Thus, our work paves the road towards more efficient serving of complex models with minimal developer effort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 M*，一个面向复合多模态模型（如视觉语言模型、语音语言模型、视觉语言动作策略等）的通用服务系统。M* 将模型表示为数据流图（Walk Graph），支持任意组件组合、灵活集群放置和模型无关的优化。在 BAGEL 模型上，M* 相比 vLLM-Omni 将文本到图像的端到端延迟平均降低 20%；在 Qwen3-Omni 上，文本到语音的实时因子降低 2.9 倍，吞吐量提升 2.7 倍；在机器人规划任务上比 V-JEPA 2-AC 基线加速 12.5 倍。
Motivation: 现有模型服务框架对模型结构的假设过于狭窄，无法有效支持当前多样化的复合多模态模型架构（如融合视觉编码器、语言骨干、扩散头、音频编解码器等），亟需一个通用高效的服务系统。
Method: 提出 M* 系统，核心是称为 Walk Graph 的模块化抽象，将模型表示为由组件组成的数据流图，请求处理视为图遍历。该抽象支持任意组件组合、灵活集群放置以及分布式运行时中的模型无关优化。
Result: 在 BAGEL 模型上，文本到图像工作负载的端到端延迟比 vLLM-Omni 平均降低 20%；在 Qwen3-Omni 上，文本到语音的实时因子降低 2.9 倍，吞吐量提升 2.7 倍；机器人规划任务比 V-JEPA 2-AC 基线加速 12.5 倍。
Conclusion: M* 证明了通过图抽象可以高效服务多种复合多模态模型，且开发者只需最小努力即可适配不同架构，为未来复杂模型的高效服务铺平道路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Forecasting Is Not Attribution: Localizing Decoder Bypass in Graph-Based Neural Marketing Mix Models
papers.abstract_en: Marketing mix models are used to forecast business outcomes and to attribute those outcomes to marketing channels, but these goals are not equivalent. We study a failure mode in graph-based neural MMM called attribution bypass: a high-capacity decoder can obtain low forecasting error through target autoregression, dense communication, co-movement, context, or latent memory while failing to route counterfactual sensitivity through the graph used as the attribution object. We introduce DICE-MMM as a bounded diagnostic and training framework. We do not claim that observational neural MMM identifies causal effects. Instead, DICE separates three questions often conflated in graph-based MMM: graph recovery, forecasting accuracy, and whether the trained decoder's perturbation-induced influence is graph aligned. Stage 1 trains a graph encoder with a restricted graph-mediated decoder. Stage 2 freezes the selected encoder and trains a graph-safe latent decoder whose cross-node communication must pass through the supplied graph. Decoder use is evaluated with CIG, AR-CIG, and graph-swap tests. Across controlled R/d/T swaps and an external multi-graph rawlog stress test, DICE improves stable graph recovery over CausalMMM. The experiments show that forecasting accuracy is not an attribution certificate: in a sparse-target benchmark, no-graph and full-graph decoders achieve MSE@7 around 0.004 while AR-CIG nAUPRC remains near or below zero, whereas an oracle graph reaches 0.807 +/- 0.129 at comparable MSE. Frozen graph-swap localizes the bottleneck: the same DICE-hard-trained decoder moves from nAUPRC -0.044 +/- 0.006 under learned graph inputs to 0.894 +/- 0.027 with the oracle graph. The contribution is a stress test and failure-localization framework showing that low MSE can hide attribution bypass and that the unresolved bottleneck is graph-support selection, not forecasting or decoder capacity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出营销组合模型中的预测与归因并不等价，并揭示了基于图的神经MMM中一种称为“归因绕过”的失败模式：高容量解码器可通过目标自回归、密集通信等方式实现低预测误差，但未能使反事实敏感性通过用于归因的图。作者提出DICE-MMM作为有界诊断和训练框架，通过三个阶段分离图恢复、预测准确性和图一致性。实验表明，低MSE可能隐藏归因绕过，瓶颈在于图结构选择而非预测或解码器容量。
Motivation: 现有图基神经营销组合模型将预测准确性与归因有效性混为一谈，导致归因绕过问题：高容量解码器即使未正确利用图结构也能获得低预测误差，从而在归因任务上表现不佳。
Method: 提出DICE-MMM框架，包含三个阶段：阶段1训练图编码器配合受限图介导解码器；阶段2冻结编码器，训练图安全潜在解码器，其跨节点通信必须通过给定图；通过CIG、AR-CIG和图交换测试评估解码器使用情况。
Result: 在受控R/d/T交换和外部多图原始日志压力测试中，DICE相比CausalMMM改进了稳定图恢复。在稀疏目标基准上，无图解码器和全图解码器MSE@7约0.004但AR-CIG nAUPRC接近或低于0，而oracle图在可比MSE下达到0.807±0.129。冻结图交换定位瓶颈：同一DICE硬训练解码器在学得图输入下nAUPRC为-0.044±0.006，在oracle图下升至0.894±0.027。
Conclusion: 论文贡献在于提供了一个压力测试和失败定位框架，表明低MSE可能隐藏归因绕过，且未解决的瓶颈是图结构选择，而非预测或解码器容量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From AGI to ASI
papers.abstract_en: Over the last decade, building human-level artificial general intelligence has moved from far-fetched speculation to being a concrete next-decade target for many of the largest AI organisations. Achieving this goal would have profound and far-reaching impacts on human society, which raises many complex questions for the decade ahead. This report investigates how AI itself might continue to develop in a post-AGI world along the continuum of machine intelligence. The endpoint of this continuum, Universal AI, is theoretically well understood, which provides some formal grounding for the main focus of this report: the transition from human-level AGI to artificial general superintelligence, which, intuitively, can be understood as a system that is more intelligent and cognitively capable than large organisations of humans. After characterizing ASI, the report discusses four potential pathways from AGI to ASI: scaling AGI, AI paradigm shifts, recursive improvement, and ASI emerging from large-scale multi-agent collectives. The report then discusses possible frictions and bottlenecks along these pathways. Determining whether the impact of these frictions will be negligible or substantial raises a number of concrete open research questions. Due to large uncertainties for predicting ASI progress, it cannot be ruled out that AI progress might continue to accelerate over the next years. This could imply that the image of a single transformative step change, caused by the introduction of human-level AGI into our society, could be inaccurate. More apt might be the prospect of a series of transformative societal changes caused by AI-enabled progress and breakthroughs across many areas of science and technology. Preparing for this prospect requires a massively interdisciplinary endeavour of global scope and interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨从人类水平的通用人工智能（AGI）向通用超级智能（ASI）过渡的可能路径、摩擦和瓶颈，并指出这一过程可能并非单一变革，而是由多个领域的AI驱动突破引发的系列社会变革。
Motivation: 现有研究多聚焦于实现AGI本身，但对AGI之后如何继续发展至ASI的路径及潜在社会影响缺乏系统分析。
Method: 通过理论分析，描述ASI的特征，提出四种潜在路径：缩放AGI、AI范式转变、递归改进、以及从大规模多智能体集体中涌现ASI，并讨论各路径的摩擦与瓶颈。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果，但提出一系列开放研究问题，并指出由于预测不确定性，AI进展可能持续加速，引发多次变革而非一次性事件。
Conclusion: 指出准备应对ASI的可能性需要全球范围的大规模跨学科努力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果，但提出一系列开放研究问题，并指出由于预测不确定性，AI进展可能持续加速，引发多次变革而非一次性事件。
summary_sections.conclusion: 指出准备应对ASI的可能性需要全球范围的大规模跨学科努力。

papers.title: How Useful is Causal Invariance for Domain Adaptation in Finite-Sample Settings?
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models often degrade when they are deployed on a target distribution that differs from the source distributions they were trained on. Recent work in causality-based domain generalization has shown how shared causal structure between domains can induce invariant predictors, e.g., models on a subset of features which have stable risk across structured domain shifts. However, the extent to which such population-level causal invariances can lead to gains in finite-sample settings remains underexplored. In particular, in practice we often have access to a few labeled target samples, a setting called supervised domain adaptation (sDA). In this paper, we explore when (full or partial) causal knowledge can provably improve supervised domain adaptation. As a first step, we study linear regression, where full or partial causal knowledge specifies a collection of invariant or possibly invariant feature subsets, each yielding a source-trained candidate predictor. We derive matching upper and lower bounds showing that finite-sample gains are governed by the target-risk margins separating the candidates, together with the finite-source estimation error. When these margins are sufficiently large relative to $n_Q$, an adaptive aggregation procedure can match the best candidate predictor while avoiding negative transfer relative to target-only learning. On the other hand, when the margins are too small, no algorithm can reliably exploit the candidate collection to obtain faster finite-sample rates. We further connect these margins to structural shift magnitude in linear SCMs and validate the theory on real-world causal benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究因果不变性在有限样本监督域适应（sDA）中的实用价值，以线性回归为例。理论分析表明，目标风险边际和源估计误差共同决定有限样本增益；当边际足够大时，自适应聚合能匹配最佳候选预测器并避免负迁移，否则无法加速。结论将边际与线性SCM中的结构移位幅度相联系，并在真实因果基准上验证。
Motivation: 现有因果域泛化工作展示了不变预测器的种群级优势，但有限样本下因果不变性是否以及何时带来增益尚不明确，尤其当存在少量标注目标样本时。
Method: 在线性回归设定下，利用完全或部分因果知识指定不变或可能不变的候选特征子集，训练源域候选预测器；提出自适应聚合过程，理论分析其有限样本风险上界与匹配下界。
Result: 理论证明有限样本增益由候选预测器间的目标风险边际和源估计误差决定；边际足够大时聚合可达到最优候选，边际过小时无算法能可靠利用候选集合加速收敛。
Conclusion: 因果不变性在有限样本sDA中的收益受限于结构移位幅度；通过线性SCM将边际与移位大小关联，并在实际因果基准上验证理论。

papers.title: Fed-FBD: Federated Functional Block Diversification for Isolation, Privacy, and Surgical Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without sharing raw patient data, but standard approaches such as FedAvg treat each client as a black box and provide no mechanism for isolating an adversarial contributor, auditing per-client influence, or honoring a departed participant's right to be forgotten. We present Fed-FBD (Federated Functional Block Diversification), a modular federated architecture that decomposes a ResNet backbone into six functional blocks (the stem, four residual groups, and the classification head) and maintains a warehouse of N color variants, each assembled from independently tracked and contributor-stamped blocks. Fed-FBD provides three capabilities absent in FedAvg: (i) architecturally guaranteed block-level isolation, so that an adversarial or mislabelled client cannot contaminate the clean colous; (ii) privacy-by-design, where membership inference advantage is already indistinguishable from chance before any privacy mechanism is applied; and (iii) surgical machine unlearning of a departed participant's contribution at sub-second cost and without retraining. Experiments on six MedMNIST-2D datasets, PathMNIST at 224x224, and CIFAR-10 show that Fed-FBD trades a modest 0.3%-3.1% IID accuracy gap on the adequately sized datasets for these guarantees, remains within 0.8%-4.0% of FedAvg at Dirichlet alpha=1.0 on three of four datasets, and confines all six adversarial attacks we study to the poisoned client's own blocks with at most +/-0.01 AUC drift on the clean colors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Fed-FBD，一种模块化联邦学习架构，将ResNet骨干分解为六个功能块，并维护一个颜色变体仓库，每个变体由独立追踪和贡献者标记的块组装。Fed-FBD实现了块级隔离、设计内置隐私以及亚秒级的精准机器遗忘，无需重训练。在MedMNIST-2D、PathMNIST和CIFAR-10上的实验表明，在足够大的数据集上，Fed-FBD以0.3%-3.1%的IID精度损失换取这些保证，在非IID下与FedAvg差距在0.8%-4.0%以内，并能将六种对抗攻击限制在受污染客户端自己的块内，对干净颜色变体的AUC漂移不超过±0.01。
Motivation: 标准联邦学习如FedAvg将每个客户端视为黑盒，无法隔离恶意贡献者、审计每客户端影响或满足退出参与者的被遗忘权。
Method: 将ResNet骨架分解为六个功能块（stem、四个残差组和分类头），维护N个颜色变体的仓库，每个变体由独立追踪和贡献者标记的块组装。
Result: 在六个MedMNIST-2D数据集、PathMNIST和CIFAR-10上，Fed-FBD在足够大数据集上以0.3%-3.1%的IID精度损失实现隔离、隐私和遗忘；在Dirichlet alpha=1.0的非IID下，在四个数据集中的三个上保持与FedAvg差距在0.8%-4.0%以内；所有六种对抗攻击被限制在受污染客户端块内，干净颜色变体的AUC漂移不超过±0.01。
Conclusion: Fed-FBD通过功能块多样化和颜色变体仓库，在联邦学习中提供了隔离、隐私和精准遗忘的保证，仅牺牲少量精度。

papers.title: Evoflux: Inference-Time Evolution of Executable Tool Workflows for Compact Agents
papers.abstract_en: Compact language models (LMs) reduce cost, latency, and deployment risk for tool agents. Yet MCP-style tool use requires more than isolated function calling: an agent must discover tools from live catalogs, satisfy schemas, preserve dependencies across intermediate outputs, and ground final responses in executed evidence. Small planners often generate plausible workflow graphs that fail under tool resolution, parameter validation, dependency tracking, or execution. We argue that this failure mode is poorly handled by small-corpus distillation. A few hundred teacher traces can teach workflow format, but rarely cover the recovery behavior needed to repair failed plans over changing tool catalogs. We introduce Evoflux, an inference-time evolutionary search method that treats compact tool use as the repair of executable tool workflows. It evolves typed workflow graphs through structured edits, execution feedback, adaptive intensity, meta-guided redesign, and diversity pruning. On held-out MCP-Bench tasks spanning live MCP servers and 250 tools, Evoflux raises execution feasibility from roughly 3% to 17-24% across small planners. In contrast, SFT and SFT+DPO on the same search-mined data match, underperform, or collapse below zero-shot performance; ReAct reaches higher peaks, but with higher variance and token cost. These results show that execution-grounded search is more reliable under scarce teacher-trace budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对紧凑语言模型在工具使用中工作流易失败的问题，提出推理时演化搜索方法Evoflux，通过结构化编辑、执行反馈、自适应强度、元引导重设计和多样性修剪来演化类型化工作流图。在MCP-Bench（含250个工具）上，将小规划器的执行可行性从约3%提升至17-24%，优于SFT和SFT+DPO，而ReAct虽更高但方差大、成本高。
Motivation: 紧凑语言模型进行工具调用时，由于缺乏恢复行为，生成的规划在工具解析、参数验证等环节容易失败，而小规模教师蒸馏无法覆盖修复行为。
Method: 提出Evoflux，一种推理时演化搜索方法，通过结构化编辑、执行反馈、自适应强度、元引导重设计和多样性修剪来演化类型化工作流图。
Result: 在MCP-Bench（含250个工具）上，Evoflux将小规划器的执行可行性从约3%提升至17-24%，优于SFT和SFT+DPO，而ReAct虽更高但方差大、成本高。
Conclusion: 执行接地搜索在教师轨迹预算不足时比小规模蒸馏更可靠。

papers.title: A Zero-shot Generalized Graph Anomaly Detection Framework via Node Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to identify abnormal nodes in unseen target graphs, showing strong potential in real-world applications with heterogeneous graph data. However, existing methods often depend on dataset-specific feature semantics and structural patterns, which limits their ability to generalize across different domains. To address this challenge, we propose AlignGAD, a zero-shot generalized graph anomaly detection framework. Our framework is built upon three key components: a Global Unification Module that aligns heterogeneous node features and normalizes graph signals in the spectral domain; a Clustering Module that constructs cluster-aware graph views to capture group-level abnormal patterns; and a Node Discrepancy Scoring Module that measures reconstruction discrepancy and aggregates anomaly evidence from different graph views. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of AlignGAD under the zero-shot GAD setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AlignGAD，一个零样本通用图异常检测框架，通过节点重建检测未知目标图中的异常节点。框架包括全局统一模块（对齐特征并归一化频谱信号）、聚类模块（构建聚类感知图视图捕捉群组级异常模式）和节点差异评分模块（测量重建差异并聚合不同视图的异常证据）。在多个真实数据集上验证了零样本GAD设置下的有效性。

Method: 提出AlignGAD框架，包含三个模块：Global Unification Module（对齐异构节点特征并在谱域归一化图信号），Clustering Module（构建聚类感知图视图以捕捉群组级异常模式），Node Discrepancy Scoring Module（测量重建差异并聚合不同视图的异常证据）。
Result: 在多个真实数据集上验证了AlignGAD在零样本图异常检测设置下的有效性。

papers.title: SalArt-VQA: Diagnosing Whether VLMs Understand Salient Artifacts in Generated Images
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to detect whether AI-generated images contain visible artifacts, yet their ability to analyze such artifacts remains poorly understood. A correct image-level decision can still hide important failures: a model may correctly flag an artifact while relying on the wrong visual cue, selecting the wrong region, or describing a defect that the image does not support. To evaluate these behaviors directly, we introduce SalArt-VQA, a diagnostic benchmark for fine-grained SALient ARTifact understanding in AI-generated images. SalArt-VQA contains 950 images and 3,681 human-authored multiple-choice questions spanning artifact images, matched real reference images, and paired generated reference images. Four aligned question types evaluate presence detection, semantic localization, spatial grounding, and evidence-grounded defect identification, while the reference splits test calibration and abstention when the annotated defect is absent. Across 20 VLMs, SalArt-VQA reveals failures that image-level detection accuracy hides: the strongest model reaches 99.37% detection recall on artifact images but answers all four artifact-side questions correctly on only 53.26% of images. Comparing artifact images with artifact-free references reveals a sensitivity-calibration tradeoff: sensitive models often make unsupported artifact claims, while conservative models avoid false alarms largely by missing real artifacts. These results show that high artifact detection accuracy alone does not imply grounded artifact understanding. SalArt-VQA exposes these hidden failure modes and provides a fine-grained evaluation of whether VLM artifact claims are supported by local visual evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了SalArt-VQA，一个用于诊断视觉语言模型（VLM）对AI生成图像中显著伪影（salient artifacts）理解能力的细粒度基准。该基准包含950张图像和3681道人工编写的多选题，覆盖伪影检测、语义定位、空间定位和基于证据的缺陷识别四种题型，并引入参考图像分集来测试校准和弃权能力。实验表明，即使检测召回率高达99.37%，模型在所有伪影问题上正确回答的比例仅为53.26%，揭示了检测准确率与伪影理解之间的鸿沟。
Motivation: 现有VLM在检测AI生成图像伪影时，即使整体准确率高，仍可能依赖错误的视觉线索、选错区域或描述不存在的缺陷。需要更细粒度的评估方法来诊断模型对伪影的真正理解。
Method: 构建SalArt-VQA基准，包含伪影图像、匹配的真实参考图像和生成参考图像，设计四种对齐的问题类型（存在性检测、语义定位、空间定位、基于证据的缺陷识别），并通过参考分集测试校准和弃权能力。
Result: 在20个VLM上，最强模型检测召回率达99.37%，但所有伪影问题（四类）全部正确的图像比例仅为53.26%。敏感模型易产生无依据的伪影断言，保守模型则通过忽略真实伪影来避免误报。
Conclusion: 高检测准确率并不等同于对伪影的扎实理解。SalArt-VQA揭示了隐藏的失败模式，为评估VLM伪影判断是否基于局部视觉证据提供了细粒度评测。
