papers.title: HairPort: In-context 3D-aware Hair Import and Transfer for Images
papers.abstract_en: Transferring hairstyles between images is an important but challenging task in computer graphics, computer vision, and visual effects. It enables users to explore new looks without physically altering their hair, with applications in virtual try-on systems, augmented reality, and entertainment. Most prior works operate best under small pose gaps, and they fall short under large viewpoint and scale differences, where missing hair content must be synthesized rather than transferred. We propose HairPort, a 3D-aware hairstyle transfer framework that attempts to solve these issues by explicitly separating hair removal from transfer and enforcing geometric consistency before synthesis. We introduce a Bald Converter, which produces realistic bald versions of faces through LoRA-based in-context adaptation of FLUX.1 Kontext. To train our Bald Converter, we introduce a new dataset, Baldy, containing 6,000 paired bald and original images across diverse identities and conditions. We also use a 3D-Aware Transfer Pipeline that reconstructs and re-renders the reference hairstyle from the target viewpoint before compositing it onto the source image. Being 3D aware, our method supports large pose and scale discrepancies between the source and target. Finally, a conditional flow-matching generator synthesizes the transferred result from the bald source and geometry-aligned reference guidance. Together, our method enables accurate, pose-consistent, and identity-preserving hairstyle transfer, outperforming existing methods both qualitatively and quantitatively.
papers.comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH 2026 (Conference Papers Track). 23 pages, 15 figures, 10 tables, including supplementary material as appendices. Project page: https://deepmancer.github.io/HairPort/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HairPort，一种3D感知的发型转移框架，通过显式分离头发移除与转移，并强制几何一致性来解决大姿态和尺度差异下的发型转移问题。方法包括基于LoRA的Bald Converter生成逼真秃头版本，以及3D感知转移流水线进行重渲染和合成。在多个数据集上优于现有方法，支持大姿态差异下的准确、身份保持的发型转移。
Motivation: 现有发型转移方法在源和目标图像存在大姿态和尺度差异时效果不佳，因为缺失的头发内容需要合成而非简单转移。
Method: 提出Bald Converter，利用LoRA微调FLUX.1 Kontext生成逼真秃头图像；引入包含6000对图像的Baldy数据集训练；设计3D感知转移流水线，从目标视角重建并重渲染参考发型，再与秃头源图像合成；使用条件流匹配生成器整合几何对齐的参考引导。
Result: 摘要报告HairPort在定量和定性上均优于现有方法，支持大姿态和尺度差异，实现准确、姿态一致且身份保持的发型转移。
Conclusion: HairPort通过显式分离移除与转移以及3D几何约束，有效处理大姿态差异下的发型转移，为虚拟试戴等应用提供鲁棒方案。

papers.title: Feature-preserving Latent-EnKF for Data Assimilation of Flows with Shocks
papers.abstract_en: The ensemble Kalman filter (EnKF) is widely adopted for sequential data assimilation, but fails for solutions with discontinuities, such as shocks in compressible flows. Uncertainty in shock location induces multimodal ensemble statistics that violate the Gaussian assumptions underlying the EnKF, producing large-scale spurious oscillations in the analysis state. We introduce a feature-preserving latent-EnKF that performs the ensemble update in a learned low-dimensional latent space, where shock and flow features admit a smooth manifold representation, thereby preserving sharp features during EnKF analysis. The updated latent state is mapped back to physical state through a shared decoder for all ensemble members. The algorithm eliminates the member-specific ordered training and positivity flooring used in prior approaches. Numerical experiments on a Sod shock tube and Mach 2 shock interaction with a 2D cylinder, using sparse and noisy observations, show accurate feature recovery of shocks and contact discontinuities without spurious oscillations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一种特征保留的潜在空间EnKF（Latent-EnKF）方法，用于含激波的可压缩流数据同化。通过将集合更新在自编码器学习的低维潜在空间中执行，避免了传统EnKF在处理非高斯多模态统计时的伪振荡，并去除了先前方法中逐成员的有序训练和正性限制。在Sod激波管和马赫2激波-圆柱相互作用数值实验中，该方法能准确恢复激波和接触间断，且无伪振荡。
Motivation: 传统EnKF在含间断（如激波）的流场同化中失效，因为激波位置不确定性导致集合统计多模态、违背高斯假设，产生大尺度伪振荡。
Method: 引入特征保留的Latent-EnKF：通过自编码器将物理状态映射到低维潜在空间，该空间中激波和流特征呈光滑流形；在潜在空间执行EnKF分析，再通过共享解码器映射回物理状态。
Result: 在Sod激波管和二维圆柱马赫2激波相互作用的稀疏噪声观测实验中，准确恢复激波和接触间断，无伪振荡。
Conclusion: 所提方法在保持间断特征的同时消除了分析伪振荡，且无需先前方法的逐成员有序训练和正性限制。

papers.title: AudioX-Turbo: A Unified Framework for Efficient Anything-to-Audio Generation
papers.abstract_en: Audio and music generation based on flexible multimodal control signals is a widely applicable topic, with the following key challenges: 1) a unified multimodal modeling framework, 2) large-scale, high-quality training data, and 3) the prohibitive inference cost of multi-step diffusion sampling. As such, we propose AudioX-Turbo, a unified and efficient framework for anything-to-audio generation that integrates varied multimodal conditions (i.e., text, video, and audio signals) in this work. AudioX-Turbo follows a teacher-student paradigm. The teacher AudioX-Base is built on a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer with a Multimodal Adaptive Fusion module that aligns diverse multimodal inputs for high-fidelity synthesis, and is then distilled into the few-step student AudioX-Turbo via Distribution Matching Distillation adapted to flow matching, complemented by a diffusion-based discriminator for high-quality few-step generation. To support the training of AudioX-Turbo, we construct a large-scale, high-quality dataset, IF-caps-Pro, comprising approximately 9.2M samples curated through a two-stage data collection and annotation pipeline. We benchmark AudioX-Turbo across a wide range of tasks, finding that our model achieves superior performance, especially on text-to-audio and text-to-music generation, while operating at only 4 sampling steps and requiring approximately 25x fewer function evaluations (NFE) than multi-step baselines. These results demonstrate that our method is capable of audio generation under flexible multimodal control, showing efficient and powerful instruction-following capabilities. The code and datasets will be available at https://zeyuet.github.io/AudioX-Turbo/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AudioX-Turbo，一种统一的高效多模态到音频生成框架，基于教师-学生范式将AudioX-Base（多模态扩散Transformer）蒸馏为少步采样模型，并构建了920万样本的IF-caps-Pro数据集。在文本到音频和文本到音乐任务上，仅需4步采样，性能优于多步基线，NFE降低约25倍。
Motivation: 多模态可控音频生成面临建模框架统一、大规模高质量训练数据匮乏以及多步扩散采样推理成本高的问题。
Method: 采用教师-学生范式：教师模型AudioX-Base基于多模态扩散Transformer和多模态自适应融合模块对齐输入；学生模型AudioX-Turbo通过适应流匹配的分布匹配蒸馏和扩散判别器实现高质量少步生成。同时构建了包含约920万样本的大规模数据集IF-caps-Pro。
Result: 在多种任务上，模型在文本到音频和文本到音乐生成中取得最优性能，仅需4步采样，NFE比多步基线减少约25倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法实现了灵活多模态控制下的高效音频生成，展示了强大的指令遵循能力，代码和数据集将公开。

papers.title: Crossing the Validation Crisis: Cross-Validation Reduces Benchmarking Variance Surprisingly Well
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine learning progresses through empirical work, benchmarking new methods to evaluate relative performance. However, the statistical variability inherent to evaluation - exacerbated by the stochastic nature of many algorithms - often makes performance estimation unreliable due to the limited test samples available, leading to a validation crisis in which genuine advances are difficult to discern. In this work, we show that cross-validation improves markedly confidence when evaluating and comparing learning algorithm performances. We introduce the concept of sample gain, which quantifies the virtual data augmentation achieved by using multiple cross-validation splits to reduce benchmarking variance. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets (histopathologic scans and NLP fine-tuning) demonstrate that multiple splits can substantially improve the reliability and stability of performance estimates, with diminishing returns often setting in later than expected. We also introduce a procedure to dynamically early-stop cross-validation by estimating from the first few folds if subsequent folds will bring large sample gains. Our findings highlight the value of pushing cross-validation on available samples to achieve robust and reliable benchmarking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器学习基准测试中由于测试样本有限导致的性能估计统计变异问题，证明交叉验证能显著提高评估置信度。提出样本增益（sample gain）概念，量化多折交叉验证带来的虚拟数据增强效果。在合成数据、组织病理扫描和NLP微调实验上，多折分割能大幅提升性能估计的可靠性和稳定性，且收益递减点比预期出现得更晚。还提出一种动态早停交叉验证过程，通过前几折估计后续折是否带来大样本增益。
Motivation: 现代机器学习通过基准测试比较新方法，但随机算法导致性能估计因测试样本有限而不可靠，存在验证危机（validation crisis），难以辨别真正进步。
Method: 引入样本增益概念衡量交叉验证多折分割减少基准测试方差的效果，并提出基于前几折估计后续折样本增益的动态早停程序。
Result: 在合成数据、组织病理扫描和NLP微调数据集上，多折交叉验证显著提高性能估计的可靠性和稳定性，且收益递减点比预期晚。
Conclusion: 研究强调在可用样本上积极使用交叉验证以实现稳健可靠的基准测试。

papers.title: Foresight: Iterative Reasoning About Clues that Matter for Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Open-world mapless navigation from sparse language instructions requires resolving underspecified goals and inferring which environmental cues are relevant for reaching the goal. For instance, reaching an out-of-view destination may require interpreting ramps, signs, or detours that reveal where to go or which route to take. Prior works are limited by their reliance on known navigation factors and closed-set factor categories, or identify cues before motion planning and miss plan-dependent cues. We argue that pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can discover novel instruction-relevant cues, but require adaptation to focus on which cues matter and how they should influence motion planning. We realize these ideas in Foresight, a test-time framework in which a finetuned VLM alternates between proposing image-space motion plans and critiquing them using the language goal and visual context. Subsequent plans are conditioned on prior critiques, enabling iterative motion refinement before execution. To align plan critiques and refinements with open-set behavior preferences, we learn a reward model from human feedback and use it to post-train the VLM with reinforcement learning in the plan-critique loop. In offline evaluations and 6 real-world environments, Foresight improves average task success by 37% and reduces interventions per mission by 52% relative to state-of-the-art test-time reasoning and foundation-model baselines, while running in real-time on a Jetson AGX Orin. We will release code, data, and training details to support future work on test-time reasoning for robot motion refinement. Additional videos at: https://amrl.cs.utexas.edu/foresight
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Foresight，一种测试时框架，利用微调的VLM交替提出图像空间运动计划并用语言目标和视觉上下文进行批评，从而在导航中迭代细化运动。在6个真实环境中，平均任务成功率提升37%，每次任务干预减少52%。
Motivation: 开放世界无地图导航中，稀疏语言指令需要解析不明确的目标并推断哪些环境线索与到达目标相关，现有方法依赖已知导航因素或封闭集类别，或是在运动规划前识别线索而遗漏依赖于规划的线索。
Method: 采用微调的VLM交替提出图像空间运动计划并用语言目标和视觉上下文批评，后续计划依赖于先前的批评，实现执行前的迭代细化；同时从人类反馈学习奖励模型，并用强化学习在计划-批评循环中后训练VLM。
Result: 离线评估和6个真实环境中，相对于最先进的测试时推理和基础模型基线，平均任务成功率提高37%，每次任务干预减少52%，并在Jetson AGX Orin上实时运行。
Conclusion: 摘要表明Foresight利用预训练VLM发现新线索，并通过测试时迭代推理改进运动规划，未来将发布代码、数据和训练细节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation: Post-Training Without Rubric Verifiers
papers.abstract_en: Rubrics have emerged as an alternative to RLVR in open-ended domains where a single ground-truth final answer is not available. Existing rubric-based training methods rely on an LLM verifier that scores each rollout against rubrics. This introduces substantial training-time overhead, exposes optimization to verifier-specific biases, and reduces rubric feedback to a sparse end-of-trajectory signal. We propose Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation (RGSD), a verifier-free training method in which the base policy, conditioned on the rubric, serves as the teacher for the unconditioned student. RGSD distills the rubric-conditioned teacher distribution into the student token-by-token, replacing sparse trajectory-level rewards with dense per-token learning signals and removing the LLM judge from the training loop entirely. Across Qwen-2.5 (3B, 7B) and Qwen3-Thinking (4B, 8B) models on medical and science domains, RGSD achieves rubric satisfaction comparable to judge-based GRPO while using one on-policy rollout per prompt and no training-time verifier calls. Ablations show that raw rubrics provide a stronger teacher enrichment signal than self-generated reference responses, while a stronger GRPO judge can outperform RGSD in some settings, positioning RGSD as a complementary verifier-free alternative when verifier cost or reliability is the bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Rubric-Guided Self-Distillation (RGSD)，一种无需验证器的训练方法，通过基策略（条件于rubric）作为教师，蒸馏到无条件学生，提供密集的逐token学习信号。在Qwen-2.5和Qwen3-Thinking模型上，医疗和科学领域，RGSD达到与基于judge的GRPO相当的rubric满意度，且无需训练时验证器调用。
Motivation: 现有基于rubric的训练依赖LLM验证器，带来训练开销、验证器偏差和稀疏奖励信号。本文旨在消除验证器，实现更高效的训练。
Method: RGSD让基策略（条件于rubric）充当教师，蒸馏到无条件学生，逐token进行蒸馏，替代稀疏的轨迹级奖励。
Result: 在Qwen-2.5 (3B, 7B)和Qwen3-Thinking (4B, 8B)模型上，医疗和科学领域，RGSD的rubric满意度与GRPO相当，且每个提示只需一次on-policy rollout，无训练时验证器调用。消融显示原始rubric比自生成参考响应提供更强的教师信号。
Conclusion: RGSD是一种互补的无验证器替代方案，当验证器成本或可靠性成为瓶颈时适用。但在某些设置下，更强的GRPO验证器可能优于RGSD。

papers.title: Boosting Direct Preference Optimization with Penalization
papers.abstract_en: Offline preference optimization has become a practical substitute for reinforcement learning from human feedback, but pairwise objectives such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and its variants use only the chosen and rejected responses stored in a static dataset. This leaves a useful signal unused: the response that the reference model itself would generate for the same prompt. We propose Direct Preference Optimization with Penalization (DPOP), a simple extension of DPO that augments the base preference loss with a gated penalty on reference-greedy responses. DPOP activates this penalty only when the current policy still assigns a lower likelihood to the preferred response than to the rejected response. On AlpacaEval 2.0, DPOP improves length-controlled win rate over DPO, SimPO, and AlphaDPO on both Llama-3-8b-it and Gemma-2-9b-it, achieving relative gains of 5.3\% and 4.4\% over baselines on the two models, respectively. Ablations further show that a SimNPO-style length-normalized penalty is stronger than NPO and token-level unlikelihood in this setting.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Decision-Making from Offline Datasets to Online Adaptation: Black-Box Optimization to Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Direct Preference Optimization with Penalization (DPOP)，扩展 DPO 通过门控惩罚参考模型生成的响应，仅当当前策略对优选响应的似然低于拒绝响应时激活惩罚。在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上，DPOP 在 Llama-3-8b-it 和 Gemma-2-9b-it 上分别比 DPO、SimPO、AlphaDPO 提高长度控制胜率 5.3% 和 4.4%。
Motivation: 离线偏好优化如 DPO 只使用数据集中被选和拒绝响应，忽略了参考模型自身生成的响应信号，该信号可提供额外信息。
Method: 提出 DPOP，在 DPO 损失上增加一个门控惩罚项，惩罚当前策略对参考模型贪心响应的偏好，仅当当前策略对优选响应似然低于拒绝响应时激活。
Result: 在 AlpacaEval 2.0 上，DPOP 在 Llama-3-8b-it 和 Gemma-2-9b-it 上分别比 DPO、SimPO、AlphaDPO 提高长度控制胜率 5.3% 和 4.4%；消融实验显示 SimNPO 风格的长度归一化惩罚优于 NPO 和 token 级 unlikelihood。
Conclusion: DPOP 简单有效，利用参考模型响应信号提升偏好优化，无需额外数据收集。

papers.title: Dolph2Vec: Self-Supervised Representations of Dolphin Vocalizations
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) has opened new opportunities in bioacoustics by enabling scalable modeling of animal vocalizations without the need for expensive manual annotation. However, current SSL models in this domain prioritize broad generalization across species and are not optimized for uncovering the fine-grained structure of individual communication systems. In this work, we collect and release a novel dataset of over five years of longitudinal recordings, from five known dolphins in a semi-naturalistic marine environment, an unprecedented resource for studying dolphin communication. We adapt the Wav2Vec2.0 Baevski et al. (2020) architecture to this domain and introduce Dolph2Vec, the first large-scale, species-specific SSL model trained exclusively on this data. We benchmark our model on two biologically relevant tasks: signature whistle classification and whistle detection. Dolph2Vec significantly outperforms general-purpose baselines in both tasks. Beyond performance, we show that learned embeddings and codebook structure capture interpretable acoustic units aligned with dolphin whistle categories and possibly sub-whistle structure, enabling fine-grained analysis of communication patterns. Our findings demonstrate how SSL can serve as both a model and a scientific tool to explore hypotheses in animal communication research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文收集了五年多来自五只海豚的纵向录音数据集，并基于Wav2Vec2.0架构训练了第一个大规模物种特异性自监督模型Dolph2Vec。该模型在签名哨声分类和哨声检测任务上显著优于通用基线，且学习到的嵌入和码本结构可解释，与海豚哨声类别及亚哨声结构对齐。
Motivation: 现有自监督学习模型在生物声学中优先考虑跨物种泛化，未针对个体交流系统的细粒度结构进行优化，而海豚发声研究需要专用模型。
Method: 收集五年多来自五只已知海豚的纵向录音数据集，适配Wav2Vec2.0架构，提出Dolph2Vec模型，仅在该数据集上训练。
Result: 在签名哨声分类和哨声检测任务上，Dolph2Vec显著优于通用基线；学习到的嵌入和码本结构可解释，与海豚哨声类别及亚哨声结构对齐。
Conclusion: 自监督学习可作为模型和科学工具探索动物交流研究中的假设。

papers.title: A Mathematical Theory of Value: a synthesis on goal-directed agency under resource constraints
papers.abstract_en: We propose that value -- the quantity goal-directed agents create, destroy, and exchange -- is a lawful structural quantity in the same category as information. Following Shannon's method, we make one ruthless abstraction: value is the rate at which an agent converts a resource into goal-progress, relative to a frame fixed by its goal. A scale-invariance axiom forces a logarithmic measure, $V=\sum_i k_i \ln e_i$; compounding of a reinvested resource forces the same form via the ergodicity argument of Peters (2019). The two routes are kin rather than independent; their agreement is a consistency check, not an over-determination. We derive a coding theorem of value: $ΔG \le I(X;Y)$, achieved by Bayes-proportional allocation; realized value decomposes as $G=D(q\|r)-D(q\|p)$, identifying misalignment with measurable waste. For populations, value is frame-relative while price is frame-independent; a fleet that pools its resource and fuses its perception inherits the ceiling $G_{\mathrm{fleet}} \le I(X;Y_{1:m}) \le H(X)$ (a corollary; an earlier sum-form claim was wrong and is corrected in v5). A dynamical layer yields an is/ought asymmetry from which alignment emerges as a control-stability condition with a closed-form residual. We test the single-frame laws on live language models in a pre-registered scale-up: perception mutual information tracks realized capability rather than parameter count (Spearman $ρ= 0.977$ pooled over 30 model$\times$domain points), out-of-sample $ΔG$ tracks $I(X;Y)$, and over-confidence is measurable dissipation; a further pre-registered test shows the bridge is shape-invariant across four task shapes ($n=42$, slope 0.953). None of the mechanisms is individually new -- generalized Kelly, Armstrong & Mindermann (2018), classical control; the contribution is their unification and the governance mapping (incentive design over oversight) that follows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种价值数学理论，将价值定义为目标导向智能体在资源约束下将资源转化为目标进展的速率，并推导出对数测量形式。通过编码定理和动态层分析，展示了价值与信息论、贝叶斯分配及一致性控制条件的关系，并在语言模型上进行了预注册验证。
Motivation: 现有对价值的概念缺乏精确的数学基础，尤其是在多智能体系统和资源受限情境下，需要一种类似信息论的统一理论。
Method: 遵循Shannon的方法，通过公理化抽象和尺度不变性假设，推导出价值的对数测量形式；利用编码定理和动态系统分析，建立价值与信息容量、贝叶斯分配及校准误差的关系。
Result: 在30个模型×领域点上的实验表明，感知互信息与实际能力高度相关（Spearman ρ=0.977），且ΔG与互信息匹配；过置信导致可测量的浪费；跨任务形状不变的桥梁测试（n=42, 斜率0.953）支持理论预测。
Conclusion: 该理论统一了广义Kelly准则、Armstrong & Mindermann（2018）及经典控制等已有机制，核心贡献在于统一框架及由之导出的治理映射（激励设计而非监督）。

papers.title: Policy-driven Conformal Prediction for Trustworthy QoT Estimation
papers.abstract_en: We propose Conformal QoT, a policy-driven framework that combines statistically guaranteed QoT estimation with operational decision policies, enabling reliable lightpath-feasibility predictions under domain shift and improving accuracy from 92\% to 99.6\% on open datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出策略驱动的共形预测框架Conformal QoT，用于光网络中的可信QoT估计，在开放数据集上将准确率从92%提升至99.6%。
Motivation: 现有QoT估计在域偏移下不可靠，需要统计保证。
Method: 结合统计保证的共形预测与操作决策策略。
Result: 准确率从92%提升至99.6%。
Conclusion: 框架在域偏移下提供了可靠的QoT估计。

papers.title: Improving Crash Frequency Prediction from Simulated Traffic Conflicts Using Machine Learning Based Microsimulation
papers.abstract_en: Traffic microsimulation combined with surrogate safety measures has increasingly been used as a proactive alternative to historical crash data for predicting crash frequency for current or planned road infrastructure designs. However, existing microsimulation-based safety studies have adopted simplified rule-based behaviour models, which reproduce traffic flow reasonably well but often fail to generate realistic conflict dynamics, limiting crash prediction accuracy. Recent advances in machine learning (ML)-based behaviour models offer a promising opportunity to potentially improve microsimulation realism and crash frequency predictions by learning human driving behaviour directly from large-scale trajectory datasets. To investigate this possibility, traffic microsimulation was conducted for five real-world signalised intersections in Leeds, UK, using both a standard rule-based model and a state-of-the-art ML model. Simulated vehicle trajectories were analysed using a two-dimensional Time-to-Collision metric to identify simulated conflicts, which were then modelled using Extreme Value Theory to predict crash frequency. Results show that conflicts from the ML model yielded crash predictions in line with the real-world crash data, whereas the rule-based model did not permit meaningful predictions, presumably due to a lack of model calibration to the specific simulated intersections. Directly using ML-generated simulated crashes to predict real-world crash frequency also yielded poor results, suggesting that while current ML models can realistically reproduce conflicts, they are not yet able to generate realistic crashes. Overall, the findings demonstrate that ML-based behaviour models are promising for improving crash prediction from simulated conflicts, without a need for location-specific model calibration, and suggest clear future directions for ML-based traffic microsimulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨利用机器学习（ML）基于的微观交通仿真模型替代传统规则模型，通过模拟交通冲突预测碰撞频率。在利兹五个信号交叉口的实验表明，ML模型生成的冲突能够较好地匹配真实碰撞数据，而规则模型因缺乏校准无法给出有意义预测。直接使用ML生成的模拟碰撞效果不佳，说明当前ML模型能生成真实冲突但尚不能生成真实碰撞。
Motivation: 现有基于微观仿真的交通安全研究采用简化规则模型，难以生成真实冲突动态，限制了碰撞预测准确性。ML模型通过学习人类驾驶行为有望提升仿真真实性和预测精度。
Method: 对英国利兹五个真实信号交叉口，分别使用标准规则模型和先进ML模型进行微观仿真；利用二维碰撞时间指标识别模拟冲突，并通过极值理论预测碰撞频率。
Result: ML模型冲突预测的碰撞频率与真实数据吻合，规则模型因缺乏校准无法做出有效预测；直接使用ML模拟碰撞预测效果不佳。

papers.title: From Parameters to Feature Space: Task Arithmetic for Backdoor Mitigation in Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Model merging (MM) has gained significant attention as a cost-effective approach to integrate multiple task-specific models into a unified model. However, recent work reveals that MM is highly susceptible to backdoor attacks. Existing defenses based on task arithmetic often fail to eliminate backdoors without substantially degrading clean-task performance, owing to their reliance on direct parameter-space editing. To address this gap, we propose Linear Feature Path Minimization (LFPM), a backdoor mitigation framework for model merging, which introduces an anti-backdoor task vector into the backdoored merged model. Unlike prior approaches, LFPM formulates the backdoor robustness of the merged model from a unified feature-space perspective under the Cross-Task Linearity (CTL) framework, which leverages the approximate linearity of features across tasks. This perspective guides the optimization of the anti-backdoor task to suppress backdoors while preserving clean-task performance. Furthermore, we introduce an effective optimization mechanism based on gradient accumulation and loss path-integral, ensuring robust backdoor suppression along the interpolation path. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LFPM consistently exhibits strong robustness against backdoor attacks in both full fine-tuning and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文针对模型合并中后门攻击的脆弱性问题，提出线性特征路径最小化（LFPM）框架。不同于直接编辑参数空间的现有防御，LFPM在跨任务线性（CTL）框架下从特征空间视角定义后门鲁棒性，通过引入反后门任务向量来抑制后门并保持干净任务性能。实验显示在全微调和参数高效微调（PEFT）设置下均表现出强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有基于任务算术的防御方法在消除后门时严重退化干净任务性能，需要一种不牺牲性能的后门缓解方法。
Method: 提出LFPM，在跨任务线性框架下从特征空间优化反后门任务向量，采用梯度累积和损失路径积分机制沿插值路径进行鲁棒后门抑制。
Result: 大量实验表明LFPM在全微调和PEFT设置下持续展现对后门攻击的强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要声称LFPM为模型合并中的后门缓解提供了有效框架，特别是从特征空间视角处理问题。

papers.title: $μ$VLA: On Recurrent Memory for Partially Observable Manipulation in VLA Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions from the current observation, an assumption that fails under partial observability, where decisions depend on information no longer visible. Existing memory-augmented VLAs simultaneously introduce recurrence, retrieval, compression modules, auxiliary objectives, hierarchical memory, or task-specific architectural changes, so the contribution of recurrence itself remains entangled with surrounding machinery. We present a controlled isolation study of recurrence in a strong pretrained VLA backbone. Our formulation augments the transformer with a small set of learnable memory tokens carried across timesteps and updated through self-attention, trained end to end with truncated backpropagation through time, with no auxiliary losses and no architectural changes. We instantiate this as $μ$VLA, a family of OpenVLA-OFT variants parameterized by memory width m, TBPTT length K, and the memory update rule (cross-step gradients or a detached EMA), so that recurrence is the only varying factor. On MIKASA-Robo, $μ$VLA improves average success rate on five training tasks from 0.42 to 0.84 at the strongest setting and reaches 0.23 on held-out tasks with the same memory structure versus 0.07 for the memoryless baseline. On tasks requiring different memory structure, performance remains near baseline. On LIBERO, the strongest recurrent variant achieves 96.2% average success, indicating no regression under full observability. We interpret these results as a calibration of the capability envelope of minimal in-backbone recurrence, identifying the regime in which it is sufficient and the regime where additional memory structure is required. Demos and videos can be found in https://avanturist322.github.io/mu-vla/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的递归记忆进行受控隔离研究，提出μVLA，在预训练VLA骨干中仅添加少量可学习记忆token，通过截断反向传播训练，无辅助损失或架构变化。在MIKASA-Robo上，最强变体将平均成功率从0.42提升至0.84，在LIBERO上达96.2%，证明最小递归足以处理部分可观测性，但需要额外记忆结构的任务性能未提升。
Motivation: 现有带记忆的VLA模型同时引入多种机制（递归、检索、压缩、辅助目标、层级记忆等），使得递归本身的贡献难以剥离。本文旨在隔离研究递归在强预训练VLA骨干中的独立效果。
Method: 在Transformer中引入少量可学习记忆token，跨时间步携带并通过自注意力更新，使用截断反向传播时间（TBPTT）端到端训练，无辅助损失或架构变化。参数化为记忆宽度m、TBPTT长度K和记忆更新规则（跨步梯度或分离的EMA）。
Result: 在MIKASA-Robo上，最强μVLA变体在五个训练任务上平均成功率从0.42提升至0.84；保留任务上达到0.23（无记忆基线为0.07）；需要不同记忆结构的任务性能接近基线。在LIBERO上最强递归变体平均成功率达96.2%，表明完全可观测下无退化。
Conclusion: 结果表明最小化骨干内递归可处理的任务范围：在部分可观测但记忆结构匹配时足够，否则需要额外记忆结构。这标定了递归能力包络。

papers.title: Net-Ev$^2$: A Generative Simulator for Network Event Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Reducing real-world trial and error has long been a central goal of decision making, and generative simulators advance this goal by modeling the evolution of future states. An even more challenging yet meaningful task is simulating how disturbance events (e.g., accidents) propagate their impacts across real-world networks. The existing approaches fall short of modeling both structured attributes and unstructured semantics of events, and capturing topological structures in simulating network event evolution. Therefore, we are motivated to propose Net-Ev$^2$ ($\underline{\textbf{Net}}$work $\underline{\textbf{Ev}}$ent $\underline{\textbf{Ev}}$olution), a novel generative simulator that jointly leverages event cues while preserving network topology in simulations. Specifically, the framework consists of two stages, namely structure-guided masked pre-training and topology-aware diffusion process, which is achieved by U-Net-like graph downsampling and upsampling during denoising. At inference time, Net-Ev$^2$ can generate simulations using natural-language event input only, with greater flexibility for practical usage. Furthermore, we introduce Net-Ev$^2$-6.5M, a multimodal benchmark of aligned event and network traffic data across four large-scale road networks, as well as a new topology-aware metric, namely JL-MMD, to evaluate topological fidelity in generated network dynamics. Extensive experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance and strong generalization ability of Net-Ev$^2$. Code is made available at https://github.com/Guangyu4/Net-Ev-2.
papers.journal_ref: In Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining (KDD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Net-Ev$^2$ 是一个生成式模拟器，用于模拟突发事件（如事故）在现实世界网络中的影响传播。它通过结构引导的掩码预训练和拓扑感知的扩散过程（U-Net 结构）来联合建模事件的结构化属性和非结构化语义，同时保持网络拓扑。在四个大规模道路网络上的实验表明其具有最先进的性能和强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有方法无法同时建模事件的结构化属性和非结构化语义，也无法有效捕捉网络拓扑结构，因此难以准确模拟网络事件的演化。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段为结构引导的掩码预训练（structure-guided masked pre-training），第二阶段为拓扑感知的扩散过程（topology-aware diffusion process），通过类似 U-Net 的图下采样和上采样进行去噪。推理时仅需自然语言事件输入即可生成模拟。
Result: 在四个大规模道路网络上的实验表明 Net-Ev$^2$ 取得了最先进的性能，并具有较强的泛化能力；同时提出了 Net-Ev$^2$-6.5M 多模态基准和新拓扑保真度度量 JL-MMD。
Conclusion: Net-Ev$^2$ 能够有效模拟网络事件演化，为减少实际试错提供支持，且仅需自然语言输入，灵活性高。

papers.title: Robustness Verification of Recurrent Neural Networks with Abstraction Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Certified local robustness verification for recurrent neural networks (RNNs) is challenging because approximation errors introduced by nonlinear relaxations can propagate through recurrent connections and accumulate over time. As a result, scalable linear bound propagation methods often become overly conservative and fail to certify inputs that are in fact robust, especially when many pre-activation intervals cross zero. We propose an abstraction-refinement framework for RNN verification that partitions such intervals to remove the dominant relaxation error: on each refined branch, ReLU becomes exact, and smooth activations such as tanh and sigmoid admit substantially tighter linear envelopes. To control the combinatorial cost of splitting in long sequences, we introduce a SHAP-guided timestep selection strategy that ranks hidden states by their contribution to the verification objective and refines only the most critical timesteps in temporal order. Experiments on CIFAR10 and MNIST stroke benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements in verification success and robustness-margin tightness over abstraction-only baselines, while exposing clear runtime trade-offs between ReLU and tanh models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一个针对循环神经网络（RNN）鲁棒性验证的抽象-精炼框架，通过分割预激活区间消除非线性松弛近似误差，并利用SHAP引导的时间步选择策略控制分支成本。在CIFAR10和MNIST笔画基准上，该方法在验证成功率和鲁棒性边界紧度上优于纯抽象基线，揭示了ReLU与tanh模型之间的运行时权衡。
Motivation: RNN的鲁棒性验证因非线性松弛误差通过循环连接累积而困难，现有线性界传播方法过于保守，尤其在预激活区间跨越零点时无法验证实际鲁棒的输入。
Method: 提出抽象-精炼框架，分割跨越零点的预激活区间使ReLU精确、tanh和sigmoid的线性包络更紧；引入SHAP引导的时间步选择策略，按贡献排序隐藏状态，仅精炼最关键时间步。
Result: 在CIFAR10和MNIST笔画基准上，验证成功率和鲁棒性边界紧度一致优于纯抽象基线，并显示ReLU与tanh模型间明显的运行时权衡。
Conclusion: 通过区间分割和SHAP引导的精炼有效提升了RNN鲁棒性验证的紧度，但存在时间步选择带来的运行时权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Masked Neural Detection for Constrained Channel Coding in Molecular Communication
papers.abstract_en: Molecular communication (MC) suffers from severe diffusion memory because molecules released for one symbol may arrive during later symbols. Neural sequence detectors, especially sliding bidirectional recurrent neural networks (SBRNNs), can substantially outperform threshold detectors in such channels. This raises a central question for MC channel coding: does a code whose advantage was established under threshold detection retain it when both coded and uncoded transmission are evaluated with neural detection? This letter answers this question for run-length-limited ISI-mitigation (RLIM) codes, a class of constrained codes previously shown to provide large BER gains in MC. Across the tested operating points, the best RLIM-SBRNN receiver beats the best uncoded receiver, chosen between threshold and SBRNN detection, in $46$ of $59$ cases, with a mean gain of $10.36\times$ over those wins. We also propose an RLIM-tailored training mask for compact SBRNN detectors, improving the unmasked RLIM-SBRNN in $227$ of $236$ comparisons with $3.267\times$ mean gain when masking is beneficial. Finally, the compact masked RLIM-SBRNN is competitive with channel-state-aware MLSE despite using no channel knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分子通信中约束信道编码的神经网络检测。实验表明，在大多数情况下，RLIM码结合SBRNN检测器优于最佳无编码接收器，平均增益10.36倍。还提出针对RLIM的掩码训练方法，进一步提升了性能。
Motivation: 分子通信受扩散记忆影响严重，神经序列检测器可显著优于阈值检测器。但此前RLIM码的优势仅在阈值检测下验证，本文需评估在神经检测下是否保持。
Method: 采用滑动双向循环神经网络（SBRNN）作为检测器，并提出针对RLIM码的定制化训练掩码，以压缩模型大小。
Result: 在59个测试点中，46个点RLIM-SBRNN优于最佳无编码接收器，平均增益10.36倍；掩码方法在236个比较中227个有改进，平均增益3.267倍。紧凑掩码SBRNN与无需信道知识的MLSE竞争。
Conclusion: 说明RLIM码在神经检测下仍具优势，且提出的掩码训练可提升紧凑检测器性能。适用于分子通信的非线性ISI信道。

summary_sections.result: 在59个测试点中，46个点RLIM-SBRNN优于最佳无编码接收器，平均增益10.36倍；掩码方法在236个比较中227个有改进，平均增益3.267倍。紧凑掩码SBRNN与无需信道知识的MLSE竞争。
summary_sections.conclusion: 说明RLIM码在神经检测下仍具优势，且提出的掩码训练可提升紧凑检测器性能。适用于分子通信的非线性ISI信道。

papers.title: A Stationary (and Therefore Compatible) Representation is All You Need
papers.abstract_en: Learning compatible representations aims to learn feature representations that can be used interchangeably over time whenever a model undergoes updates. In this paper, we demonstrate that stationary representations learned by d-Simplex fixed classifiers imply compatibility as in its formal definition. This result establishes a foundation for future works and can be directly exploited in practical learning scenarios. We address the challenge of learning compatibility using $d$-Simplex fixed classifiers when the model is sequentially fine-tuned. Learning according to a d-Simplex fixed classifier with the cross-entropy loss aligns feature distributions at the first-order statistics. Consequently, it may not fully capture higher-order dependencies in the representation between model updates. To address this issue, we demonstrate that training the model using a $d$-Simplex fixed classifier through a convex combination of the cross-entropy loss and a contrastive loss not only captures higher-order dependencies, but is also equivalent to learning with the cross-entropy under the compatibility constraints. We confirm our findings with extensive experiments also considering a new scenario where a pre-trained model is sequentially fine-tuned and occasionally replaced with an improved model. We show that stationary representations enable uninterrupted retrieval services (without reprocessing gallery images) while improving performance during model updates and replacements, achieving state-of-the-art. Code at https://github.com/miccunifi/iamcl2r.
papers.comment: Accepted to TPAMI2026. Extension of the CVPR2024 version (arXiv:2405.02581)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，使用d-Simplex固定分类器学习得到的平稳表示（stationary representations）在形式定义上蕴含兼容性（compatibility）。针对模型顺序微调时学习兼容性的挑战，提出交叉熵损失与对比损失的凸组合，不仅捕获高阶依赖，且等价于兼容性约束下的交叉熵学习。实验表明该方法在模型更新和替换时实现无中断检索服务，性能达到最优。
Motivation: 兼容表示学习旨在使模型更新后特征表示可互换，但现有方法难以在顺序微调中保持兼容性，且d-Simplex固定分类器仅对齐一阶统计量，未充分捕获高阶依赖。
Method: 在d-Simplex固定分类器基础上，采用交叉熵损失与对比损失的凸组合进行训练，证明该方法等价于兼容性约束下的交叉熵学习。
Result: 实验证明平稳表示支持无中断检索服务（无需重新处理图库图像），在模型更新和替换中性能提升，达到最优。
Conclusion: 平稳表示（通过d-Simplex固定分类器和凸组合损失训练）为实现兼容表示提供了理论基础和实用方法，未来可应用于持续学习场景。

papers.title: DynamicPTQ: Mitigating Activation Quantization Collapse via Residual-Stream Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is essential for efficient large language model inference, but reliably quantizing activations remains challenging when weights, activations, and KV caches are all quantized to 4-bit precision. A key difficulty lies in massive activations, whose extreme values dominate the activation range and amplify quantization errors. State-of-the-art methods mainly mitigate massive activations through transformation-based smoothing, such as orthogonal rotations and affine scaling, but overlook the cross-layer dynamics of the residual stream. In this paper, we show that massive activations emerge and disappear in a phase-wise pattern across network depth, triggering large residual changes. These changes cause newly injected layer-wise updates to dominate the 4-bit quantization scale and weaken historical residual information. To characterize this behavior, we introduce Jump Ratio and Historical Feature SNR. This suggests that static transformation-based smoothing cannot fully resolve dynamic quantization instability caused by cross-layer residual changes. Based on this analysis, we propose DynamicPTQ, a Dynamic Post-Training Quantization policy for phase-aware mixed-precision activation quantization. DynamicPTQ identifies quantization-sensitive layers from residual-stream dynamics and assigns 8-bit activation precision only to these layers, while keeping weights, KV caches, and other activations in 4-bit precision. It can be directly integrated with strong PTQ baselines such as QuaRot, SpinQuant, and FlatQuant. Experiments on LLaMA-2 and LLaMA-3 show that DynamicPTQ consistently improves perplexity and zero-shot QA performance under W4A4KV4 quantization, while achieving 1.05 to 1.07 times throughput improvement with modest memory overhead. These results demonstrate a practical path toward robust low-bit LLM inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型后训练量化（PTQ）中激活量化塌陷问题，提出DynamicPTQ方法。研究发现残差流中巨幅激活会出现相位模式，导致静态变换平滑无法解决动态量化不稳定性。DynamicPTQ通过识别量化敏感层，仅对这些层使用8位激活精度，其余保持4位，与QuaRot等基线兼容。在LLaMA-2/3上，W4A4KV4量化下困惑度和零样本QA性能提升，吞吐量提升1.05-1.07倍。
Motivation: 现有PTQ方法通过变换平滑缓解巨幅激活，但忽略了残差流的跨层动态，导致4位激活量化时历史残差信息被压制。
Method: 提出DynamicPTQ，利用Jump Ratio和历史特征SNR刻画残差流动态，自动识别量化敏感层并分配8位激活精度，其余部分保持4位。
Result: 在LLaMA-2和LLaMA-3上，W4A4KV4量化下困惑度和零样本QA性能一致提升，同时实现1.05-1.07倍吞吐量提升，内存开销适度。
Conclusion: DynamicPTQ提供了一种鲁棒的低比特LLM推理路径，可集成现有强PTQ基线，验证了残差流动态感知的必要性。

papers.title: An Empirical Study on Predictive Maintenance for Component X in Heavy-Duty Scania Trucks
papers.abstract_en: Condition-based Predictive Maintenance (PdM) for truck fleets has gained momentum in recent years. This maintenance strategy aims to minimize unplanned downtimes and reduce costs by monitoring the health status of vehicles and taking proactive action based on their condition. However, the implementation of condition-based PdM systems is challenging due to the large volume of data generated by the trucks, the inherent complexity of detecting failures through sensor data and the difficulties in finding cost-effective trade-offs in the solution's implementation. In this paper, we define and validate a condition-based PdM methodology built on the assumption that the wear-and-tear state of the monitored component can be represented as a monotonically non-decreasing time series. It involves selecting only the most recent observations from the time series and transforming them into a tabular format for classification using machine learning (ML) models designed for tabular data. Our results indicate that the proposed methodology reduces costs on the Scania Component X dataset compared to current state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches, while also simplifying the modeling process through AutoML.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对重型卡车组件X的预测性维护（PdM）问题，提出一种基于状态监测的方法，假设磨损状态可用单调非减时间序列表示。通过选择最近观测并转换为表格格式，使用适用于表格数据的机器学习模型进行分类，并利用AutoML简化建模过程。在Scania Component X数据集上，该方法相比现有最先进方法降低了成本。
Motivation: 卡车车队的状态基预测性维护面临数据量大、故障检测复杂以及实现成本权衡困难等挑战，现有方法难以兼顾效果与简单性。
Method: 定义并验证一种状态基PdM方法，核心假设是监控组件的磨损状态为单调非减时间序列。仅选取时间序列中最近观测值，转换为表格格式，使用为表格数据设计的机器学习模型进行分类，并通过AutoML简化建模流程。
Result: 在Scania Component X数据集上，所提方法相比当前最先进方法降低了成本，同时简化了建模过程。
Conclusion: 该方法在成本效益和建模简易性上具有优势，但仍需在更多组件和场景下验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Speculative Rollback Correction for Quality-Diverse Web Agent Imitation
papers.abstract_en: Training interactive web agents through imitation learning from expert trajectories has emerged as a highly effective approach. However, determining the optimal timing for expert intervention presents a critical challenge in this context. Delayed intervention often leads to the accumulation of early-stage errors, pushing the page state into an irrecoverable regime. Conversely, premature or excessive intervention causes the agent to become overly reliant on expert policies, trapping the model in local optima characterized by a single, rigid trajectory. We propose Speculative Rollback Correction (SRC), a branch-level imitation framework for resettable agent environments. Instead of requesting teacher labels at every visited state or correcting only after a completed trajectory, SRC uses fixed-horizon branch review: the student executes a short speculative segment before teacher review, and the teacher localizes the first harmful deviation only when local progress breaks. Rollback preserves useful prefixes, while successful rollouts are filtered by a hard verifier and retained in a lightweight quality-diversity archive. The resulting data supports next-action supervised fine-tuning on both localized corrections and verifier-passing trajectories. On WebArena-Infinity, SRC collects 977 verifier-passing trajectories and 9,183 next-action examples; fixed-horizon review improves the recovery-versus-query tradeoff over step-level review while retaining verifier-passing solution variants. Code is available at https://github.com/LongkunHao/SRC_gui_agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出 Speculative Rollback Correction (SRC)，一种用于可重置环境的智能体模仿学习框架，通过固定水平分支审查机制，在 WebArena-Infinity 上收集了977条验证通过的轨迹和9183个下一个动作示例，改善了恢复与查询的权衡。
Motivation: 在交互式网络智能体的模仿学习中，专家干预的时机至关重要：延迟干预导致早期错误累积，过度干预导致智能体过度依赖专家策略而陷入局部最优。
Method: 提出 SRC 框架，学生先执行短推测片段，然后由教师审查；仅在局部进展受阻时，教师定位首次有害偏离并回滚到该点之前的有效前缀；成功的轨迹经过硬验证器过滤后存入轻量级质量多样性档案，用于下一动作监督微调。
Result: 在 WebArena-Infinity 上，SRC 收集了977条验证通过的轨迹和9183个下一个动作示例；固定水平审查在保持验证通过解多样性的同时，改善了恢复与查询的权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SRC 通过分支级回滚和多样性档案有效解决了模仿学习中的干预时机问题。

papers.title: Scalable anomaly detection via a univariate Christoffel function
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection plays a critical role in identifying unusual patterns across domains such as fraud detection, network intrusion, and system fault diagnosis. Recently, Christoffel function-based methods, rooted in polynomial optimization, have emerged as promising alternatives to deep learning due to their strong mathematical foundations and computational frugality. However, their practical applicability is hindered by the need to invert a matrix whose size grows exponentially with the data dimension, rendering the method intractable even for moderate-dimensional datasets. This paper addresses the dimensionality limitations of Christoffel function-based anomaly detection while preserving its key theoretical properties, i.e., the on-off support dichotomy behavior and the accurate support shape capture. We introduce UCF, a univariate Christoffel function which is based on the squared distance between the query point and the support points. Extensive experiments on the ADBench benchmark demonstrate that UCF consistently outperforms 14 state-of-the-art baselines in terms of Average Precision. By resolving the scalability bottleneck of the Christoffel Function, this work expands the toolkit of anomaly detection methods with a robust, theoretically grounded, and universally applicable approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于单变量Christoffel函数（UCF）的可扩展异常检测方法，解决了传统Christoffel函数方法因矩阵求逆随维度指数增长而难以应用于中高维数据的问题。UCF利用查询点与支持点之间的平方距离，保持原方法的关键理论性质（开-关支持二分性和准确的支撑形状捕捉）。在ADBench基准上，UCF在平均精度（Average Precision）上持续优于14个最先进的基线方法。
Motivation: 传统Christoffel函数异常检测方法因需要求逆一个随数据维度指数增长的矩阵，导致即使中等维度数据集也无法应用，限制了其实用性。本文旨在解决这一维度限制，同时保留其核心理论性质。
Method: 引入单变量Christoffel函数（UCF），基于查询点与支持点之间的平方距离构建，避免了高维矩阵求逆，从而实现可扩展的异常检测。
Result: 在ADBench基准上的大量实验表明，UCF在平均精度指标上持续优于14个最先进的基线方法。
Conclusion: UCF通过解决Christoffel函数的可扩展性瓶颈，为异常检测工具箱增加了一种鲁棒、有理论依据且普遍适用的方法。

papers.title: Representing Time Series as Structured Programs for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning and instruction-following capabilities, making them potentially powerful tools for time-series analysis. However, time series lie outside their native textual modality, raising a fundamental question: how should time series be represented so that LLMs can reason about them effectively? Existing work typically serializes raw numerical sequences or fine-tunes pre-trained LLMs on time-series data. These approaches place the burden of extracting temporal structure directly on the LLM, creating a modality mismatch that often degrades performance on long sequences and introduces substantial computational overhead. In this work, we introduce Time-Series-to-Structured-Program representation (T2SP), a deterministic, training-free method that represents a time series as a structured symbolic program. T2SP decomposes time series into trends, periods, and salient events, expressing them in a program-friendly format aligned with the textual and code-like modalities on which LLMs are natively trained. By shifting temporal-structure extraction from the model to the representation itself, T2SP enables off-the-shelf LLMs to leverage their existing reasoning capabilities for time-series understanding. We evaluate T2SP on three reasoning tasks -- editing, captioning, and question answering -- where it consistently improves performance, reduces reasoning time, and lowers failure rates compared with raw-string representations. Our results demonstrate that T2SP provides an effective interface between time series and LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出时间序列到结构化程序表示（T2SP），一种确定性的、无需训练的方法，将时间序列分解为趋势、周期和显著事件，并以结构化符号程序的形式表示，使得预训练的大语言模型（LLM）无需微调即可进行推理。在编辑、描述和问答三个推理任务上，相比原始字符串表示，T2SP一致提升了性能，减少了推理时间和失败率。
Motivation: 现有方法通常将原始数值序列序列化或微调LLM，导致模态不匹配，长序列性能下降且计算开销大。
Method: T2SP是一种确定性的、无需训练的方法，通过将时间序列分解为趋势、周期和显著事件，并以程序友好的格式表示，与LLM原本训练所基于的文本和代码模态对齐。
Result: 在编辑、描述和问答三个推理任务上，T2SP相比原始字符串表示一致提升了性能，减少了推理时间和失败率。
Conclusion: T2SP为时间序列和LLM之间提供了有效接口，使得现成的LLM能够利用其现有推理能力进行时间序列理解。

papers.title: ReCal: Reward Calibration for RL-based LLM Routing
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) routing has emerged as an effective paradigm for leveraging the complementary strengths of multiple LLMs through dynamic model and reasoning-strategy selection. Recent reinforcement learning (RL)-based routing methods further improve routing quality by optimizing routing policies from interaction feedback. However, they still struggle to provide informative and comparable learning signals under heterogeneous tasks with varying difficulty. In practice, multiple objectives (e.g., correctness, format behavior) are aggregated into a single scalar reward, leading to ambiguous credit assignment and conflicting optimization signals. Moreover, reward signals exhibit significant variability across instances, where some instances produce higher or more variable rewards, introducing optimization bias that favors trivial samples over informative ones. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{ReCal}, a \textbf{\underline{Re}}ward \textbf{\underline{Cal}}ibration framework for RL-based LLM routing. We first introduce a hierarchical reward decomposition mechanism with component-wise advantage estimation. We further propose a distribution-aware optimization strategy that calibrates optimization variability through variance-aware reweighting and per-dataset normalization. Experiments on seven datasets demonstrate that ReCal consistently improves routing performance, and training stability over baselines. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ReCal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCal，一个用于基于强化学习（RL）的大语言模型（LLM）路由的奖励校准框架。通过分层奖励分解机制和分布感知优化策略，解决了异构任务中奖励信号不可比较、多目标聚合导致冲突以及优化偏差偏向简单样本的问题。实验在七个数据集上表明 ReCal 在路由性能和训练稳定性上持续优于基线。
Motivation: 现有 RL-based 路由方法在异构任务中难以提供信息丰富且可比较的学习信号，多目标聚合为单一标量奖励导致模糊的信用分配和冲突的优化信号，且奖励信号在不同实例间差异大，引入偏向简单样本的优化偏差。
Method: 提出 ReCal 框架，包含两个关键组件：一是分层奖励分解机制，进行组件级别的优势估计（component-wise advantage estimation）；二是分布感知优化策略，通过方差感知重新加权和每数据集归一化来校准优化偏差。
Result: 在七个数据集上的实验表明，ReCal 在路由性能和训练稳定性上均优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调所提出的奖励校准框架有效改善了 RL-based LLM 路由中奖励信号的质量和优化稳定性。

papers.title: Boltzmann Attention: Learnable Ising Couplings for Cooperative Attention
papers.abstract_en: Attention mechanisms are central to modern sequence models, yet standard attention computes relevance primarily through individual query--key similarities. Although softmax normalization introduces competition among positions, a standard attention layer does not explicitly parameterize learnable interactions between attention decisions. This limits its ability to directly model cooperative or antagonistic co-attention structure within the attention mechanism itself. We propose Boltzmann attention, an energy-based generalization in which attention patterns are governed by an interacting Ising model. The method augments the usual data-dependent local fields with learnable pairwise couplings, allowing the model to represent inter-position correlations beyond those captured by softmax or sigmoid attention. Experiments on character-level language modeling and synthetic bracket matching show that Boltzmann attention consistently improves over standard softmax attention within a standard Transformer architecture, with the advantage becoming more pronounced as sequence length increases. A four-way ablation confirms that the improvement arises from the learnable pairwise couplings. These results suggest that explicit inter-position interactions provide a principled enhancement for attention-based sequence modeling. Moreover, the Ising formulation opens a natural path toward quantum-computing-based sampling strategies: we demonstrate that diabatic quantum annealing provides a practical training method while maintaining competitive performance with exact Boltzmann computation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出玻尔兹曼注意力（Boltzmann attention），一种基于能量模型的注意力机制，通过可学习的Ising耦合在注意力决策中引入位置间的相互作用，超越了标准softmax或sigmoid注意力的表达能力。在字符级语言建模和合成括号匹配任务上，该方法在标准Transformer架构中始终优于softmax注意力，且优势随序列长度增加而更明显。消融实验证实改进来源于可学习的成对耦合，同时作者演示了量子退火可作为训练方法。
Motivation: 标准注意力机制仅通过查询-键相似度计算相关性，虽经softmax归一化引入位置间竞争，但未显式参数化注意力决策间的可学习相互作用，限制了建模协同或拮抗共注意力结构的能力。
Method: 提出玻尔兹曼注意力，将注意力模式建模为相互作用Ising模型的平衡分布，在通常的数据相关局域场（data-dependent local fields）基础上添加可学习的成对耦合（pairwise couplings），从而表示位置间相关性。训练时可采用精确玻尔兹曼计算或基于量子退火的采样策略。
Result: 在字符级语言建模和合成括号匹配任务中，玻尔兹曼注意力相比标准softmax注意力持续提升性能，且序列越长优势越明显。四路消融实验证实提升源于可学习的成对耦合。量子退火训练方法在保持竞争力的同时提供实际训练途径。
Conclusion: 显式的位置间相互作用为基于注意力的序列建模提供了有原则的增强，且Ising公式化为基于量子计算的采样策略开辟了自然路径。

papers.title: Quickest Detection of Hallucination Onset: Delay Bounds and Learned CUSUM Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Token-level hallucination detectors are evaluated as classifiers, by AUC over all tokens, yet a streaming monitor is judged by its reaction time: the number of tokens that pass between the onset of a hallucination and the alarm. We formulate hallucination onset detection as a quickest change detection problem. A first-order Markov model of the latent faithful/hallucinated state, validated on RAGTruth, places the task inside classical change-point theory and yields Lorden's lower bound on detection delay: about 1.3 tokens at a false-alarm rate of 0.01. We then show that a causal recurrent labeler acts as a CUSUM with a learned increment; at a matched false-alarm rate it detects in 11-13 tokens, against 31 for a linear per-token baseline, and a controlled decomposition attributes most of this advantage to a better per-token score rather than to temporal accumulation. An information-rate optimality theorem of Donsker-Varadhan type explains the remaining order-of-magnitude gap: the learned score realizes only 1/4.5 of the divergence the features carry, a deficit that recalibration cannot remove, with the remainder a finite-horizon effect. Classification metrics conceal this delay structure; sequential analysis makes it measurable
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将幻觉起始检测建模为快速变化检测问题，使用一阶马尔可夫模型描述潜在忠实/幻觉状态，并在RAGTruth上验证。Lorden下界显示在误报率0.01时最小延迟约1.3个token。因果循环标注器作为CUSUM算法，在匹配误报率下实现11-13个token的检测延迟，优于线性基准的31个token。优势主要来自逐token得分的改进，而非时间累积。Donsker-Varadhan型最优性定理表明学习得分仅实现特征携带散度的1/4.5，剩余差距源于有限时域效应，且无法通过重校准消除。
Motivation: 现有token级幻觉检测器以AUC评估分类性能，但流式监测更关注反应时间（从幻觉起始到告警的token数）。本文旨在将幻觉起始检测形式化为快速变化检测问题，以量化延迟界限并理解现有方法的差距。
Method: 提出基于一阶马尔可夫链的潜在状态模型，将任务纳入经典变化点理论，推导Lorden下界。采用因果循环标注器作为CUSUM统计量的学习增量，实现顺序检测。
Result: 在RAGTruth上，误报率0.01时Lorden下界约1.3个token；CUSUM检测延迟11-13个token，线性per-token基线为31个token。分解表明优势主要源于更好的逐token得分，而非时间累积。
Conclusion: 分类指标（如AUC）掩盖了检测的延迟结构，而顺序分析使其可量化。存在理论上的数量级差距：学习得分仅利用特征中1/4.5的散度，且无法通过重校准弥补，剩余为有限时域效应。

papers.title: SAIGuard: Communication-State Simulation for Proactive Defense of LLM Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) solve complex tasks through inter-agent collaboration, but their communication-driven nature also allows security risks to spread across agents and trigger system-wide failures. Existing MAS defenses mainly follow a reactive paradigm after execution by detecting and isolating harmful agents, which may cause irreversible damage and degrade collaborative utility. To address this, we propose a proactive defense framework for MAS security, namely a Simulation-aware Interception Guard (SAIGuard). SAIGuard performs communication-state simulation over the MAS interaction graph, estimates the impact of incoming messages on local agent states and the global MAS state, and detects risky messages via reconstruction deviations from benign communication patterns. Instead of isolating agents, SAIGuard sanitizes or regenerates suspicious messages before it propagation into system. Experiments across diverse topologies and attack scenarios show that SAIGuard reduces attack success rates while maintaining MAS utility, outperforming reactive defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）的安全问题，提出主动防御框架SAIGuard。SAIGuard通过对MAS交互图进行通信状态模拟，估计传入消息对局部和全局状态的影响，并利用与良性通信模式的重构偏差检测风险消息，在消息传播前对其进行消毒或重新生成。实验表明，SAIGuard在多种拓扑和攻击场景下降低了攻击成功率，同时保持了MAS的协作效用，优于现有反应式防御方法。
Motivation: 现有MAS防御主要采用事后反应式范式，即检测和隔离有害智能体，但这种方式可能已在系统内造成不可逆损害，并降低协作效用。因此需要一种能够在攻击传播前进行干预的主动防御机制。
Method: 提出SAIGuard框架，包含通信状态模拟模块，该模块基于MAS的交互图，通过模拟计算传入消息对智能体局部状态和全局MAS状态的影响；同时构建良性通信模式的重建模型，通过计算重建偏差来识别风险消息；对于检测到的可疑消息，采用消毒或重新生成的方式处理，而非直接隔离智能体。
Result: 在多种MAS拓扑结构和攻击场景下的实验显示，SAIGuard显著降低了攻击成功率，同时保持了MAS的协作效用，其性能优于基于检测和隔离的反应式防御基线。
Conclusion: SAIGuard是首个面向LLM多智能体系统的主动防御框架，通过通信状态模拟实现攻击前的风险干预，平衡了安全性与系统效用。

papers.title: Stereo Vision-Based Fall Prediction and Detection using Human Pose Estimation on the AMD Kria K26 SOM
papers.abstract_en: Background and Objective: Falls among elderly people can cause serious injury and reduce quality of life. Timely prediction and detection are essential to prevent harm and support well-being. We propose a portable, low-power, battery-operated, vision-based fall prediction and detection system using HPE on an AMD Kria K26 System-on-Module (SOM). The objective is a non-intrusive, privacy-preserving system for real-time fall detection. Methods: The system uses an Intel RealSense D455 range-sensing camera connected to the K26 SOM by USB. It captures synchronized RGB and depth frames, 640 x 480 x 3 and 640 x 480 pixels, at 60 FPS. The SOM runs a three-stage pipeline with quantized YOLOX, Anchor-to-Joint (A2J), and fall-detection models. YOLOX identifies human bounding boxes from RGB frames, then discards the RGB frames to preserve privacy. A2J uses depth frames to estimate 15 joint keypoints per person. A CNN uses selected joint coordinates (x, y, z) to classify fall activity. YOLOX was trained on CrowdHuman; A2J on ITOP, MP-3DHP, UR Fall Detection, and a custom SDSU PSG dataset; and the CNN on UR Fall Detection and SDSU PSG. The design used a single-core DPU with a serial pipeline and a dual-core DPU running YOLOX and A2J with multiple threads. Results: Quantized accuracy was evaluated using IoU >= 50% for YOLOX, mAP with a 10-cm rule for A2J, and classification accuracy, (TP + TN)/(TP + TN + FP + FN), for the CNN. Accuracies were 74%, 84.13%, and 75.85%. Throughput improved from 2.5 FPS for the single-threaded pipeline to 4.5 FPS for the multi-threaded version. Conclusion: Results demonstrate the feasibility of privacy-preserving fall detection on an AMD Kria K26 edge device. On-device HPE and fall classification runs without cloud dependency, supporting elderly monitoring and assistive healthcare. Future work will improve model accuracy and speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于立体视觉和人体姿态估计的跌倒预测与检测系统，运行在 AMD Kria K26 SOM 上。系统使用 Intel RealSense D455 摄像头，通过量化 YOLOX、A2J 和 CNN 的三阶段流水线，在边缘设备上实现隐私保护的跌倒检测。实验显示量化模型在 YOLOX（IoU≥50%）上准确率 74%，A2J（10cm mAP）84.13%，CNN 分类准确率 75.85%，多线程流水线帧率 4.5 FPS。
Motivation: 老年人跌倒可能导致严重伤害，现有的跌倒检测系统往往缺乏隐私保护或依赖云端，本文旨在开发一种便携、低功耗、电池供电且隐私保护的实时跌倒预测与检测系统。
Method: 系统采用 Intel RealSense D455 相机捕获同步 RGB 和深度帧，在 Kria K26 SOM 上运行三阶段流水线：量化 YOLOX 从 RGB 帧检测人体边界框，随后丢弃 RGB 帧以保护隐私；A2J 从深度帧估计 15 个关节关键点；CNN 基于选定的关节坐标分类跌倒活动。训练数据集包括 CrowdHuman、ITOP、MP-3DHP、UR Fall Detection 和 SDSU PSG。

Conclusion: 结果证明了在 AMD Kria K26 边缘设备上实现隐私保护跌倒检测的可行性，无需依赖云端，适用于老年人监护和辅助医疗。未来工作将改进模型精度和速度。

papers.title: When to Align, When to Predict: A Phase Diagram for Multimodal Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cross-modal alignment (CA) and cross-modal prediction (CP) are the dominant paradigms for multimodal representation learning, yet there is no systematic understanding of when each succeeds, when each fails, and when cross-modal training helps at all -- a gap that leaves practitioners, especially in scientific domains like biomedicine or astrophysics, with heterogeneous instruments and multiple levels of organization and measurement, unable to diagnose why standard methods underperform the best single modality. We develop a unified linear framework that addresses both questions. Under a spiked signal-plus-noise model with structured cross-modal nuisance correlation, we derive separation ratios for both objectives that expose complementary failure modes: alignment whitens each modality and fails when nuisance is strongly correlated across views; prediction encodes whatever is cross-predictable through a one-sided whitening, with recovery governed by source-modality quality. The resulting phase diagram partitions multimodal problems into four regimes: Both, CA only, CP only, and Neither. We present a data-driven procedure to locate real-world datasets in this diagram using a small labeled subsample, identifying the preferred objective and prediction direction before any cross-modal training. Experiments on synthetic data, stereo-vision benchmarks, image-caption pairs, and real astrophysical data validate the predictions in the nonlinear regime, including the Neither regime where cross-modal training is actively harmful. Our framework lets practitioners diagnose their multimodal problem and choose the right objective before committing to training. Code to reproduce the results is available at https://github.com/IlayMalinyak/mm_align_vs_pred.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态表示学习中跨模态对齐（CA）与跨模态预测（CP）两种范式的适用条件缺乏系统理解的问题，提出了一个统一的线性框架。在尖峰信号加噪声模型下，推导出两种目标的分离比，揭示了互补的失败模式，并构建了一个将多模态问题划分为四个区域的相图（Both、仅CA、仅CP、Neither）。通过少量标记数据即可定位实际数据集在该相图中的位置，从而在训练前选择最优目标和预测方向。实验在合成数据、立体视觉基准、图像-字幕对和真实天体物理数据上验证了非线性情况下的预测，包括跨模态训练有害的Neither区域。
Motivation: 目前缺乏对跨模态对齐与预测何时有效、何时失败以及跨模态训练何时完全无益的系统理解，导致在科学领域（如生物医学、天体物理）中，面对异构仪器和多层次测量数据时，无法诊断标准方法为何不如最佳单模态表现。
Method: 提出一个统一的线性框架，基于尖峰信号加噪声模型和结构化的跨模态伪相关，推导了对齐和预测的分离比，揭示对齐会白化每个模态并在伪相关强时失败，预测则通过单向白化编码可跨模态预测的信息。由此构建四区域相图，并设计一个数据驱动流程，利用少量标记样本将真实数据集定位到相图中。
Result: 在合成数据、立体视觉基准、图像-字幕对和真实天体物理数据上验证了非线性情况下的预测，包括Neither区域中跨模态训练有害的现象。
Conclusion: 该框架使从业者能够诊断多模态问题并在训练前选择正确的目标，避免盲目训练。

papers.title: One Step Closer to Ground Truth: A Multi-Scale Residual-Aware Representation Learning Pipeline for Predicting Time Series Data
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based models have emerged as leading paradigms in time-series forecasting in recent years, employing self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range dependencies. Despite their success, these single-stage forecasting architectures exhibit persistent systematic residual biases arising from structural discrepancies, unmodeled stochastic components, or inadequate multi-scale temporal representations. This limitation persists when residuals are treated as irreducible noise, precluding adaptive correction of structured error patterns. To address this limitation, we introduce a two-stage, model-agnostic framework that explicitly decouples forecasting and residual learning into distinct stages of representation learning. A base transformer first generates the initial predictions. Subsequently, a dedicated meta-corrector dynamically models structured error patterns across multivariate channels, preserves cross-variable dependencies, and iteratively refines the residual bias of the base transformer. By formalizing this pipeline as a hypothesis space expansion, our framework addresses approximation limitations inherent in single-stage architectures, removes reliance on restrictive assumptions, and enables end-to-end learning of complex error dynamics. Evaluated on eight popular benchmark datasets using established protocols, our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance, with significant improvements in standard metrics (MSE, MAE). The results demonstrate the framework's ability to mitigate systematic biases and enhance robustness to complex temporal dynamics, advancing the practical applicability of transformer-based forecasting models.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.2 (KDD '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段的、模型无关的时间序列预测框架，将预测与残差学习解耦：基础Transformer先生成初始预测，然后一个元校正器动态建模多变量通道的结构化误差模式，迭代修正残差。在8个基准数据集上取得SOTA，显著提升MSE和MAE。
Motivation: 现有单阶段Transformer预测模型存在系统性残差偏差，源于结构差异、未建模随机成分或不足的多尺度时间表征，这些残差被当作不可约噪声，无法自适应修正。
Method: 提出两阶段管道：阶段一使用基础Transformer生成初始预测；阶段二使用专用元校正器（meta-corrector）对多变量通道上的结构化误差模式建模，保持跨变量依赖，并迭代修正基础Transformer的残差偏差。该框架被视为假设空间扩展，实现端到端学习复杂误差动力学。
Result: 在8个流行基准数据集上，使用标准协议评估，达到SOTA性能，MSE和MAE有显著改进。
Conclusion: 框架能够减轻系统偏差，增强对复杂时间动态的鲁棒性，推进基于Transformer的预测模型的实际应用。
Relevance: 60

papers.title: A Unifying Lens on Reward Uncertainty in RLHF
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is bottlenecked by reward hacking, where the policy exploits errors in a proxy reward model (RM) and produces high RM scores without genuine quality gains. A natural mitigation is pessimism: lowering rewards in regions where the RM is uncertain. However, standard scalar RMs provide no principled notion of uncertainty. We argue that the right object is a distributional reward model $p(r\mid x,y)$. Under either a Bayesian inference or a KL-distributionally robust optimization (KL-DRO) lens, the KL-regularized RLHF objective admits a closed-form effective reward $\tilde r(x,y) = \pmβ\log\mathbb{E}_p[e^{\pm r/β}]$. The pessimistic branch unifies the prior heuristics for RM ensemble aggregation: mean aggregation, worst-case optimization (WCO), and uncertainty-weighted optimization (UWO) all emerge as limits or truncations of this single expression. This also clarifies the implicit assumptions of each existing rule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从贝叶斯推断和KL分布鲁棒优化（KL-DRO）两个视角统一了RLHF中奖励不确定性处理的理论框架。作者推导出KL正则化RLHF目标的闭式有效奖励形式，并证明现有奖励模型集成聚合方法（均值聚合、最坏情况优化、不确定性加权优化）均是该表达式的极限或截断情况。该工作澄清了各启发式方法的隐含假设，但未在具体实验中进行验证。
Motivation: RLHF面临奖励破解问题，标准标量奖励模型缺乏不确定性概念，而现有基于悲观主义的缓解方法（如降低不确定区域的奖励）缺乏统一的理论基础。
Method: 引入分布性奖励模型 p(r|x,y)，分别从贝叶斯推断和KL-DRO视角导出KL正则化RLHF目标的闭式有效奖励表达式，并分析其与现有RM集成聚合方法（均值聚合、WCO、UWO）的关系。
Result: 推导出有效奖励 \(\tilde r(x,y) = \pm \beta \log \mathbb{E}_p[e^{\pm r/\beta}]\)，并证明均值聚合、最坏情况优化和不确定性加权优化均是该表达式的极限或截断形式。
Conclusion: 该统一视角揭示了现有启发式方法的隐含假设，但摘要未涉及具体实验效果或局限性。

papers.title: Spatially Grounded Concept Bottleneck Models via Part-Factorized Attention
papers.abstract_en: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) predict a layer of human-named attributes before predicting a class, which makes their decisions auditable. On fine-grained recognition tasks the concept heads are usually free to attend anywhere in the image, so a head named for one body region can be satisfied by evidence on another. This work studies a part-factorized CBM that removes that freedom by construction. The method has three components built on a frozen DINOv3 vision transformer. A learned foreground gate, trained on DINOv3 patch features, suppresses background patches inside the part attention. A set of part queries cross-attends to patch features and each of the 312 CUB attributes is routed, through a fixed concept-to-part map, to read only from the part token its name implies. A learnable two-dimensional Gaussian prior, injected additively in log space into the attention logits, breaks the permutation symmetry among part queries; its means are initialized from the dataset-average keypoint location of each part, which requires no per-image keypoint supervision at training or test time. On CUB-200-2011 the spatial-prior model matches a fully supervised baseline (88.85% versus 88.95% top-1) while raising pointing accuracy by 16 points (52.6% versus 36.4%). Replacing bounding-box supervision with a PCA foreground target and combining it with the Gaussian prior removes all per-image supervision and reaches 88.6% top-1 at about 70% pointing accuracy. A keypoint-fraction sweep shows that 0.5% of the training set (about 27 images) suffices to initialize the prior with no measurable loss. Removing part identity entirely is the harder case: without any spatial prior, pointing accuracy collapses to $2.9\%$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出空间接地概念瓶颈模型（Spatially Grounded CBM），通过部分因子化注意力强制每个概念头只关注其命名身体区域。方法基于冻结的DINOv3视觉Transformer，包括前景门控、部分查询交叉注意力和可学习的二维高斯先验。在CUB-200-2011上，该方法匹配全监督基线（88.85% vs 88.95% top-1），且指向精度提升16个百分点（52.6% vs 36.4%）。无需逐图像关键点监督，仅需少量图像（约27张）即可初始化高斯先验。
Motivation: 传统概念瓶颈模型在细粒度识别中，概念头可自由关注图像任何区域，导致命名身体区域的概念可能被其他区域的证据满足，降低了可审计性。
Method: 提出部分因子化CBM，基于冻结DINOv3 ViT，包括：1) 学习的前景门控抑制背景块；2) 部分查询交叉注意力，并通过固定概念到部分映射将312个CUB属性路由到对应部分令牌；3) 可学习的二维高斯先验，以加法形式注入注意力logits，打破部分查询的排列对称性，其均值从数据集平均关键点位置初始化，无需逐图像关键点监督。
Result: 在CUB-200-2011上，空间先验模型匹配全监督基线（88.85% vs 88.95% top-1），指向精度从36.4%提升至52.6%。用PCA前景目标替代边界框监督，结合高斯先验，在无逐图像监督下达到88.6% top-1和约70%指向精度。仅需0.5%训练集（约27张）即可初始化先验而无性能损失。若移除部分身份，指向精度降至2.9%。
Conclusion: 空间接地CBM通过强制空间一致性提升了细粒度识别的可解释性和指向精度，且仅需极少量监督信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Transit Is All You Need: Detecting Exoplanets Through Learned Stellar Behaviour with EXOVEIL
papers.abstract_en: I present EXOVEIL, a transit detection system that learns what a star's brightness should look like and flags when reality disagrees. Unlike existing systems that require phase-folded input, EXOVEIL operates on raw flux time series and can detect planets that transit only once.A Transformer world model, trained on 16,499 Kepler light curves with transit-masked self-supervised learning, predicts expected stellar flux. A matched-filter detector with variance weighting extracts transit signals from the prediction residuals. A learned classifier (XGBoost) separates planets from false positives, achieving AUC 0.938 on Kepler DR25. Applied to single-transit injection-recovery, EXOVEIL recovers 32% of transits at 1000 ppm depth a task where all classification-based systems score 0% by construction. A blind search of 3,737 Kepler stars yields 179 new transit-like signals not present in the DR25 TCE catalogue, including 46 monotransit candidates. Applied withoutretraining to 47 confirmed TESS planets in the PLATO LOPS2 field, EXOVEIL achieves 100% recovery, demonstrating zero-shot cross-mission transfer. At PLATO's 25-second cadence, detection reaches 100 ppm -- approaching the Earth-analog regime. I provide the first application of conformal prediction to transit detection (95.9% empirical coverage) and release the system as pip install exoveil with pretrained weights and a candidate catalogue.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EXOVEIL，一种基于Transformer世界模型和自监督学习的系外行星凌星检测系统，可在原始光变曲线上检测单次凌星事件。在Kepler和TESS数据上展示了性能，并首次将共形预测应用于凌星检测。
Motivation: 现有凌星检测系统依赖相位折叠输入，无法检测仅出现一次的行星凌星信号。本文旨在通过学习恒星亮度行为，直接从原始时序中检测此类罕见事件。
Method: 使用Transformer世界模型（在16499条Kepler光变曲线上通过凌星掩蔽自监督学习训练）预测恒星预期亮度；匹配滤波检测器从残差中提取凌星信号；XGBoost分类器区分行星与假阳性。
Result: 在Kepler DR25上AUC 0.938；单次凌星注入恢复实验中，1000 ppm深度恢复32%凌星（所有分类系统为0%）；盲搜发现179个新凌星信号；对47个已确认TESS行星实现100%零样本跨任务恢复；PLATO 25秒采样下检测限达100 ppm。
Conclusion: EXOVEIL可检测单次凌星并零样本迁移至其他任务，首次将共形预测应用于凌星检测（95.9%经验覆盖），系统已发布为pip install exoveil。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Triangle Splatting SLAM
papers.abstract_en: We present a dense RGB-D SLAM system using differentiable triangles as the 3D map representation. While 3D Gaussian Splatting has emerged as the leading method for novel-view synthesis, triangles remain the standard primitive for traditional rendering hardware, game engines, and downstream tasks requiring explicit geometry such as simulation, collision, and editing. Recent offline methods have demonstrated that an unstructured 'triangle soup' can be optimised into a photorealistic mesh via Delaunay triangulation across a set of posed images. Building upon this insight, we present the first dense SLAM system to employ Triangle Splatting to perform both tracking and mapping through online differentiable rendering of a triangle soup. The map can be converted into a connected mesh on-the-fly via restricted Delaunay triangulation, enabling new online capabilities such as mesh deformation and collision checking. On Replica and TUM-RGBD, our system outperforms baselines on 3D geometry, matches the camera-tracking accuracy, and enables online mesh-based scene editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了第一个使用可微分三角形（triangle soup）作为3D地图表示的密集RGB-D SLAM系统。通过在线可微分渲染进行跟踪和建图，并利用受限Delaunay三角化将地图实时转换为连接网格，支持网格变形和碰撞检测。在Replica和TUM-RGBD数据集上，该方法在3D几何精度上优于现有基线，相机跟踪精度相当，并实现了在线网格场景编辑。
Motivation: 3D高斯泼溅在新型视角合成中表现优异，但三角形仍然是传统渲染硬件、游戏引擎及需要显式几何的下游任务（如仿真、碰撞、编辑）的标准图元。现有离线方法已展示通过Delaunay三角化从有姿态图像优化三角形Soup生成逼真网格的可行性，但缺乏在线SLAM系统。
Method: 使用可微分三角形作为3D地图表示，通过在线可微分渲染同时进行相机跟踪和地图优化，并采用受限Delaunay三角化将三角形Soup实时转换为连接网格。
Result: 在Replica和TUM-RGBD数据集上，该方法在3D几何指标上优于基线，相机跟踪精度与现有方法相当，并支持在线网格变形和碰撞检测。
Conclusion: 这是第一个采用Triangle Splatting的密集SLAM系统，展示了三角形表示在实时建图和跟踪中的潜力，为网格级场景交互开辟了新可能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Learning-based Algebraic Reynolds Stress Closures for RANS Simulations of Turbulent Flows
papers.abstract_en: Turbulence is ubiquitous in engineering and science, yet direct simulation is prohibitively expensive. The Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) equations provide savings exceeding ten orders of magnitude but introduce unclosed terms (the closure problem). Offline-trained machine-learning (ML) closures suffer distribution shift in predictive simulations, while ML methods that bypass the governing equations struggle to generalise from scarce high-fidelity data. We develop a physics-derived deep learning closure model for RANS, the Deep Algebraic Reynolds Stress Model (DARSM), which can be trained on small datasets and accurately generalise across Reynolds numbers, to unseen geometries, and to different flow regimes. A neural network maps flow invariants to empirical parameters in an implicit algebraic Reynolds stress equation, derived from the Reynolds stress transport equations under the weak-equilibrium assumption, imposing physics-based structure on the ML closure. End-to-end optimisation through the governing PDEs and the coupled implicit closure eliminates distribution shift, but both unrolled and implicit automatic differentiation fail on the stiff coupled solver. We derive adjoint equations that exploit the solver's implicit-explicit structure for efficient optimisation. On canonical square-duct and periodic-hill benchmarks, DARSM reduces average test velocity error over baseline RANS by $2$-$4\times$ across Reynolds number, geometries, and flow regimes, with peak case-level reductions of $12\times$. The model trained on attached, anisotropy-dominated flows (square duct) accurately generalises without retraining to separated flows (periodic hills), a regime change in the underlying physics. DARSM also outperforms five established ML methods: offline training, tensor-basis neural networks, field-inversion machine learning, DeepONets, and physics-informed neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于物理推导的深度学习RANS封闭模型——深度代数雷诺应力模型（DARSM），将神经网络映射到隐式代数雷诺应力方程的经验参数，并通过伴随方程实现端到端优化，克服分布偏移问题。在方管和周期山基准上，平均速度误差比基线RANS降低2-4倍，峰值降低12倍，且从附着流到分离流无需重新训练。
Motivation: 传统RANS封闭问题依赖经验模型，离线训练的机器学习封闭模型存在分布偏移，而绕开控制方程的ML方法难以从小数据泛化。需要一种可训练且物理一致的封闭模型。
Method: 推导基于弱平衡假设的隐式代数雷诺应力方程，用神经网络将流动不变量映射为经验参数；通过伴随方程利用求解器的隐式-显式结构实现端到端优化，避免自动微分失效。
Result: 在方管和周期山基准上，平均速度误差较基线RANS降低2-4倍，最优案例降低12倍；模型从附着流迁移到分离流无需重新训练，优于五种现有ML方法。
Conclusion: DARSM通过物理结构约束和端到端优化，实现了在小数据上训练并泛化到不同雷诺数、几何和流态的RANS封闭模型，但未涉及气象或降水相关流动。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ShapeBench: A Scalable Benchmark and Diagnostic Suite for Standardized Evaluation in Aerodynamic Shape Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Rapid progress in aerodynamic shape optimization (ASO) has outpaced currently-available standardized evaluation frameworks. Fair comparison requires a unified benchmark spanning diverse shape classes, objective formulations, and matched-budget state-of-the-art baselines. We introduce ShapeBench, an open-source ASO benchmark with a unified API spanning 103 tasks across eight shape categories and multiple optimization regimes. Each ShapeBench task includes a validated surrogate for fast search; when feasible, a high-fidelity Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) pipeline for final verification is available, enabling systematic fidelity-gap analysis. ShapeBench provides a reproducible protocol with well-configured baselines to compare fairly using a consistent budget metric, allowing for comparison among both classical and LLM-driven methods, including general-purpose optimizers and a new domain-specialized evolutionary LLM baseline, ShapeEvolve. Results on ShapeBench demonstrate substantial variance in optimizer rankings across shape categories and problem formulations, with mean pairwise Spearman $ρ= 0.013$, so single-task conclusions do not reliably generalize across problem classes. The benchmark is also far from saturation; classical methods are rarely applicable across all shape categories and tasks, further highlighting the need for more general-purpose approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ShapeBench，一个开源的气动外形优化（ASO）基准测试套件，包含 103 个任务、8 种形状类别和多种优化设置，并提供验证过的代理模型与高保真 CFD 管道。基准包含经典优化器和 LLM 驱动方法（含新基线 ShapeEvolve）。实验显示优化器排名在不同形状类别间差异极大（平均 Spearman ρ=0.013），表明单任务结论无法推广，且基准远未饱和。
Motivation: 气动外形优化领域缺乏统一、可重复的评估框架，导致不同方法难以公平比较，尤其缺乏跨形状类别和优化目标的标准化基准。
Method: 构建 ShapeBench，提供统一 API 覆盖 103 个任务（8 种形状类别），每个任务包含验证过的代理模型用于快速搜索，及可选的高保真 CFD 管道。引入一致预算度量和配置好的基线，包括经典优化器、通用 LLM 方法和新提出的领域专用进化 LLM 基线 ShapeEvolve。
Result: 基线对比显示优化器排名随形状类别和问题公式剧烈变化（平均 Spearman ρ=0.013），经典方法难以跨所有类别适用，说明当前基准远未饱和，通用方法需求迫切。
Conclusion: ShapeBench 提供了标准化评估平台，揭示了现有优化器缺乏通用性，强调了开发更普适的 ASO 方法的必要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Strategic PAC Learnability via Geometric Definability
papers.abstract_en: Strategic classification studies learning settings in which individuals can modify their features, at a cost, in order to influence the classifier's decision. A central question is how the sample complexity of the induced (strategic) hypothesis class depends on the complexities of the underlying hypothesis class and the cost structure governing feasible manipulations. Prior work has shown that in several natural settings, such as linear classifiers with norm costs, the induced complexity can be controlled. We begin by showing that such guarantees fail in general - even in simple cases: there exist hypothesis classes of VC dimension $1$ on the real line such that, even under the simplest interval neighborhoods, the induced class has infinite VC dimension. Thus, strategic behavior can turn an easy learning problem into a non-learnable one. To overcome this, we introduce structure via a geometric definability assumption: both the hypothesis class and the cost-induced neighborhood relation can be defined by first-order formulas over $\mathbb{R}_{\mathtt{exp}}$. Intuitively, this means that hypotheses and costs can be described using arithmetic operations, exponentiation, logarithms, and comparisons. This captures a broad range of natural classes and cost functions, including $\ell_p$ distances, Wasserstein distance, and information-theoretic divergences. Under this assumption, we prove that learnability is preserved, with sample complexity controlled by the complexity of the defining formulas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究战略分类（strategic classification）中，个体为影响分类器决策而修改特征时的可学习性问题。作者首先证明即使基础假设类的VC维为1，在简单区间邻域下诱导出的战略假设类的VC维可能无限，即战略行为可将易学问题变为不可学。为解决此问题，引入基于几何可定义性（geometric definability）的结构假设：假设类和成本诱导的邻域关系可由一阶公式在实数指数域上定义，涵盖ℓ_p距离、Wasserstein距离等。在此假设下，可学习性得以保持，样本复杂度由定义公式的复杂度控制。
Motivation: 战略分类中个体可以代价修改特征以影响决策，但已有的可学习性保证仅在特定情况下成立。作者发现一般情况下，即使基础类简单（如VC维为1的线性分类器），战略行为也可能导致假设类VC维无限，使学习问题变为不可学。需要引入结构条件来保证战略可学习性。
Method: 引入几何可定义性假设：假设类和成本诱导的邻域关系可由一阶公式在实数指数域（ℝ_exp）上定义，即使用算术运算、指数、对数、比较等描述。这覆盖了ℓ_p距离、Wasserstein距离、信息论散度等自然成本函数。
Result: 在几何可定义性假设下，战略假设类的VC维有限，样本复杂度由定义公式的复杂度控制，即战略可学习性得以保持。
Conclusion: 几何可定义性提供了一种足以恢复战略PAC可学习性的通用结构条件，适用于广泛的假设类和成本函数，突破了此前仅在特例下成立的结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: COSMOS: Model-Agnostic Personalized Federated Learning with Clustered Server Models and Pseudo-Label-Only Communication
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) in heterogeneous environments remains challenging because client models often differ in both architecture and data distribution. While recent approaches attempt to address this challenge through client clustering and knowledge distillation, simultaneously handling architectural and statistical heterogeneity remains difficult. We introduce COSMOS, a model-agnostic framework that enables server-side personalization using only pseudo-label communication. Clients train local models and predict on the public data; the server clusters clients by prediction similarity, trains a cluster-specific model for each group using its own compute, and distills the resulting models back to clients. We provide the first theoretical analysis showing that distillation from the learned cluster models can yield exponential personalization risk contraction, going beyond the convergence-to-stationarity guarantees typically provided in model-agnostic FL. Experiments across benchmarks demonstrate that COSMOS consistently outperforms all model-agnostic FL baselines while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art personalized FL methods. More broadly, our results highlight personalized server-side learning with pseudo-labels as a promising paradigm for scalable and model-agnostic federated learning in highly heterogeneous environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出COSMOS，一个模型无关的个性化联邦学习框架，仅通过伪标签在服务器和客户端之间通信。服务器根据客户端在公共数据上的预测相似性进行聚类，为每个簇训练专属模型，再通过知识蒸馏将模型能力传回客户端。理论分析表明该方法的个性化风险呈指数级收缩，实验在多个基准上超越所有模型无关FL基线，并与最先进的个性化FL方法竞争力相当。
Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端模型架构和数据的双重异质性使得现有方法难以兼顾，亟需一种既能处理架构差异又能应对数据分布偏移的模型无关方案。
Method: 客户端在本地数据上训练模型并对公共数据集生成伪标签；服务器收集所有伪标签后，按预测相似性对客户端聚类，为每一簇独立训练一个服务器端模型，最后通过知识蒸馏（蒸馏）将服务器模型的预测逻辑传回客户端，无需客户端模型架构信息。
Result: 实验表明COSMOS在所有模型无关FL基线上表现最优，且与最先进的个性化FL方法相比不落下风；理论分析证明了该方法的个性化风险能够指数级收敛，超越了传统模型无关FL仅保证收敛到驻点的结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为伪标签驱动的服务器端个性化学习是一种可扩展且模型无关的联邦学习新范式，尤其适合高度异质的环境。
